title: UNIT 001 · 基础建筑材料
body:
Basic building materials include timber, mud, stone, marble, brick, tile, steel, and cement concrete. Masonry walls are built with stones or bricks, cemented together with mortar, originally composed of lime and sand.

The profusion of aluminum products, incorporating anodized coatings, provided cladding materials that are lightweight and virtually maintenance free. Glass was known in prehistory and is renowned for its contribution to Gothic architecture.
translation:
基础建筑材料包括木材、泥土、石材、大理石、砖块、瓷砖、钢材以及水泥混凝土。砖石墙由石块或砖块砌成，并用砂浆粘合在一起；砂浆最初由石灰和沙子调配而成。

大量铝制品的出现——这些铝制品带有阳极氧化涂层——提供了重量轻、几乎免维护的覆层材料。玻璃早在史前时期就已为人所知，并因其对哥特式建筑的贡献而闻名。
insights: 【分词短语拆译】原文：cemented together with mortar, originally composed of lime and sand。直译：用最初由石灰和沙子组成的砂浆粘合在一起。翻译精雕：并用砂浆粘合在一起；砂浆最初由石灰和沙子调配而成。技巧：英文的过去分词链层层后置，中文若全部前置会形成“的的不休”，应拆成独立分句并重复中心词“砂浆”衔接。
【抽象名词具体化】原文：The profusion of aluminum products... provided cladding materials。直译：铝制品的大量提供了覆层材料。翻译精雕：大量铝制品的出现……提供了……覆层材料。技巧：profusion 是抽象名词，译成“大量……的出现”补出隐含动作，使主语成为可感知的事件。
【被动转主动 + 范畴词】原文：Glass was known in prehistory and is renowned for...。翻译精雕：玻璃早在史前时期就已为人所知，并因……而闻名。技巧：was known 译为“为人所知”保留客观色彩；renowned for 统一译“因……而闻名”，比“被称赞”更符合中文书面语。

grammar.title: 第一句：列举型主谓宾
grammar.skeleton: Basic building materials (主语) + include (谓语) + timber, mud, stone, ... and cement concrete (并列宾语).
grammar.notes: include 引导的开放式列举是说明文最常见的分类句；最后一项前用 and，体现英文“A, B, C, and D”的平行格式。

grammar.title: 第二句：被动语态 + 双层分词修饰
grammar.skeleton: Masonry walls (主) + are built with (被动谓语) + stones or bricks, [cemented together with mortar], [originally composed of lime and sand].
grammar.notes: cemented 作伴随状语修饰整个砌墙动作；originally composed of 作后置定语修饰 mortar。注意 be composed of = consist of（由……组成）。

grammar.title: 第三句：现在分词插入语
grammar.skeleton: The profusion (主) + [of aluminum products, incorporating anodized coatings] + provided (谓) + cladding materials (宾) + [that are lightweight...].
grammar.notes: incorporating 现在分词短语补充说明铝制品的特性；that 定语从句修饰 materials；virtually 意为“几乎”，学术写作高频副词。

vocab.root: 来自古英语 timber “建筑物/木料”，与德语 Zimmer (房间) 同源 → 建房用的木料
来自希腊语 marmaros “闪亮的石头” → 大理石
来自拉丁语 tegula，tegere (覆盖) → 用来覆盖的东西 → 瓦/瓷砖
concrete: con- (共同) + crescere (生长) → 长在一起 → 凝固的；混凝土
mason (石匠) + -ry (行业/产物) → 石匠的活计 → 砖石结构
co- (共同) + haerere (粘附) → 粘在一起；派生 coherent (连贯的)
来自拉丁语 mortarium “研钵” → 在研钵中调和的灰浆

vocab.meaning: 大量（a profusion of: 大量的）
vocab.root: pro- (向前) + fus- (倒，pour) + -ion → 向外倾倒 → 大量，丰富
来自拉丁语 alumen “明矾” → 由明矾提炼的金属 → 铝

vocab.meaning: 电镀层，电镀膜［anodize v. 阳极氧化：用电解方式给（金属面）镀上一层保护性或装饰性的氧化物］
vocab.root: anode (阳极：ana- 向上 + hodos 道路) + -ize → 阳极氧化处理

vocab.meaning: 覆层（在高温高压下结合到另一金属上的金属外层）
vocab.root: clad (覆盖，clothe 的古过去分词) + -ing → 覆盖在外的层
celebr- (来自拉丁语 celeber “频繁的/有名的”) + -ate + -ed → 被众人传颂的 → 著名的
Goth (哥特人) + -ic → 哥特式的（中世纪尖拱建筑风格）
archi- (首要的) + tect (建造者) + -ure → 首席建造者的技艺 → 建筑学

vocab.meaning: 著名的，享有盛誉的（be renowned for 因……而著名）
vocab.root: re- (反复) + nown (来自拉丁语 nomen 名字) + -ed → 名字被反复提及 → 有名望的
virtu- (来自拉丁语 virtus “力量/本质”) + -al + -ly → 在本质上 → 几乎/实际上

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述某材料/技术的大量出现带来了某种优势
模板：The profusion of [products/technology], incorporating [feature], provided [benefit] that is [adj.] and virtually [adj.].
例句：The profusion of open-source software, incorporating modular designs, provided development tools that are flexible and virtually cost free.

句型：说明某事物由某些成分构成，并追溯其最初组成
模板：[Object] is built with [materials], [bonded/joined] together with [medium], originally composed of [A] and [B].
例句：Modern smartphones are built with layers of glass and metal, bonded together with adhesive, originally composed of resin and hardener.

🏛️ 托福同义替换：renowned / celebrated

renowned、celebrated、famous、well-known、noted 都表示“著名的”。托福原文中出现 renowned for，题干或选项常改写为 famous for 或 well known for。注意：notorious 也是“出名”，但是指臭名昭著，带贬义。

title: UNIT 002 · 跨越墙体的结构方式
body: Several basic approaches are used for spanning masonry walls, such as post-and-lintel construction, arch, vault, and dome structures.
translation: 人们采用几种基本方法来跨越砖石墙体，例如梁柱结构、拱、拱顶以及穹顶结构。
insights: 【被动句转无主句】原文：Several basic approaches are used for spanning masonry walls。直译：几种基本方法被用于跨越砖石墙。翻译精雕：人们采用几种基本方法来跨越砖石墙体。技巧：补出泛指主语“人们”，把被动转为主动，是英译中处理泛指被动句最稳妥的方法。
【专业术语对译】原文：post-and-lintel, arch, vault, dome。翻译精雕：梁柱结构、拱、拱顶、穹顶。技巧：建筑术语必须使用行业通行译名，arch 与 vault 的区别在于前者为平面拱券、后者为三维延伸的拱顶，不可混译。

grammar.title: 被动语态 + 动名词作介词宾语
grammar.skeleton: Several basic approaches (主) + are used for (被动谓语) + spanning masonry walls (介宾：动名词短语).
grammar.notes: be used for doing 表示“用于做……”，区别于 be used to do（被用来做）和 be used to doing（习惯于做）。

grammar.title: such as 引导举例同位成分
grammar.skeleton: ..., such as [post-and-lintel construction], [arch], [vault], and [dome structures].
grammar.notes: such as 后面接名词性列举，用来具体化前面的抽象名词 approaches；列举项保持名词词性一致（平行结构）。

vocab.root: 来自古英语 spannan “连接/伸展”；名词 span 亦指“时间跨度”(life span)，托福高频
post (立柱) + lintel (过梁，来自拉丁语 limes “边界”) → 立柱承托横梁的结构
来自拉丁语 arcus “弓” → 弓形结构；同源词 arc (弧)
来自拉丁语 volvere (滚动/弯曲) → 弯曲的顶 → 拱顶；另义“撑竿跳/金库”

vocab.meaning: 穹隆（结构）：类似于穹隆（弓形、有拱的）或圆屋顶的结构
vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 domus “房屋” → 教堂的圆顶 → 穹顶
ap- (= ad- 朝向) + proach (来自拉丁语 prope “靠近”) → 靠近问题的方式 → 方法

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：列举解决某问题的几种基本方法
模板：Several basic approaches are used for [doing sth.], such as [method A], [method B], and [method C].
例句：Several basic approaches are used for reducing urban traffic congestion, such as congestion pricing, carpool lanes, and expanded public transit.

🏗️ 结构术语图解：arch / vault / dome
Arch (拱)：二维的弧形结构，把上方荷载转化为侧推力传到两端支座。
Vault (拱顶)：拱沿一个方向延伸形成的连续屋顶，如筒形拱顶 (barrel vault)。
Dome (穹顶)：拱绕中心轴旋转 360° 形成的半球形屋顶，如罗马万神殿。

title: UNIT 003 · 芝加哥学派与摩天大楼
body: The career of the Chicago architect, Louis Sullivan, coincided with the so-called Chicago School of Architects, which was given the challenge to invent the high-rise building, known as a skyscraper. This was facilitated by the introduction of the electric elevator, and the abundance of steel. The building's steel skeleton could be erected and the remaining components quickly attached to complete the project. This was an immense construction advantage for high-rise buildings on busy city streets.
translation: 芝加哥建筑师路易斯·沙利文的职业生涯，恰逢所谓的“芝加哥建筑学派”兴起。当时，该学派肩负着一项历史使命——发明被称为“摩天大楼”的高层建筑。这一进程得益于电梯的引入以及钢材的大量供应。只要将建筑物的钢骨架搭建起来，便能迅速附上其余构件以完成工程。对于在繁忙城市街道上建造高层建筑而言，这是一项巨大的施工优势。
insights: 【增词法与词类转换】原文：the abundance of steel。直译：钢材的丰富。翻译精雕：钢材的大量供应 / 充足储备。技巧：将抽象名词转换为动宾或偏正结构，符合中文工业文体表达习惯。
【被动语态无痕转换】原文：This was facilitated by... 直译：这被……所促进。翻译精雕：这一进程得益于……的引入。技巧：在中文中尽量避免死板的“被”字句，用“得益于”、“在……推动下”进行无痕转换。
【句式重组】原文：...which was given the challenge to invent the high-rise building... 直译：……他们被给予了去发明高层建筑的挑战。翻译精雕：……该学派肩负着一项历史使命——发明高层建筑。技巧：将 was given the challenge 意译为“肩负使命”，并将定语拆成独立的短句。
【指代词显化】原文：This was an immense construction advantage... 直译：这是一个巨大的建筑优势。翻译精雕：对于……而言，这是一项巨大的施工优势。技巧：英文 This 指代上一句的整套施工方式，中文把状语 for high-rise buildings on busy city streets 提前作话题，句子重心更稳。

grammar.title: 第一句：多重定语嵌套
grammar.skeleton: The career (主语) + coincided with (谓语) + the Chicago School (宾语).
grammar.notes: Louis Sullivan 是主语的同位语；coincide with 是高频短语（与……重合）；which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 School；to invent 做后置定语修饰 challenge；known as a skyscraper 是过去分词短语作定语修饰 building。

grammar.title: 第二句：被动语态与指代主语
grammar.skeleton: This (主语) + was facilitated by (被动谓语) + [the introduction... and the abundance...] (介宾结构).
grammar.notes: This 指代上一句“发明摩天大楼”这一整件事。在学术写作中，被动语态比主动语态更显客观，同时能让主语 This 保持句际连贯性。

grammar.title: 第三句：并列句与省略技巧 (Ellipsis)
grammar.skeleton: The building's skeleton could be erected and the components quickly [could be] attached...
grammar.notes: 后半句省略了与前半句相同的情态助动词 could be（只留下过去分词 attached），这是英语为避免重复而常用的省略手法。

grammar.title: 第四句：主系表 + 后置限定
grammar.skeleton: This (主) + was (系) + an immense construction advantage (表) + [for high-rise buildings on busy city streets].
grammar.notes: for 介词短语限定“优势”适用的对象；immense 比 big/great 更正式，是托福写作中替换 huge 的佳选。

vocab.root: archi- (首要的) + tect (来自希腊语 tekton “建造者”) → 首席建造者 → 建筑师
co- (共同) + incide (落入，来自拉丁语 incidere) → 共同落入同一时空 → 巧合/重合
“学派”义项：一群持相同理念的人，如 the Chicago School / a school of thought
sky (天空) + scrape (刮擦) + -er → 刮擦天空的东西 → 摩天大楼
facil- (容易的，来自拉丁语 facilis) + -ate (动词后缀) → 使变得容易 → 促进
elevate (e- 向上 + levare 举起) + -or → 向上举起的装置 → 电梯
ab- (离开) + und- (波浪，来自拉丁语 unda) + -ance (名词后缀) → 波浪溢出 → 充裕/丰富
来自希腊语 skeletos “干枯的” → 干枯的骨架 → 骨骼/框架
e- (向上) + rect (直的，来自拉丁语 regere) → 使直立 → 竖立/建造
com- (共同) + pon- (放置) + -ent → 放到一起的东西 → 组成部分
im- (不) + mense (测量，来自拉丁语 metiri) → 无法测量的 → 巨大的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述人物/组织的职业发展与某个时代浪潮完美契合
模板：The career of [person], coincided with [historical movement], which was given the challenge to [task].
例句：The career of the pioneering software engineer coincided with the dawn of the Internet age, which was given the challenge to connect the entire world.

句型：说明某一进程得益于若干条件
模板：This was facilitated by the introduction of [A], and the abundance of [B].
例句：The rapid spread of online education was facilitated by the introduction of broadband networks, and the abundance of affordable devices.

🏙️ 托福高频：facilitate 的同义替换

facilitate ≈ make easier / promote / help / enable / foster。阅读题中常以 “made... possible” 或 “helped” 来改写。注意 facilitate 的主语通常是物（技术、政策），宾语是过程或行为，而不是人。

title: UNIT 004 · 住宅室内设计要素
body: The interior design of dwellings, such as apartments and houses, usually involves both practical and aesthetic decisions. Choices have to be made for almost every element, from ceilings and lamps, curtains and blinds, corridors and doorways, niches and ledges, grates and ventilations, terraces and staircases and even sewers or drainers. Sometimes the design work is extended to the facade of the building, and even to garden landscaping and installing a fountain.
translation: 住宅（如公寓、独栋房屋等）的室内设计通常涉及实用与美观的双重抉择。从天花板与灯具、窗帘与百叶窗、走廊与门道、壁龛与壁架、壁炉与通风设备、露台与楼梯，甚至到下水道和排水装置，几乎每一个要素都需要做出选择。有时，设计工作还会延伸到建筑物的外立面，乃至园林景观设计和喷泉安装。
insights: 【无灵主语与被动化解】原文：Choices have to be made... 直译：选择必须被做出。翻译精雕：几乎每一个要素都需要做出选择。技巧：英文常用无灵主语强调客观必要性，中文则将其化被动为主动，理顺动作逻辑。
【排比句的韵律与意合】原文：from ceilings and lamps, curtains and blinds... 直译：从天花板和灯、窗帘和百叶窗…… 翻译精雕：从天花板与灯具、窗帘与百叶窗…… 技巧：英文以 and 进行结构连接（形合），中文重意合，通过顿号与配对连词交叉使用，增强空间纵深感与节奏美。
【递进关系显化】原文：is extended to the facade..., and even to garden landscaping。翻译精雕：还会延伸到建筑物的外立面，乃至园林景观设计。技巧：and even 译为“乃至”，比“甚至还有”更书面，突出由内到外、由建筑到环境的递进层次。

grammar.title: 第一句：同位语插入与经典宾语搭配
grammar.skeleton: The interior design (主语) + [of dwellings...] (后置定语) + usually involves (谓语) + decisions (宾语).
grammar.notes: such as apartments and houses 作为插入语，补充说明 dwellings。involve both A and B decisions 是学术论文中概括综合性问题的黄金搭配。

grammar.title: 第二句：超长排比平行结构 (Parallel Structure)
grammar.skeleton: Choices have to be made for elements + from [Category A, B... and even Z].
grammar.notes: 运用 from 引导的长排比，通过 from... and even... 的递进结构，将 14 个家装词汇两两配对，营造穷尽式列举的视觉说服力。

grammar.title: 第三句：被动语态 + 并列介词短语
grammar.skeleton: the design work (主) + is extended (被动谓语) + to the facade... and even to garden landscaping and installing a fountain.
grammar.notes: be extended to 表“延伸至”；to 后并列两个介宾，第二个介宾内部又并列动名词 landscaping 与 installing，体现名词与动名词的平行。

vocab.root: interior: inter- (在……之内) + -ior (比较级后缀) → 更里面的 → 内部的
dwell (居住，来自古英语 dwellan “停留”) + -ing → 停留之处 → 住所
in- (进入) + volv- (卷，来自拉丁语 volvere) → 卷入 → 涉及/包含
aesthet- (来自希腊语 aisthētikos “感知的”) + -ic → 与感知美相关的 → 审美的

vocab.meaning: 窗帘（尤指固定在卷轴上能够拉下来的布质窗帘）
vocab.root: 名词义项“百叶窗/卷帘”，与形容词“盲的”同形：都含“遮挡视线”之意
来自意大利语 correre (跑) → 可以跑过的通道 → 走廊
来自法语 nicher “筑巢” → 墙上凹进的小空间 → 壁龛；引申为“生态位/市场细分”(ecological niche)
来自拉丁语 cratis “篱笆/格子” → 炉格/壁炉
vent- (风，来自拉丁语 ventus) + -il + -ation → 让风流通 → 通风
terr- (土地，来自拉丁语 terra) + -ace → 平整的土台 → 阳台/梯田
来自古法语 seuwiere “排水渠” → 下水道
drain (排水) + -er → 排水装置
来自意大利语 faccia “脸” → 建筑的脸面 → 外立面；引申义“假象/门面”
来自拉丁语 fons “泉水” → 喷泉；fountainhead = 源泉

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：表达“在诸多繁杂要素中皆需做出考量/选择”
模板：Choices have to be made for almost every element, from [Item A] and [Item B] to [Item C], and even [Item D].
例句：In digital marketing, choices have to be made for almost every element, from content creation and channel selection to data analysis, and even customer feedback.

句型：描述工作范围由核心向外延伸
模板：Sometimes the [work] is extended to [wider scope A], and even to [wider scope B].
例句：Sometimes the research project is extended to field surveys, and even to long-term community engagement.

🚿 深度辨析：Site (线与面) 与 Spot (具体点)
Site (大场地、规划土地)：边界明确，具特定用途。如 Construction site (建筑工地)。
Spot (具体点、眼前位置)：面积小，具现场感。如 Parking spot (停车位), Sweet spot (最佳击球点/黄金位)。
🔍 托福熟词僻义
blind n. 百叶窗 (≠ 盲的)；grate n. 炉格 (≠ 摩擦)；niche n. 生态位/壁龛 — 托福生物学文章中 ecological niche 极为常见。

title: UNIT 005 · 房屋租赁契约定义
genre: 法律英语 / 合同文本
body: The lease is a contract to rent by which one party, called the landlord or lessor, grants possession and use of the property for a limited term to another party, who is called the tenant or lessee.
translation: 租约是一种租赁合同。根据该合同，一方（称为房东或出租人）在一定期限内，将财产的占有权和使用权让与另一方（称为房客或承租人）。
insights: 【法律名词严谨对译】原文：grants possession and use。直译：给占有和使用。翻译精雕：将……的占有权和使用权让与……。技巧：在法律语境中，grant 不可译为随意的“给”，必须精雕为法理严谨的“让与/授予”；possession 需界定为“占有权”。

【身份名词句式重组】原文：one party, called the landlord or lessor, grants... to another party, who is called the tenant or lessee。直译：被称为房东或出租人的一方，让与给另一被称为房客或承租人的一方。翻译精雕：一方（称为房东或出租人）……让与另一方（称为房客或承租人）。技巧：将繁琐的定语从句和分词短语处理为中文的括号备注，消除阅读障碍。
【语域对照】landlord / tenant 为日常用语，lessor / lessee 为法律术语。原文用 or 并列二者，翻译时以“或”连接并保留两套称谓，体现法律文本“口语 + 术语”双重界定的严谨习惯。

grammar.title: 核心主干与防歧义定语从句
grammar.skeleton: The lease is a contract to rent + [by which one party... grants... to another party].
grammar.notes: by which 相当于 through this contract，界定了合同的核心交换性质。法律英语必须用“介词 + which”来确保关系代词的指代绝对清晰，杜绝漏洞。

grammar.title: 双重身份嵌套修饰
grammar.skeleton: one party, [called the landlord or lessor] (分词作定语), grants... for a limited term to another party, [who is called the tenant or lessee] (定语从句).
grammar.notes: 这是一种双重嵌套结构，目的在于在同一条长句中将“行为主体”、“权利边界”、“期限”与“受让主体”紧紧绑定。for a limited term 插在宾语与 to 之间，限定期限。

vocab.root: 来自古法语 laissier “让出/留给” (= let) → 让出使用权 → 租约
来自古法语 rente “收入” → 定期支付的费用 → 租金
land (土地) + lord (主人) → 土地的主人 → 房东/地主
lease + -or (施动者) → 出租人
来自古法语 graanter / 拉丁语 credere (信任) → 因信任而给予 → 授予/同意
possess- (来自拉丁语 possidere: pot- “有力的” + sedere “坐/占据”) + -ion → 有力地占据 → 占有权
proper- (自己的，来自拉丁语 proprius) + -ty → 属于自己的东西 → 财产；亦作“性质/属性”
ten- (持有，来自拉丁语 tenere) + -ant → 持有（租用权）的人 → 房客
lease + -ee (受动者) → 承租人
来自拉丁语 partire “分开” → 分出的一部分 → 一方
来自拉丁语 terminus “界限” → 时间的界限 → 期限

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：界定具有法律效力的契约或协议
模板：[Agreement] is a contract by which one party, called [Party A], grants [Right] to another party, who is called [Party B].
例句：A non-disclosure agreement is a contract by which one party, called the discloser, grants access to confidential information to another party, who is called the recipient.

⚖️ 法律英语核心规律：-or 与 -ee
-or 代表“施动者”，-ee 代表“受动者”。如：Lessor (出租人) vs Lessee (承租人)；Mortgagor (抵押人) vs Mortgagee (受抵押人/银行)；Employer (雇主) vs Employee (雇员)。
⚖️ 权利让与的四维梯度

1. possession (占有权)：具有实际物理控制权。
2. use (使用权)：仅限在特定目的范围内使用。
3. permit (批准许可)：行政性质，政府准许。
4. right (合法权利)：最抽象，受法律保护的资格。

title: UNIT 006 · 都市圈与城市扩张
body: A big city, or metropolis, is often surrounded by suburbs. These cities are usually associated with metropolitan areas and urban sprawl that creates a large numbers of business commuters. When a city's growth sprawls far enough to reach another city, the two cities can be deemed a conurbation, or megalopolis.
translation: 大城市，即大都市，通常被郊区所环绕。这些城市往往与大都市区以及城市无序扩张联系在一起，而城市扩张又催生了大量的通勤上班族。当一个城市的扩张范围足够大，以致与另一个城市相接时，这两个城市便可被视为一个城市群（或称连绵大都市带）。
insights: 【同位语的轻量化处理】原文：A big city, or metropolis。翻译精雕：大城市，即大都市。技巧：此处 or 表示“换言之”，用“即”引出术语，既保留解释关系又不显累赘。
【因果逻辑链重组】原文：urban sprawl that creates a large numbers of... 直译：创造大量通勤者的城市扩张。翻译精雕：与城市扩张联系在一起，而城市扩张又催生了大量的通勤上班族。技巧：原文的定语从句若直译会导致头重脚轻，将其拆译为后续分句，理顺中文的因果递进链条。
【同位语的多级递进翻译】原文：deemed a conurbation, or megalopolis. 直译：被视为城市群或特大城市。翻译精雕：被视为一个城市群（或称连绵大都市带）。技巧：or 在这里不是选择关系，而是概念的跃升补充，译为“或称……”极好地还原了学术递进感。

grammar.title: 第一句：被动语态描述空间关系
grammar.skeleton: A big city, [or metropolis] (同位语), + is often surrounded by (被动谓语) + suburbs.
grammar.notes: be surrounded by 描述地理空间格局；or metropolis 是解释性同位语，学术写作常用“A, or B,”来引入术语。

grammar.title: 第二句：客观现象关联与定语从句
grammar.skeleton: These cities (主) + are associated with (谓语) + areas and sprawl (宾) + [that creates...] (定从).
grammar.notes: be associated with 是学术写作表达“事物间存在客观联系”的首选被动短语，避免武断地使用 cause (导致)。注：原文 a large numbers of 为原书笔误，正确应为 a large number of。

grammar.title: 第三句：程度状语与高级推论谓语
grammar.skeleton: When [a city's growth sprawls far enough to reach another city], + the two cities can be deemed a conurbation.
grammar.notes: far enough to reach 构成了典型的“程度 + 结果”状语结构；deem 是表达“客观认定、学术判定”的正式动词，其严谨度高于 consider。

vocab.root: metro- (母亲，来自希腊语 meter) + polis (城市) → 母城 → 大都市
sub- (在……下/附近) + urb (城市，来自拉丁语 urbs) → 城市附近 → 郊区
associate: as- (= ad- 朝向) + soci- (同伴) + -ate → 使成为同伴 → 联系
metropolis + -an → 大都市的
来自拉丁语 urbs “城市” → 城市的；反义 rural (乡村的)
来自古英语 spreawlian “蹬腿/伸展” → 四肢摊开 → 城市的无序蔓延

vocab.meaning: 通勤者（定期从一地到另一地旅行的人，如从郊区到城市并回来）
vocab.root: commute: com- (彻底) + mutare (改变) → 交换/往返 → 通勤；-er → 通勤者
来自古英语 deman (判断)，与 doom (判决/命运) 同源 → 正式地判定/认定

vocab.meaning: （连带卫星城镇和市郊的）大都市
vocab.root: con- (共同) + urb (城市) + -ation → 城市连在一起 → 城市群
megalo- (巨大的) + polis (城市) → 特大城市/城市带

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：表达“某现象伴随某因素产生，并引发了进一步后果”
模板：[Subject] is usually associated with [Phenomenon A] that creates [Result C].
例句：The rapid development of AI is usually associated with big data that creates a massive demand for computing power.

句型：描述量变达到临界点后的定性
模板：When [A] grows far enough to reach [B], the two can be deemed [new category].
例句：When a startup grows far enough to dominate its market, it can be deemed a monopoly.

🗺️ 空间词汇辨析：Suburbs vs Outskirts

• Suburbs (住宅郊区)：侧重生活居住属性，西方语境指中产阶级居住、绿化极佳的成熟社区。
• Outskirts (市郊/边缘)：侧重地理边界，指城市与乡村交界处，常伴随工业区或荒地。

📐 北美生活必备：英美制度量衡换算

• 1 inch = 2.54 cm；1 foot = 12 inches ≈ 30.48 cm；1 mile = 5280 feet ≈ 1.61 km
• 容量：1 gallon ≈ 3.78 L
• 温度：华氏度(℉) = ℃ × 1.8 + 32

title: UNIT 007 · 环境卫生与健康预防
body: Sanitation is a hygienic process of limiting human exposure to the potential health hazards of wastes from physical, microbiological, biological, or chemical agents that may cause diseases. Human and animal feces, solid wastes, and domestic wastewater, such as sewage, sullage, and greywater, are particularly included. Hygienic means of prevention can be practiced by using the simple technologies of latrines, septic tanks and personal hygiene practices.
translation: 公共卫生是指限制人类接触由物理、微生物、生物或化学等可能致病的因素所产生的废物的潜在健康危害的卫生过程。人类和动物的粪便、固体废物以及家庭污水（如污水、污物和生活废水）尤其包括在内。人们可以利用公共厕所、化粪池等简单技术以及个人卫生习惯来进行卫生防护。
insights: 【经典动名转换】原文：limiting human exposure to... 直译：限制人类对……的暴露。翻译精雕：限制人类接触…… 技巧：名词 exposure 直译生硬，转换为动宾结构完美契合中文语感。
【介词链逆向翻译】原文：hazards of wastes from agents that may cause... 直译：来自可能致病介质的废物的危害。翻译精雕：由……可能致病的因素所产生的废物的潜在健康危害。技巧：面对嵌套的 of/from，必须逆向重组（因素 → 废物 → 危害），由内向外排列定语。
【被动句补出主语】原文：Hygienic means of prevention can be practiced by using... 直译：卫生的预防手段可以通过使用……被实践。翻译精雕：人们可以利用……来进行卫生防护。技巧：补出泛指主语“人们”，把 means of prevention 动词化为“防护”，消除“被实践”的翻译腔。

grammar.title: 主句骨架：极简定义句式
grammar.skeleton: Sanitation (主语) + is (系动词) + a hygienic process (表语).
grammar.notes: 这是学术论文下定义的标准主系表结构，主干极简，为后面承载海量修饰语留出语法空间。

grammar.title: 修饰语：葡萄串式介词链 (Prepositional Chain)
grammar.skeleton: ...a process + [of limiting exposure] + [to hazards] + [of wastes] + [from agents] + [that may cause diseases].
grammar.notes: 托福学术阅读中常见的介词嵌套。每一层介词都在界定前一个名词的范围，犹如连环扣。拆解时找到最末端的 that 定语从句，然后从内向外回溯。

grammar.title: 第三句：被动语态 + by doing 方式状语
grammar.skeleton: Hygienic means of prevention (主) + can be practiced (被动谓语) + by using [the simple technologies of A, B] and [personal hygiene practices].
grammar.notes: by using 引出方式；using 的宾语是 technologies 与 practices 两个并列名词短语，注意 and 连接的是谁与谁。

vocab.root: sanit- (来自拉丁语 sanitas “健康”，词根 san- “健全的”) + -ation → 使健康的过程 → 公共卫生
来自希腊女神 Hygieia (健康女神) → hygiene 卫生 + -ic → 卫生的
micro- (微小) + bio- (生命) + -logical (学科的) → 微生物学的
ag- (做，驱动，来自拉丁语 agere) + -ent → 起作用的东西 → 媒介/因素/代理人
来自拉丁语 faex “渣滓” → 粪便
domest- (来自拉丁语 domus “家”) + -ic → 家庭的；引申“国内的”
sewer (下水道) + -age → 下水道里的东西 → 污水
sully (弄脏) + -age → 污物/污水
grey (灰色) + water → 灰水：洗涤等轻度污染的生活废水
来自拉丁语 lavatrina “洗涤处” (lavare 洗) → 公共厕所
septic: 来自希腊语 sepein “腐烂” → 腐败的；septic tank → 化粪池
ex- (向外) + pos- (放置) + -ure → 放到外面 → 暴露

vocab.meaning: 危险源；隐患 (强调潜在的客观威胁)
vocab.root: 来自阿拉伯语 az-zahr (骰子/机会) → 经西班牙语 azar (不幸的机会) → 潜在危险/隐患

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：为复杂的“防御/预防”机制下严谨定义
模板：[Concept] is a process of limiting human exposure to the potential hazards of [Element] from [Source] that may cause [Problem].
例句：Cybersecurity is a process of limiting human exposure to the potential hazards of malicious software from unauthorized sources that may cause data breaches.

句型：说明某目标可以借由若干手段实现
模板：[Goal] can be practiced by using [technology A], [technology B] and [practice C].
例句：Energy conservation can be practiced by using the simple technologies of LED lighting, smart thermostats and mindful daily habits.

🚿 排水与排污名词精准辨析

• Sewage (黑水)：含有排泄物、高浓度病原体的极脏废水。
• Sullage/Greywater (灰水)：洗衣服、洗碗等可回收的轻污染废水。
• Drainer (地漏/排水口)：家用的最前端集水装置。
• Septic Tank (化粪池)：独立的地下排污沉淀罐，依靠微生物自然净化。

title: UNIT 008 · 公用事业与自然垄断
body: A public utility is a company that maintains and provides the infrastructure for a public service. Although utilities can be privately or publicly owned, they often involve natural monopolies.
translation: 公用事业是指为某项公共服务维护并提供基础设施的公司。虽然公用事业既可以私有也可以公有，但它们往往涉及自然垄断。
insights: 【定义句的中文范式】原文：A public utility is a company that maintains and provides...。翻译精雕：公用事业是指为某项公共服务维护并提供基础设施的公司。技巧：定义句用“……是指……的……”结构，将英文后置定语从句前置为“的”字定语，符合中文定义习惯。
【副词转形容词谓语】原文：can be privately or publicly owned。直译：可以被私人地或公共地拥有。翻译精雕：既可以私有也可以公有。技巧：副词 + 过去分词合并为中文的双音节动词“私有/公有”，并用“既……也……”呈现并列。

grammar.title: 定义句：主系表 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: A public utility (主) + is (系) + a company (表) + [that maintains and provides the infrastructure for a public service].
grammar.notes: that 引导限制性定语从句，从句内两个谓语 maintains and provides 共享宾语 infrastructure。

grammar.title: 让步状语从句
grammar.skeleton: Although [utilities can be privately or publicly owned], + they often involve natural monopolies.
grammar.notes: although 引导让步，主句不可再加 but（中英差异的经典考点）。privately or publicly 两个副词共同修饰 owned。

vocab.root: utility: ut- (使用，来自拉丁语 uti) + -ility → 有用的东西 → 公共事业/效用
infra- (在……之下) + structure (结构) → 底层结构 → 基础设施
mono- (单一) + poly (来自希腊语 polein “出售”) → 只有一个卖家 → 垄断

vocab.meaning: 自然垄断（因规模经济，由一家企业供应最有效率的行业）

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：对机构/组织下功能性定义
模板：A [organization] is a [type] that maintains and provides [resource] for [purpose].
例句：A public library is an institution that maintains and provides access to knowledge for the entire community.

句型：让步：承认差异，强调共性
模板：Although [A] can be [X] or [Y], they often involve [common feature].
例句：Although museums can be privately or publicly funded, they often involve a commitment to public education.

💡 托福经济学关键概念：Natural Monopoly

当一个行业的固定成本极高（如铺设电网、水管），由一家企业供应整个市场的平均成本最低时，就形成自然垄断。典型例子：供水、供电、燃气。因此这类行业通常受到政府的严格监管 (regulation)。

title: UNIT 009 · 交通运输系统的构成
body: The field of transport includes aspects of infrastructure, vehicles, and operations. Infrastructure covers the transportation networks of roads, railways, airways, waterways, canals, and pipelines. This network would also include the terminals associated with airports, railway stations, bus stations and seaports. Conveyances utilizing these networks include automobiles, bicycles, buses, trains and aircraft. The operations deal with the way the transportation entities are operated on the network. The legal procedures related to this purpose include the laws, codes and regulations of the particular legal environment. Policies on how to finance the system, for example, the use of tolls or gasoline taxes, may be considered as part of the operational procedures.
translation: 交通运输领域包括基础设施、交通工具和运营三个方面。基础设施涵盖由公路、铁路、航线、水路、运河和管道构成的运输网络。这一网络还包括与机场、火车站、汽车站和港口相关的终点站。利用这些网络的交通工具包括汽车、自行车、公共汽车、火车和飞机。运营则涉及交通实体在网络中的运作方式。与此相关的法律程序包括特定法律环境中的法律、法规和规章。关于如何为该系统筹措资金的政策，例如征收通行费或汽油税，也可被视为运营程序的一部分。
insights: 【总分结构显化】原文：includes aspects of infrastructure, vehicles, and operations。翻译精雕：包括基础设施、交通工具和运营三个方面。技巧：中文喜欢“总括数字”，补出“三个方面”，为后文分述埋下伏笔，结构更清晰。
【抽象名词意译】原文：the transportation entities。直译：运输实体。翻译精雕：交通实体（即运营中的车辆、线路与机构）。技巧：entity 是高度抽象的词，必要时可加括号补充指称范围。
【法律三连词区分】原文：the laws, codes and regulations。翻译精雕：法律、法规和规章。技巧：law 指立法机关通过的法律，code 指系统编纂的法规（如 traffic code），regulation 指行政机关制定的规章，层级不同，不可混译。

grammar.title: 总起句：主谓宾 + of 列举
grammar.skeleton: The field of transport (主) + includes (谓) + aspects of [infrastructure, vehicles, and operations] (宾).
grammar.notes: 说明文“总—分”结构的总起句，后文依次展开三个方面：infrastructure → vehicles(conveyances) → operations。

grammar.title: 分词作后置定语
grammar.skeleton: Conveyances [utilizing these networks] (主语 + 现在分词定语) + include (谓) + automobiles, ...
grammar.notes: utilizing these networks = which utilize these networks，现在分词作定语表示主动关系，是压缩定语从句的高级写法。

grammar.title: 复杂主语 + 被动推测
grammar.skeleton: Policies [on how to finance the system], [for example, the use of tolls or gasoline taxes], + may be considered as (被动谓语) + part of the operational procedures.
grammar.notes: 主语带两个后置成分：on + 疑问词 + to do 结构与 for example 插入语。be considered as 表“被视为”。

vocab.root: vehi- (运载，来自拉丁语 vehere) + -cle (小物) → 运载工具 → 交通工具；引申“媒介/载体”
oper- (工作，来自拉丁语 opus) + -ation → 运作/运营
来自拉丁语 canalis “管道/水道” → 运河；同源词 channel
pipe (管) + line (线) → 管道；引申为“在研项目(in the pipeline)”
来自拉丁语 nodus “结” → 节点/中转站
termin- (界限/终点，来自拉丁语 terminus) + -al → 终点站；亦作“晚期的、终端”
来自拉丁语 codex “书册/法典” → 法规；亦作“密码/代码”
regul- (规则，来自拉丁语 regula) + -ation → 规章制度；regulate 管理
来自希腊语 telos “税” → 通行费；toll 亦作“伤亡人数” (death toll)
con- (共同) + vey (道路/运送，来自拉丁语 via) + -ance → 一起运送 → 运输
ent- (来自拉丁语 esse “存在”) + -ity → 存在之物 → 实体

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：总分结构：概括某领域的若干组成部分
模板：The field of [X] includes aspects of [A], [B], and [C].
例句：The field of public health includes aspects of disease prevention, health education, and policy making.

句型：用分词短语压缩定语从句
模板：[Things] utilizing [resource] include [examples].
例句：Devices utilizing solar energy include calculators, street lights, and water heaters.

🚦 托福高频：-ance / -ence 名词化

convey → conveyance；maintain → maintenance；appear → appearance；depend → dependence。托福阅读常用名词化把整个动作浓缩为一个名词，如 the conveyance of goods = 运送货物这件事。

title: UNIT 010 · 铁路运输的结构与特点
body: Rail transport refers to the conveyance of passengers and goods by means of specially designed wheeled carriages and wagons that run on fixed rails known as railroads. A typical railway consists of two parallel rails, normally made of steel, and secured to crossbeams called ties or sleepers. The “gauge” of the track is the distance between the two rails, which is held constant by the fixture to the ties. The alignment of the track is maintained, either by laying it on a bed of ballast or securing the track to a solid concrete foundation. Rail transport is an energy-efficient, but a capital-intensive logistic system when compared to traditional trucking, where the vehicle can only carry a few tons of freight.
translation: 铁路运输是指借助专门设计的轮式车厢和货车运送乘客和货物，这些车辆在被称为铁路的固定轨道上运行。典型的铁路由两条平行的钢轨构成，钢轨通常由钢制成，并固定在被称为枕木的横梁上。轨道的“轨距”是指两条钢轨之间的距离，通过固定在枕木上而保持不变。轨道的直线走向要么通过将其铺设在道碴层上来维持，要么通过将其固定在坚固的混凝土基础上来维持。与传统的卡车运输相比，铁路运输是一种节能但资本密集型的物流系统，而卡车每次只能运载几吨货物。
insights: 【定义句化“动作”为“名词”】原文：refers to the conveyance of passengers and goods by means of...。翻译精雕：是指借助……运送乘客和货物。技巧：conveyance 名词还原为动词“运送”，by means of 译为“借助”，句子更具动感。
【长定语拆分】原文：wheeled carriages and wagons that run on fixed rails known as railroads。翻译精雕：轮式车厢和货车……这些车辆在被称为铁路的固定轨道上运行。技巧：把 that 从句拆成独立分句，用“这些车辆”复指，避免中文定语过长。
【either...or 的对称译法】原文：either by laying it on... or securing the track to...。翻译精雕：要么通过……来维持，要么通过……来维持。技巧：重复“来维持”使两种方式对称，读者一眼看清并列关系。
【转折对比显化】原文：an energy-efficient, but a capital-intensive logistic system。翻译精雕：一种节能但资本密集型的物流系统。技巧：but 连接两个修饰语形成优劣对照，是托福常考的“作者态度”句。

grammar.title: 定义句 + 定语从句 + 分词定语
grammar.skeleton: Rail transport (主) + refers to (谓) + the conveyance (宾) + [of passengers and goods] + [by means of ... wagons] + [that run on fixed rails] + [known as railroads].
grammar.notes: refer to 下定义；wagons 后接 that 从句，rails 后又接过去分词 known as，层层修饰需逐一定位中心词。

grammar.title: consist of + 并列分词
grammar.skeleton: A typical railway (主) + consists of (谓) + two parallel rails, [normally made of steel], and [secured to crossbeams called ties or sleepers].
grammar.notes: made of 与 secured to 两个过去分词并列，都修饰 rails；called ties or sleepers 又修饰 crossbeams。

grammar.title: 比较状语 + where 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Rail transport is an energy-efficient, but a capital-intensive logistic system + [when compared to traditional trucking], + [where the vehicle can only carry a few tons of freight].
grammar.notes: when compared to = 省略式比较状语；where 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 trucking（抽象“情形”），说明对比的依据。

vocab.root: con- (共同) + vey (道路/运送) + -ance → 运输
means (方法/手段) — 注意 means 单复同形
con- (共同) + sist (站立，来自拉丁语 sistere) → 共同站在一起 → 由……组成
se- (离开) + cure (担心) → 无需担心的 → 安全的；作动词“固定/获得”
cross (交叉) + beam (梁) → 横梁
熟词僻义：tie 作“枕木”(美式)，英式为 sleeper
来自古法语 jauge “量尺” → 测量标准 → 轨距；动词 gauge = 估计、评估
a- (= ad-) + line (线) + -ment → 排成一线 → 对齐/直线排列
来自古丹麦语 barlast “压舱物” → 压舱物/道碴
con- (共同) + crete (生长) → 长在一起 → 混凝土；形容词“具体的”
efficient: ef- (= ex- 出) + fic- (做) + -ient → 做出成果的 → 高效的
intensive: in- (向内) + tens- (拉伸) + -ive → 拉紧的 → 密集的
来自法语 logistique “军需供应” → 物流
来自中古荷兰语 vracht “运费” → 货物/货运
para- (旁边) + allel (彼此，来自希腊语 allelon) → 彼此并排 → 平行的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：对比两种方式的优劣（让步 + 对比）
模板：[A] is a [positive adj.], but a [negative adj.] [system] when compared to [B], where [limitation of B].
例句：Online learning is a flexible, but a self-discipline-intensive educational model when compared to traditional classrooms, where students follow a fixed schedule.

句型：用 either...or 说明维持某状态的两种方式
模板：The [state] of [X] is maintained, either by [method A] or [method B].
例句：The stability of the bridge is maintained, either by anchoring it to bedrock or reinforcing it with steel cables.

🚂 托福熟词僻义：tie / sleeper / gauge
tie 枕木 (≠ 领带)；sleeper 枕木 (≠ 睡觉的人)；gauge 轨距、仪表 (动词：评估)。熟词在专业语境中的新义项是托福词汇题的高频陷阱。

title: UNIT 011 · 公用事业的自由化改革
body: Developments in technology have eroded some of the natural monopoly aspects of traditional public utilities. For instance, electricity generation and electricity retailing, along with telecommunication and postal services, have been opened to competition in some countries. The trend towards liberalization, deregulation and privatization of public utilities is growing, but the infrastructure of the distribution network for the products and services, has remained largely monopolistic.
translation: 技术的发展已经削弱了传统公用事业所具有的某些自然垄断属性。例如，在一些国家，发电和电力零售，以及电信和邮政服务，都已向市场竞争开放。公用事业自由化、放松管制和私有化的趋势正在增强，但产品和服务的配送网络基础设施在很大程度上仍处于垄断状态。
insights: 【比喻性动词的意译】原文：Developments in technology have eroded...。直译：技术的发展已经侵蚀了……。翻译精雕：技术的发展已经削弱了……。技巧：erode 本义“侵蚀”，用于抽象事物时译为“削弱/逐渐瓦解”，保留“渐进性”的含义。
【被动转译为“向……开放”】原文：have been opened to competition。翻译精雕：都已向市场竞争开放。技巧：补出“市场”二字使经济语境更明确，“向……开放”化解被动语态。
【三连名词的标准译名】原文：liberalization, deregulation and privatization。翻译精雕：自由化、放松管制和私有化。技巧：经济学术语需使用通行译名，deregulation 不宜译为“去规则化”，而是“放松管制”。

grammar.title: 现在完成时 + 抽象主语
grammar.skeleton: Developments in technology (主) + have eroded (谓：现在完成时) + some of the natural monopoly aspects (宾) + [of traditional public utilities].
grammar.notes: 现在完成时强调“过去发生、影响持续至今”，是描述趋势变化的标准时态。

grammar.title: along with 连接主语 + 被动完成时
grammar.skeleton: electricity generation and electricity retailing, [along with telecommunication and postal services], + have been opened to competition.
grammar.notes: along with 引导的成分不影响主谓一致，谓语跟前面的真正主语保持一致；本句主语本身是复数，用 have。

grammar.title: but 转折 + 插入逗号
grammar.skeleton: The trend towards [A, B and C] is growing, + but the infrastructure [of the distribution network...] + has remained largely monopolistic.
grammar.notes: but 前后形成“趋势 vs 现实”的对比，是托福常见的作者态度信号。remain + adj. 为系表结构。

vocab.root: e- (出) + rode (咬，来自拉丁语 rodere) → 咬掉 → 侵蚀/削弱；名词 erosion
re- (再) + tail (切，来自古法语 tailler) → 再切成小份卖 → 零售
com- (共同) + pet- (寻求，来自拉丁语 petere) + -itive → 共同追求 → 竞争的
liber- (自由，来自拉丁语 liber) + -al + -ization → 自由化

vocab.meaning: 缩小国家对经济干预的范围
vocab.root: de- (去除) + regulation (管制) → 放松管制
private (私人的) + -ization → 私有化
infra- (在……之下) + structure → 基础设施
dis- (分开) + tribute (给予，来自拉丁语 tribuere) → 分给 → 分配/分销
monopoly + -istic → 垄断的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述技术发展削弱旧有格局
模板：Developments in [field] have eroded some of the [traditional feature] of [old system].
例句：Developments in digital media have eroded some of the gatekeeping power of traditional newspapers.

句型：承认趋势，指出残余（让步对比）
模板：The trend towards [A] and [B] is growing, but [core element] has remained largely [adj.].
例句：The trend towards remote work and flexible hours is growing, but the structure of corporate management has remained largely hierarchical.

📈 托福写作高分动词：描述“削弱”

erode (逐渐侵蚀)、undermine (暗中破坏)、weaken (削弱)、diminish (减少)、compromise (损害)。erode 强调缓慢渐进，undermine 强调从根基破坏，写作时按语境精准选用。

title: UNIT 012 · 中世纪行会与工匠之路
body: An aspiring master would have to pass through the career chain from apprentice to journeyman before he or she could be recognized as a master craftsman. They would also have to provide a sum of money and produce a masterpiece before actually being eligible to join a guild.
translation: 一名有志成为大师的人必须经历从学徒到熟练工的职业阶梯，才能被认可为一名手工艺大师。此外，他们还必须缴纳一笔钱款并创作出一件杰作，才真正有资格加入行会。
insights: 【形容词作中心名词】原文：An aspiring master。直译：一个有抱负的大师。翻译精雕：一名有志成为大师的人。技巧：aspiring 意为“渴望成为……的”，此时 master 尚未成为大师，必须译出“有志成为”，否则逻辑错误。
【before 从句的逆向翻译】原文：would have to pass through... before he or she could be recognized as...。直译：在被认可为大师之前必须经历……。翻译精雕：必须经历……，才能被认可为……。技巧：before 表示“先决条件”时，译为“……才……”比“在……之前”更地道。
【专有历史术语】原文：apprentice, journeyman, master craftsman, guild。翻译精雕：学徒、熟练工（帮工）、手工艺大师、行会。技巧：中世纪行会三级制度有固定译法，journeyman 源于法语 journée（一天），指按日计酬的工匠。

grammar.title: 情态推测 + before 条件从句
grammar.skeleton: An aspiring master (主) + would have to pass through (谓) + the career chain (宾) + [from apprentice to journeyman] + [before he or she could be recognized as a master craftsman].
grammar.notes: would have to 表示对过去惯常情况的描述（“那时必须”）；from A to B 说明阶梯；before 从句表达先决条件。

grammar.title: 并列谓语 + before doing
grammar.skeleton: They would also have to [provide a sum of money] and [produce a masterpiece] + before actually being eligible to join a guild.
grammar.notes: before 后接动名词 being eligible，be eligible to do 表“有资格做”。actually 强调“真正地”。

vocab.root: a- (= ad- 朝向) + spir- (呼吸，来自拉丁语 spirare) → 朝着目标呼吸 → 渴望的/有志的
来自古法语 aprendre (学习) → 学习手艺的人 → 学徒
journey (来自法语 journée “一天”) + man → 按日计酬的工匠 → 熟练工
master + piece → 证明自己是大师的作品 → 杰作
来自古英语 gield “付款” → 交会费的团体 → 行会/协会
craft (手艺) + s + man → 手艺人；craftsmanship 工艺
e- (出) + lig- (选，来自拉丁语 legere) + -ible → 可被选出的 → 有资格的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述获得资格前必须经历的阶段
模板：An aspiring [role] would have to pass through [stage A] to [stage B] before he or she could be recognized as [title].
例句：An aspiring surgeon would have to pass through years of residency to fellowship before he or she could be recognized as a specialist.

句型：说明成为成员的额外条件
模板：They would also have to [requirement 1] and [requirement 2] before actually being eligible to [goal].
例句：Applicants would also have to submit a portfolio and pass an interview before actually being eligible to join the program.

🛠️ 中世纪行会三级制度

1. Apprentice (学徒)：在师傅家中学艺，通常 7 年左右，没有工资。
2. Journeyman (熟练工)：可以按日领取工钱，四处游历积累经验。
3. Master (大师)：提交杰作 (masterpiece) 并获行会认可后，可开设作坊、招收学徒。

title: UNIT 013 · 手工艺人的销售拓展
body: A craftsperson, who perhaps initially has only sold craft items to friends, or at local bazaars, will find that increased demand leads to a wider clientele. Improved sales may be generated by mail order at crafts fairs, or selling through an established shop.
translation: 一位手工艺人起初也许只是把手工艺品卖给朋友，或在当地集市上出售，但他会发现，需求的增长会带来更广泛的客户群。销量的提升可以通过在手工艺品展销会上接受邮购订单，或通过一家成熟的店铺代售来实现。
insights: 【插入定语从句的前置处理】原文：A craftsperson, who perhaps initially has only sold craft items to friends...。翻译精雕：一位手工艺人起初也许只是把手工艺品卖给朋友。技巧：非限制性定语从句提供背景信息，直接融入主语后的叙述，用“起初……但……”构成时间对比。
【因果动词意译】原文：increased demand leads to a wider clientele。直译：增长的需求导致一个更宽的顾客群。翻译精雕：需求的增长会带来更广泛的客户群。技巧：lead to 在正面语境中译为“带来”，比“导致”更恰当；wider 译为“更广泛的”。
【被动句主动化】原文：Improved sales may be generated by...。翻译精雕：销量的提升可以通过……来实现。技巧：generate 不宜直译为“产生”，用“通过……来实现”使中文更顺畅。

grammar.title: 主语 + 非限制性定语从句 + find that 宾语从句
grammar.skeleton: A craftsperson, [who perhaps initially has only sold craft items to friends, or at local bazaars], + will find + [that increased demand leads to a wider clientele].
grammar.notes: who 从句用现在完成时描述此前的经历；find that... 为宾语从句，表达“发现”的结果。

grammar.title: 被动语态 + 并列方式状语
grammar.skeleton: Improved sales (主) + may be generated (被动谓语) + by [mail order at crafts fairs], or [selling through an established shop].
grammar.notes: by 后接两种方式：名词短语 mail order 与动名词短语 selling...，由 or 连接。

vocab.root: 来自古英语 cræft “力量/技能” → 手艺/工艺；craftsperson 手艺人
来自波斯语 bazar “市场” → 集市/义卖会
client (客户，来自拉丁语 cliens “依附者”) + -ele (集合名词) → 顾客群
熟词僻义：fair n. 集市/展销会 (≠ 公平的)，如 job fair 招聘会
in- (进入) + it- (走，来自拉丁语 ire) + -ial → 刚走进来 → 起初

vocab.meaning: 已确立的，成熟的，知名的
vocab.root: e- + stabl- (稳固，来自拉丁语 stabilis) + -ish → 使稳固 → 建立

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述规模从小到大的扩张过程
模板：A [person/organization], who perhaps initially has only [small-scale activity], will find that increased [demand/interest] leads to a wider [audience].
例句：A blogger, who perhaps initially has only written for close friends, will find that increased attention leads to a wider readership.

🛍️ 托福熟词僻义：fair
fair n. 集市、博览会 (science fair 科学展)；adj. 公平的、白皙的、晴朗的 (fair weather)；adv. 公正地。托福词汇题常考名词义项。

title: UNIT 014 · 业余手工与专业工匠
body: There can be a fine line of distinction between crafts produced by amateur hobbyists for their personal satisfaction, and those made by gifted artisans, specifically for the use and enjoyment of others.
translation: 业余爱好者为满足个人兴趣而制作的手工艺品，与天赋出众的工匠专门为他人使用和欣赏而制作的手工艺品之间，可能只有一线之隔。
insights: 【习语意译】原文：There can be a fine line of distinction between A and B。直译：A 和 B 之间可能有一条细微的区别线。翻译精雕：A 与 B 之间，可能只有一线之隔。技巧：fine line 是固定表达，用成语“一线之隔”传神达意。

【结构后置调整】原文：crafts produced by amateur hobbyists for their personal satisfaction, and those made by gifted artisans...。翻译精雕：业余爱好者为……而制作的手工艺品，与……工匠……而制作的手工艺品。技巧：英文用 those 替代 crafts 避免重复，中文必须重复“手工艺品”，否则指代不清。

grammar.title: There be 句型 + between A and B
grammar.skeleton: There can be (存在句) + a fine line of distinction + between [crafts produced by...] and [those made by...].
grammar.notes: between A and B 中 A、B 结构对称：过去分词 produced by... 对 made by...；those 指代 crafts。

grammar.title: 对比结构中的目的状语
grammar.skeleton: [for their personal satisfaction] vs. [specifically for the use and enjoyment of others]
grammar.notes: 两个 for 短语形成“自娱 vs 为他人”的对照，是本句区分业余与专业的关键信息。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：fine adj. 细微的 (a fine distinction 细微区别)
di- (分开) + stinct (刺，来自拉丁语 stinguere) + -ion → 刺点分开 → 区别；亦作“卓越、荣誉”
amateur: amat- (爱，来自拉丁语 amare) + -eur (人) → 出于热爱而做的人 → 业余爱好者
art- (技艺) + -isan (人) → 手艺人/工匠
gift (天赋) + -ed → 被赋予天赋的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：指出两类事物之间的界限很模糊
模板：There can be a fine line of distinction between [A] produced by [group 1] for [purpose 1], and those made by [group 2] for [purpose 2].
例句：There can be a fine line of distinction between photos taken by amateurs for fun, and those taken by professionals for publication.

title: UNIT 015 · 织物的编织原理
body: Fabric weaving involves interlacing warp and weft. The warp made of threads of yarn are arranged parallel to one another and tensioned on a loom. The single thread of the weft passes over and under the warp threads to create a solid, or patterned, piece of cloth. To create larger pieces, a treadle loom is usually needed.
translation: 织物编织是指将经线和纬线交织在一起。经线由纱线构成，彼此平行排列，并绷紧在织布机上。单根纬线在经线上下来回穿梭，从而织出一块纯色或带图案的结实布料。要织出更大的布块，通常需要使用脚踏织布机。
insights: 【动名词主语的定义化】原文：Fabric weaving involves interlacing warp and weft。翻译精雕：织物编织是指将经线和纬线交织在一起。技巧：involve 在定义语境下译为“是指/涉及”，并用“将……”把宾语提前。
【方位描述的动态化】原文：passes over and under the warp threads。翻译精雕：在经线上下来回穿梭。技巧：over and under 是交替动作，补出“来回穿梭”使画面生动。
【目的状语前置】原文：To create larger pieces, a treadle loom is usually needed。翻译精雕：要织出更大的布块，通常需要使用脚踏织布机。技巧：不定式目的状语保持在句首，被动 is needed 转为“需要使用”。

grammar.title: 主谓一致陷阱
grammar.skeleton: The warp [made of threads of yarn] (主) + are arranged ... and tensioned (谓).
grammar.notes: 原书此处 The warp ... are 是把 warp 视为集合（多根经线）。在规范写作中单数 warp 应接 is；写作时注意主语中心词。

grammar.title: 目的结果不定式
grammar.skeleton: The single thread of the weft (主) + passes over and under (谓) + the warp threads + [to create a solid, or patterned, piece of cloth].
grammar.notes: to create 表结果/目的；solid, or patterned 两个形容词并列修饰 piece，插入逗号表示“或者”。

vocab.root: fabric: 来自拉丁语 fabrica “工场/制品” → 织物；fabricate 制造/捏造
in- (进入) + volv- (卷) → 卷入 → 包含/涉及
inter- (相互) + lace (带子) → 相互交织

vocab.meaning: 织物上纵的方向的纱或线
vocab.root: 另义：warp v. 弯曲、扭曲 (warped 变形的)

vocab.meaning: 织物上横的方向的纱或线

vocab.root: para- (旁边) + allel (彼此) → 平行的
tens- (拉伸，来自拉丁语 tendere) + -ion → 拉紧；引申“紧张局势”
另义：loom v. 隐约出现，(危险)逼近 (loom large)
熟词僻义：solid 此处指“纯色的/结实的”
treadle: tread (踩) + -le → 踏板

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述两种成分交织形成整体的过程
模板：[Process] involves interlacing [A] and [B]: [A] is arranged [manner], while [B] passes over and under it to create [result].
例句：Effective teamwork involves interlacing individual strengths and shared goals: each member contributes expertise, while common objectives pass through every task to create a coherent outcome.

🧵 托福熟词僻义：loom / warp
loom n. 织布机；v. 隐约逼近 (A crisis is looming. 危机迫在眉睫)。
warp n. 经线；v. 扭曲、使变形 (Heat can warp wood.)。两词在托福阅读中都以动词义项更常见。

title: UNIT 016 · 编篮工艺与天然材料
body: Basketry is the craft of making baskets, bags, mats, rugs, and other items through weaving, plaiting, and coiling techniques. Materials, such as reeds, cane, rushes, sisal fiber, ash-wood splints, and ropes twisted from strands of hemp, are commonly used.
translation: 编篮工艺是指通过编织、辫编和盘绕等技法制作篮子、袋子、垫子、地毯及其他物品的手艺。人们通常使用的材料包括芦苇、藤条、灯心草、剑麻纤维、白蜡木薄条，以及由大麻纤维股捻成的绳子。
insights: 【术语定义 + 方式状语】原文：the craft of making... through weaving, plaiting, and coiling techniques。翻译精雕：通过编织、辫编和盘绕等技法制作……的手艺。技巧：through 方式状语前置到动词前，“等技法”概括列举。
【被动句转主动 + 主语后置】原文：Materials, such as reeds, cane..., are commonly used。翻译精雕：人们通常使用的材料包括……。技巧：主语中插入长列举时，转为“……包括……”句型，先给结论再列举，阅读负担更小。

grammar.title: 定义句 + through 方式状语
grammar.skeleton: Basketry (主) + is (系) + the craft (表) + [of making baskets, bags, mats, rugs, and other items] + [through weaving, plaiting, and coiling techniques].
grammar.notes: of 后的动名词短语界定 craft 的内容；三个动名词 weaving, plaiting, coiling 并列修饰 techniques。

grammar.title: 主语插入超长列举
grammar.skeleton: Materials, [such as reeds, cane, ..., and ropes twisted from strands of hemp], + are commonly used.
grammar.notes: twisted from strands of hemp 是过去分词定语修饰 ropes。主谓被 such as 列举隔开，阅读时先找到 are commonly used。

vocab.root: basket + -ry (技艺/产物) → 编篮工艺
来自拉丁语 plicare “折叠” → 编辫子；同源 pleat 褶
来自拉丁语 colligere “收集” → 盘绕/线圈
另义：sugar cane 甘蔗；cane 手杖
熟词僻义：rush n. 灯心草 (≠ 匆忙)

vocab.meaning: 波罗麻：一种分布在墨西哥和中美洲的植物

vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 fibra “纤维/须根” → 纤维；dietary fiber 膳食纤维
熟词僻义：ash 白蜡树 (≠ 灰烬)
另义：夹板 (医学固定骨折)
另义：strand v. 使搁浅、使困住 (stranded 被困的)

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：对某种工艺/学科下定义并说明手段
模板：[Craft/Field] is the [craft/art/science] of [doing A, B, and C] through [technique 1], [technique 2], and [technique 3] techniques.
例句：Data visualization is the art of turning numbers into insight through charting, mapping, and storytelling techniques.

🧺 托福熟词僻义：rush / ash / strand
rush 灯心草；ash 白蜡树；strand 股/缕，动词“使搁浅”(stranded whales 搁浅的鲸鱼)。植物与材料类文章中这些义项高频出现。

title: UNIT 017 · 装饰性绳结编织
body: In ornamental knotting, cotton, linen, or jute cord, is used to make bags, wall hangings, and containers.
translation: 在装饰性绳结编织中，人们使用棉绳、亚麻绳或黄麻绳来制作袋子、壁挂和容器。
insights: 【领域状语前置】原文：In ornamental knotting, ... is used to make...。翻译精雕：在装饰性绳结编织中，人们使用……来制作……。技巧：保留“在……中”的领域状语，被动句补出主语“人们”。
【材料名词的统一】原文：cotton, linen, or jute cord。翻译精雕：棉绳、亚麻绳或黄麻绳。技巧：cord 同时修饰三种材料，中文需在每个材料后都加“绳”，避免歧义。

grammar.title: 被动语态 + 目的不定式
grammar.skeleton: [In ornamental knotting], + cotton, linen, or jute cord (主) + is used (被动谓语) + to make bags, wall hangings, and containers.
grammar.notes: be used to do 表“被用来做”。注意原文主语与谓语之间多余的逗号，规范写作中应删去。

grammar.title: 共享中心词的并列结构
grammar.skeleton: cotton, linen, or jute + cord
grammar.notes: 三个材料名词作定语共享中心词 cord；理解时要还原为 cotton cord, linen cord, or jute cord。

vocab.root: orna- (装饰，来自拉丁语 ornare) + -ment + -al → 装饰性的；ornate 华丽的
knot (结) + -ing → 打结/结饰
来自拉丁语 linum “亚麻” → 亚麻布；同源 line (线)

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：介绍某工艺所用材料及成品
模板：In [craft], [material A], [material B], or [material C] is used to make [product 1], [product 2], and [product 3].
例句：In modern packaging, recycled paper, bamboo fiber, or cornstarch is used to make boxes, cups, and food containers.

title: UNIT 018 · 被子的三层结构
body: In quilting, three layers of fabric are normally required. These comprise of a decorative top layer, a filler layer, and a liner, which are stitched, or tied together, to create the finished product.
translation: 制作被子通常需要三层布料。它们包括装饰性的面层、填充层和衬里，三层通过缝合或系扎连接在一起，最终制成成品。
insights: 【主题名词动作化】原文：In quilting, three layers of fabric are normally required。翻译精雕：制作被子通常需要三层布料。技巧：quilting 动名词译为“制作被子”，被动 are required 转为“需要”。
【定语从句拆为结果句】原文：..., which are stitched, or tied together, to create the finished product。翻译精雕：三层通过缝合或系扎连接在一起，最终制成成品。技巧：which 从句拆为独立分句，用“三层”复指，加“最终”体现工序结果。

grammar.title: comprise 的用法辨析
grammar.skeleton: These (主) + comprise (of) (谓) + a decorative top layer, a filler layer, and a liner.
grammar.notes: 规范用法为 comprise sth. 或 be composed of / consist of sth.；comprise of 是原文的常见误用，写作中应避免。

grammar.title: 非限制性定语从句 + 结果不定式
grammar.skeleton: ..., + [which are stitched, or tied together], + [to create the finished product].
grammar.notes: which 指代三层布料；to create 表示结果。

vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 culcita “床垫/垫子” → 被子
lay (放置) + -er → 放置的一层 → 层
decor- (装饰，来自拉丁语 decus “美/荣誉”) + -ative → 装饰性的
fill + -er → 填充物
line (衬里) + -er → 衬里；另义“班轮”
来自古英语 stice “刺” → 针脚/缝合；A stitch in time saves nine. 及时一针省九针

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述多层/多部分结构及组合方式
模板：[Product] normally requires [number] layers. These comprise [A], [B], and [C], which are [joined] together to create [result].
例句：A strong research paper normally requires three layers. These comprise a clear thesis, solid evidence, and careful analysis, which are woven together to create a convincing argument.

📝 写作纠错：comprise 的正确用法

✅ The quilt comprises three layers. (整体 comprise 部分)
✅ The quilt is composed of / consists of three layers.
✅ Three layers make up / constitute the quilt. (部分构成整体)
⚠️ comprise of 虽常见于口语，但在学术写作中被视为不规范。

title: UNIT 019 · 皮革制作工具
body: Many useful objects can be fashioned from leather, but the work requires the use of special tools. Some of these tools include leather shears, punches, thonging chisels, lacing needles and equipment for carving thick leather.
translation: 许多实用物品都可以用皮革制作，但这项工作需要使用专门的工具。其中一些工具包括皮革剪刀、打孔器、穿皮带用的凿子、穿线针以及用来雕刻厚皮革的设备。
insights: 【熟词僻义】原文：can be fashioned from leather。翻译精雕：可以用皮革制作。技巧：fashion 作动词意为“制作、塑造”，不是“时尚”；被动 + from 材料，译为“用……制作”。
【转折显化】原文：but the work requires the use of special tools。翻译精雕：但这项工作需要使用专门的工具。技巧：the use of 名词结构转译为动词“使用”，避免“需要……的使用”的翻译腔。

grammar.title: 被动语态 + 转折并列句
grammar.skeleton: Many useful objects can be fashioned from leather, + but the work requires the use of special tools.
grammar.notes: be fashioned from = be made from（由原料制成，原料形态改变）。

grammar.title: 动名词/分词作定语的工具名
grammar.skeleton: leather shears, punches, thonging chisels, lacing needles and equipment [for carving thick leather].
grammar.notes: thonging、lacing 是动名词作定语，表示用途（用于穿皮带的凿子、用于穿线的针）；for carving 表示目的。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：fashion v. 制作、塑造 (fashion a tool from stone)
shear v. 剪 (羊毛)；shears 大剪刀，常用复数
另义：punch v. 打孔；用拳猛击
来自古英语 ceorfan “切割” → 雕刻；carving 雕刻品

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明某材料用途广泛但需特殊条件
模板：Many useful [objects] can be fashioned from [material], but the work requires the use of special [tools/skills].
例句：Many useful applications can be fashioned from open data, but the work requires the use of specialized analytical skills.

title: UNIT 020 · 陶瓷的成型与烧制
body: Ceramic items can be molded by hand, or thrown on a potter's wheel. When the clay is shaped to its final form, it is fired in a high-temperature oven, or kiln. This strengthens and hardens the finished product. Glazes can be used to make the object waterproof, but this requires the piece to be fired a second time.
translation: 陶瓷制品可以用手捏塑成型，也可以在陶轮上拉坯成型。当黏土被塑造成最终形态后，便被放入高温炉，即窑中烧制。这一过程能使成品更加坚固坚硬。釉料可以使器物防水，但这需要对器物进行第二次烧制。
insights: 【工艺术语对译】原文：molded by hand, or thrown on a potter's wheel。翻译精雕：用手捏塑成型，也可以在陶轮上拉坯成型。技巧：throw 在陶艺中指“拉坯”，是熟词僻义，不可译为“扔”。
【同位语 or 的处理】原文：a high-temperature oven, or kiln。翻译精雕：高温炉，即窑。技巧：or 表示同义解释，用“即”引出专业名称。
【指代句承接】原文：This strengthens and hardens the finished product。翻译精雕：这一过程能使成品更加坚固坚硬。技巧：This 指代“烧制”整个动作，译为“这一过程”更明确。

grammar.title: 并列被动谓语
grammar.skeleton: Ceramic items (主) + can be [molded by hand], or [thrown on a potter's wheel].
grammar.notes: 两个过去分词共享情态动词 can be，各自带方式状语。

grammar.title: 时间状语从句 + 被动主句
grammar.skeleton: When [the clay is shaped to its final form], + it is fired in a high-temperature oven, or kiln.
grammar.notes: fire 在陶艺中意为“烧制”(熟词僻义)；被动语态突出工艺对象 clay。

grammar.title: make + 宾语 + 形容词 / require + 宾语 + to do
grammar.skeleton: Glazes can be used to make the object waterproof, + but this requires the piece to be fired a second time.
grammar.notes: make sth. adj. 为复合宾语；require sb./sth. to do 表“要求……做”，此处不定式用被动 to be fired。

vocab.root: 来自希腊语 keramos “陶土” → 陶瓷的
来自拉丁语 modulus “尺度/模型” → 模具/塑造；另义“霉菌”
熟词僻义：throw 拉坯 (在陶轮上制陶坯)
potter (陶工) = pot + -er
water + -proof (防……的) → 防水的；同类 fireproof, bulletproof
来自 glass → 上釉/釉料；glaze over 目光呆滞
熟词僻义：fire v. 烧制陶器；亦作“解雇”

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述某步骤带来益处但也有额外代价
模板：[Method] can be used to make [object] [desired quality], but this requires [object] to be [processed] a second time.
例句：Peer review can be used to make a paper more rigorous, but this requires the manuscript to be revised a second time.

🏺 托福熟词僻义：fire / throw

陶艺文章中：fire = 烧制 (fired clay 烧过的黏土)；throw = 拉坯 (throw a pot)。理解这些义项可避免阅读时的误解。

title: UNIT 021 · 基础木工技法
body: Basic woodworking techniques, such as sawing, joining and finishing, are employed to make jewellery boxes, picture frames, and a wide variety of other useful and ornamental objects.
translation: 锯切、拼接和抛光等基础木工技法，被用来制作首饰盒、相框以及其他种类繁多的实用及装饰物品。
insights: 【被动句保留】原文：Basic woodworking techniques, such as..., are employed to make...。翻译精雕：锯切、拼接和抛光等基础木工技法，被用来制作……。技巧：中文主语较长时，把 such as 列举前置为“……等”，再接“被用来”，结构紧凑。
【a wide variety of 的译法】原文：a wide variety of other useful and ornamental objects。翻译精雕：其他种类繁多的实用及装饰物品。技巧：a wide variety of 译为“种类繁多的”，比“各种各样的”更书面。

grammar.title: 被动语态 + employ
grammar.skeleton: Basic woodworking techniques, [such as sawing, joining and finishing], + are employed (被动谓语) + to make ... objects.
grammar.notes: employ 原义“雇用”，在学术写作中常作“使用/采用”，比 use 更正式。

grammar.title: a wide variety of + 复数名词
grammar.skeleton: a wide variety of [other useful and ornamental] objects
grammar.notes: a variety of 后接可数名词复数；作主语时谓语通常用复数。

vocab.meaning: 木工艺，木工行业；adj. 木工的

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：finishing 表面处理/抛光
orna- (装饰) + -ment + -al → 装饰的
em- (进入) + ploy (折叠，来自拉丁语 plicare) → 卷入工作 → 雇用/使用

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明基础方法被用于制作多种成果
模板：Basic [field] techniques, such as [A], [B] and [C], are employed to make [product 1], [product 2], and a wide variety of other [adj.] [products].
例句：Basic statistical techniques, such as sampling, averaging and regression, are employed to make forecasts, policy reports, and a wide variety of other evidence-based decisions.

title: UNIT 022 · 木匠的工具箱
body: A carpenter's tools include saws, planes, flat-edged and semicircular gouging chisels. A brace and bit is used with a C-clamp to drill holes. A steel rule, set squares and trisquares, are common measuring tools.
translation: 木匠的工具包括锯子、刨子以及平口凿和半圆凿。手摇曲柄钻与钻头配合 C 型夹使用，用来钻孔。钢尺、直角尺和曲尺是常见的测量工具。
insights: 【工具名词的规范化】原文：flat-edged and semicircular gouging chisels。翻译精雕：平口凿和半圆凿。技巧：两个形容词共享中心词 chisels，中文分别译出完整的工具名。
【搭配词组的整体翻译】原文：A brace and bit。翻译精雕：手摇曲柄钻与钻头。技巧：brace and bit 是一套工具（曲柄 + 钻头），作单数主语，用“与”连接，后接 is used。

grammar.title: include + 列举
grammar.skeleton: A carpenter's tools (主) + include (谓) + saws, planes, [flat-edged and semicircular gouging] chisels.
grammar.notes: 复合形容词 flat-edged 与 semicircular 并列修饰 chisels。

grammar.title: 被动 + with 伴随 + 目的不定式
grammar.skeleton: A brace and bit (主) + is used (被动) + with a C-clamp + to drill holes.
grammar.notes: A and B 表示一套整体时，谓语用单数。

vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 carpentarius “造车匠” → 木匠
熟词僻义：plane n. 刨子；另义“平面、层次”
另义：gouge v. 挖出；敲竹杠
熟词僻义：bore v. 钻孔 (≠ 无聊)
另义：brace v. 支撑、使做好准备 (brace for impact)
另义：drill n. 操练、演习 (fire drill)
熟词僻义：square n. 直角尺

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：列举某职业/领域的常用工具
模板：A [professional]'s tools include [A], [B], and [C]. [D] is used with [E] to [purpose].
例句：A data scientist's tools include Python, SQL, and visualization libraries. A notebook environment is used with version control to share reproducible analyses.

🪚 托福熟词僻义：plane / bore / brace / drill
plane 刨子/平面；bore 钻孔 (boring tool 钻具)；brace 支架/使做好准备；drill 钻头/操练。这些词在机械、地质 (drilling for oil) 文章中均高频。

title: UNIT 023 · 榫卯结构
body: When joining two pieces of timber perpendicularly, a tenon and mortise system is often used. The end of one piece of timber is cut with a number of rectangular or square projections, which are then fitted to the end of the other piece. This second piece is cut with compensating grooves, known as the mortise, and creates a snugly, interlocking join.
translation: 当要将两块木料垂直连接时，人们通常采用榫卯结构。一块木料的末端被切出若干长方形或正方形的凸出部分（即榫头），然后插入另一块木料的末端。第二块木料上被切出与之相配的凹槽，即榫眼，从而形成紧密咬合的接头。
insights: 【时间状语 + 被动的流畅化】原文：When joining two pieces of timber perpendicularly, a tenon and mortise system is often used。翻译精雕：当要将两块木料垂直连接时，人们通常采用榫卯结构。技巧：tenon and mortise 在中文里有现成术语“榫卯”，直接借用更地道。
【补全隐含信息】原文：rectangular or square projections。翻译精雕：长方形或正方形的凸出部分（即榫头）。技巧：原文未写明 projections 就是 tenon，译文补充括号说明，帮助读者建立概念对应。
【结果状语显化】原文：and creates a snugly, interlocking join。翻译精雕：从而形成紧密咬合的接头。技巧：and 连接的第二谓语表示结果，加“从而”显化因果。

grammar.title: 省略主语的状语从句
grammar.skeleton: When [joining two pieces of timber perpendicularly], + a tenon and mortise system is often used.
grammar.notes: When + doing 是状语从句的省略形式；严格来说逻辑主语应与主句一致，这里属于学术文中可接受的“悬垂”用法。

grammar.title: 被动 + 非限制性定语从句
grammar.skeleton: The end of one piece of timber + is cut with + a number of rectangular or square projections, + [which are then fitted to the end of the other piece].
grammar.notes: be cut with 表“被切出……”；which 指代 projections。

grammar.title: 分词插入语 + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: This second piece + [is cut with compensating grooves, known as the mortise], + and [creates a snugly, interlocking join].
grammar.notes: known as 引出术语；snugly 原文作副词修饰形容词 interlocking 的位置，规范写法为 a snug, interlocking joint。

vocab.root: 来自古法语 tenir “抓住” (= 拉丁语 tenere) → 被抓牢的部分 → 榫头
pro- (向前) + ject (扔) + -ion → 向前扔出 → 凸出物；亦作“投影、预测”
snug adj. 舒适的、紧贴的 + -ly
perpendicular: per- (彻底) + pend (悬挂) → 铅锤垂下的 → 垂直的
com- (共同) + pens- (称重，来自拉丁语 pendere) → 两边称重相抵 → 补偿
inter- (相互) + lock (锁) → 互相锁住

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明两部分如何互补结合
模板：[Part A] is cut with [feature], which is then fitted to [Part B]. [Part B] is cut with compensating [feature], and creates a [tight, interlocking] [connection].
例句：The theory is built with clear assumptions, which are then fitted to the data. The data are collected with compensating controls, and create a tight, interlocking argument.

🧩 托福写作同义替换：垂直 / 平行

perpendicular (垂直的) ≈ at right angles / vertical；parallel (平行的) ≈ side by side。托福学科类文章常用 perpendicular to the ground (与地面垂直)。

title: UNIT 024 · 木器的表面处理
body: Finishes serve to protect and preserve wooden objects, and also, to bring out the beauty of the grain. The timber is smoothed with rasps, files, and sandpaper before applying common finishes. These can include waxes, oils, bleaches, fillers, stains, shellac, varnish, lacquer, sealers, and flat or enamel paints.
translation: 表面涂饰的作用在于保护和保养木制品，同时也能展现木纹之美。在涂上常用的涂饰材料之前，人们会先用粗锉、锉刀和砂纸将木料打磨光滑。这些涂饰材料可能包括蜡、油、漂白剂、填充料、着色剂、虫胶清漆、清漆、天然漆、封底漆，以及亚光漆或瓷漆。
insights: 【serve to 的译法】原文：Finishes serve to protect and preserve wooden objects。翻译精雕：表面涂饰的作用在于保护和保养木制品。技巧：serve to do 表示“起……作用”，译为“作用在于……”。
【bring out 的引申】原文：to bring out the beauty of the grain。翻译精雕：展现木纹之美。技巧：bring out 原义“拿出来”，引申为“使显现”，“展现……之美”有文学韵味。
【时间顺序重排】原文：The timber is smoothed... before applying common finishes。翻译精雕：在涂上……之前，人们会先……打磨光滑。技巧：中文按时间先后叙述，把 before 状语提前。

grammar.title: serve to do + 并列不定式
grammar.skeleton: Finishes (主) + serve (谓) + [to protect and preserve wooden objects], and also, [to bring out the beauty of the grain].
grammar.notes: 两个不定式短语表示“作用/目的”；and also 前后用逗号强调第二种作用。

grammar.title: 被动语态 + before doing
grammar.skeleton: The timber (主) + is smoothed (被动) + with rasps, files, and sandpaper + before applying common finishes.
grammar.notes: before + 动名词表时间先后；逻辑主语是泛指的“人”。

vocab.root: bring out ≈ reveal / highlight / emphasize，托福词汇题高频短语
熟词僻义：grain 木纹、纹理 (≠ 谷物)；against the grain 违反本性
熟词僻义：finish n. 表面涂饰/抛光层

vocab.meaning: 粗锉：一种有锋利、突出、尖锐凸起的钝锉

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：file n. 锉刀 (≠ 文件)
熟词僻义：stain n. 着色剂 (≠ 污渍)

vocab.meaning: 虫胶清漆：用于涂饰木料
清漆：用于把表面涂成坚硬的、有光泽的透明的膜
天然漆：一种用作表面涂层的光滑的树脂般的物质
瓷漆：一种烧制在金属、玻璃或瓷器上不透明的、保护性或装饰性的覆盖层
vocab.root: 另义：tooth enamel 牙釉质
pre- (预先) + serv- (保护，来自拉丁语 servare) → 预先保护 → 保存

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明某事物具有双重作用
模板：[Thing] serves to [function 1] and [function 2], and also, to bring out [hidden value].
例句：Good editing serves to correct and clarify a manuscript, and also, to bring out the author's unique voice.

🪵 托福熟词僻义：grain / file / stain
grain 纹理/颗粒 (a grain of sand)；file 锉刀；stain 着色剂/染色 (biology: staining cells 细胞染色)。

title: UNIT 025 · 油漆与清漆的成分
body: Paints are formed by mixing a colour pigment with a fluid vehicle as a binder. Linseed oil is a binder that solidifies when exposed to air. A varnish is a transparent solution that hardens into a protective coating. Opaque and coloured varnishes are called lacquers.
translation: 油漆是由彩色颜料与作为粘合剂的液态调漆料混合而成的。亚麻籽油是一种暴露在空气中便会凝固的粘合剂。清漆是一种透明溶液，会硬化成一层保护涂层。不透明的有色清漆被称为天然漆（漆）。
insights: 【被动定义句】原文：Paints are formed by mixing... with...。翻译精雕：油漆是由……与……混合而成的。技巧：“是由……而成的”是中文描述构成的经典句式。
【熟词僻义】原文：a fluid vehicle as a binder。翻译精雕：作为粘合剂的液态调漆料。技巧：vehicle 在涂料化学中指“载体/调漆料”，不是“车辆”。
【定语从句前置】原文：a binder that solidifies when exposed to air。翻译精雕：一种暴露在空气中便会凝固的粘合剂。技巧：短定语从句前置为“的”字结构，加“便”字体现条件关系。

grammar.title: 被动语态 + by doing + as
grammar.skeleton: Paints (主) + are formed (被动) + by mixing a colour pigment with a fluid vehicle + as a binder.
grammar.notes: mix A with B 表“把 A 与 B 混合”；as 表“作为”。

grammar.title: 定语从句中的省略状语
grammar.skeleton: Linseed oil is a binder + [that solidifies + when (it is) exposed to air].
grammar.notes: when exposed = when it is exposed，省略主语和 be 动词。

grammar.title: 定义句：that 从句 + into 结果
grammar.skeleton: A varnish is a transparent solution + [that hardens into a protective coating].
grammar.notes: harden into 表示“硬化成……”，into 表示状态的转变。

vocab.root: pig- (涂色，来自拉丁语 pingere，同源 paint) + -ment → 颜料/色素
bind (捆绑) + -er → 粘合剂
熟词僻义：vehicle 载体/调漆料；亦作“传播媒介”
solid + -ify (使……化) → 使凝固
ex- (向外) + pose (放置) → 暴露
trans- (穿过) + par- (出现，来自拉丁语 parere) + -ent → 光能穿过的 → 透明的；引申“透明公开的”
熟词僻义：solution 溶液 (≠ 解决方案)
来自拉丁语 opacus “阴暗的” → 不透明的；反义 transparent

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明某物质由哪些成分混合而成
模板：[Product] is formed by mixing [component A] with [component B] as a [function].
例句：Concrete is formed by mixing cement and gravel with water as a binding agent.

🎨 透光度三级
transparent (透明的，可清晰看透) → translucent (半透明的，透光但看不清) → opaque (不透明的)。托福物理/光学文章常考这一组词。

title: UNIT 026 · 烹饪方法大全
body: Cookery involves creating a diverse array of cuisines using various preparation methods. Food may be boiled, poached or stewed by immersing it in water, stock, or wine. When immersed in fat or oil, the food is fried, but it may also be steamed or braised by exposing it to vapour. Other styles of cooking include roasting and baking where the food is exposed to dry heat in an oven. Broiling and sauntering occurs when food is subjected to contact with hot fats.
translation: 烹饪是指运用各种烹调方法制作出丰富多样的菜肴。食物可以浸入水、高汤或葡萄酒中进行煮、水煮或炖。若浸在油脂中，食物就是被炸，但也可以通过接触蒸汽进行蒸或焖。其他烹饪方式还包括烤和烘焙，即把食物放在烤箱中受干热加热。当食物与热油直接接触时，便是在进行炙烤和煸炒。
insights: 【a diverse array of 的译法】原文：creating a diverse array of cuisines。翻译精雕：制作出丰富多样的菜肴。技巧：array 意为“一系列”，a diverse array of 译为“丰富多样的”。
【条件句的简化】原文：When immersed in fat or oil, the food is fried。翻译精雕：若浸在油脂中，食物就是被炸。技巧：省略式状语 When immersed 译为“若……”，体现条件—结果。
【烹饪动词的精细区分】boil 煮 / poach 水煮（小火低温）/ stew 炖 / braise 焖（先煎后炖）/ steam 蒸 / roast 烤（肉类）/ bake 烘焙（面点）/ broil 炙烤 / sauté 煸炒。技巧：翻译烹饪动词务必区分火候与介质。

grammar.title: involve + doing 定义
grammar.skeleton: Cookery (主) + involves (谓) + creating a diverse array of cuisines + [using various preparation methods].
grammar.notes: using... 为现在分词作方式状语。

grammar.title: 被动语态 + by doing
grammar.skeleton: Food may be boiled, poached or stewed + by immersing it in water, stock, or wine.
grammar.notes: 三个过去分词共享 may be；by immersing 说明方式。

grammar.title: where 定语从句修饰抽象名词
grammar.skeleton: Other styles of cooking include roasting and baking + [where the food is exposed to dry heat in an oven].
grammar.notes: where 引导定语从句修饰 roasting and baking（抽象“情形”）。

grammar.title: be subjected to 的用法
grammar.skeleton: ... occurs when food is subjected to contact with hot fats.
grammar.notes: be subjected to 表“遭受、经受”，to 是介词，后接名词。原文 sauntering 为 sautéing 的误拼，occurs 应为 occur。

vocab.root: di- (分开) + vers- (转，来自拉丁语 vertere) → 转向不同方向 → 多样的；diversity 多样性
来自法语 cuisine “厨房/烹饪” (拉丁语 coquere 烹煮) → 菜肴/烹饪风格
im- (进入) + merse (浸，来自拉丁语 mergere) → 浸入；引申“沉浸于”
熟词僻义：stock 高汤 (≠ 库存/股票)
另义：poach v. 偷猎；挖走（人才）

vocab.meaning: 炖：用小火烧或慢慢地煮沸来烹饪

vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 vapor “蒸汽”；evaporate 蒸发

vocab.meaning: 炖：先用油炒，然后在有盖容器中炖

vocab.root: sub- (在下) + ject (扔) → 扔到下面 → 使遭受；be subject to 易受……影响
con- (共同) + tact (触摸，来自拉丁语 tangere) → 接触

vocab.meaning: 一系列，大量 (a wide array of)
vocab.root: 来自古法语 areer “布置/排列” → 排列好的一组 → 一系列

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述某活动涵盖多种方法
模板：[Activity] involves creating a diverse array of [outputs] using various [methods].
例句：Scientific research involves creating a diverse array of models using various experimental methods.

句型：说明不同条件下产生的不同结果
模板：When [condition A], [result A], but it may also be [result B] by [method B].
例句：When exposed to sunlight, the material expands, but it may also be compressed by applying pressure.

🍳 烹饪动词火候梯度
水介质：poach (低温水煮) < simmer (文火炖) < boil (沸煮)
油介质：sauté (少油快炒) < pan-fry (煎) < deep-fry (油炸)
干热：bake (烘焙面点) / roast (烤大块肉) / broil (上火炙烤) / grill (烧烤架烤)

title: UNIT 027 · 现代厨房设备
body: A modern kitchen requires the following essential equipment: a stove, or range; sink; work surface; various knives, pots and pans, rolling pins and utensils, such as spatulas, whisks, and specialised spoons. A more highly specialised array of gear is required for producing pastries and other baked goods. Other more sophisticated equipment, such as blenders, food processors and microwave ovens, have become commonplace.
translation: 现代厨房需要以下基本设备：炉子（或称炉灶）、水槽、操作台、各种刀具、锅具、擀面杖以及器具，例如刮铲、打蛋器和专用勺子。制作糕点和其他烘焙食品则需要一套更加专业化的设备。其他更为复杂精巧的设备，如搅拌机、食品加工机和微波炉，已经变得十分普遍。
insights: 【冒号列举的保留】原文：requires the following essential equipment: a stove, or range; sink; ...。翻译精雕：需要以下基本设备：……。技巧：中文同样可以用冒号 + 顿号/分号列举，保持原文层次。
【比较级的译法】原文：A more highly specialised array of gear。翻译精雕：一套更加专业化的设备。技巧：more highly specialised 双重修饰，译为“更加专业化”即可，不必重复“高度”。
【become commonplace】原文：have become commonplace。翻译精雕：已经变得十分普遍。技巧：commonplace 作形容词“普遍的、司空见惯的”，补“十分”加强语气。

grammar.title: 冒号 + 分号分层列举
grammar.skeleton: A modern kitchen requires the following essential equipment: + [a stove, or range]; [sink]; [work surface]; [various knives, ..., utensils, such as spatulas...].
grammar.notes: 分号用来分隔内部本身含有逗号的列举项，是学术写作中处理复杂列举的规范标点。

grammar.title: 被动 + for doing 目的
grammar.skeleton: A more highly specialised array of gear (主) + is required (被动) + for producing pastries and other baked goods.
grammar.notes: array of gear 作主语，中心词 array 单数，谓语用 is。

grammar.title: 主谓一致考点
grammar.skeleton: Other more sophisticated equipment, [such as blenders...], + have become commonplace.
grammar.notes: equipment 为不可数名词，规范应为 has become；原文受插入列举影响用了 have，写作时注意。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：range 炉灶 (≠ 范围)
ut- (使用，来自拉丁语 uti) + -ensil → 用具/器皿
另义：whisk v. 迅速带走 (be whisked away)
熟词僻义：gear 设备/装备 (≠ 齿轮)
sophist- (智者，来自希腊语 sophos “聪明”) + -icated → 精于世故的 → 复杂精密的/老练的
common (普通) + place → 随处可见的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述曾经先进的事物已变得普遍
模板：Other more sophisticated [devices/practices], such as [A], [B] and [C], have become commonplace.
例句：Other more sophisticated technologies, such as facial recognition, voice assistants and smart sensors, have become commonplace.

title: UNIT 028 · 马赛克镶嵌工艺
body: In ancient times, mosaics were a form of floor decoration made of small pebbles. Later, shaped pieces of marble, hard stone, glass, terra-cotta, mother-of-pearl and enamels, came into common use. When pieces are shaped in the form of small cubes, they are called tesserae. The mosaic is created when the pieces are held in place by embedding them in plaster, cement, or putty.
translation: 在古代，马赛克是一种用小鹅卵石铺成的地面装饰。后来，经过切割成形的大理石、硬石、玻璃、赤陶、珍珠母和瓷釉碎片开始被普遍使用。当这些碎片被切成小立方体时，它们被称为“镶嵌块”。通过将碎片嵌入石膏、水泥或油灰中加以固定，马赛克便制作完成了。
insights: 【come into common use】原文：came into common use。翻译精雕：开始被普遍使用。技巧：come into use 表示“开始使用”，补“普遍”还原 common。
【术语引入】原文：they are called tesserae。翻译精雕：它们被称为“镶嵌块”。技巧：专业术语用引号标示，必要时可附原文 tesserae。
【主从句顺序重排】原文：The mosaic is created when the pieces are held in place by embedding them in...。翻译精雕：通过将碎片嵌入……中加以固定，马赛克便制作完成了。技巧：中文习惯“先手段后结果”，把 when 从句提前，主句作结。

grammar.title: 主系表 + made of
grammar.skeleton: In ancient times, + mosaics (主) + were (系) + a form of floor decoration (表) + [made of small pebbles].
grammar.notes: made of 过去分词短语作后置定语，表示材料。

grammar.title: 时间状语从句 + 被动 + in the form of
grammar.skeleton: When pieces are shaped in the form of small cubes, + they are called tesserae.
grammar.notes: in the form of 表“以……形式”；be called 引出术语。

grammar.title: when 从句 + by doing + held in place
grammar.skeleton: The mosaic is created + when [the pieces are held in place] + [by embedding them in plaster, cement, or putty].
grammar.notes: hold sth. in place 表“固定住”；by embedding 说明手段。

vocab.root: 来自希腊语 mouseios “属于缪斯的” → 艺术装饰 → 马赛克；引申“拼凑而成的整体”
来自希腊语 marmaros “闪亮的石头”
terra (土) + cotta (烧过的) → 烧过的土 → 赤陶
em- (进入) + bed (床) → 放进床里 → 嵌入；embedded 根深蒂固的
另义：cement v. 巩固 (cement a relationship)
in place 就位；反义 out of place 不合适的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述某事物材料/形式的历史演变
模板：In ancient times, [X] was a form of [Y] made of [simple material]. Later, [advanced materials] came into common use.
例句：In ancient times, writing was a form of record-keeping made of clay tablets. Later, papyrus, parchment and paper came into common use.

🏛️ 托福写作：时间演变连接词

In ancient times / Initially / Originally → Later / Subsequently / Over time → Eventually / By the modern era。描述演变时搭配 came into use / gave way to / was replaced by。

title: UNIT 029 · 彩色玻璃的制作
body: Molten glass is tinted in a wide range of colours through the use of metal oxides. When the molten glass cools after being poured on a flat surface, such as a marble slab, it can form a plate of coloured glass. The glass can then be scored with a sharp tool and broken into appropriate strips and cubes for use in mosaics and stained glass windows.
translation: 人们利用金属氧化物将熔融玻璃染成各种各样的颜色。熔融玻璃被倒在大理石板等平整表面上冷却后，便可形成一块彩色玻璃板。随后，可以用锋利的工具在玻璃上划出刻痕，再将其掰成合适的长条和方块，用于制作马赛克和彩色玻璃窗。
insights: 【被动转主动 + 方式前置】原文：Molten glass is tinted in a wide range of colours through the use of metal oxides。翻译精雕：人们利用金属氧化物将熔融玻璃染成各种各样的颜色。技巧：through the use of 名词结构还原为动词“利用”，并移至句首作方式。
【after being done 的时序处理】原文：When the molten glass cools after being poured on a flat surface...。翻译精雕：熔融玻璃被倒在……上冷却后。技巧：英文用 when + after 两层时间，中文合并为一个“……后”，按先倒后冷的自然顺序。
【熟词僻义】原文：scored with a sharp tool。翻译精雕：用锋利的工具划出刻痕。技巧：score 在此为“刻痕/划线”，不是“得分”。

grammar.title: 被动语态 + through the use of
grammar.skeleton: Molten glass (主) + is tinted (被动) + in a wide range of colours + through the use of metal oxides.
grammar.notes: through the use of = by using，名词化结构更正式。

grammar.title: when + after being done
grammar.skeleton: When [the molten glass cools] [after being poured on a flat surface, such as a marble slab], + it can form a plate of coloured glass.
grammar.notes: after being poured 是动名词的被动形式，主语 glass 是“被倒”的对象。

grammar.title: 并列被动谓语 + for use in
grammar.skeleton: The glass can then be [scored with a sharp tool] and [broken into appropriate strips and cubes] + for use in mosaics and stained glass windows.
grammar.notes: break into 表“破碎成……”；for use in 表用途。

vocab.root: melt 的古过去分词 → 熔化的 (用于金属、岩石：molten lava)

vocab.meaning: 带白的颜色，淡色；v. 染色；着色于……

vocab.root: range 范围；a wide range of ≈ a variety of / diverse
oxide: oxy- (氧) + -ide (化合物) → 氧化物
熟词僻义：score v. 刻痕、划线；n. 二十 (four score = 80)；乐谱

vocab.meaning: 彩色玻璃（常用于教堂窗户）

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述加工步骤的先后顺序
模板：[Material] can then be [processed A] and [processed B] into [shapes] for use in [applications].
例句：The raw data can then be cleaned and divided into training and test sets for use in machine learning models.

title: UNIT 030 · 肖像的多种媒介
body: Portraits can be created in any medium, from sculpted stone, carved wood, and hammered or poured metal. Other techniques include oil painting, drawing in pastel, tempera on parchment, carved cameos, encaustic on wood panels, and painted ivory.
translation: 肖像可以用任何媒介来创作，从雕刻的石材、木雕，到锤打成型或浇铸而成的金属皆可。其他技法还包括油画、色粉画、羊皮纸上的蛋彩画、浮雕宝石、木板上的蜡画以及象牙彩绘。
insights: 【from 列举的处理】原文：in any medium, from sculpted stone, carved wood, and hammered or poured metal。翻译精雕：可以用任何媒介来创作，从……到……皆可。技巧：from 引导的列举没有 to，中文补成“从……到……皆可”，形成完整呼应。
【分词定语化】原文：sculpted stone, carved wood, hammered or poured metal。翻译精雕：雕刻的石材、木雕、锤打成型或浇铸而成的金属。技巧：过去分词修饰材料，表示加工方式，中文转为“……成型的”。

grammar.title: 被动语态 + in any medium
grammar.skeleton: Portraits (主) + can be created (被动) + in any medium, + from [sculpted stone], [carved wood], and [hammered or poured metal].
grammar.notes: medium 指艺术“媒介/材料”，复数 media 或 mediums。

grammar.title: include + 名词短语列举
grammar.skeleton: Other techniques include + oil painting, drawing in pastel, tempera on parchment, carved cameos, encaustic on wood panels, and painted ivory.
grammar.notes: 列举项结构为“技法 + in/on + 材料”，体现英文“技法 + 载体”的固定表述。

vocab.root: por- (= pro- 向前) + trait (画、拉，来自拉丁语 trahere) → 画出来 → 肖像；portray 描绘
来自拉丁语 sculpere “雕刻” → 雕塑
另义：pastel adj. 柔和淡雅的 (pastel colors)
en- (在内) + caust (烧，来自希腊语 kaiein) → 烙画/蜡画
另义：cameo 客串演出
来自拉丁语 medius “中间的” → 中间物 → 媒介

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明某种作品可由多种媒介或方式完成
模板：[Works] can be created in any medium, from [A], [B], and [C]. Other techniques include [D], [E], and [F].
例句：Stories can be told in any medium, from oral tradition, printed books, and recorded audio. Other techniques include film, comics, and interactive games.

title: UNIT 031 · 雕塑的定义与类型
body: The word sculpture is derived from Latin, meaning “to carve” . Sculpture applies to three-dimensional art, involving masses and volumes of various materials. The two principal types of sculpture are traditional freestanding works in the round and depictions carved in relief.
translation: “雕塑”（sculpture）一词源自拉丁语，意为“雕刻”。雕塑是指三维艺术，涉及各种材料的体块与体积。雕塑的两种主要类型是传统的独立圆雕作品和以浮雕形式雕刻的作品。
insights: 【词源句的译法】原文：The word sculpture is derived from Latin, meaning “to carve”。翻译精雕：“雕塑”一词源自拉丁语，意为“雕刻”。技巧：be derived from 译为“源自”；meaning 分词短语译为“意为”。
【apply to 的语义】原文：Sculpture applies to three-dimensional art。翻译精雕：雕塑是指三维艺术。技巧：apply to 此处表“适用于/指称”，译为“是指”更符合定义句。
【艺术术语】原文：works in the round / carved in relief。翻译精雕：圆雕作品 / 浮雕。技巧：in the round 是“圆雕（可四面观赏）”的专业表达。

grammar.title: 被动 + 分词短语补充
grammar.skeleton: The word sculpture (主) + is derived from (被动谓语) + Latin, + [meaning “to carve”].
grammar.notes: be derived from 表来源；meaning 现在分词短语补充说明含义。

grammar.title: 现在分词作伴随状语
grammar.skeleton: Sculpture applies to three-dimensional art, + [involving masses and volumes of various materials].
grammar.notes: involving 补充说明三维艺术的特点。

grammar.title: 主系表 + 并列表语
grammar.skeleton: The two principal types of sculpture (主) + are (系) + [traditional freestanding works in the round] and [depictions carved in relief].
grammar.notes: carved in relief 过去分词作后置定语修饰 depictions。

vocab.root: sculpt- (雕刻) + -ure → 雕塑品
艺术语境：mass 体块；物理语境：质量
熟词僻义：volume 体积；亦作“音量、卷册”
princip- (首要，来自拉丁语 princeps) + -al → 主要的；注意区别 principle (原则)

vocab.meaning: （雕刻、建筑物等）独立的，自力撑持的
雕刻成立体（的），栩栩如生的，表现无余的

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：relief 浮雕 (≠ 宽慰)；地理中 relief map 地形图
de- (离开) + riv- (河流，来自拉丁语 rivus) → 从河里引水 → 源自
de- (加强) + pict- (画，来自拉丁语 pingere) + -ion → 描绘

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：给术语追溯词源并下定义
模板：The word [term] is derived from [language], meaning “[original sense]”. [Term] applies to [definition], involving [key features].
例句：The word democracy is derived from Greek, meaning “rule by the people”. Democracy applies to systems of government involving free elections and civil rights.

📚 托福易混词：principal vs principle
principal adj. 主要的；n. 校长、本金。
principle n. 原则、原理 (the principle of gravity)。记忆：principal 的 al 联想 “pal (伙伴)” → 校长是学生的伙伴。

title: UNIT 032 · 铸造的两个阶段
body: Casting is accomplished in two stages. The first stage is to make an impression, or negative mould, using the original object, or a clay model. The negative impression is then filled with the desired liquid material to cast a positive reproduction of the original work.
translation: 铸造分两个阶段完成。第一阶段是利用原物或黏土模型制作印模，即阴模。然后，在阴模中注入所需的液态材料，铸造出原作的正像复制品。
insights: 【被动转主动】原文：Casting is accomplished in two stages。翻译精雕：铸造分两个阶段完成。技巧：“分……完成”简洁表达阶段性，避免“被完成”。
【同位语的处理】原文：an impression, or negative mould。翻译精雕：印模，即阴模。技巧：or 表示同义解释，用“即”连接。
【positive / negative 的专业译法】原文：a positive reproduction。翻译精雕：正像复制品。技巧：铸造与摄影中 negative = 阴/负像，positive = 阳/正像，需统一术语。

grammar.title: 主系表 + 不定式作表语
grammar.skeleton: The first stage (主) + is (系) + to make an impression, or negative mould, + [using the original object, or a clay model].
grammar.notes: 不定式作表语说明“阶段内容”；using 现在分词表方式。

grammar.title: 被动 + 目的不定式
grammar.skeleton: The negative impression (主) + is then filled with (被动) + the desired liquid material + to cast a positive reproduction of the original work.
grammar.notes: be filled with 表“被填满”；to cast 表目的。

vocab.root: cast v. 铸造；投射；分配角色
im- (进入) + press (压) + -ion → 压进去的痕迹 → 印痕；亦作“印象”
re- (再) + produce (生产) + -tion → 复制品；生物学中意为“繁殖”
ac- (= ad- 加强) + compl- (完成，来自拉丁语 complere) + -ish → 完成

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述分阶段完成的过程
模板：[Process] is accomplished in two stages. The first stage is to [step 1], using [tool]. [Result of step 1] is then [step 2] to [final goal].
例句：Translation is accomplished in two stages. The first stage is to grasp the meaning, using context. The understood meaning is then re-expressed to produce a natural target text.

title: UNIT 033 · 音高与音阶
body: Pitch depends upon the rate of vibration, or frequency of sound waves, in producing a particular tone. Most Western music is based on 12 equivalent intervals per octave; however, a great deal of the best-known Western folk music conforms to the pentatonic scale, which contains no half steps.
translation: 在产生特定音调时，音高取决于振动的速率，即声波的频率。大多数西方音乐以每个八度包含 12 个等距音程为基础；然而，许多最著名的西方民间音乐却遵循五声音阶，而五声音阶中不含半音。
insights: 【depend upon 的译法】原文：Pitch depends upon the rate of vibration, or frequency of sound waves。翻译精雕：音高取决于振动的速率，即声波的频率。技巧：depend on 译“取决于”；or 表同义解释译“即”。
【however 转折】原文：...per octave; however, a great deal of the best-known Western folk music conforms to...。翻译精雕：……；然而，许多最著名的西方民间音乐却遵循……。技巧：分号 + however 构成对比，中文加“却”强化转折。
【定语从句的后置说明】原文：the pentatonic scale, which contains no half steps。翻译精雕：五声音阶，而五声音阶中不含半音。技巧：非限制性从句补充特点，重复中心词衔接。

grammar.title: depend upon + in doing
grammar.skeleton: Pitch (主) + depends upon (谓) + the rate of vibration, or frequency of sound waves, + [in producing a particular tone].
grammar.notes: in doing 表示“在……过程中”。

grammar.title: 分号 + however 连接两个独立句
grammar.skeleton: Most Western music is based on 12 equivalent intervals per octave; + however, + a great deal of the best-known Western folk music conforms to the pentatonic scale.
grammar.notes: however 是副词，不能单独用逗号连接两个句子，须用分号或句号。

grammar.title: conform to + 非限制性定语从句
grammar.skeleton: ... conforms to the pentatonic scale, + [which contains no half steps].
grammar.notes: conform to 表“遵照、符合”；a great deal of 修饰不可数名词 music。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：pitch 音高；亦作“球场、沥青、推销 (sales pitch)”
vibr- (摇动，来自拉丁语 vibrare) + -ation → 振动
frequent (频繁的) + -cy → 频率
equivalent: equi- (相等) + val- (价值) + -ent → 等价的
oct- (八) + -ave → 八度；同源 octopus (八爪鱼)、October (古罗马第八月)
con- (共同) + form (形状) → 形状一致 → 遵照、符合
penta- (五) + ton- (音) + -ic → 五声音阶的
熟词僻义：scale 音阶；亦作“规模、鳞片、天平”

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：对比主流规则与例外
模板：Most [category] is based on [rule A]; however, a great deal of the best-known [subcategory] conforms to [rule B], which [feature].
例句：Most modern architecture is based on steel frames; however, a great deal of the best-known traditional housing conforms to timber construction, which requires no welding.

🎵 托福物理×音乐：pitch 与 frequency

频率 (frequency) 越高 → 音高 (pitch) 越高；振幅 (amplitude) 越大 → 响度 (loudness) 越大。一个八度 (octave) 的两端音，频率恰好相差一倍 (2:1)。

title: UNIT 034 · 节奏的定义
body: Rhythm is the way music uses time, which includes characteristics such as duration of tones, silences, and repetition of patterns.
translation: 节奏是音乐运用时间的方式，它包括音的时值、休止以及模式的重复等特性。
insights: 【定义句中 the way 的译法】原文：Rhythm is the way music uses time。翻译精雕：节奏是音乐运用时间的方式。技巧：the way + 从句直接译为“……的方式”。
【非限制性定语从句的拆分】原文：which includes characteristics such as...。翻译精雕：它包括……等特性。技巧：用“它”复指，把列举放在“包括……等”之间。

grammar.title: the way + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Rhythm (主) + is (系) + the way + [(that/in which) music uses time].
grammar.notes: the way 后的定语从句可省略 that / in which。

grammar.title: which 从句 + such as 列举
grammar.skeleton: ..., + [which includes characteristics such as duration of tones, silences, and repetition of patterns].
grammar.notes: which 指代 the way（或 rhythm），从句中 such as 列举 characteristics 的具体内容。

vocab.root: 来自希腊语 rhythmos “有规律的流动” → 节奏
character (特性) + -istic → 特性/特征 (n.)；典型的 (adj.)
dur- (持续，来自拉丁语 durare) + -ation → 持续时间；同源 durable 耐用的、during
re- (再) + pet- (寻求) + -ition → 再次寻求 → 重复

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用“方式 + 包含要素”给抽象概念下定义
模板：[Concept] is the way [subject] uses [resource], which includes characteristics such as [A], [B], and [C].
例句：Style is the way a writer uses language, which includes characteristics such as word choice, sentence length, and tone.

title: UNIT 035 · 和弦与和声
body: The most important patterns that define the style of music are formed by pitches that overlap with one another in time, thereby, producing a chord, or harmony. Two or more tones heard simultaneously, may belong to separate melodies that fit well together. They may occupy different octave registers and have distinct rhythmic patterns, in other words, different shapes and contours, but still create a harmonic effect.
translation: 界定音乐风格的最重要的模式，是由在时间上相互重叠的音高构成的，从而产生和弦或和声。同时听到的两个或多个音，可能属于彼此协调的不同旋律。它们可能处于不同的八度音域，拥有截然不同的节奏型，换言之，具有不同的形态和起伏轮廓，但仍能产生和声效果。
insights: 【thereby 的结果译法】原文：..., thereby, producing a chord, or harmony。翻译精雕：从而产生和弦或和声。技巧：thereby + doing 表示“由此产生的结果”，译为“从而”。
【分词定语前置】原文：Two or more tones heard simultaneously。翻译精雕：同时听到的两个或多个音。技巧：过去分词短语前置为“的”字定语。
【in other words 的位置】原文：have distinct rhythmic patterns, in other words, different shapes and contours。翻译精雕：拥有截然不同的节奏型，换言之，具有不同的形态和起伏轮廓。技巧：保留“换言之”的解释功能，并重复动词“具有”使句子平衡。

grammar.title: 复杂主语 + 被动 + thereby doing
grammar.skeleton: The most important patterns [that define the style of music] (主) + are formed by (被动) + pitches [that overlap with one another in time], + thereby, producing a chord, or harmony.
grammar.notes: 两个 that 从句分别修饰 patterns 和 pitches；thereby + doing 表结果。

grammar.title: 分词定语 + may belong to
grammar.skeleton: Two or more tones [heard simultaneously], + may belong to + separate melodies [that fit well together].
grammar.notes: 主语与谓语之间不应有逗号，原文为风格性停顿。

grammar.title: 并列谓语 + but 转折
grammar.skeleton: They may [occupy different octave registers] and [have distinct rhythmic patterns], ... + but still create a harmonic effect.
grammar.notes: 三个谓语 occupy / have / create 共享主语 They；but still 表示“尽管不同，仍然……”。

vocab.meaning: 定义完整的，仔细定义过的
