title: UNIT 036 · 多声部乐谱
body: A musical score for a multipart composition is written as a set of notations using clefs on separate staves, which are all aligned, one above another. This type of score is used when a musical recital is performed by combinations of instruments or singers.
translation: 多声部乐曲的乐谱是用一套谱号记谱法写成的，各声部分别写在不同的五线谱上，这些五线谱上下对齐排列。当音乐演奏会由多种乐器或歌手组合表演时，就会使用这种乐谱。
insights: 【长被动句拆分】原文：A musical score for a multipart composition is written as a set of notations using clefs on separate staves, which are all aligned, one above another。翻译精雕：多声部乐曲的乐谱是用……写成的，各声部分别写在不同的五线谱上，这些五线谱上下对齐排列。技巧：把 on separate staves 与 which 从句分别拆出，逐层说明。
【when 从句提前】原文：This type of score is used when...。翻译精雕：当……时，就会使用这种乐谱。技巧：中文条件在前、结果在后。

grammar.notes: which 指代 staves；one above another 为独立结构，描述排列方式。

title: UNIT 037 · 管弦乐团的构成
body: An orchestra, in the narrowest sense, can be represented by an ensemble of Western musical instruments. At its core, it consists of a group of bowed-string instruments from the violin family, augmented by woodwind, brass and percussion instruments.
translation: 从最狭义上讲，管弦乐团可以代表一个由西方乐器组成的合奏团。其核心由小提琴家族的弓弦乐器组构成，并辅以木管乐器、铜管乐器和打击乐器加以扩充。
insights: 【in the narrowest sense】原文：An orchestra, in the narrowest sense, can be represented by...。翻译精雕：从最狭义上讲，管弦乐团可以代表……。技巧：插入语提前作句首状语，中文更流畅。
【augment 的译法】原文：augmented by woodwind, brass and percussion instruments。翻译精雕：并辅以木管乐器、铜管乐器和打击乐器加以扩充。技巧：过去分词表补充，用“辅以……”体现主次关系。

grammar.title: 插入语 + 被动
grammar.skeleton: An orchestra, [in the narrowest sense], + can be represented by + an ensemble of Western musical instruments.
grammar.notes: in the narrowest sense 插入语限定定义范围。

grammar.title: consist of + 过去分词补充
grammar.skeleton: At its core, + it consists of a group of bowed-string instruments [from the violin family], + [augmented by woodwind, brass and percussion instruments].
grammar.notes: augmented 修饰 a group of...，表示“被扩充”。

title: UNIT 038 · 打击乐器的分类
body: Percussion instruments, such as drums, are referred to as membranophones, where the sound is produced through the vibrations of a stretched skin or other membrane. Other types of percussion instruments are called idiophones when they produce sound through their natural resonance. This sound can be created from hollowed logs, bells, gongs, xylophones, and pianos, when the instrument is struck, rubbed, plucked, or shaken.
translation: 鼓之类的打击乐器被称为膜鸣乐器，其声音通过绷紧的皮革或其他薄膜的振动产生。其他类型的打击乐器若通过自身的自然共振发声，则被称为体鸣乐器。当乐器被敲击、摩擦、拨动或摇晃时，这种声音可以由中空的原木、铃、锣、木琴和钢琴等发出。
insights: 【where 从句的翻译】原文：..., where the sound is produced through the vibrations of a stretched skin...。翻译精雕：其声音通过……的振动产生。技巧：where 从句补充原理，用“其”承接。
【条件状语的提前】原文：are called idiophones when they produce sound through their natural resonance。翻译精雕：若通过自身的自然共振发声，则被称为体鸣乐器。技巧：when 表条件，译为“若……则……”。

grammar.skeleton: Percussion instruments, [such as drums], + are referred to as membranophones, + [where the sound is produced through the vibrations of a stretched skin or other membrane].
grammar.notes: be referred to as 表“被称为”；where 指代这类乐器的情形。

grammar.skeleton: Other types of percussion instruments + are called idiophones + when they produce sound through their natural resonance.
grammar.notes: be called + 名词补足语。

grammar.title: 四个过去分词并列

grammar.notes: struck (strike 的过去分词) / rubbed / plucked / shaken 共享 is。

🥁 乐器四大分类法 (Hornbostel–Sachs)
Idiophones (体鸣)：乐器本体振动发声，如木琴、锣。
Membranophones (膜鸣)：绷紧的膜振动，如鼓。
Chordophones (弦鸣)：琴弦振动，如吉他、竖琴。
Aerophones (气鸣)：空气柱振动，如长笛、小号。

title: UNIT 039 · 管乐器的发声原理
body: Wind instruments, or aerophones, produce sound by vibration. In the case of brass instruments, this is produced by the lips of the performers. Flutes, pipes and whistles create sound from a column of air split across a sharp edge, while the clarinet, saxophone, oboe and bassoon use the vibration from one or two reeds in a mouthpiece.
translation: 管乐器，又称气鸣乐器，通过振动发声。就铜管乐器而言，振动是由演奏者的嘴唇产生的。长笛、管笛和哨子通过被锐利边缘劈开的空气柱发声，而单簧管、萨克斯管、双簧管和巴松管则利用吹口中一片或两片簧片的振动发声。
insights: 【In the case of 的译法】原文：In the case of brass instruments, this is produced by the lips of the performers。翻译精雕：就铜管乐器而言，振动是由演奏者的嘴唇产生的。技巧：in the case of 译为“就……而言”；this 显化为“振动”。
【while 对比】原文：Flutes... create sound from..., while the clarinet... use the vibration from...。翻译精雕：……，而……则……。技巧：while 表对比，中文用“而……则……”。

grammar.notes: or aerophones 为术语性同位语。

grammar.notes: split 为过去分词（原形同形）作后置定语修饰 air。

title: UNIT 040 · 弦乐器的三大分支
body: The string family of musical instruments, or chordophones, has several branches. One branch includes the zither and dulcimer, where the strings are stretched across a flat body. A second branch includes the lute, guitar, and violin, where each instrument has a neck that allows the string tension to be adjusted. The third branch consists of instruments like the lyre and harp. These instruments use multiple strings, with each string having its individual pitch. The musical rendition is produced as the strings are plucked in sequence.
translation: 弦乐器家族，又称弦鸣乐器，有几个分支。第一个分支包括齐特琴和扬琴，其琴弦横跨在平整的琴身上。第二个分支包括鲁特琴、吉他和小提琴，每件乐器都有琴颈，可以调节琴弦的张力。第三个分支由里拉琴和竖琴等乐器组成。这些乐器使用多根琴弦，每根琴弦都有各自的音高。按顺序拨动琴弦，便能演奏出乐曲。
insights: 【分支列举的衔接】原文：One branch... A second branch... The third branch...。翻译精雕：第一个分支……第二个分支……第三个分支……。技巧：英文 One / A second / The third 统一译为序数，结构更清晰。
【with 独立主格】原文：with each string having its individual pitch。翻译精雕：每根琴弦都有各自的音高。技巧：with + 名词 + doing 独立主格结构，中文直接转为分句。
【as 从句的结果化】原文：The musical rendition is produced as the strings are plucked in sequence。翻译精雕：按顺序拨动琴弦，便能演奏出乐曲。技巧：主从句顺序调换，先动作后结果。

grammar.title: where 定语从句修饰抽象类别
grammar.skeleton: One branch includes the zither and dulcimer, + [where the strings are stretched across a flat body].
grammar.notes: where 修饰前面的乐器类别（情形），相当于 in which。

grammar.skeleton: These instruments use multiple strings, + [with each string having its individual pitch].
grammar.notes: with + 宾语 + 现在分词，补充说明伴随情况。

title: UNIT 041 · 钢琴的六大构造
body: The modern pianoforte has six major parts:（1）A frame, which is usually made of iron. Strings are attached on the string plate at the rear of the frame and stretched to the wrest plank at the front, where the tuning pins are located. The turning pins allow the tension of the strings to be regulated.（2）The soundboard is a thin piece of fine-grained spruce, placed under the strings to reinforce the tone by means of sympathetic vibrations.（3）The strings are made of steel wire of various length and thickness, ranging from treble to bass. The higher pitches are each given two or three strings, with each string tuned alike. The lower ones are single strings made heavier by being wound with a coil of thin copper wire, or overspun, as it is called.（4）The action is represented by the entire mechanism required to propel the felt wrapped hammers striking against the strings. The most visible part of the action is the keyboard, which is a row of keys manipulated by the fingers. The keys are made of ivory, or plastic, and each one corresponds to the chromatic tones created from striking the strings.（5）The pedals are levers pressed down by the feet. The loud pedal raises all the dampers which allow the strings to continue vibrating after the keys are released. The use of these pedals can produce subtle changes in tonal quality.（6）According to the shape of the case, pianos are classified as grand, square, and upright. Grand pianos are built in various sizes, from the full concert grand, 2.69m long, to the parlour, or baby grand, which is less than 1.8m long.
translation: 现代钢琴由六个主要部分构成：（1）骨架，通常由铁制成。琴弦固定在骨架后部的挂弦板上，并拉伸到前部的弦轴板，调音弦轴就位于那里。调音弦轴可以调节琴弦的张力。（2）音板是一块纹理细密的云杉薄板，置于琴弦下方，通过共振来增强音色。（3）琴弦由长度和粗细各异的钢丝制成，从高音区一直延伸到低音区。较高的音每个配有两到三根琴弦，每根琴弦的音调都调得相同。较低的音则是单根琴弦，通过缠绕一圈细铜丝使其更重，这种工艺被称为“缠弦”。（4）击弦机是指推动包裹着毛毡的音锤敲击琴弦所需的整套机械装置。击弦机最显眼的部分是键盘，即一排由手指操控的琴键。琴键由象牙或塑料制成，每个键都对应敲击琴弦所产生的半音阶音调。（5）踏板是用脚踩下的控制杆。延音踏板会抬起所有制音器，使琴弦在琴键松开后仍能继续振动。使用这些踏板可以使音质产生细微的变化。（6）根据琴箱的形状，钢琴可分为三角钢琴、方形钢琴和立式钢琴。三角钢琴有各种尺寸，从长 2.69 米的全尺寸音乐会三角钢琴，到长度不足 1.8 米的客厅三角钢琴，即小型三角钢琴。
insights: 【长篇说明文的分条翻译】原文按（1）—（6）分条说明构造。翻译精雕：保留编号，每条先给出部件名称再说明功能。技巧：说明文翻译要保持“部件—材料—位置—功能”的信息顺序，读者才能对照理解。
【by means of 的意译】原文：to reinforce the tone by means of sympathetic vibrations。翻译精雕：通过共振来增强音色。技巧：sympathetic vibration 是物理术语“共振/共鸣”，不能直译为“同情的振动”。
【as it is called 的处理】原文：or overspun, as it is called。翻译精雕：这种工艺被称为“缠弦”。技巧：as it is called 引出行业术语，单独成句并加引号。
【被动分类句】原文：pianos are classified as grand, square, and upright。翻译精雕：钢琴可分为三角钢琴、方形钢琴和立式钢琴。技巧：be classified as 译为“可分为”。

title: UNIT 042 · 小提琴的构造与演奏
body: A violin is made up of several parts starting with the front, also called the belly. The top, or soundboard, is usually made of well-seasoned spruce and the back, of well-seasoned maple. The ribs, neck, fingerboard, pegbox, scroll, bridge, tailpiece, and f-holes, or soundholes, represent the other parts that make up the complete instrument. The front, back and ribs are joined together to form a hollow sound box which is fitted with a sound post. This is a thin, dowel-like stick of wood, wedged inside and underneath, on the right side of the bridge. The bass-bar is a long strip of wood, glued to the inside of the front and under the left side of the bridge. This connects the front and back of the violin, and together with the sound post, it serves an important function in the transmission of the sound. These two parts also give additional support to the construction of the instrument. The strings are fastened to the tailpiece and suspended over the fingerboard by passing over the bridge, before being attached to the tuning pegs on the pegbox. The pegs allow the strings to be tuned for changing their pitch. The sounds of the violin are created from the vibration of the strings as the player draws the bow across them at right angles near the bridge. The singing tone and the potential to play rapid, brilliant, figurations, as well as lyrical melodies, are among the prized characteristics of the violin. Violinists can also create special effects by means of the following techniques: pizzicato, plucking, tremolo, etc.
translation: 小提琴由多个部分组成，首先是前部，也称面板。面板，即音板，通常由充分风干的云杉制成，背板则由充分风干的枫木制成。侧板、琴颈、指板、弦轴箱、琴头涡卷、琴马、系弦板以及 f 孔（即音孔）是构成整件乐器的其他部分。面板、背板和侧板拼接在一起，形成一个中空的共鸣箱，箱内装有音柱。音柱是一根细长的、类似暗榫的木棍，楔在琴马右侧下方的琴箱内部。低音梁是一条长木条，粘在面板内侧、琴马左侧的下方。它连接着小提琴的面板和背板，与音柱一起，在声音的传导中发挥着重要作用。这两个部件还为乐器的结构提供了额外的支撑。琴弦固定在系弦板上，越过琴马悬于指板上方，最后系在弦轴箱的调音弦轴上。弦轴可以用来给琴弦调音、改变音高。演奏者在琴马附近以直角方向用琴弓拉过琴弦，琴弦振动便产生了小提琴的声音。歌唱般的音色，以及既能演奏快速华丽的装饰音型、又能演奏抒情旋律的潜力，都是小提琴备受珍视的特质。小提琴手还可以通过以下技巧制造特殊效果：拨奏、拨弦、震音等。
insights: 【长句中省略的还原】原文：The top, or soundboard, is usually made of well-seasoned spruce and the back, of well-seasoned maple。翻译精雕：……背板则由充分风干的枫木制成。技巧：the back 后省略了 is usually made，逗号代替省略部分，翻译时必须补全。
【熟词僻义】原文：well-seasoned spruce。翻译精雕：充分风干的云杉。技巧：season 作动词指“使（木材）风干”，不是“季节”或“调味”。
【先后顺序的动作链】原文：The strings are fastened to..., suspended over... by passing over..., before being attached to...。翻译精雕：琴弦固定在……上，越过……悬于……上方，最后系在……上。技巧：按琴弦走向依次叙述，用“最后”替代 before being。
【among 的译法】原文：are among the prized characteristics of the violin。翻译精雕：都是小提琴备受珍视的特质。技巧：be among 意为“属于……之列”，译为“都是……之一/都是……”。

grammar.notes: as well as 连接 figurations 与 melodies；be among 表“属于其中”。

title: UNIT 043 · 摄影的化学原理
body: Photography uses the principles of light, optics, and chemistry. Silver salts are mixed with gelatin to form a light sensitive emulsion, which is applied in a thin layer to the surface of film, or another supporting material. When the emulsion is exposed to light, the silver halide crystals undergo a chemical change, which is then processed to give a negative image on the film. The stronger the light striking the emulsion, the denser or more opaque that part of the film becomes. The processed negative film is then used to produce a positive photograph on sensitized paper. The dense dark areas of the negative translate into light areas on the final photograph. Almost all modern photography relies on this negative-to-positive process.
translation: 摄影运用了光、光学和化学的原理。人们将银盐与明胶混合，形成一种感光乳剂，再将其薄薄地涂布在胶片或其他支撑材料的表面上。当乳剂曝光时，卤化银晶体会发生化学变化，经过冲洗处理后，便在胶片上形成负像。照射到乳剂上的光越强，胶片相应部分就变得越致密、越不透明。冲洗好的底片随后被用来在感光纸上印出正像照片。底片上致密的暗部，在最终的照片上会转化为亮部。几乎所有现代摄影都依赖这种由负到正的成像过程。
insights: 【the more..., the more... 的译法】原文：The stronger the light striking the emulsion, the denser or more opaque that part of the film becomes。翻译精雕：照射到乳剂上的光越强，胶片相应部分就变得越致密、越不透明。技巧：“越……就越……”是此句型的标准对译。

【被动 + 定语从句的拆分】原文：Silver salts are mixed with gelatin to form a light sensitive emulsion, which is applied in a thin layer to...。翻译精雕：人们将银盐与明胶混合，形成一种感光乳剂，再将其薄薄地涂布在……表面上。技巧：补主语“人们”，which 从句转为“再将其……”的连续动作。
【translate into 的意译】原文：translate into light areas。翻译精雕：转化为亮部。技巧：translate into 在非语言语境中表“转化为”，托福常考。

grammar.title: 被动 + 结果不定式 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Silver salts are mixed with gelatin + [to form a light sensitive emulsion], + [which is applied in a thin layer to the surface of film, or another supporting material].
grammar.notes: to form 表结果；which 指代 emulsion。

grammar.title: the + 比较级, the + 比较级
grammar.skeleton: The stronger the light [striking the emulsion] (is), + the denser or more opaque that part of the film becomes.
grammar.notes: 前半句省略 is；striking 现在分词作定语修饰 light。

grammar.title: rely on + 复合名词
grammar.skeleton: Almost all modern photography + relies on + this negative-to-positive process.
grammar.notes: negative-to-positive 为连字符复合形容词。

title: UNIT 044 · 相机的成像原理
body: In most cases, the camera and its lens determine the quality of the photographic image. Cameras work on the basic principle of the camera obscura, where light passes through a lens fitted into a lightproof box. An image of the camera's subject —— the object, person, or scene in front of the camera is cast onto the sensitised film installed at the rear of the camera. The amount of light striking the film, is called the exposure and this controlled by the size of the lens aperture and the speed of the shutter.
translation: 在大多数情况下，相机及其镜头决定了摄影图像的质量。相机的工作原理基于暗箱的基本原理：光线穿过安装在一个不透光盒子上的镜头。相机所拍摄的对象——即相机前方的物体、人物或景色——的影像被投射到安装在相机后部的感光胶片上。照射到胶片上的光量被称为曝光量，它由镜头光圈的大小和快门的速度来控制。
insights: 【work on the principle of】原文：Cameras work on the basic principle of the camera obscura。翻译精雕：相机的工作原理基于暗箱的基本原理。技巧：work on the principle of 是“基于……原理工作”的固定表达。
【破折号插入的处理】原文：An image of the camera's subject —— the object, person, or scene in front of the camera is cast onto...。翻译精雕：相机所拍摄的对象——即……——的影像被投射到……。技巧：破折号解释 subject，中文保留破折号并加“即”。
【熟词僻义】原文：subject。翻译精雕：拍摄对象。技巧：subject 在摄影中是“被摄体”，不是“主题/科目”。

grammar.title: where 从句解释原理
grammar.skeleton: Cameras work on the basic principle of the camera obscura, + [where light passes through a lens fitted into a lightproof box].
grammar.notes: fitted into 过去分词作定语修饰 lens。

grammar.title: 主语带破折号同位语 + 被动
grammar.skeleton: An image of the camera's subject [—— the object, person, or scene in front of the camera] + is cast onto + the sensitised film [installed at the rear of the camera].
grammar.notes: cast 原形与过去分词同形；installed 修饰 film。

grammar.title: 被动 + 并列宾语
grammar.skeleton: The amount of light [striking the film], is called the exposure + and this (is) controlled by the size of the lens aperture and the speed of the shutter.
grammar.notes: 原文 this controlled 省略了 is，规范应写作 this is controlled。

vocab.root: 拉丁语 camera (房间) + obscura (黑暗的) → 暗室/暗箱；camera 本义“房间”
熟词僻义：cast 投射 (cast a shadow 投下阴影)
熟词僻义：subject 被摄对象/实验对象

句型：说明某设备基于什么原理工作
模板：[Device] works on the basic principle of [principle], where [mechanism].
例句：A refrigerator works on the basic principle of heat exchange, where a refrigerant absorbs heat inside and releases it outside.

title: UNIT 045 · 戏剧的起源
body: Anthropologists and historians have traced the origins of theater to the mythology and rituals found in ancient ceremonies marking important passages in life. These ceremonies often involved dances by masked performers, and miming significant events related to fertility rites. Imitation, costumes, masks, makeup, gestures, dance, music, and pantomime are some of the theatrical elements found in early rituals.
translation: 人类学家和历史学家已将戏剧的起源追溯到古代仪式中的神话和礼仪，这些仪式标志着人生中的重要转折阶段。这些仪式通常包括戴面具的表演者跳舞，以及模仿与生育祭仪相关的重要事件。模仿、服装、面具、化妆、手势、舞蹈、音乐和哑剧，是早期仪式中所见的一些戏剧元素。
insights: 【trace...to 的译法】原文：have traced the origins of theater to the mythology and rituals...。翻译精雕：已将戏剧的起源追溯到……。技巧：trace A to B = 把 A 追溯到 B，托福高频结构。
【passages in life 的意译】原文：ceremonies marking important passages in life。翻译精雕：标志着人生中重要转折阶段的仪式。技巧：passage 此处指“过渡/转变”，即人类学的“通过仪式”(rites of passage)。
【更正原书误释】imitation 原书释为“道具”，实为“模仿”；fertility rite 实为“生育/丰饶祭仪”。技巧：词汇释义必须结合上下文核实。

grammar.title: trace A to B + 分词定语
grammar.skeleton: Anthropologists and historians have traced + the origins of theater + to the mythology and rituals [found in ancient ceremonies] [marking important passages in life].
grammar.notes: found 过去分词修饰 rituals；marking 现在分词修饰 ceremonies。

grammar.title: involve + 并列宾语
grammar.skeleton: These ceremonies often involved + [dances by masked performers], and [miming significant events related to fertility rites].
grammar.notes: 名词 dances 与动名词 miming 并列作 involved 的宾语。

myth (神话) + -ology (学说) → 神话体系/神话学
rite (仪式) + -ual → 仪式/惯例

vocab.meaning: 哑剧、滑稽剧；vt 模拟表演
（人生的）转折，过渡阶段 (rite of passage 成年礼/通过仪式)

vocab.root: panto- (全部) + mime (模仿) → 全身模仿 → 哑剧

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：追溯某事物的起源
模板：[Scholars] have traced the origins of [X] to [earlier practice] found in [context] marking [significance].
例句：Linguists have traced the origins of many English words to Latin roots found in medieval legal texts marking the influence of the Church.

🎭 人类学概念：Rites of Passage (通过仪式)

指标志人生阶段转变的仪式，如出生、成年、婚礼、葬礼。法国人类学家 van Gennep 将其分为三阶段：分离 (separation) → 过渡 (transition/liminality) → 融入 (incorporation)。

title: UNIT 046 · 剧场与戏剧制作
body: A theatre is a place where an actor, or actors provide entertainment to an audience. The type of entertainment usually conforms to a written or improvised text and includes costumes, scenery, lights, sound and various props. The production of theatrical performances requires the collaborative efforts of many creative people. These may include a dramatist, craftspeople, a set designer, a composer and possibly a choreographer if dancing is involved. The stage manager coordinates these people in working towards a common goal. Stage plays may be performed as a tragedy, a comedy, or a musical, but other types of entertainment include vaudeville performances, puppet shows and mime. Theatrical texts provide the vital framework of a performance, particularly if it is a drama. In Aristotle's famous definition, drama is an imitation of an action that is whole, complete and of a certain magnitude or scope.
translation: 剧场是一个或多个演员为观众提供娱乐的场所。这种娱乐通常依照书面剧本或即兴文本进行，包括服装、布景、灯光、音响和各种道具。戏剧演出的制作需要众多创意人员的通力合作，其中可能包括剧作家、手工艺人、布景设计师、作曲家，如果涉及舞蹈，可能还有编舞。舞台监督负责协调这些人员，使大家朝着共同的目标努力。舞台剧可以以悲剧、喜剧或音乐剧的形式上演，而其他类型的娱乐还包括歌舞杂耍表演、木偶戏和默剧。戏剧文本为演出提供了至关重要的框架，尤其当演出是一部戏剧作品时。在亚里士多德著名的定义中，戏剧是对一个完整、完全并具有一定规模或范围的行动的模仿。
insights: 【定义句的语序】原文：A theatre is a place where an actor, or actors provide entertainment to an audience。翻译精雕：剧场是一个或多个演员为观众提供娱乐的场所。技巧：where 从句前置为“的”字定语。
【条件后置】原文：and possibly a choreographer if dancing is involved。翻译精雕：如果涉及舞蹈，可能还有编舞。技巧：中文将条件提前，更符合逻辑顺序。
【亚里士多德定义的经典译法】原文：drama is an imitation of an action that is whole, complete and of a certain magnitude。翻译精雕：戏剧是对一个完整、完全并具有一定规模的行动的模仿。技巧：of + 抽象名词 = 形容词 (of a certain magnitude = 具有一定规模的)。
【更正原书误释】improvised text 原书释为“同步字幕”，实为“即兴文本”。

grammar.title: conform to + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: The type of entertainment + usually [conforms to a written or improvised text] and [includes costumes, scenery, lights, sound and various props].
grammar.notes: 两个谓语共享主语。

grammar.title: require + 名词 + These may include
grammar.skeleton: The production of theatrical performances + requires the collaborative efforts of many creative people. These may include ... and possibly a choreographer + [if dancing is involved].
grammar.notes: if 条件从句只修饰最后一项 choreographer。

grammar.title: of + 抽象名词作表语/定语
grammar.skeleton: drama is an imitation of an action + [that is whole, complete and of a certain magnitude or scope].

title: UNIT 047 · 剧场的目的与观众互动
body: A theater can serve many ends. It can be designed to entertain, to instruct, to motivate, to persuade, and even to shock. Whatever the intentions of the director, the result depends on the interaction between the performers and the audience. The reaction of the audience by way of laughter, tears, applause, or silence, provides an immediate feedback which can greatly affect the performance. Every performance has this interaction between the patrons in the auditorium and the actors on the stage. Ultimately, audiences make their opinions known through their attendance or non-attendance. They support what appeals to them, but will decline that support for what they find distasteful, offensive, or incomprehensible.
translation: 剧场可以服务于多种目的。它可以被设计来娱乐、教育、激励、说服，甚至震撼观众。无论导演的意图如何，最终效果都取决于表演者与观众之间的互动。观众以笑声、泪水、掌声或沉默所作出的反应，提供了即时反馈，而这种反馈会极大地影响演出。每一场演出中，观众席里的观众与舞台上的演员之间都存在这种互动。归根结底，观众通过是否到场观看来表达自己的看法。他们支持吸引自己的作品，而对于那些令他们反感、觉得冒犯或难以理解的作品，则会撤回支持。
insights: 【熟词僻义】原文：A theater can serve many ends。翻译精雕：剧场可以服务于多种目的。技巧：end 此处为“目的”(means and ends 手段与目的)，不是“结尾”。
【whatever 让步省略】原文：Whatever the intentions of the director, the result depends on...。翻译精雕：无论导演的意图如何，最终效果都取决于……。技巧：Whatever + 名词 (省略 may be) 为高级让步结构，译为“无论……如何”。
【attendance or non-attendance 的意译】原文：make their opinions known through their attendance or non-attendance。翻译精雕：通过是否到场观看来表达自己的看法。技巧：将正反两个名词合并为“是否……”，简洁传神。

grammar.title: 不定式并列作目的
grammar.skeleton: It can be designed + to entertain, to instruct, to motivate, to persuade, and even to shock.
grammar.notes: 五个不定式排比，and even 引出最强烈的一项，形成递进。

grammar.title: Whatever + 名词 让步
grammar.skeleton: Whatever the intentions of the director (may be), + the result depends on the interaction between the performers and the audience.
grammar.notes: whatever 引导让步状语从句，省略 be 动词，书面语常见。

grammar.title: make + 宾语 + 过去分词
grammar.skeleton: audiences make their opinions known + through their attendance or non-attendance.
grammar.notes: make sth. known 表“使……为人所知”，宾补用过去分词表被动。

grammar.title: what 引导宾语从句
grammar.skeleton: They support [what appeals to them], but will decline that support for [what they find distasteful, offensive, or incomprehensible].
grammar.notes: find + 宾语 + 形容词，宾语 what 前置。

af- (= ad-) + fect (做) → 对……做 → 影响；注意 effect 为名词“效果”

title: UNIT 048 · 导演与表演者
body: Directors are responsible for the overall interpretation of a script, and they have the authority to approve, control, and coordinate all the elements of a production. Performers, such as jugglers, mimes, minstrels, puppeteers, acrobats, clowns, singers, dancers, and amateur or professional actors and actresses, have existed throughout the ages. The earliest performers were most likely restricted to singers and dancers, as it wasn't until later when literary standards improved, that spoken dialogue emerged.
translation: 导演负责对剧本进行整体诠释，并有权批准、控制和协调一部作品的所有元素。杂耍艺人、哑剧演员、吟游诗人、木偶戏艺人、杂技演员、小丑、歌手、舞者以及业余或职业男女演员等表演者，自古以来就一直存在。最早的表演者很可能仅限于歌手和舞者，因为直到后来文学水准提高之后，口语对白才出现。
insights: 【be responsible for 的译法】原文：Directors are responsible for the overall interpretation of a script。翻译精雕：导演负责对剧本进行整体诠释。技巧：名词 interpretation 动词化为“进行诠释”。
【it was not until... that 强调句】原文：as it wasn't until later when literary standards improved, that spoken dialogue emerged。翻译精雕：因为直到后来文学水准提高之后，口语对白才出现。技巧：not until... that 固定译为“直到……才……”。
【文化负载词】原文：minstrels。翻译精雕：吟游诗人。技巧：中世纪四处演唱诗歌的艺人，有固定译名。

grammar.title: be responsible for + have the authority to do
grammar.skeleton: Directors are responsible for the overall interpretation of a script, + and they have the authority to [approve, control, and coordinate] all the elements of a production.
grammar.notes: 三个动词共享宾语 all the elements。

grammar.title: 主语 + such as 长插入 + 现在完成时
grammar.skeleton: Performers, [such as jugglers, ..., and amateur or professional actors and actresses], + have existed throughout the ages.
grammar.notes: 现在完成时 + throughout the ages 表示“自古至今一直”。

grammar.title: It was not until... that... 强调句
grammar.skeleton: as it wasn't until later [when literary standards improved], that spoken dialogue emerged.
grammar.notes: 强调句型 It is/was not until X that Y，原文中插入了 when 从句补充“later”的具体含义。

title: UNIT 049 · 剧院制作人的职责
body: In commercial and non-profit theatres, the producer is the person responsible for putting together the financing, the management staff, and the artistic team to produce the show. Usually, the producer works in tandem with a General Manager in arranging the rehearsals, the daily running of the production and the closing procedures. In this role, he or she, may select a season of several plays, hire the artistic teams and technical staff, work with a casting director to audition and cast actors in various parts, and control the theatre's funding. They also act as the final authority in administrative operations, but the artistic matters are usually left to the discretion of the director.
translation: 在商业剧院和非营利剧院中，制作人是负责筹集资金、组建管理团队和艺术团队来制作演出的人。通常，制作人与总经理协同合作，安排排练、作品的日常运营以及闭幕事宜。在这一角色中，他或她可能会挑选一个演出季的若干剧目，聘请艺术团队和技术人员，与选角导演合作试镜并为各个角色挑选演员，同时掌控剧院的资金。他们还是行政事务的最终决策者，但艺术方面的事务通常交由导演自行决定。
insights: 【put together 的多宾语】原文：responsible for putting together the financing, the management staff, and the artistic team。翻译精雕：负责筹集资金、组建管理团队和艺术团队。技巧：put together 搭配不同宾语时需拆分为不同动词：资金→筹集，团队→组建。
【in tandem with】原文：works in tandem with a General Manager。翻译精雕：与总经理协同合作。技巧：in tandem 原指“前后纵列（如双人自行车）”，引申为“协同”。
【left to the discretion of】原文：are usually left to the discretion of the director。翻译精雕：通常交由导演自行决定。技巧：at/to the discretion of 是固定表达“由……酌情决定”。

grammar.title: the person + 形容词短语后置
grammar.skeleton: the producer is the person + [responsible for putting together the financing, ... to produce the show].
grammar.notes: responsible for 形容词短语作后置定语 (= who is responsible for)。

grammar.title: 并列谓语排比

grammar.notes: 四个动词短语共享 may，体现职责清单。

grammar.title: but 转折 + be left to
grammar.skeleton: They also act as the final authority in administrative operations, + but the artistic matters are usually left to the discretion of the director.
grammar.notes: 行政 vs 艺术的分工对比。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：season 演出季 (theater season)

vocab.meaning: 负责挑选演员的人，星探
在试演中评估某一人物

title: UNIT 050 · 细胞：生命的基本单位
body: All living things are composed of cells. Some microscopic organisms, such as bacteria and protozoa, consist of a single cell and are classed as unicellular. Plants, animals and fungi, are multicellular as they are composed of a great many cells, working in concert.
translation: 所有生物都由细胞构成。一些微小的生物，如细菌和原生动物，仅由一个细胞组成，被归类为单细胞生物。植物、动物和真菌则是多细胞生物，因为它们由大量协同运作的细胞构成。
insights: 【be composed of 的标准译法】原文：All living things are composed of cells。翻译精雕：所有生物都由细胞构成。技巧：be composed of 译为“由……构成”。
【分类被动句】原文：are classed as unicellular。翻译精雕：被归类为单细胞生物。技巧：形容词 unicellular 补出中心词“生物”。
【分词短语的意译】原文：a great many cells, working in concert。翻译精雕：大量协同运作的细胞。技巧：in concert 意为“协同一致”，不是“在音乐会中”。

grammar.title: consist of + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: Some microscopic organisms, [such as bacteria and protozoa], + [consist of a single cell] and [are classed as unicellular].
grammar.notes: consist of (主动) 与 are classed as (被动) 两个谓语并列。

grammar.title: as 原因状语 + 分词定语
grammar.skeleton: Plants, animals and fungi, are multicellular + as they are composed of a great many cells, [working in concert].
grammar.notes: as 引导原因；working in concert 现在分词修饰 cells。

vocab.root: micro- (微小) + scop- (看) + -ic → 需用显微镜看的 → 极微小的
organ (器官) + -ism → 有机体/生物
proto- (最初的) + zoa (动物) → 原生动物
uni- (单一) + cellular (细胞的) → 单细胞的
fungus 的复数；来自拉丁语 fungus “蘑菇” → 真菌
multi- (多) + cellular → 多细胞的
熟词僻义：in concert 一致地、协力 (= together)

vocab.meaning: 许多的，大量的（+ 可数复数）

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：对事物按组成单位分类
模板：Some [things], such as [A] and [B], consist of a single [unit] and are classed as [category 1]. [C] and [D] are [category 2] as they are composed of a great many [units], working in concert.
例句：Some businesses, such as freelancers and solo consultants, consist of a single person and are classed as sole proprietorships. Corporations are classed differently as they are composed of a great many employees, working in concert.

title: UNIT 051 · 细胞的分子组成
body: The components of cells are molecules, which are nonliving structures formed from the union of atoms. Small molecules serve as building blocks for larger molecules. Proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates and lipids, which include fats and oils, are the four major molecules that underlie cell structure and also participate in cell functions.
translation: 细胞的组成成分是分子，分子是由原子结合而成的非生命结构。小分子是构成大分子的基本单元。蛋白质、核酸、碳水化合物和脂质（包括脂肪和油）是构成细胞结构基础并参与细胞功能的四大类主要分子。
insights: 【定语从句的拆分】原文：molecules, which are nonliving structures formed from the union of atoms。翻译精雕：分子，分子是由原子结合而成的非生命结构。技巧：重复“分子”作主语，使说明更清晰。
【serve as 的译法】原文：Small molecules serve as building blocks for larger molecules。翻译精雕：小分子是构成大分子的基本单元。技巧：serve as 译为“充当/是”，building block 是“构件/基本单元”。
【underlie 的译法】原文：underlie cell structure。翻译精雕：构成细胞结构基础。技巧：underlie 意为“构成……的基础”，托福高频。

grammar.title: 非限制性定语从句 + 过去分词
grammar.skeleton: The components of cells are molecules, + [which are nonliving structures [formed from the union of atoms]].
grammar.notes: formed from 修饰 structures，表“由……形成”。

grammar.title: 主语插入 which 从句 + 定语从句并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: Proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates and lipids, [which include fats and oils], + are the four major molecules + [that underlie cell structure and also participate in cell functions].
grammar.notes: 第一个 which 只修饰 lipids；that 从句中 underlie 与 participate 并列。

vocab.root: mole- (团块，来自拉丁语 moles) + -cule (小) → 小团块 → 分子
uni- (一) + -on → 合为一体 → 结合/联盟
a- (不) + tom (切) → 不可再分的 → 原子
来自希腊语 proteios “首要的” → 最重要的营养 → 蛋白质
nucle- (核) + -ic → 核的；核酸
carbo- (碳) + hydr- (水) + -ate → 碳水化合物
lip- (脂肪，来自希腊语 lipos) + -id → 脂质
under- (在下) + lie (躺) → 躺在下面 → 构成……的基础；underlying 潜在的/根本的
parti- (部分) + cip- (拿，来自拉丁语 capere) + -ate → 拿一部分 → 参与

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明基础单元构成复杂整体
模板：Small [units] serve as building blocks for larger [structures]. [A], [B], [C] and [D] are the four major [units] that underlie [X] and also participate in [Y].
例句：Small habits serve as building blocks for larger achievements. Sleep, diet, exercise and focus are the four major habits that underlie productivity and also participate in long-term health.

title: UNIT 052 · 真核细胞的细胞器
genre: 细胞生物学 / 说明文
body: The eukaryotic cell, cytoplasm, is similar to that of the prokaryote cell except for one major difference: eukaryotic cells house a nucleus and numerous other membrane-enclosed organelles. Like separate rooms of a house, these organelles enable specialised functions to be carried out efficiently. For example, the building of proteins and lipids takes place in separate organelles that use specialised enzymes, geared for each job.
translation: 真核细胞的细胞质与原核细胞的细胞质相似，只有一个主要区别：真核细胞内含有细胞核和许多其他由膜包被的细胞器。就像一栋房子里各自独立的房间一样，这些细胞器使得各项专门功能得以高效进行。例如，蛋白质和脂质的合成分别在不同的细胞器中进行，这些细胞器使用专为各自任务而设的特定酶。
insights: 【that of 的还原】原文：is similar to that of the prokaryote cell。翻译精雕：与原核细胞的细胞质相似。技巧：that 指代 cytoplasm，翻译时必须还原具体名词。
【熟词僻义】原文：eukaryotic cells house a nucleus...。翻译精雕：真核细胞内含有细胞核……。技巧：house 作动词意为“容纳/装有”，托福高频。
【比喻的保留】原文：Like separate rooms of a house...。翻译精雕：就像一栋房子里各自独立的房间一样。技巧：说明文中的类比有助于理解，应完整保留。

grammar.title: except for + 冒号解释
grammar.skeleton: The eukaryotic cell cytoplasm is similar to that of the prokaryote cell + except for one major difference: + eukaryotic cells house a nucleus and numerous other membrane-enclosed organelles.
grammar.notes: 冒号后具体说明 difference；membrane-enclosed 为复合形容词“被膜包围的”。

grammar.title: enable + 宾语 + to be done
grammar.skeleton: these organelles enable + specialised functions + to be carried out efficiently.
grammar.notes: enable sth. to be done 表“使某事得以完成”。

grammar.title: 动名词主语 + 定语从句 + 过去分词
grammar.skeleton: [the building of proteins and lipids] + takes place in separate organelles + [that use specialised enzymes], + [geared for each job].
grammar.notes: geared for 过去分词修饰 enzymes，表“为……而调配的”。

vocab.root: eu- (真正的) + karyo- (核，来自希腊语 karyon) + -tic → 真核的
cyto- (细胞) + plasm (形成物) → 细胞质
pro- (之前) + karyo- (核) → 核出现之前的 → 原核生物
熟词僻义：house v. 容纳、收藏 (The museum houses ...)
来自拉丁语 nucleus “果仁/核心” → 细胞核/原子核
organ (器官) + -elle (小) → 小器官 → 细胞器
en- (在内) + zyme (酵母，来自希腊语 zyme) → 在酵母中 → 酶
熟词僻义：gear v. 使适合 (be geared to/for 适应于)

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用类比说明内部分工的好处
模板：Like separate rooms of a house, these [parts] enable specialised functions to be carried out efficiently.
例句：Like separate departments of a company, these teams enable specialised tasks to be carried out efficiently.

句型：指出两者相似中的唯一主要区别
模板：[A] is similar to that of [B] except for one major difference: [A] [key feature].
例句：The new model is similar to that of its predecessor except for one major difference: it runs entirely on battery power.

title: UNIT 053 · 细胞核与染色体
genre: 细胞生物学 / 说明文
body: The nucleus is the largest organelle in an animal cell. It contains numerous strands of DNA, where the length of each strand is many times the diameter of the cell. Unlike the circular prokaryotic DNA, long sections of eukaryotic DNA pack into the nucleus by wrapping itself around the proteins. As a cell begins to divide, each DNA strand folds onto itself several times, thus forming a rod-shaped chromosome.
translation: 细胞核是动物细胞中最大的细胞器。它含有大量 DNA 链，每条链的长度都是细胞直径的许多倍。与环状的原核 DNA 不同，真核 DNA 的长片段通过缠绕在蛋白质上而被包装进细胞核。当细胞开始分裂时，每条 DNA 链会自身折叠若干次，从而形成杆状的染色体。
insights: 【倍数表达】原文：the length of each strand is many times the diameter of the cell。翻译精雕：每条链的长度都是细胞直径的许多倍。技巧：A is many times B 译为“A 是 B 的许多倍”。
【unlike 对比的处理】原文：Unlike the circular prokaryotic DNA, long sections of eukaryotic DNA pack into the nucleus...。翻译精雕：与环状的原核 DNA 不同，真核 DNA 的长片段……。技巧：unlike 置于句首表对比，译为“与……不同”。
【thus doing 的结果】原文：thus forming a rod-shaped chromosome。翻译精雕：从而形成杆状的染色体。技巧：thus + doing 表结果，译“从而”。

grammar.title: where 定语从句（非地点）
grammar.skeleton: It contains numerous strands of DNA, + [where the length of each strand is many times the diameter of the cell].
grammar.notes: where 相当于 in which，用于抽象“情形”修饰 strands。

grammar.title: unlike 对比 + by doing 方式
grammar.skeleton: Unlike the circular prokaryotic DNA, + long sections of eukaryotic DNA + pack into the nucleus + by wrapping itself around the proteins.
grammar.notes: itself 原文应为 themselves（指 sections），写作中注意代词一致。

grammar.title: As 时间状语 + thus doing
grammar.skeleton: As a cell begins to divide, + each DNA strand folds onto itself several times, + thus forming a rod-shaped chromosome.
grammar.notes: thus forming 现在分词表结果。

vocab.root: dia- (穿过) + meter (测量) → 穿过中心测量 → 直径
chromo- (颜色) + some (体) → 能被染色的物体 → 染色体

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用 unlike 对比两种结构的不同组织方式
模板：Unlike the [A], [B] [action] by [method].
例句：Unlike traditional libraries, digital archives store information by compressing it into searchable databases.

title: UNIT 054 · 植物细胞的特有结构
genre: 细胞生物学 / 说明文
body: Plant cells have all the components of animal cells, plus several other added features. These include chloroplasts, a central vacuole, and a cell wall. Chloroplasts use a process known as photosynthesis to convert the energy from the Sun into sugar glucose, a form of chemical energy. Chloroplasts, like mitochondria, possess a circular chromosome and prokaryote like ribosomes, which manufacture the proteins that the chloroplasts need. The vacuole, a membranous bag, crowds the cytoplasm and organelles to the edges of the cell. The central vacuole stores water, salts, sugars, proteins and other nutrients, as well as, the blue, red, and purple pigments that give certain flowers their colours.
translation: 植物细胞拥有动物细胞的所有组成部分，此外还具有几个额外的特征，包括叶绿体、中央液泡和细胞壁。叶绿体利用一种名为光合作用的过程，将太阳能转化为葡萄糖——一种化学能形式。与线粒体一样，叶绿体拥有环状染色体和类似原核生物的核糖体，核糖体负责制造叶绿体所需的蛋白质。液泡是一个膜质囊袋，它将细胞质和细胞器挤到细胞边缘。中央液泡储存水、盐、糖、蛋白质及其他养分，以及使某些花朵呈现色彩的蓝色、红色和紫色色素。
insights: 【plus 的译法】原文：Plant cells have all the components of animal cells, plus several other added features。翻译精雕：植物细胞拥有动物细胞的所有组成部分，此外还具有几个额外的特征。技巧：plus 作介词表“外加”，译为“此外还”。
【convert A into B】原文：to convert the energy from the Sun into sugar glucose。翻译精雕：将太阳能转化为葡萄糖。技巧：convert A into B 是托福科学文高频结构。
【crowd...to 的形象化】原文：crowds the cytoplasm and organelles to the edges of the cell。翻译精雕：将细胞质和细胞器挤到细胞边缘。技巧：crowd 作及物动词“挤压”，形象说明液泡占据大部分空间。

grammar.title: known as 引出术语 + 同位语
grammar.skeleton: Chloroplasts use a process [known as photosynthesis] + to convert the energy from the Sun into sugar glucose, [a form of chemical energy].
grammar.notes: a form of chemical energy 是 glucose 的同位语。

grammar.title: like 比较 + 非限制性定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Chloroplasts, [like mitochondria], + possess a circular chromosome and prokaryote like ribosomes, + [which manufacture the proteins [that the chloroplasts need]].
grammar.notes: which 修饰 ribosomes；that 从句修饰 proteins。

grammar.title: as well as + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: The central vacuole stores water, salts, ... nutrients, + as well as, the blue, red, and purple pigments + [that give certain flowers their colours].
grammar.notes: give sb. sth. 双宾语结构。

vocab.root: chloro- (绿色，来自希腊语 khloros) + plast (形成物) → 叶绿体
vacu- (空，来自拉丁语 vacuus) + -ole (小) → 小空泡 → 液泡
gluc- (甜，来自希腊语 glykys) + -ose (糖) → 葡萄糖
photo- (光) + synthesis (合成) → 光合作用
mito- (线) + chondr- (颗粒) → 线粒体 (单数 mitochondrion)
ribo- (核糖) + some (体) → 核糖体

vocab.meaning: 把…… 挤进…… ；把…… 塞进……

vocab.root: con- (完全) + vert (转) → 完全转变
nutri- (滋养，来自拉丁语 nutrire) + -ent → 营养物

句型：说明 A 在 B 的基础上增加了特征
模板：[A] has all the components of [B], plus several other added features. These include [X], [Y], and [Z].
例句：The premium plan has all the features of the basic plan, plus several other added benefits. These include cloud storage, priority support, and advanced analytics.

模板：[Agent] uses a process known as [process] to convert [input] into [output], a form of [category].
例句：The plant uses a process known as fermentation to convert sugar into ethanol, a form of renewable fuel.

title: UNIT 055 · 世界森林的八大类型
body: Forests may be divided into eight general types, on the basis of leaf characteristics and climate.（1）Deciduous forests are found in temperate regions similar to the eastern United States.（2）Deciduous monsoon forests are common throughout Southeast Asia, India, Bengal and Myanmar（formerly known as Burma）.（3）Tropical savanna forests are found in regions such as the campos of Brazil, where forest and grassland meet.（4）Northern coniferous forests form a worldwide belt in subarctic and alpine regions of the northern hemisphere.（5）Tropical rain forests are characteristic of central Africa and the Amazon watershed.（6）Temperate evergreen forests are found in the subtropical regions of North America and the Caribbean islands that have a warm maritime climate.（7）Temperate rain forests, with broad-leaved evergreen trees, are common on Mediterranean coasts.（8）Tropical scrub forests occur in regions of lesser rainfall, bordering the wetter rain forest regions.
translation: 根据叶片特征和气候，森林可分为八种主要类型。（1）落叶林分布在与美国东部相似的温带地区。（2）落叶季雨林常见于东南亚、印度、孟加拉和缅甸（旧称 Burma）。（3）热带稀树草原林分布在巴西坎普斯草原等森林与草原交汇的地区。（4）北方针叶林在北半球的亚北极和高山地区形成一条环绕全球的林带。（5）热带雨林是中非和亚马孙流域的典型特征。（6）温带常绿林分布在北美亚热带地区以及具有温暖海洋性气候的加勒比群岛。（7）拥有阔叶常绿树的温带雨林常见于地中海沿岸。（8）热带灌丛林出现在降雨量较少的地区，与较湿润的雨林地区相邻。
insights: 【on the basis of 的前置】原文：Forests may be divided into eight general types, on the basis of leaf characteristics and climate。翻译精雕：根据叶片特征和气候，森林可分为八种主要类型。技巧：分类依据前置，先说标准再说结果。
【be characteristic of】原文：Tropical rain forests are characteristic of central Africa and the Amazon watershed。翻译精雕：热带雨林是中非和亚马孙流域的典型特征。技巧：be characteristic of 意为“是……的特征/典型”，不是“有特征”。
【分布动词的变化】原文用 are found / are common / form / occur 多种表达分布。翻译精雕：分布在 / 常见于 / 形成 / 出现在。技巧：中文同样需要变换动词避免单调。

grammar.title: 被动 + on the basis of
grammar.skeleton: Forests + may be divided into + eight general types, + on the basis of leaf characteristics and climate.
grammar.notes: be divided into 表分类；on the basis of = based on。

grammar.title: where 定语从句修饰地点
grammar.skeleton: Tropical savanna forests are found in regions such as the campos of Brazil, + [where forest and grassland meet].
grammar.notes: where 指代 regions。

grammar.title: 现在分词作伴随/定语
grammar.skeleton: Tropical scrub forests occur in regions of lesser rainfall, + [bordering the wetter rain forest regions].
grammar.notes: bordering 现在分词，表“与……接壤”。

vocab.root: deciduous: de- (向下) + cid- (落下，来自拉丁语 cadere) + -uous → 落下的 → 落叶的
monsoon 来自阿拉伯语 mawsim “季节” → 季风
savanna 来自泰诺语 zabana → 热带稀树草原
conifer: coni- (球果) + fer (携带) → 带球果的 → 针叶树
sub- (次/近) + arctic (北极的) → 亚北极的
alpine 来自 Alps (阿尔卑斯山) → 高山的
hemi- (半) + sphere (球) → 半球
water + shed (分开) → 分水岭/流域；引申“转折点”
temperate: temper- (调和) + -ate → 温和的
mari- (海，来自拉丁语 mare) + -time → 海洋的/海事的

模板：[Things] may be divided into [number] general types, on the basis of [criterion A] and [criterion B].
例句：Learning styles may be divided into four general types, on the basis of how learners perceive and process information.

🌲 托福生态：deciduous vs evergreen
deciduous 落叶的 (秋冬落叶，如枫树、橡树)
evergreen 常绿的 (四季保持叶片，如松树)
coniferous 针叶的、结球果的 (大多为常绿树)
broad-leaved 阔叶的

title: UNIT 056 · 美国的三大森林区
body: Three major forest areas exist in the United States. The western forests of the Rocky Mountains and the Pacific coast, are coniferous and contain Douglas fir, ponderosa pine, western white pine, Engelmann spruce, and white fir. More than half of the softwood lumber yield of the United States comes from the productive Douglas fir forests of the Pacific Northwest. The South Atlantic and Gulf states, account for most of the remaining softwood lumber, which is milled from longleaf, shortleaf, loblolly, and slash pines. Hardwoods make up about one-fourth of the total US production, and mainly come from the eastern half of the United States. Particularly dense hardwood stands are found in the area surrounding the Mississippi and Ohio river valleys. Oak, black walnut, yellow poplar, and sugar maple, are among the many hardwood species used commercially.
translation: 美国有三大森林区。落基山脉和太平洋沿岸的西部森林是针叶林，包括花旗松、西黄松、西部白松、恩氏云杉和白冷杉。美国一半以上的软木木材产量来自太平洋西北地区高产的花旗松林。南大西洋和墨西哥湾沿岸各州提供了其余大部分软木木材，这些木材由长叶松、短叶松、火炬松和湿地松加工而成。硬木约占美国木材总产量的四分之一，主要来自美国东半部。在密西西比河和俄亥俄河流域周边地区，分布着尤为茂密的硬木林。橡树、黑胡桃、北美鹅掌楸和糖枫都属于众多被用于商业用途的硬木树种。
insights: 【account for 的译法】原文：account for most of the remaining softwood lumber。翻译精雕：提供了其余大部分软木木材。技巧：account for 表“占（比例）”，此处译为“提供了……大部分”更自然。
【比例表达】原文：Hardwoods make up about one-fourth of the total US production。翻译精雕：硬木约占美国木材总产量的四分之一。技巧：make up / account for + 比例 = “占……”。
【熟词僻义】原文：dense hardwood stands。翻译精雕：茂密的硬木林。技巧：stand 在林业中指“林分/树丛”，不是“站立”。

grammar.title: 比例主语 + come from
grammar.skeleton: More than half of the softwood lumber yield of the United States + comes from + the productive Douglas fir forests of the Pacific Northwest.
grammar.notes: More than half of + 不可数名词作主语，谓语用单数。

grammar.title: account for + which 从句
grammar.skeleton: The South Atlantic and Gulf states, account for most of the remaining softwood lumber, + [which is milled from longleaf, shortleaf, loblolly, and slash pines].
grammar.notes: be milled from 表“由……加工而成”。

grammar.title: be among + 分词定语
grammar.skeleton: Oak, black walnut, yellow poplar, and sugar maple, + are among the many hardwood species [used commercially].
grammar.notes: used commercially 修饰 species。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：yield n. 产量；v. 产出、屈服、让路
account for 1) 占比例 2) 解释说明 3) 导致——托福必考多义短语
熟词僻义：stand n. 林分、一片树林 (a stand of trees)

vocab.meaning: 北美鹅掌揪（poplar ，相当于中国人说的 “杨树”）

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述比例与来源
模板：More than half of [total] comes from [source A]. [Source B] accounts for most of the remaining [X], and [category C] makes up about one-fourth of the total.
例句：More than half of the city's electricity comes from hydropower. Natural gas accounts for most of the remaining supply, and solar makes up about one-fourth of the total.

📊 托福必考：account for 三义

1. 占比例：Women account for 60% of students.
2. 解释：How do you account for the delay?
3. 导致/造成：Weather accounted for the poor harvest.
阅读词汇题常让你根据语境判断义项。

title: UNIT 057 · 雨林的界定标准
body: The classification of a rain forest is defined by its closed canopy, where the treetops, or crowns, touch each other and create a shaded forest interior. In addition, temperature and rainfall must be high and relatively even throughout the year. Forests that meet these criteria are found flanking the equator in South and Central America, Asia, Africa, and Australia.
translation: 雨林的分类以其郁闭的林冠为标准，即树梢（或称树冠）彼此相接，形成荫蔽的森林内部。此外，全年的气温和降雨量必须都很高，并且相对均衡。符合这些标准的森林分布在赤道两侧的南美洲和中美洲、亚洲、非洲以及澳大利亚。
insights: 【被动定义句】原文：The classification of a rain forest is defined by its closed canopy。翻译精雕：雨林的分类以其郁闭的林冠为标准。技巧：be defined by 译为“以……为标准/界定”。
【meet criteria】原文：Forests that meet these criteria。翻译精雕：符合这些标准的森林。技巧：meet 搭配 criteria/standards/requirements 译为“符合、满足”。
【熟词僻义】原文：are found flanking the equator。翻译精雕：分布在赤道两侧。技巧：flank 作动词意为“位于……两侧”，源自名词“侧翼”。

grammar.title: 被动 + where 从句
grammar.skeleton: The classification of a rain forest is defined by its closed canopy, + [where the treetops, or crowns, touch each other and create a shaded forest interior].
grammar.notes: where 从句具体解释 closed canopy。

grammar.title: be found doing
grammar.skeleton: Forests [that meet these criteria] + are found + flanking the equator in South and Central America, Asia, Africa, and Australia.
grammar.notes: be found + doing 表“被发现处于……状态”。

vocab.meaning: 天篷：树林中最上面一层
vocab.root: 来自希腊语 konopeion “蚊帐” → 华盖 → 林冠层
熟词僻义：crown 树冠；牙冠
criterion 的复数；来自希腊语 kriterion “判断的手段” → 标准
熟词僻义：flank v. 位于两侧；n. 侧面、侧翼
equa- (相等) + -tor → 把地球平分的线 → 赤道

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明界定某类事物的标准
模板：The classification of [X] is defined by [key feature], where [explanation]. In addition, [condition] must be [requirement].
例句：The classification of a desert is defined by its low precipitation, where annual rainfall stays below 250 mm. In addition, evaporation must exceed rainfall.

📚 拉丁/希腊复数

criterion → criteria；phenomenon → phenomena；datum → data；bacterium → bacteria；fungus → fungi；nucleus → nuclei。托福写作中误用 a criteria / a phenomena 是常见扣分点。

title: UNIT 058 · 花的结构与功能
body: The flower is the reproductive mechanism of most seed-bearing plants and their function is to carry out the multiple roles of sexual reproduction, seed development, and fruit production. Many plants produce highly visible flowers that have a distinctive size, colour, and fragrance. Almost everyone is familiar with the beautiful rose flowers, orchids, and tulips. Other plants, such as, oaks, beeches, maples, and grasses have small, green or gray flowers that go unnoticed. Whether eye-catching or inconspicuous, all flowers produce either male or female organs required for reproduction. Botanists call the cone, bearing plants, ‘gymnosperms’, which means ‘naked seeds’. Flowering plants are termed ‘angiosperms’, which means ‘enclosed seeds’. Most flowers are composed of four parts, arranged in concentric rings attached to the tip of the stem. The innermost part is the pistil which is mounted on the top of the stamen. This is surrounded by petals and the sepals that form the initial bud, or calyx of the flower.
translation: 花是大多数种子植物的繁殖器官，其功能是承担有性生殖、种子发育和果实生产等多重角色。许多植物会开出非常显眼的花，具有独特的大小、颜色和香气。几乎每个人都熟悉美丽的玫瑰、兰花和郁金香。而其他植物，如橡树、山毛榉、枫树和禾草，开的是不易被注意的绿色或灰色小花。无论是引人注目还是不起眼，所有的花都会产生繁殖所需的雄性或雌性器官。植物学家将结球果的植物称为“裸子植物”，意为“裸露的种子”。开花植物被称为“被子植物”，意为“被包裹的种子”。大多数花由四个部分组成，呈同心环状排列，附着在茎的顶端。最内层是雌蕊，位于雄蕊顶部之上。它被花瓣和萼片所环绕，萼片构成了花最初的花蕾，即花萼。
insights: 【go unnoticed】原文：small, green or gray flowers that go unnoticed。翻译精雕：不易被注意的绿色或灰色小花。技巧：go + 过去分词表状态（go unnoticed 无人注意），是托福高频表达。
【Whether... or... 让步省略】原文：Whether eye-catching or inconspicuous, all flowers produce...。翻译精雕：无论是引人注目还是不起眼，所有的花都会……。技巧：Whether (they are) A or B 省略式，译“无论……还是……”。
【术语词源的保留】原文：‘gymnosperms’, which means ‘naked seeds’。翻译精雕：“裸子植物”，意为“裸露的种子”。技巧：术语 + 词源解释对理解极有帮助，应完整翻译。

grammar.title: 主系表 + 不定式表语
grammar.skeleton: The flower is the reproductive mechanism of most seed-bearing plants + and their function is + to carry out the multiple roles of [sexual reproduction, seed development, and fruit production].
grammar.notes: 不定式作表语说明 function。

grammar.title: Whether... or... 让步 + 分词定语
grammar.skeleton: Whether eye-catching or inconspicuous, + all flowers produce either male or female organs + [required for reproduction].
grammar.notes: required 修饰 organs。

grammar.title: call + 宾语 + 宾补 + which 从句
grammar.skeleton: Botanists call the cone bearing plants ‘gymnosperms’, + [which means ‘naked seeds’].
grammar.notes: call A B 结构；原文 cone, bearing 中的逗号多余，应为 cone-bearing。

grammar.title: 被动 + 分词 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Most flowers are composed of four parts, + [arranged in concentric rings] + [attached to the tip of the stem].
grammar.notes: 两个过去分词短语层层修饰。

vocab.root: reproduce: re- (再) + produce (生产) → 繁殖
fragr- (散发气味，来自拉丁语 fragrare) + -ance → 香味
in- (不) + con- + spic- (看) + -uous → 不易被看见的 → 不显眼的；反义 conspicuous
botan- (植物，来自希腊语 botane) + -ist → 植物学家
gymno- (裸露的，来自希腊语 gymnos) + sperm (种子) → 裸子植物
angio- (容器，来自希腊语 angeion) + sperm (种子) → 被子植物
con- (共同) + centr- (中心) + -ic → 同心的
另义：stem from 起源于 (托福高频)

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述某器官/机制的功能
模板：[X] is the [type] mechanism of [Y] and its function is to carry out the multiple roles of [role A], [role B], and [role C].
例句：The liver is the main metabolic organ of the body and its function is to carry out the multiple roles of detoxification, protein synthesis, and bile production.

句型：无论表象如何，本质相同
模板：Whether [adj. A] or [adj. B], all [things] [shared function].
例句：Whether large or small, all companies rely on customer trust.

🌸 托福生物：gymnosperm vs angiosperm
Gymnosperms (裸子植物)：种子裸露，无果实包裹，如松、柏、银杏。
Angiosperms (被子植物)：种子包裹在子房（果实）中，会开花，占现存植物的约 90%。

title: UNIT 059 · 细菌的结构特征
body: Bacteria lack a true nucleus and this is the feature that distinguishes them from plant and animal cells. Plants and animals have a saclike nucleus which carries the genetic material in the form of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA). Bacteria cells have a tough, but resilient shell, which protects the usual looping or coiling DNA that floats within their cells.
translation: 细菌缺乏真正的细胞核，这正是它们区别于植物细胞和动物细胞的特征。植物和动物拥有囊状的细胞核，它以脱氧核糖核酸（DNA）的形式携带遗传物质。细菌细胞有一层坚韧而富有弹性的外壳，保护着通常呈环状或盘绕状、漂浮在细胞内的 DNA。
insights: 【distinguish A from B】原文：the feature that distinguishes them from plant and animal cells。翻译精雕：它们区别于植物细胞和动物细胞的特征。技巧：distinguish A from B 主动结构译为“A 区别于 B”。
【in the form of】原文：carries the genetic material in the form of DNA。翻译精雕：以 DNA 的形式携带遗传物质。技巧：in the form of 译为“以……的形式”。
【tough but resilient】原文：a tough, but resilient shell。翻译精雕：坚韧而富有弹性的外壳。技巧：but 连接两个看似矛盾的形容词，中文用“而”连接。

grammar.title: 并列句 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Bacteria lack a true nucleus + and this is the feature + [that distinguishes them from plant and animal cells].
grammar.notes: lack 是及物动词，不用 lack of（名词才用 lack of）。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + in the form of
grammar.skeleton: Plants and animals have a saclike nucleus + [which carries the genetic material in the form of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA)].
grammar.notes: which 指代 nucleus。

grammar.title: 双层定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Bacteria cells have a tough, but resilient shell, + [which protects the usual looping or coiling DNA [that floats within their cells]].
grammar.notes: which 修饰 shell，that 修饰 DNA。

vocab.root: 来自希腊语 bakterion “小棍” (早期显微镜下细菌呈杆状) → 细菌
di- (分开) + sting- (刺) + -uish → 刺点分开 → 区分
genetic: gen- (产生/基因) + -etic → 遗传的
de- (去) + oxy- (氧) + ribo- (核糖) + nucleic (核的) → 脱氧核糖核酸
re- (回) + sil- (跳，来自拉丁语 salire) + -ient → 弹回的 → 有弹性的/适应力强的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：指出区分两类事物的关键特征
模板：[A] lacks [feature], and this is the feature that distinguishes [A] from [B].
例句：Viruses lack their own metabolism, and this is the feature that distinguishes them from living cells.

💪 托福高频：resilient / resilience

resilient 原义“弹性的”，托福中常引申为“有恢复力的、适应力强的”：resilient ecosystems (有恢复力的生态系统)、resilient economy。同义：flexible, adaptable, tough。

title: UNIT 060 · 病毒的结构
body: A virus is an infectious agent that is found in the life forms of humans, animals, plants, fungi, and bacteria. The genetic material of a virus can be either deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), or ribonucleic acid (RNA). This material is surrounded by a protective coating of protein, called a capsid, and can exist with, or without, an outer lipid envelope.
translation: 病毒是一种感染因子，存在于人类、动物、植物、真菌和细菌等生命形式中。病毒的遗传物质既可以是脱氧核糖核酸（DNA），也可以是核糖核酸（RNA）。这种遗传物质被一层称为衣壳的蛋白质保护外壳包裹，外面可能有也可能没有一层脂质包膜。
insights: 【either...or 的译法】原文：can be either DNA, or RNA。翻译精雕：既可以是 DNA，也可以是 RNA。技巧：either A or B 译为“既可以是……也可以是……”或“要么……要么……”。
【with, or without 的处理】原文：can exist with, or without, an outer lipid envelope。翻译精雕：外面可能有也可能没有一层脂质包膜。技巧：with or without 译为“可能有也可能没有”，简洁对称。
【熟词僻义】原文：envelope。翻译精雕：包膜。技巧：envelope 在生物学中指“包膜”，不是“信封”。

grammar.title: 定义句 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: A virus is an infectious agent + [that is found in the life forms of humans, animals, plants, fungi, and bacteria].
grammar.notes: that 从句修饰 agent。

grammar.title: 被动 + 分词 + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: This material + [is surrounded by a protective coating of protein, called a capsid], + and [can exist with, or without, an outer lipid envelope].
grammar.notes: called a capsid 修饰 coating；两个谓语共享主语。

vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 virus “毒液” → 病毒
infect: in- (进入) + fect (做) → 进入体内作用 → 感染

vocab.meaning: 衣壳（包裹着一个病毒粒子的蛋白质外壳）
vocab.root: caps- (盒子，来自拉丁语 capsa) + -id → 衣壳

vocab.meaning: 包裹性的结构或包皮，例如膜，或者病毒的包膜
vocab.root: 熟词僻义：envelope 病毒包膜

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明某物可能有两种形式
模板：The [component] of [X] can be either [A], or [B]. This [component] is surrounded by [layer], and can exist with, or without, [optional part].
例句：The core of the program can be either open-source, or proprietary. This core is wrapped by a user interface, and can exist with, or without, cloud integration.

title: UNIT 061 · 四类生物大分子
body:
The most important classes of biomolecules are nucleic acids, proteins, carbohydrates, and lipids. Nucleic acids are responsible for storing and transferring genetic information. They are enormous molecules made up of long strands of subunits, arranged in a precise sequence called ‘bases’. These subunits are “read” by other components of the cell and used as a guide in making proteins. Proteins are large molecules built up of small subunits called ‘amino acids’. The proteins of greatest interest to biochemists are the enzymes, which serve as catalysts in chemical reactions.

Carbohydrates are the basic fuel molecules of the cell and contain carbon, hydrogen and oxygen in approximately equal amounts. Green plants and some bacteria use a process known as photosynthesis to make simple carbohydrates (sugars) from carbon dioxide, water and sunlight. Animals obtain their carbohydrates from foods. A cell can convert its carbohydrates to yield chemical energy, or use it as raw material to produce other biomolecules. Lipids are fatty substances that play a variety of roles in the cell. Some lipids are held in storage for use as high-energy fuel while others serve as essential components of the cell membrane.
translation:
最重要的几类生物分子是核酸、蛋白质、碳水化合物和脂质。核酸负责储存和传递遗传信息。它们是巨大的分子，由按精确顺序排列的长链亚单位构成，这些亚单位被称为“碱基”。这些亚单位会被细胞的其他组分“读取”，并作为合成蛋白质的指导。蛋白质是由称为“氨基酸”的小亚单位构成的大分子。生物化学家最感兴趣的蛋白质是酶，它们在化学反应中充当催化剂。

碳水化合物是细胞的基本燃料分子，含有大致等量的碳、氢和氧。绿色植物和某些细菌利用一种被称为光合作用的过程，用二氧化碳、水和阳光制造简单的碳水化合物（糖）。动物则从食物中获取碳水化合物。细胞可以转化碳水化合物以产生化学能，或将其用作生产其他生物分子的原料。脂质是在细胞中发挥多种作用的脂肪类物质。一些脂质被储存起来作为高能燃料使用，而另一些则是细胞膜的重要组成部分。
insights: 【引号词的翻译】原文：These subunits are “read” by other components of the cell。翻译精雕：这些亚单位会被细胞的其他组分“读取”。技巧：原文引号表示比喻用法，译文保留引号。
【of greatest interest to】原文：The proteins of greatest interest to biochemists are the enzymes。翻译精雕：生物化学家最感兴趣的蛋白质是酶。技巧：of interest to sb. 表“某人感兴趣的”，转换为主动表达。
【while 对比】原文：Some lipids are held in storage... while others serve as...。翻译精雕：一些脂质被储存起来……，而另一些则是……。技巧：Some... while others... 译为“一些……而另一些则……”。

grammar.title: be responsible for + doing
grammar.skeleton: Nucleic acids are responsible for + storing and transferring genetic information.
grammar.notes: 两个动名词共享宾语 genetic information。

grammar.title: 双层后置修饰
grammar.skeleton: They are enormous molecules [made up of long strands of subunits], [arranged in a precise sequence called ‘bases’].
grammar.notes: 原文 called ‘bases’ 在语义上指 subunits，修饰关系较远，阅读时需判断。

grammar.title: of + 抽象名词作定语 + 非限制性从句
grammar.skeleton: The proteins [of greatest interest to biochemists] are the enzymes, + [which serve as catalysts in chemical reactions].
grammar.notes: serve as 表“充当”。

grammar.title: Some... while others...
grammar.skeleton: Some lipids are held in storage for use as high-energy fuel + while others serve as essential components of the cell membrane.
grammar.notes: while 表对比。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：class 类别 (classify 分类)
e- (出) + norm (标准) + -ous → 超出标准的 → 巨大的

vocab.meaning: 碱基：嘌呤（腺嘌呤和鸟嘌呤）或嘧啶（胸嘧啶、胸腺嘧啶和尿嘧啶）的一种
vocab.root: 熟词僻义：base 碱基；化学中“碱”
pre- (预先) + cis- (切) + -e → 预先切好的 → 精确的
sequ- (跟随) + -ence → 顺序；gene sequence 基因序列
cata- (向下/完全) + lyst (分解，来自希腊语 lyein) → 促进分解的东西 → 催化剂；引申“促进因素”
hydro- (水) + gen (产生) → 生成水的元素 → 氢
oxy- (酸) + gen (产生) → 产生酸的元素 → 氧
ap- (= ad-) + proxim- (最近) + -ate + -ly → 接近地 → 大约
di- (二) + oxide (氧化物) → 二氧化物
ob- (加强) + tain (拿住，来自拉丁语 tenere) → 获得

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明某物充当某种角色
模板：The [items] of greatest interest to [experts] are the [subtype], which serve as [role] in [process].
例句：The species of greatest interest to ecologists are the keystone species, which serve as anchors in their ecosystems.

句型：对比同类事物的不同用途
模板：Some [X] are [used for A] while others serve as [B].
例句：Some forests are preserved for recreation while others serve as sources of timber.

⚗️ 托福高频：catalyst 的引申义

catalyst 本义“催化剂”，托福阅读常用于引申义“促进因素、导火索”：The invention of the steam engine was a catalyst for the Industrial Revolution.

title: UNIT 062 · 药物与人类寿命
body: The availability of new and highly effective drugs helped increase the average American's life span from about 60 years in 1900, to about 78 years in 2005. Many drugs are used in medicine to diagnose, cure and prevent the occurrence of diseases and disorders. Because these substances affect the function of living cells, they can also help prolong the life of patients with incurable conditions. Drugs are classed as antibiotics fighting bacterial infections and vaccines which help prevent diseases caused by bacteria and viruses. During the 20th century, drugs enabled the eradication of the previously widespread and often fatal disease, smallpox. By the early 21st century, vaccines have led to the near eradication of poliomyelitis, the long feared cause of paralysis.
translation: 新型高效药物的出现，帮助美国人的平均寿命从 1900 年的约 60 岁延长到 2005 年的约 78 岁。医学中使用许多药物来诊断、治疗和预防疾病与身体失调的发生。由于这些物质会影响活细胞的功能，它们还能帮助延长身患不治之症的患者的生命。药物可分为对抗细菌感染的抗生素和有助于预防由细菌和病毒引起的疾病的疫苗。20 世纪，药物使人类根除了曾经广泛流行且往往致命的天花。到 21 世纪初，疫苗已使长期令人恐惧的瘫痪病因——小儿麻痹症几近根除。
insights: 【availability 的意译】原文：The availability of new and highly effective drugs。翻译精雕：新型高效药物的出现。技巧：availability 字面为“可获得性”，在此语境中意译为“出现/普及”更自然。
【from... to... 数据对比】原文：from about 60 years in 1900, to about 78 years in 2005。翻译精雕：从 1900 年的约 60 岁延长到 2005 年的约 78 岁。技巧：数据描述保持时间与数值配对，加“延长到”体现变化。
【enable the eradication of】原文：drugs enabled the eradication of...smallpox。翻译精雕：药物使人类根除了……天花。技巧：名词 eradication 转为动词“根除”，补出施动者“人类”。

grammar.title: help (to) do + from... to...
grammar.skeleton: The availability of new and highly effective drugs + helped increase + the average American's life span + from about 60 years in 1900, to about 78 years in 2005.
grammar.notes: help do 可省略 to。

grammar.title: because 原因 + help do
grammar.skeleton: Because these substances affect the function of living cells, + they can also help prolong the life of patients [with incurable conditions].
grammar.notes: condition 在医学语境指“病症”。

grammar.title: 同位语后置
grammar.skeleton: drugs enabled the eradication of the previously widespread and often fatal disease, + smallpox.
grammar.notes: smallpox 是 disease 的同位语，置于句末形成强调。

grammar.title: 现在完成时 + 同位语
grammar.skeleton: By the early 21st century, vaccines have led to the near eradication of poliomyelitis, + [the long feared cause of paralysis].
grammar.notes: By + 过去时间点 一般用过去完成时，原文用现在完成时强调对现在的影响。

vocab.root: dia- (穿过) + gnose (知道，来自希腊语 gnosis) → 看穿而知 → 诊断
pro- (向前) + long (长) → 延长
熟词僻义：condition 疾病、病症 (a heart condition 心脏病)
anti- (反) + bio- (生命) + -tic → 抗生素
来自拉丁语 vacca “牛” (牛痘疫苗) → 疫苗
e- (出) + radic- (根，来自拉丁语 radix) + -ation → 连根拔出 → 根除
fat- (命运，来自拉丁语 fatum) + -al → 命中注定的 → 致命的

vocab.meaning: 小儿麻痹症，急性骨髓灰白质炎

vocab.root: para- (旁边) + lysis (松开) → 一侧松弛 → 瘫痪；引申“停顿”
in- (不) + cure (治愈) + -able → 无法治愈的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用数据描述某因素带来的变化
模板：The availability of [new resource] helped increase [indicator] from about [value 1] in [year 1], to about [value 2] in [year 2].
例句：The availability of affordable smartphones helped increase internet access in Africa from about 10 percent in 2005, to about 40 percent in 2020.

句型：描述某手段促成了某问题的根除
模板：During [period], [means] enabled the eradication of the previously widespread and often [adj.] [problem], [name].
例句：During the 20th century, public sanitation enabled the eradication of the previously widespread and often fatal disease, cholera, in many cities.

title: UNIT 063 · 昆虫的变态发育
body: For sheer variety and abundance, insects rank among the most successful animals on Earth. Dragonflies, unlike butterflies, do not create a chrysalis or undergo complete metamorphosis. Instead, they undergo a series of small transformations until they finally develop into their adult, winged form, known as “imago” .
translation: 就种类之繁多与数量之丰富而言，昆虫位列地球上最成功的动物之列。与蝴蝶不同，蜻蜓不会结蛹，也不经历完全变态。相反，它们经历一系列小的转变，直到最终发育为有翅膀的成虫形态，即“成虫”(imago)。
insights: 【For sheer... 的译法】原文：For sheer variety and abundance, insects rank among the most successful animals on Earth。翻译精雕：就种类之繁多与数量之丰富而言，昆虫位列……之列。技巧：for 表“就……而言”；sheer 起强调作用，用“之繁多、之丰富”体现。
【rank among】原文：rank among the most successful animals。翻译精雕：位列地球上最成功的动物之列。技巧：rank among 表“跻身……之列”。
【Instead 的承接】原文：Instead, they undergo a series of small transformations。翻译精雕：相反，它们经历一系列小的转变。技巧：instead 承接前句的否定，译为“相反/而是”。

grammar.title: For + 名词 + rank among
grammar.skeleton: For sheer variety and abundance, + insects rank among the most successful animals on Earth.
grammar.notes: rank 作不及物动词表“位列”。

grammar.title: unlike 对比 + 并列否定
grammar.skeleton: Dragonflies, [unlike butterflies], + do not [create a chrysalis] or [undergo complete metamorphosis].
grammar.notes: 否定句中用 or 连接并列谓语。

grammar.title: until 时间从句 + 分词同位
grammar.skeleton: they undergo a series of small transformations + until they finally develop into their adult, winged form, + [known as “imago”].
grammar.notes: develop into 表“发育成”；known as 引出术语。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：sheer adj. 纯粹的、完全的 (sheer luck)；陡峭的 (sheer cliff)
来自希腊语 khrysos “金子” (蛹常呈金色) → 蛹
meta- (变化) + morph (形态) + -osis → 形态变化 → 变态/蜕变
trans- (转变) + form (形) + -ation → 转变
来自拉丁语 imago “形象” → (昆虫的) 成虫

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：强调某类事物的成功
模板：For sheer [quality A] and [quality B], [X] rank among the most successful [category] on Earth.
例句：For sheer adaptability and reach, smartphones rank among the most successful inventions in history.

🦋 完全变态 vs 不完全变态
Complete metamorphosis (完全变态)：卵 → 幼虫 (larva) → 蛹 (pupa/chrysalis) → 成虫，如蝴蝶、甲虫。
Incomplete metamorphosis (不完全变态)：卵 → 若虫 (nymph) → 成虫，没有蛹期，如蜻蜓、蝗虫。

title: UNIT 064 · 螳螂的捕食姿态
body: The praying mantis is a carnivore that feeds on flies, crickets, grasshoppers and other smaller insects. Its name reflects the prayer-like posture it assumes while waiting for its victims to venture within the reach of its long, barbed, forelegs.
translation: 螳螂是一种食肉动物，以苍蝇、蟋蟀、蚱蜢和其他较小的昆虫为食。它的名字反映了它在等待猎物冒险进入其带倒钩的长前肢攻击范围时所采取的祈祷般的姿势。
insights: 【feed on 的译法】原文：a carnivore that feeds on flies...。翻译精雕：一种食肉动物，以……为食。技巧：feed on 固定译为“以……为食”。
【熟词僻义】原文：the prayer-like posture it assumes。翻译精雕：它所采取的祈祷般的姿势。技巧：assume 此处意为“采取（姿势）”，不是“假设”。
【venture within reach】原文：waiting for its victims to venture within the reach of its forelegs。翻译精雕：等待猎物冒险进入其前肢的攻击范围。技巧：venture 表“冒险前往”，within reach 表“在够得着的范围内”。

grammar.title: 定义句 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: The praying mantis is a carnivore + [that feeds on flies, crickets, grasshoppers and other smaller insects].
grammar.notes: feed on + 食物。

grammar.title: 省略关系词的定语从句 + while doing
grammar.skeleton: Its name reflects the prayer-like posture + [(that) it assumes] + [while waiting for its victims to venture within the reach of its long, barbed, forelegs].
grammar.notes: wait for sb. to do 复合结构。

vocab.root: carn- (肉，来自拉丁语 caro) + vore (吞食) → 食肉动物；herbivore 食草动物
pos- (放置) + -ture → 摆放的方式 → 姿势/态度
熟词僻义：assume 采取 (姿势)、承担 (职责)；本义假设
来自 adventure → 冒险；joint venture 合资企业

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

模板：Its name reflects the [feature] it [action] while [context].
例句：The cheetah's name reflects the spotted coat it displays while hunting in tall grass.

title: UNIT 065 · 昆虫的利与弊
body: Insects are often regarded as pests, because they can bite, sting, spread diseases, or compete with humans for crop plants. Nevertheless, without insects to pollinate flowers, the many crop plants that humans rely on for food would not be able to reproduce. In addition, some insects are considered to be of aesthetic importance. Dragonflies, beetles, and particularly butterflies, are widely thought to be among the most beautiful of all animals.
translation: 昆虫常被视为害虫，因为它们会叮咬、蜇人、传播疾病，或与人类争夺农作物。然而，如果没有昆虫为花朵授粉，人类赖以为食的许多农作物将无法繁殖。此外，一些昆虫被认为具有审美价值。蜻蜓、甲虫，尤其是蝴蝶，被普遍认为是所有动物中最美丽的一类。
insights: 【without 虚拟条件】原文：without insects to pollinate flowers, the many crop plants... would not be able to reproduce。翻译精雕：如果没有昆虫为花朵授粉，……将无法繁殖。技巧：without 引导含蓄虚拟条件，译为“如果没有……”。
【of + 抽象名词】原文：are considered to be of aesthetic importance。翻译精雕：被认为具有审美价值。技巧：be of importance = be important，译为“具有……价值/意义”。
【让步转折逻辑】原文：are often regarded as pests... Nevertheless...。翻译精雕：常被视为害虫……然而……。技巧：先抑后扬的结构，是托福“作者态度”题的典型信号。

grammar.title: be regarded as + because 原因
grammar.skeleton: Insects are often regarded as pests, + because they can [bite], [sting], [spread diseases], or [compete with humans for crop plants].
grammar.notes: compete with sb. for sth. 表“与某人争夺某物”。

grammar.title: without 含蓄虚拟
grammar.skeleton: Nevertheless, + without insects to pollinate flowers, + the many crop plants [that humans rely on for food] + would not be able to reproduce.
grammar.notes: 主句用 would + 动词原形表示与现在事实相反的推测。

grammar.title: be thought to be among
grammar.skeleton: Dragonflies, beetles, and particularly butterflies, + are widely thought to be among the most beautiful of all animals.
grammar.notes: be thought to be = 被认为是；among + 最高级 表“最……之一”。

vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 pestis “瘟疫” → 害虫；pesticide 杀虫剂
pollen (花粉) + -ate → 授粉
never + the + less → 一点也不少 → 尽管如此

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：先抑后扬：承认缺点，强调不可或缺
模板：[X] are often regarded as [negative label], because they can [harm]. Nevertheless, without [X] to [function], [important thing] would not be able to [result].
例句：Social media platforms are often regarded as distractions, because they can waste time and spread misinformation. Nevertheless, without them to connect people, many grassroots movements would not be able to grow.

title: UNIT 066 · 节肢动物的分类
body: Insects belong to a category of invertebrates called arthropods. These insects have jointed legs, segmented bodies and a hard outer covering called an exoskeleton. They are classified with the two other well-known groups of animals without backbones, the crustaceans and the arachnids. The former include crayfish and crabs and the latter include spiders, ticks, mites and scorpions. Often, arthropods are called bugs, but not every “bug” is an insect. Spiders, for example, are not insects, because they have eight legs and only two main body segments.
translation: 昆虫属于一类被称为节肢动物的无脊椎动物。这些昆虫具有分节的腿、分段的身体，以及一层被称为外骨骼的坚硬外壳。它们与另外两类著名的无脊椎动物——甲壳纲动物和蛛形纲动物——被归为一类。前者包括小龙虾和螃蟹，后者包括蜘蛛、蜱、螨和蝎子。人们常把节肢动物称为“虫子”，但并非每一种“虫子”都是昆虫。例如，蜘蛛就不是昆虫，因为它们有八条腿，身体只有两个主要部分。
insights: 【the former / the latter】原文：The former include crayfish and crabs and the latter include spiders...。翻译精雕：前者包括……，后者包括……。技巧：former / latter 固定译为“前者 / 后者”。
【部分否定】原文：not every “bug” is an insect。翻译精雕：并非每一种“虫子”都是昆虫。技巧：not every 为部分否定，译“并非每一……都……”，切勿译成“每一种都不是”。
【同位语破折号化】原文：the two other well-known groups of animals without backbones, the crustaceans and the arachnids。翻译精雕：另外两类著名的无脊椎动物——甲壳纲动物和蛛形纲动物。技巧：句末同位语用破折号引出，层次更清晰。

grammar.title: belong to + 分词定语
grammar.skeleton: Insects belong to a category of invertebrates + [called arthropods].
grammar.notes: belong to 不用于被动和进行时。

grammar.title: be classified with + 同位语
grammar.skeleton: They are classified with the two other well-known groups of animals without backbones, + [the crustaceans and the arachnids].
grammar.notes: 同位语解释 groups。

grammar.title: 部分否定 + because 原因
grammar.skeleton: Often, arthropods are called bugs, + but not every “bug” is an insect.
grammar.notes: not every / not all = 部分否定；none 才是全部否定。

vocab.root: in- (无) + vertebr- (脊椎，来自拉丁语 vertebra) + -ate → 无脊椎动物
arthro- (关节，来自希腊语 arthron) + pod (足) → 节肢动物
segment (部分/节) + -ed → 分段的
exo- (外) + skeleton (骨骼) → 外骨骼
crust- (外壳，来自拉丁语 crusta) + -acean → 甲壳类动物
来自希腊神话 Arachne (被变成蜘蛛的少女) → 蛛形纲动物

vocab.meaning: （寄生于体大动物的吸血小虫）壁虱

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用 former / latter 组织并列分类
模板：They are classified with [group A] and [group B]. The former include [examples], and the latter include [examples].
例句：Renewable resources are often compared with fossil fuels and nuclear power. The former include coal and oil, and the latter include uranium-based reactors.

句型：部分否定纠正常见误解
模板：Often, [X] are called [label], but not every [label] is [X]. [Example], for instance, is not [X], because [reason].
例句：Often, tomatoes are called vegetables, but not every vegetable-like food is a vegetable. The tomato, for instance, is botanically a fruit, because it develops from a flower and contains seeds.

🕷️ 托福生物：昆虫 vs 蛛形纲
Insects：6 条腿，3 个体节 (头、胸、腹)，通常有翅膀和触角。
Arachnids：8 条腿，2 个体节 (头胸部、腹部)，无翅膀、无触角。

title: UNIT 067 · 毛虫的发育阶段
body: The caterpillar is the larval stage of butterflies and moths, and is a member of the order, Lepidoptera. This is a special order relating to the larva phase in the life history of insects, such as the grub and maggot. The caterpillar develops like any other larva from the segmented egg and differentiating embryo, and undergoes several moltings, or ecdyses. It later falls into a quiescent pupa stage, and the pupa is usually sheathed in a silken cocoon.
translation: 毛虫是蝴蝶和蛾子的幼虫阶段，属于鳞翅目。这一目涉及昆虫生活史中的幼虫阶段，例如蛴螬和蛆。毛虫与其他幼虫一样，由分裂的卵和不断分化的胚胎发育而来，并经历数次蜕皮。之后，它进入静止的蛹期，蛹通常被包裹在丝质的茧中。
insights: 【术语的统一】原文：moltings, or ecdyses。翻译精雕：数次蜕皮。技巧：两个词同义（一个是通俗词，一个是学术词），中文合译为一个“蜕皮”即可。
【falls into 的译法】原文：It later falls into a quiescent pupa stage。翻译精雕：之后，它进入静止的蛹期。技巧：fall into 表示“进入（某种状态）”。
【被动的处理】原文：the pupa is usually sheathed in a silken cocoon。翻译精雕：蛹通常被包裹在丝质的茧中。技巧：生物描述中保留“被包裹”可接受，因为强调状态。

grammar.title: 并列谓语 + 同位语
grammar.skeleton: The caterpillar [is the larval stage of butterflies and moths], and [is a member of the order, Lepidoptera].
grammar.notes: order 在生物分类学中指“目”。

grammar.title: develop from + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: The caterpillar develops like any other larva from the segmented egg and differentiating embryo, + and undergoes several moltings, or ecdyses.
grammar.notes: like any other larva 插入比较。

vocab.root: larva (幼虫) + -al → 幼虫的
lepido- (鳞片) + ptera (翅膀) → 鳞翅目
differentiate: 使分化/区分 → 细胞分化 (cell differentiation)
em- (在内) + bryo (生长) → 在体内生长的东西 → 胚胎
quiesc- (安静，来自拉丁语 quiescere) + -ent → 静止的/休眠的；同源 quiet
熟词僻义：order 目 (界门纲目科属种：kingdom-phylum-class-order-family-genus-species)

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述生物发育的阶段性过程
模板：[Organism] develops like any other [type] from [initial stage], and undergoes several [changes]. It later falls into a [adj.] [stage].
例句：A startup develops like any other business from an initial idea, and undergoes several funding rounds. It later falls into a stable growth stage.

🧬 生物分类七级

Kingdom (界) → Phylum (门) → Class (纲) → Order (目) → Family (科) → Genus (属) → Species (种)。记忆口诀：King Philip Came Over For Good Soup.

title: UNIT 068 · 蜜蜂与互利共生
body: Bees are dependent on pollen as a protein source and use the oily nectar of flowers to provide energy. Adult worker bees collect pollen primarily to feed their larvae. They inevitably lose some of the pollen onto the pistils of other flowers as they go from flower to flower. This is part of the important process in achieving cross-pollination and fertilising plant life. Bees are, in fact, the most important pollinating insects and their interdependence with plants makes them an excellent example of the type of symbiosis known as mutualism. This occurs when unlike organisms have an association that is beneficial to both parties.
translation: 蜜蜂依赖花粉作为蛋白质来源，并利用花朵中油质的花蜜来获取能量。成年工蜂采集花粉主要是为了喂养幼虫。当它们从一朵花飞到另一朵花时，不可避免地会把一些花粉留在其他花朵的雌蕊上。这是实现异花授粉、使植物受精这一重要过程的一部分。事实上，蜜蜂是最重要的传粉昆虫，它们与植物之间的相互依存关系，使它们成为一种被称为互利共生的共生关系的绝佳例子。当不同种类的生物之间形成一种对双方都有益的关系时，就出现了互利共生。
insights: 【be dependent on】原文：Bees are dependent on pollen as a protein source。翻译精雕：蜜蜂依赖花粉作为蛋白质来源。技巧：be dependent on = depend on，译“依赖”。
【inevitably 的语气】原文：They inevitably lose some of the pollen onto the pistils...。翻译精雕：不可避免地会把一些花粉留在……雌蕊上。技巧：lose 在此不是“丢失”，而是“（无意中）留下”。
【概念层级的翻译】原文：the type of symbiosis known as mutualism。翻译精雕：一种被称为互利共生的共生关系。技巧：symbiosis 为上位概念“共生”，mutualism 为下位概念“互利共生”，翻译时必须区分。

grammar.title: make + 宾语 + 名词宾补
grammar.skeleton: their interdependence with plants + makes them + an excellent example of the type of symbiosis [known as mutualism].
grammar.notes: make sb. sth. 复合宾语。

grammar.title: when 从句定义
grammar.skeleton: This occurs + when unlike organisms have an association + [that is beneficial to both parties].
grammar.notes: unlike 此处为形容词“不同的”(= different)，不是介词。

vocab.root: inter- (相互) + dependence (依赖) → 相互依赖
sym- (共同) + bio- (生命) + -sis → 共同生活 → 共生
mutual (相互的) + -ism → 互利共生
bene- (好) + fic- (做) + -ial → 做好事的 → 有益的
in- (不) + e- (出) + vit- (避免，来自拉丁语 vitare) + -able → 无法避免的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用实例说明某种关系类型
模板：[A]'s interdependence with [B] makes them an excellent example of the type of [relationship] known as [term]. This occurs when [definition].
例句：The farmer's interdependence with the local market makes them an excellent example of the type of economic relationship known as reciprocity. This occurs when two parties exchange goods to mutual benefit.

🐝 共生关系三分类
Mutualism (互利共生)：双方都受益，如蜜蜂与花。
Commensalism (偏利共生)：一方受益，另一方无影响，如鮣鱼附着鲨鱼。
Parasitism (寄生)：一方受益，另一方受害，如跳蚤与狗。

title: UNIT 069 · 独居蜂与群居蜂
body: The primitive bees, like their relatives the wasps, are solitary. Each female makes her own burrow and constructs earthen chambers to contain her young. Some bees are communal, but differ from the solitary bees in that several females of the same generation may use the same nest. However, they each make their own cells for housing their eggs, larvae and pupae.
translation: 原始的蜜蜂和它们的近亲黄蜂一样，是独居的。每只雌蜂各自挖掘洞穴，并建造泥土巢室来容纳幼虫。有些蜜蜂是群居的，但它们与独居蜂的不同之处在于，同一代的几只雌蜂可能共用同一个巢穴。不过，它们各自建造自己的巢室，用来容纳各自的卵、幼虫和蛹。
insights: 【differ from... in that】原文：differ from the solitary bees in that several females of the same generation may use the same nest。翻译精雕：它们与独居蜂的不同之处在于……。技巧：differ from A in that... 固定译为“与 A 的不同之处在于……”。
【the young 的译法】原文：to contain her young。翻译精雕：来容纳幼虫。技巧：the young 指“幼崽/幼体”，在昆虫语境中译为“幼虫”。
【原书释义更正】primitive 原书释为“自然的”，在此语境应为“原始的”。

grammar.title: like + 同位语插入
grammar.skeleton: The primitive bees, [like their relatives the wasps], + are solitary.
grammar.notes: their relatives 与 the wasps 互为同位语。

grammar.title: differ from + in that 从句
grammar.skeleton: Some bees are communal, + but differ from the solitary bees + [in that several females of the same generation may use the same nest].
grammar.notes: in that = because / in the respect that，引导原因或说明方面。

vocab.root: prim- (第一) + -itive → 最初的 → 原始的
sol- (单独，来自拉丁语 solus) + -itary → 独居的/孤独的；solitude 孤独
commun- (共同) + -al → 公共的/群居的
熟词僻义：cell 蜂房；本义细胞、牢房

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明两类事物的不同之处
模板：[Group A] are [adj.], but differ from [Group B] in that [key difference].
例句：Some universities are research-oriented, but differ from research institutes in that they also have a strong teaching mission.

title: UNIT 070 · 真社会性蜜蜂
body: The eusocial, or truly social bees, live in large colonies of females from two overlapping generations. The mothers are known as the Queen bees and their daughters as worker bees. Males, called drones, play no part in the colony's organization and serve only to mate with the Queen bees. New cells are opened as necessary and the larvae are progressively fed and tended by the worker bees. Parasitic or cuckoo bees do not forage or make their own nests, but use the nests and food of other species of bees to provide for their parasitic young.
translation: 真社会性蜜蜂，即真正的社会性蜜蜂，生活在由两代重叠的雌蜂组成的大型群落中。母亲被称为蜂后，它们的女儿被称为工蜂。雄蜂不参与蜂群的组织工作，唯一的作用是与蜂后交配。蜂群会根据需要开辟新的蜂房，幼虫由工蜂逐步喂养和照料。寄生蜂，又称杜鹃蜂，不采集食物也不筑巢，而是利用其他种类蜜蜂的巢穴和食物来养育自己的寄生幼虫。
insights: 【省略的补全】原文：The mothers are known as the Queen bees and their daughters as worker bees。翻译精雕：母亲被称为蜂后，它们的女儿被称为工蜂。技巧：第二个分句省略了 are known，翻译时补全。
【serve only to】原文：serve only to mate with the Queen bees。翻译精雕：唯一的作用是与蜂后交配。技巧：serve only to do 译为“唯一的作用是……”。
【cuckoo 的比喻】原文：Parasitic or cuckoo bees。翻译精雕：寄生蜂，又称杜鹃蜂。技巧：杜鹃把蛋下在别的鸟巢里（巢寄生），cuckoo 因此引申为“寄生的”。

grammar.title: 省略结构
grammar.skeleton: The mothers are known as the Queen bees + and their daughters (are known) as worker bees.
grammar.notes: 并列结构中省略相同谓语。

grammar.title: 分词插入 + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: Males, [called drones], + [play no part in the colony's organization] and [serve only to mate with the Queen bees].
grammar.notes: play no part in = 不参与。

grammar.title: not... but... 结构
grammar.skeleton: Parasitic or cuckoo bees + do not forage or make their own nests, + but use the nests and food of other species of bees + to provide for their parasitic young.
grammar.notes: provide for 表“供养”。

vocab.root: eu- (真正的) + social (社会性的) → 真社会性的
熟词僻义：drone 雄蜂；嗡嗡声；无人机
pro- (向前) + gress (走) + -ive + -ly → 逐步地
熟词僻义：tend v. 照料 (tend the sick)；本义“倾向于”
para- (旁边) + sit- (食物，来自希腊语 sitos) + -ic → 在旁边吃饭的 → 寄生的
来自古法语 fourrage “草料” → 觅食

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述群体中不同角色的分工
模板：[Group A], called [term], play no part in [main activity] and serve only to [single function].
例句：Some board members, called non-executive directors, play no part in daily management and serve only to provide oversight.

🐝 托福熟词僻义：tend / drone
tend v. 照料 (tend the garden)；drone n. 雄蜂、嗡嗡声、无人机；v. 喋喋不休地说。托福生物文章中二者均为高频。

title: UNIT 071 · 蚂蚁的社会结构
body: Ant colonies have elaborate social structures where specially adapted individual ants engage in various activities necessary for the feeding, shelter and reproduction of the colony. Ants belong to an order of insects called the Hymenoptera, a group that also includes bees, wasps, and sawflies. Some species of wasps and bees live in colonies and are, therefore, said to be social. However, ants are the only hymenopterans in which every species is social. Ants are distinguished from other hymenopterans through their bent, or elbowed, antennae and an indented abdomen that forms a narrow waist.
translation: 蚁群拥有复杂的社会结构，其中经过特化的个体蚂蚁从事蚁群觅食、筑巢和繁殖所需的各种活动。蚂蚁属于膜翅目昆虫，这一类群还包括蜜蜂、黄蜂和叶蜂。有些种类的黄蜂和蜜蜂群居生活，因此被称为社会性昆虫。然而，蚂蚁是唯一所有物种都具有社会性的膜翅目昆虫。蚂蚁与其他膜翅目昆虫的区别在于它们弯曲的（或称肘状的）触角，以及形成细腰的凹陷腹部。
insights: 【where 从句的拆分】原文：elaborate social structures where specially adapted individual ants engage in...。翻译精雕：复杂的社会结构，其中经过特化的个体蚂蚁从事……。技巧：where 从句拆开，用“其中”连接。
【the only... in which every...】原文：ants are the only hymenopterans in which every species is social。翻译精雕：蚂蚁是唯一所有物种都具有社会性的膜翅目昆虫。技巧：定语从句前置，强调“唯一”。
【be said to be】原文：are, therefore, said to be social。翻译精雕：因此被称为社会性昆虫。技巧：be said to be 译为“被称为/据说是”。

grammar.skeleton: Ant colonies have elaborate social structures + [where specially adapted individual ants engage in various activities [necessary for the feeding, shelter and reproduction of the colony]].
grammar.notes: necessary for 形容词短语后置修饰 activities。

grammar.notes: a group 是 Hymenoptera 的同位语，后接定语从句。

grammar.title: be distinguished from + through
grammar.skeleton: Ants are distinguished from other hymenopterans + through their bent, or elbowed, antennae and an indented abdomen [that forms a narrow waist].
grammar.notes: through 表“通过/凭借”。

复数 antennae (触角)；antennas (天线)
