例句：Some mammals lay eggs and are, therefore, said to be unusual. However, monotremes are the only mammals in which every species lays eggs.

title: UNIT 072 · 蚁群的等级分工
body: An ant colony is divided into categories known as castes, with each caste having a different role. Female worker ants comprise the majority of a colony and are unable to mate. They do not have wings and perform most of the work in searching for food, nursing young and defending the colony against ants from other colonies. Queen ants are larger than worker ants and are the only females of the colony capable of mating. Queens are born with wings, which they break off after mating. They mate with winged male ants whose sperm fertilizes their eggs. When the eggs are hatched, they produce more worker ants and a new generation of Queen ants.
translation: 蚁群被划分为若干被称为“品级”的类别，每个品级承担不同的角色。雌性工蚁占蚁群的大多数，且无法交配。它们没有翅膀，承担了寻找食物、照料幼虫以及保卫蚁群抵御其他蚁群蚂蚁入侵等大部分工作。蚁后比工蚁体型更大，是蚁群中唯一能够交配的雌蚁。蚁后生来就有翅膀，交配后会将翅膀折断。它们与有翅的雄蚁交配，雄蚁的精子使其卵受精。卵孵化后，会产生更多的工蚁以及新一代的蚁后。
insights: 【with 独立主格】原文：with each caste having a different role。翻译精雕：每个品级承担不同的角色。技巧：with 结构转为独立分句。
【comprise the majority of】原文：Female worker ants comprise the majority of a colony。翻译精雕：雌性工蚁占蚁群的大多数。技巧：comprise 此处表“构成/占”。
【defend... against】原文：defending the colony against ants from other colonies。翻译精雕：保卫蚁群抵御其他蚁群蚂蚁入侵。技巧：defend A against B 译“保护 A 抵御 B”。

grammar.title: 被动 + 分词 + with 独立主格
grammar.skeleton: An ant colony is divided into categories [known as castes], + [with each caste having a different role].
grammar.notes: with + 名词 + doing 表伴随。

grammar.title: the only + 名词 + 形容词后置
grammar.skeleton: Queen ants ... are the only females of the colony + [capable of mating].
grammar.notes: capable of 形容词短语后置修饰 females。

grammar.title: whose 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: They mate with winged male ants + [whose sperm fertilizes their eggs].
grammar.notes: whose 表所属关系。

title: UNIT 073 · 森林的病虫害威胁
body: Insects and diseases are a continuing menace to forests. The gypsy moth, the tussock moth and the spruce budworm can cause extensive areas of defoliation. Other insects carry causative agents that destroy trees through the propagation of parasitic diseases caused by bacteria, fungi, viruses, and nematodes. Certain parasitic plants, like mistletoe and dodder, can also affect tree growth. Sunscald, drought injury, root drowning, suffocation, winter injury, injury from smoke, gases and fumes, are noninfectious maladies that affect trees. Nutritional excesses, or deficiencies, can also present serious problems for tree growth.
translation: 昆虫和疾病一直是森林面临的威胁。舞毒蛾、毒蛾和云杉卷叶蛾会造成大面积落叶。其他昆虫则携带病原体，通过传播由细菌、真菌、病毒和线虫引起的寄生性疾病来毁坏树木。某些寄生植物，如槲寄生和菟丝子，也会影响树木生长。日灼、旱害、根部淹水、窒息、冻害以及烟雾、气体和废气造成的伤害，都是影响树木的非传染性病害。营养过剩或缺乏也会给树木生长带来严重问题。
insights: 【continuing menace】原文：Insects and diseases are a continuing menace to forests。翻译精雕：昆虫和疾病一直是森林面临的威胁。技巧：continuing 译为“一直/持续”，menace to 译为“对……的威胁”。
【through the propagation of】原文：destroy trees through the propagation of parasitic diseases。翻译精雕：通过传播……寄生性疾病来毁坏树木。技巧：名词 propagation 转为动词“传播”。
【长主语后置判断】原文：Sunscald, drought injury, ... are noninfectious maladies。翻译精雕：日灼、旱害……都是……非传染性病害。技巧：长列举作主语时加“都”字总括。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + through + 分词
grammar.skeleton: Other insects carry causative agents + [that destroy trees through the propagation of parasitic diseases [caused by bacteria, fungi, viruses, and nematodes]].
grammar.notes: caused by 修饰 diseases。

grammar.title: 长列举主语 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: [Sunscald, drought injury, ..., injury from smoke, gases and fumes], + are noninfectious maladies + [that affect trees].
grammar.notes: 主语为多个名词并列，谓语用复数。

grammar.title: present + 宾语 + for
grammar.skeleton: Nutritional excesses, or deficiencies, + can also present serious problems for tree growth.
grammar.notes: present problems = cause problems，更正式。

vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 minax “威胁的” → 威胁
de- (加强) + vast- (荒废，来自拉丁语 vastare) + -ate → 使荒废 → 毁坏
de- (去除) + foli- (叶) + -ation → 落叶/去叶
causative: cause + -ative → 致病的；causative agent 病原体
de- (向下) + fic- (做) + -iency → 做得不够 → 缺乏
propag- (扦插/繁殖，来自拉丁语 propagare) + -ation → 繁殖/传播

例句：Cyber attacks and data leaks are a continuing menace to online businesses. Ransomware can cause extensive downtime, while weak passwords can also present serious problems for security.

title: UNIT 074 · 鸟类的独特特征
body: There are many form of flying animals, but birds are the only animals with a plumage of feathers. Flying insects and bats, have wings, but no feathers. Whilst most birds can fly, ostriches and penguins are grouped in the species, but cannot fly even though they have evolved from flying ancestors. The behaviour and characteristics of birds are distinct from all other animals, but there are some similarities. Like mammals, birds have four-chambered hearts and are warm-blooded. Their relatively constant body temperature enables them to live in a wide variety of environments. There is also a similarity with reptiles through reproduction from embryos in eggs, outside of the mothers' body.
translation: 会飞的动物有很多种，但鸟类是唯一长有羽毛的动物。会飞的昆虫和蝙蝠有翅膀，但没有羽毛。虽然大多数鸟类都会飞，但鸵鸟和企鹅虽同属鸟类，却不会飞，尽管它们是由会飞的祖先进化而来的。鸟类的行为和特征与所有其他动物截然不同，但也存在一些相似之处。与哺乳动物一样，鸟类拥有四腔心脏，并且是恒温动物。它们相对恒定的体温使它们能够在各种各样的环境中生存。鸟类与爬行动物也有相似之处，即都通过在母体外的卵中孕育胚胎来繁殖。
insights: 【the only 强调】原文：birds are the only animals with a plumage of feathers。翻译精雕：鸟类是唯一长有羽毛的动物。技巧：plumage of feathers 合译为“羽毛”，避免重复。
【多重让步】原文：Whilst most birds can fly, ostriches and penguins... cannot fly even though...。翻译精雕：虽然大多数鸟类都会飞，但鸵鸟和企鹅……却不会飞，尽管……。技巧：whilst 与 even though 两层让步，中文用“虽然……但……尽管……”逐层展开。
【enable 的主语】原文：Their relatively constant body temperature enables them to live in...。翻译精雕：它们相对恒定的体温使它们能够……。技巧：无生命主语 + enable 译为“使……能够”。

grammar.title: There be + but 对比
grammar.skeleton: There are many form(s) of flying animals, + but birds are the only animals + [with a plumage of feathers].
grammar.notes: 原文 many form 为笔误，应为 many forms。

grammar.title: Whilst 让步 + even though 让步
grammar.skeleton: Whilst most birds can fly, + ostriches and penguins are grouped in the species, but cannot fly + even though they have evolved from flying ancestors.
grammar.notes: whilst 为英式英语 while；even though 强调让步事实。

grammar.title: like 比较 + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: Like mammals, + birds [have four-chambered hearts] and [are warm-blooded].
grammar.notes: four-chambered 复合形容词。

vocab.root: plum- (羽毛，来自拉丁语 pluma) + -age → 羽毛 (总称)
ante- (之前) + cess (走，来自拉丁语 cedere) + -or → 走在前面的人 → 祖先
熟词僻义：chamber (心脏的) 腔室
反义 cold-blooded 冷血的 (变温的)

rept- (爬行，来自拉丁语 repere) + -ile → 爬行动物
e- (出) + volv- (卷/滚) → 展开 → 进化

句型：说明某类事物的唯一性特征

title: UNIT 075 · 羽毛的结构与功能
body: The main component of feathers is keratin, a flexible protein that also forms the hair and fingernails of mammals. Feathers provide the strong, lightweight, surface area needed for powered, aerodynamic flight. They also serve as insulation by trapping pockets of air to help birds conserve their body heat. Feathers vary in patterns, colours, textures and shapes, and this helps birds signal their age, sex, social status and species identity. Some birds have plumage that blends with their surroundings, thus providing camouflage and helping to escape notice by their predators. Birds use their beaks to preen their feathers, often making use of oil from a gland at the base of their tails. Preening removes dirt and parasites and keeps feathers waterproof and supple. Feathers are nonliving structures that cannot repair themselves when worn or broken; hence, at least once a year, birds lose and replace their feathers through the process of molting.
translation: 羽毛的主要成分是角蛋白，这是一种柔韧的蛋白质，哺乳动物的毛发和指甲也由它构成。羽毛提供了动力飞行和空气动力学飞行所需的强韧、轻质的表面积。它们还能通过锁住空气层起到隔热作用，帮助鸟类保持体温。羽毛的图案、颜色、质地和形状各不相同，这有助于鸟类传达其年龄、性别、社会地位和物种身份。有些鸟的羽毛能与周围环境融为一体，从而起到伪装作用，帮助它们躲避捕食者的注意。鸟类用喙梳理羽毛，常常会利用尾部基部腺体分泌的油脂。梳理羽毛可以清除污垢和寄生虫，使羽毛保持防水和柔软。羽毛是无生命的结构，磨损或折断后无法自我修复；因此，鸟类每年至少一次通过换羽来脱落并更换羽毛。
insights: 【同位语扩展】原文：keratin, a flexible protein that also forms the hair and fingernails of mammals。翻译精雕：角蛋白，这是一种柔韧的蛋白质，哺乳动物的毛发和指甲也由它构成。技巧：同位语较长时，用“这是一种……”单独成句。
【serve as insulation】原文：They also serve as insulation by trapping pockets of air。翻译精雕：它们还能通过锁住空气层起到隔热作用。技巧：serve as 译为“起到……作用”，trap pockets of air 意译为“锁住空气层”。
【escape notice】原文：helping to escape notice by their predators。翻译精雕：帮助它们躲避捕食者的注意。技巧：escape notice 固定搭配“不被注意”。
【hence 因果】原文：...when worn or broken; hence, at least once a year...。翻译精雕：……；因此，……每年至少一次……。技巧：hence 译为“因此”，分号保留。

grammar.notes: 同位语中又嵌套定语从句。

title: UNIT 076 · 鸟翼的结构
body: The wings of a bird are a highly modified forelimb with a skeletal structure resembling that of arms. The shape of a bird's wings influences its style of flight, which may consist of gliding, soaring, or flapping. Flight muscles are located in the chest and are attached to the wings by large tendons. The breastbone is a large bone, shaped like the keel of a boat, and supports the flight muscles.
translation: 鸟的翅膀是一种高度特化的前肢，其骨骼结构与手臂的骨骼结构相似。鸟翼的形状影响其飞行方式，飞行方式可能包括滑翔、翱翔或振翅飞行。飞行肌位于胸部，通过粗大的肌腱与翅膀相连。胸骨是一块大骨头，形似船的龙骨，用来支撑飞行肌。
insights: 【that of 的还原】原文：a skeletal structure resembling that of arms。翻译精雕：其骨骼结构与手臂的骨骼结构相似。技巧：that 指代 skeletal structure，必须还原。
【which 从句的处理】原文：its style of flight, which may consist of gliding, soaring, or flapping。翻译精雕：其飞行方式，飞行方式可能包括……。技巧：重复中心词衔接。
【原书释义更正】soar 原书释为“振翅飞行”，实为“翱翔（借上升气流高飞）”；flap 才是“振翅”。

grammar.title: 分词定语 + that of
grammar.skeleton: The wings of a bird are a highly modified forelimb + [with a skeletal structure [resembling that of arms]].
grammar.notes: resembling 现在分词修饰 structure；resemble 为及物动词，不加 to/with。

grammar.title: 并列被动谓语
grammar.skeleton: Flight muscles [are located in the chest] and [are attached to the wings by large tendons].
grammar.notes: be located in 表位置。

grammar.title: 分词插入 + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: The breastbone [is a large bone, [shaped like the keel of a boat]], and [supports the flight muscles].
grammar.notes: shaped like 表“形状像……”。

句型：说明形态如何影响功能
模板：The shape of [X] influences its [function], which may consist of [type A], [type B], or [type C].
例句：The design of a classroom influences its style of learning, which may consist of lectures, group discussions, or hands-on projects.

title: UNIT 077 · 鸟类的尾羽
body: Nearly all birds have tail feathers, which consist of paired flight feathers called rectrices. The two central tail feathers are attached to the tail bone of the bird, and the others to fat and muscle surrounding the area. Tails may be square, rounded, pointed, or forked, depending on the lengths of the rectrices and the way they terminate.
translation: 几乎所有鸟类都有尾羽，尾羽由成对的飞羽组成，被称为舵羽。中央的两根尾羽附着在鸟的尾骨上，其余的则附着在该区域周围的脂肪和肌肉上。根据舵羽的长度及其末端的形态，鸟尾可能呈方形、圆形、尖形或叉形。
insights: 【省略还原】原文：The two central tail feathers are attached to the tail bone of the bird, and the others to fat and muscle...。翻译精雕：……，其余的则附着在……。技巧：the others 后省略了 are attached，翻译时补全。
【depending on 后置条件】原文：Tails may be square... depending on the lengths of the rectrices and the way they terminate。翻译精雕：根据舵羽的长度及其末端的形态，鸟尾可能呈……。技巧：depending on 条件前置。

grammar.title: 非限制性定语从句 + 分词
grammar.skeleton: Nearly all birds have tail feathers, + [which consist of paired flight feathers [called rectrices]].
grammar.notes: which 指代 tail feathers。

grammar.title: depending on + 并列宾语
grammar.skeleton: Tails may be square, rounded, pointed, or forked, + depending on [the lengths of the rectrices] and [the way (that) they terminate].
grammar.notes: the way 后省略 that/in which。

vocab.meaning: 舵羽（鸟尾上的硬毛）（plural: rectrices ［'rektrisis ］）
vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 rectrix “女舵手” → 舵羽
fork (叉) + -ed → 叉状的
termin- (终点) + -ate → 结束/终止

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：根据条件说明形态的差异
模板：[Things] may be [type A], [type B], [type C], or [type D], depending on [factor 1] and [factor 2].
例句：Contracts may be short-term, long-term, renewable, or fixed, depending on the needs of the parties and the nature of the work.

title: UNIT 078 · 鸟足的适应性
body: Birds are two legged animals of which the lower part of each leg is called the tarsus. Most birds have four toes on each foot, and many birds, including all songbirds, have their first toe, called a hallux, pointing backwards. The toes are adapted in the different species of birds to suit a particular function. These range from grasping perches, climbing, swimming, capturing prey, or carrying and manipulating food.
translation: 鸟类是两足动物，每条腿的下部称为跗骨。大多数鸟类每只脚有四个脚趾，许多鸟类，包括所有鸣禽，其第一个脚趾（称为后趾）朝向后方。不同种类鸟的脚趾适应于各自特定的功能，从抓握栖木、攀爬、游泳、捕捉猎物，到携带和处理食物，不一而足。
insights: 【of which 定语从句】原文：Birds are two legged animals of which the lower part of each leg is called the tarsus。翻译精雕：鸟类是两足动物，每条腿的下部称为跗骨。技巧：of which 从句拆为独立分句。
【have + 宾语 + doing】原文：have their first toe, called a hallux, pointing backwards。翻译精雕：其第一个脚趾（称为后趾）朝向后方。技巧：have sth. doing 表状态，中文直接描述。
【range from 的列举】原文：These range from grasping perches, climbing... or carrying and manipulating food。翻译精雕：从抓握栖木……到携带和处理食物，不一而足。技巧：range from 列举多项时，可用“不一而足”收尾。

grammar.title: of which 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Birds are two legged animals + [of which the lower part of each leg is called the tarsus].
grammar.notes: of which = of these animals。

grammar.title: have + 宾语 + 现在分词
grammar.skeleton: many birds, including all songbirds, + have + their first toe, [called a hallux], + pointing backwards.
grammar.notes: have sth. doing 表示“使某物处于……状态”。

grammar.title: 被动 + to do 目的
grammar.skeleton: The toes are adapted in the different species of birds + to suit a particular function.
grammar.notes: be adapted to do = 适应以……

vocab.root: 另义：perch v. 栖息；坐在高处
来自拉丁语 praeda “战利品” → 猎物；fall prey to 成为……的牺牲品

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明结构适应不同功能
模板：The [parts] are adapted in different [types] to suit a particular function. These range from [function A], [function B], to [function C].
例句：Smartphone apps are adapted in different markets to suit particular needs. These range from mobile payments, ride-hailing, to online education.

title: UNIT 079 · 鸟喙与鸟眼
body: The beaks and bills of modern birds are toothless and lightweight jaws that have evolved over the years. A bird's eyes are protected by three eyelids: an upper lid resembling that of humans, a lower lid that closes when birds sleeps, and a third lid called a nictitating membrane. This latter eyelid sweeps sideways across the eye, starting from the side nearest the beak. It is a thin, translucent fold of skin that moistens and cleans the eyes and protects them from wind and bright light.
translation: 现代鸟类的喙是经过漫长岁月进化而来的、无齿且轻质的颌。鸟的眼睛由三层眼睑保护：上眼睑与人类的相似；下眼睑在鸟睡觉时闭合；第三层眼睑被称为瞬膜。瞬膜从靠近喙的一侧开始横向扫过眼睛。它是一层薄而半透明的皮褶，能湿润和清洁眼睛，并保护眼睛免受风吹和强光刺激。
insights: 【冒号后的分项】原文：three eyelids: an upper lid..., a lower lid..., and a third lid...。翻译精雕：三层眼睑……：上眼睑……；下眼睑……；第三层眼睑……。技巧：分项较长时用分号隔开。
【This latter 的译法】原文：This latter eyelid sweeps sideways across the eye。翻译精雕：瞬膜从……横向扫过眼睛。技巧：This latter 指最后提到的那一个，直接用名称替代更清楚。
【protect... from】原文：protects them from wind and bright light。翻译精雕：保护眼睛免受风吹和强光刺激。技巧：protect A from B 译为“保护 A 免受 B”。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + over the years
grammar.skeleton: The beaks and bills of modern birds are toothless and lightweight jaws + [that have evolved over the years].
grammar.notes: 现在完成时表示长期演化至今。

grammar.title: 冒号 + 三项同位语
grammar.skeleton: three eyelids: + [an upper lid resembling that of humans], [a lower lid that closes when birds sleep], and [a third lid called a nictitating membrane].
grammar.notes: 三项分别由分词、定语从句、过去分词修饰，结构各异但功能对等。原文 birds sleeps 为笔误。

grammar.title: 现在分词表起点
grammar.skeleton: This latter eyelid sweeps sideways across the eye, + starting from the side nearest the beak.
grammar.notes: nearest the beak = nearest to the beak。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：bill 鸟嘴；亦作“账单、法案”

vocab.meaning: 瞬膜：鸟类、爬行动物和一些哺乳动物的内生透明眼睑，闭上可保护和滋润眼睛
vocab.root: nictitate 来自拉丁语 nictare “眨眼” → 瞬膜
trans- (穿过) + luc- (光) + -ent → 光能透过的 → 半透明的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明某物由多层/多部分构成并分述功能
模板：[X] is protected by three [layers]: [layer A] resembling that of [Y], [layer B] that [function], and [layer C] called [term].
例句：The building is protected by three security layers: a front gate resembling that of a bank, a lobby checkpoint that verifies IDs, and a final layer called biometric access.

title: UNIT 080 · 鸟巢的功能
body: When breeding, most birds build nests to incubate and warm their eggs. Their nests may offer camouflage from predators, but often, are built to provide physical protection from the elements. Nests may be elaborate constructions or mere scrapes on the ground.
translation: 在繁殖期，大多数鸟类会筑巢来孵化和温暖它们的卵。鸟巢可以帮助躲避捕食者的伪装，但更多时候，筑巢是为了提供抵御风雨等自然因素的物理保护。鸟巢可能是精心构筑的建筑，也可能只是地面上的浅坑。
insights: 【熟词僻义】原文：physical protection from the elements。翻译精雕：抵御风雨等自然因素的物理保护。技巧：the elements 指“自然力/恶劣天气”，不是“元素”。
【elaborate vs mere 对比】原文：Nests may be elaborate constructions or mere scrapes on the ground。翻译精雕：鸟巢可能是精心构筑的建筑，也可能只是地面上的浅坑。技巧：mere 译为“只是/仅仅”，与 elaborate 形成强烈对比。

grammar.title: When doing 省略状语
grammar.skeleton: When breeding, + most birds build nests + to incubate and warm their eggs.
grammar.notes: When (they are) breeding 省略主语和 be。

grammar.title: may... but often...
grammar.skeleton: Their nests may offer camouflage from predators, + but often, are built to provide physical protection from the elements.
grammar.notes: may 让步 + but 转折，突出主要功能。

vocab.root: 另义：breed n. 品种
in- (在上) + cub- (躺，来自拉丁语 cubare) + -ate → 躺在上面 → 孵化；incubator 孵化器
熟词僻义：the elements 自然力、恶劣天气 (exposed to the elements)

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：对比次要功能与主要功能
模板：[X] may offer [secondary benefit], but often, [X] are [designed] to provide [primary benefit].
例句：Uniforms may offer a sense of style, but often, they are designed to provide equality and safety.

🌧️ 托福熟词僻义：the elements
the elements = 自然力 (风、雨、寒冷等)：The ruins were exposed to the elements for centuries. (遗迹在风吹雨打中暴露了数百年)

title: UNIT 081 · 猛禽
body: The best-known birds are the birds of prey. Hawks, eagles and falcons are active during the daytime while others, notably owls, are nocturnal and hunt at night. Birds of prey have hooked beaks, strong claw like talons on their feet, keen eyesight and hearing. Vultures are scavengers that feed on dead animals, but are also classed as birds of prey.
translation: 最为人熟知的鸟类是猛禽。鹰、雕和隼在白天活动，而其他猛禽，尤其是猫头鹰，则是夜行性的，在夜间捕猎。猛禽拥有钩状的喙、脚上强健的爪状利爪，以及敏锐的视力和听力。秃鹫是以动物尸体为食的食腐动物，但也被归类为猛禽。
insights: 【while 对比 + notably】原文：Hawks, eagles and falcons are active during the daytime while others, notably owls, are nocturnal。翻译精雕：……在白天活动，而其他猛禽，尤其是猫头鹰，则是夜行性的。技巧：notably 译“尤其是”。
【术语】原文：birds of prey。翻译精雕：猛禽。技巧：固定译名，不译“捕食的鸟”。

grammar.title: while 对比 + 插入语
grammar.skeleton: Hawks, eagles and falcons are active during the daytime + while others, [notably owls], are nocturnal and hunt at night.
grammar.notes: notably 插入，引出典型例子。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + but also 被动
grammar.skeleton: Vultures are scavengers [that feed on dead animals], + but are also classed as birds of prey.
grammar.notes: be classed as = be classified as。

vocab.root: noct- (夜，来自拉丁语 nox) + -urnal → 夜间的；反义 diurnal 白天的
scavenge (搜寻食物/拾荒) + -er → 食腐动物/拾荒者

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：对比同类中的两种模式
模板：[Group A] are [active/pattern A] while others, notably [example], are [pattern B].
例句：Most students study in the morning while others, notably night owls, are more productive after dark.

🦉 托福生物：diurnal / nocturnal / crepuscular
diurnal 昼行性的；nocturnal 夜行性的；crepuscular 晨昏活动的 (黄昏和黎明活动，如鹿、兔子)。

title: UNIT 082 · 候鸟的导航线索
body: Migrating birds use a variety of cues to find their ways. These include the positions of the sun during the day, the stars at night, the Earth's magnetic field and visual, olfactory and auditory landmarks.
translation: 候鸟利用多种线索来寻找迁徙路线。这些线索包括白天太阳的位置、夜晚的星辰、地球磁场，以及视觉、嗅觉和听觉上的地标。
insights: 【a variety of cues】原文：Migrating birds use a variety of cues to find their ways。翻译精雕：候鸟利用多种线索来寻找迁徙路线。技巧：find their ways 意译为“寻找迁徙路线”，补出语境。
【形容词共享中心词】原文：visual, olfactory and auditory landmarks。翻译精雕：视觉、嗅觉和听觉上的地标。技巧：三个感官形容词共享 landmarks。

grammar.title: use + 宾语 + to do
grammar.skeleton: Migrating birds use a variety of cues + to find their ways.
grammar.notes: to find 表目的。

grammar.title: include + 多层列举
grammar.skeleton: These include [the positions of the sun during the day], [the stars at night], [the Earth's magnetic field] and [visual, olfactory and auditory landmarks].
grammar.notes: 四项并列，最后一项内部又有三个形容词并列。

vocab.root: migr- (迁移，来自拉丁语 migrare) + -ate → 迁徙；immigrate 移入、emigrate 移出
ol- (气味，来自拉丁语 olere) + fact (做) + -ory → 嗅觉的
audi- (听) + -tory → 听觉的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：列举某行为所依赖的多种信息来源
模板：[Agents] use a variety of cues to [goal]. These include [cue A], [cue B], and [cue C].
例句：Investors use a variety of cues to predict market trends. These include interest rates, consumer confidence, and corporate earnings.

👃 托福五感形容词

visual 视觉的 · auditory 听觉的 · olfactory 嗅觉的 · gustatory 味觉的 · tactile 触觉的

title: UNIT 083 · 家禽的称谓
body: The modern use of the word, fowl, usually applies to the common domestic fowl, but not when used in combinations like waterfowl or wildfowl. The fowls sold in poultry markets are normally, full-grown female bird, but the younger birds of both sexes, such as broilers and fryers, are sold as chickens. The male fowl is called a rooster, or cock, and the females, especially those more than a year old, are called hens. Younger females come under the term pullets and very young chickens of either sex are called chicks. A capon is a male rooster that has been castrated.
translation: 在现代用法中，fowl 一词通常指常见的家禽，但用在 waterfowl（水禽）或 wildfowl（野禽）这类组合词中时则不然。家禽市场上出售的禽类通常是成年母鸡，而两种性别的幼鸡，如适合烤制的嫩鸡和适合油炸的嫩鸡，则作为“鸡”(chicken) 出售。雄性家鸡被称为公鸡 (rooster 或 cock)，而雌鸡，尤其是一岁以上的，被称为母鸡 (hen)。较年轻的雌鸡被称为小母鸡 (pullet)，而非常小的雏鸡不论雌雄都被称为小鸡 (chick)。阉鸡 (capon) 是指被阉割过的公鸡。
insights: 【词汇说明文的翻译策略】原文围绕英文单词本身展开说明。翻译精雕：保留英文原词并在括号中给出中文。技巧：讨论词汇用法的文本，若只给中文会丢失信息，必须中英并列。
【but not when used in...】原文：usually applies to the common domestic fowl, but not when used in combinations like...。翻译精雕：通常指常见的家禽，但用在……这类组合词中时则不然。技巧：but not when 省略了主谓，译为“……时则不然”。
【come under the term】原文：Younger females come under the term pullets。翻译精雕：较年轻的雌鸡被称为小母鸡。技巧：come under 表“归入……类别”。

grammar.title: apply to + but not when 省略
grammar.skeleton: The modern use of the word, fowl, usually applies to the common domestic fowl, + but not when (it is) used in combinations like waterfowl or wildfowl.
grammar.notes: 省略状语从句 when used。

grammar.title: 分词定语 + but 对比
grammar.skeleton: The fowls [sold in poultry markets] are normally full-grown female birds, + but the younger birds of both sexes, [such as broilers and fryers], are sold as chickens.
grammar.notes: 原文 full-grown female bird 应为复数 birds。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + 现在完成时被动
grammar.skeleton: A capon is a male rooster + [that has been castrated].
grammar.notes: has been done 表示已完成的状态。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：domestic 驯养的 (domestic animals 家畜)

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明一个词的使用范围与例外
模板：The modern use of the word, [X], usually applies to [main sense], but not when used in combinations like [compound A] or [compound B].
例句：The modern use of the word, cloud, usually applies to remote computing services, but not when used in combinations like cloudburst or cloud nine.

title: UNIT 084 · 鱼类的身体结构
body: All fishes are classified as vertebrates, because they come with a backbone. Their gills allow them to breath underwater and their slender bodies are covered in scales for protection. Fish are fitted with fins to stabilize their swimming. The pointed snouts of their streamlined bodies are designed for easy movement through water, and the broad tail at the posterior is their means of propulsion.
translation: 所有鱼类都被归为脊椎动物，因为它们都有脊椎。鳃使它们能够在水下呼吸，它们细长的身体覆盖着鳞片以起保护作用。鱼长有鳍，用来使游动保持稳定。它们流线型身体的尖形口鼻部便于在水中轻松移动，而身体后部宽大的尾巴则是它们的推进工具。
insights: 【come with 的意译】原文：because they come with a backbone。翻译精雕：因为它们都有脊椎。技巧：come with 表“带有、配有”，此处译“有”即可。
【be fitted with】原文：Fish are fitted with fins to stabilize their swimming。翻译精雕：鱼长有鳍，用来使游动保持稳定。技巧：be fitted with 原义“装配有”，生物语境译“长有”。
【means of propulsion】原文：the broad tail at the posterior is their means of propulsion。翻译精雕：身体后部宽大的尾巴则是它们的推进工具。技巧：means of + 名词 = “……的手段/工具”。

grammar.title: allow + 宾语 + to do / be covered in
grammar.skeleton: Their gills allow them to breath(e) underwater + and their slender bodies are covered in scales for protection.
grammar.notes: 原文 breath 为名词，动词应为 breathe。

grammar.title: 被动 + for doing 目的
grammar.skeleton: The pointed snouts of their streamlined bodies + are designed for easy movement through water.
grammar.notes: be designed for 表“为……而设计”。

vocab.root: vertebr- (脊椎) + -ate → 脊椎动物
引申：backbone 支柱、骨干 (the backbone of the economy)
熟词僻义：scale 鳞片
stream (流) + line (线) → 流线型的；引申“精简高效的”
post- (后) + -erior (比较级) → 后部的；反义 anterior 前部的
pro- (向前) + puls- (推) + -ion → 推进
stable (稳定的) + -ize → 使稳定

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述结构与功能的对应
模板：Their [part A] allow them to [function A], and their [part B] are covered in [material] for [purpose]. [Part C] is their means of [function C].
例句：Their solar panels allow them to generate power off-grid, and their walls are covered in insulation for energy efficiency. A battery bank is their means of storage.

title: UNIT 085 · 渔业的对象
body: The term fishery is also used to describe the species of fish being harvested (because most of them are edible), which include familiar finned fish species, like cods and flounders; mollusks, including oysters and squids; and crustaceans, such as shrimps and crabs. Lesser-known fisheries include echinoderms, like sea urchins; some amphibians, including frogs; and cnidarians, such as jellyfish. Even the harvest of whales is usually considered a fishery.
translation: “渔业”一词也被用来描述被捕捞的鱼类物种（因为它们大多可以食用），其中包括人们熟悉的有鳍鱼类，如鳕鱼和比目鱼；软体动物，包括牡蛎和鱿鱼；以及甲壳类动物，如虾和蟹。不太为人所知的渔业对象包括棘皮动物，如海胆；一些两栖动物，如青蛙；以及刺胞动物，如水母。甚至捕鲸通常也被视为渔业的一种。
insights: 【分号的层级列举】原文：...like cods and flounders; mollusks, including oysters and squids; and crustaceans, such as shrimps and crabs。翻译精雕：……；软体动物，包括……；以及甲壳类动物，如……。技巧：分号分隔大类，逗号分隔例子，中文完全保留此层级。
【括号说明的保留】原文：(because most of them are edible)。翻译精雕：（因为它们大多可以食用）。技巧：括号补充原因，保留括号形式。
【Even 的递进】原文：Even the harvest of whales is usually considered a fishery。翻译精雕：甚至捕鲸通常也被视为渔业的一种。技巧：even 强调出乎意料，译为“甚至……也……”。

grammar.title: 被动 + 现在分词被动
grammar.skeleton: The term fishery is also used + to describe the species of fish [being harvested].
grammar.notes: being harvested 表“正在被捕捞的”。

grammar.title: which 从句 + 分号分层列举
grammar.skeleton: ..., which include [familiar finned fish species, like cods and flounders]; [mollusks, including oysters and squids]; and [crustaceans, such as shrimps and crabs].
grammar.notes: like / including / such as 三种举例方式交替使用，避免重复。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：harvest v. 捕获、采集 (harvest fish/organs)
ed- (吃，来自拉丁语 edere) + -ible → 可食用的
另义：flounder v. 挣扎、困惑
来自拉丁语 mollis “软的” → 软体动物
echino- (刺猬/刺) + derm (皮肤) → 棘皮动物

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用三种举例方式列举分类
模板：[Term] is also used to describe [scope], which include [category A], like [examples]; [category B], including [examples]; and [category C], such as [examples].
例句：The term media is also used to describe channels of communication, which include print outlets, like newspapers and magazines; broadcast outlets, including radio and television; and digital platforms, such as blogs and podcasts.

📝 写作技巧：举例词的轮换

such as / like / including / for example / for instance / notably / e.g.。在同一句中交替使用可避免重复，让列举更有层次感。

title: UNIT 086 · 休闲垂钓
body: Fishing for recreation, relaxation, sport and competition, is referred to as angling. Most catches are made using a fishing rod, which is a long, straight, flexible pole, fitted with a reel and line. Early rods were made of bamboo, but modern ones now use fiberglass or graphite. The fishing line is fitted with a hook, bait and sinker and the angler uses the rod to cast the line into the water. Some forms of angling use specially made lures rather than bait, as in the case of fly fishing.
translation: 为娱乐、放松、运动和比赛而进行的钓鱼被称为垂钓。大多数渔获是用钓竿钓到的，钓竿是一根长而直、富有弹性的杆子，上面装有渔线轮和钓线。早期的钓竿由竹子制成，而现代钓竿则使用玻璃纤维或石墨。钓线上装有鱼钩、鱼饵和铅坠，垂钓者用钓竿将钓线抛入水中。有些垂钓方式使用特制的拟饵而不是鱼饵，飞蝇钓就是如此。
insights: 【定义句】原文：Fishing for recreation, relaxation, sport and competition, is referred to as angling。翻译精雕：为娱乐……而进行的钓鱼被称为垂钓。技巧：for 目的状语前置为“为……而进行的”。
【定语从句的说明化】原文：a fishing rod, which is a long, straight, flexible pole, fitted with a reel and line。翻译精雕：钓竿，钓竿是一根……的杆子，上面装有……。技巧：重复“钓竿”，再用“上面装有”承接过去分词。
【as in the case of】原文：as in the case of fly fishing。翻译精雕：飞蝇钓就是如此。技巧：as in the case of 译为“……就是如此 / 正如……的情况”。

grammar.title: 动名词短语主语 + be referred to as
grammar.skeleton: [Fishing for recreation, relaxation, sport and competition], + is referred to as angling.
grammar.notes: 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数。

grammar.title: 分词 + which 从句 + 过去分词
grammar.skeleton: Most catches are made [using a fishing rod], + [which is a long, straight, flexible pole, [fitted with a reel and line]].
grammar.notes: fitted with 修饰 pole。

grammar.title: rather than + as in the case of
grammar.skeleton: Some forms of angling use specially made lures + rather than bait, + as in the case of fly fishing.
grammar.notes: rather than 连接两个名词，表“而不是”。

vocab.root: re- (再) + create (创造) → 再创造精力 → 消遣/娱乐
graph- (写) + -ite → 用来写字的矿物 → 石墨 (铅笔芯)
另义：lure v. 引诱、吸引 (lure customers)

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：材料的古今对比
模板：Early [tools] were made of [old material], but modern ones now use [new material A] or [new material B].
例句：Early bridges were made of timber and stone, but modern ones now use reinforced concrete or steel.

title: UNIT 087 · 珊瑚礁的形成
body: Coral reefs are built up by limestone skeletons of coral. They are mainly found in shallow tropical saltwater where bright sunlight can penetrate. Corals exist because of the symbiotic algae that live in coral tissues and use sunlight for photosynthesis.
translation: 珊瑚礁由珊瑚的石灰岩骨骼堆积而成。它们主要分布在阳光能够穿透的浅海热带咸水区域。珊瑚之所以能够存在，是因为有共生藻类生活在珊瑚组织中，并利用阳光进行光合作用。
insights: 【be built up by】原文：Coral reefs are built up by limestone skeletons of coral。翻译精雕：珊瑚礁由珊瑚的石灰岩骨骼堆积而成。技巧：build up 表“逐渐堆积”，译为“堆积而成”。
【exist because of 的强调】原文：Corals exist because of the symbiotic algae...。翻译精雕：珊瑚之所以能够存在，是因为……。技巧：“之所以……是因为……”句式突出因果关系。

grammar.title: where 从句修饰地点
grammar.skeleton: They are mainly found in shallow tropical saltwater + [where bright sunlight can penetrate].
grammar.notes: where 指代 saltwater 区域。

grammar.title: because of + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Corals exist because of the symbiotic algae + [that live in coral tissues and use sunlight for photosynthesis].
grammar.notes: because of 后接名词短语；从句中两个谓语并列。

vocab.root: lime (石灰) + stone → 石灰岩
pene- (几乎/深入) + trate (进入) → 穿透；渗透
symbiosis + -tic → 共生的
alga 的复数 → 藻类

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用“之所以……是因为……”说明存在条件
模板：[X] exist because of the [adj.] [Y] that [action] and [action].
例句：Thriving small towns exist because of the local businesses that hire residents and reinvest profits in the community.

🪸 托福海洋：珊瑚白化 (coral bleaching)

当海水温度过高时，珊瑚会排出体内的共生藻 (zooxanthellae)，因而失去颜色和主要的能量来源，这就是珊瑚白化。它是托福海洋生态类文章的常见话题。

title: UNIT 088 · 鱿鱼的构造与习性
body: Squids are carnivorous mollusks that belong to the same class as the cuttlefish and octopus. The two lateral fins and the spherical body of a squid are stiffened by an interior, cartilaginous, skeleton. Eight sucker-bearing arms, and two contractile tentacles with spatulate tips on the latter, surround the mouth of the squid. There are four rows of suction cups, encircled by rings of chitinous (horny) hooks, on each arm. The longer contractile tentacles are used to seize the prey and pass it to the shorter arms. These arms then hold the food as it is torn by strong jaws, shaped like a parrot's beak. Squids can swim faster than any other invertebrate by rapidly expelling water from the mantle cavity that resembles a “funnel” . Many deep-sea squids are bioluminescent, and one genus secretes luminescent ink, which can be ejected as a cloud when pursued.
translation: 鱿鱼是肉食性软体动物，与乌贼和章鱼同属一纲。鱿鱼的两片侧鳍和球形身体由内部的软骨质骨骼支撑而变得坚挺。鱿鱼的嘴周围环绕着八条长有吸盘的腕和两条可收缩的触腕，触腕末端呈铲状。每条腕上有四排吸盘，吸盘周围环绕着一圈几丁质（角质）钩。较长的可收缩触腕用来抓住猎物并将其传递给较短的腕。随后，这些腕抓住食物，由形似鹦鹉喙的强壮颚将其撕碎。鱿鱼通过从形似“漏斗”的外套腔中迅速喷出水流，能比任何其他无脊椎动物游得都快。许多深海鱿鱼能够生物发光，其中一个属会分泌发光墨汁，在被追捕时可以将其喷射成一团墨云。
insights: 【被动转主动】原文：The two lateral fins and the spherical body of a squid are stiffened by an interior, cartilaginous, skeleton。翻译精雕：……由内部的软骨质骨骼支撑而变得坚挺。技巧：stiffen 被动译为“支撑而变得坚挺”。
【倒装主语的调整】原文：Eight sucker-bearing arms, and two contractile tentacles..., surround the mouth of the squid。翻译精雕：鱿鱼的嘴周围环绕着……。技巧：中文用存现句“某处环绕着某物”，把地点放前面。
【比较级 + any other】原文：Squids can swim faster than any other invertebrate。翻译精雕：能比任何其他无脊椎动物游得都快。技巧：than any other 表最高级含义。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + belong to
grammar.skeleton: Squids are carnivorous mollusks + [that belong to the same class as the cuttlefish and octopus].
grammar.notes: the same... as... 表“与……相同的”。

grammar.title: as 时间从句 + 被动 + 分词定语
grammar.skeleton: These arms then hold the food + as it is torn by strong jaws, + [shaped like a parrot's beak].
grammar.notes: shaped like 修饰 jaws。

grammar.title: by doing + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Squids can swim faster than any other invertebrate + by rapidly expelling water from the mantle cavity + [that resembles a “funnel”].
grammar.notes: 比较级 + than any other + 单数名词 = 最高级。

grammar.title: which 从句 + when 省略
grammar.skeleton: one genus secretes luminescent ink, + [which can be ejected as a cloud + when (it is) pursued].
grammar.notes: when pursued 省略主语和 be。

sphere (球) + -ical → 球形的
lateral: later- (侧面，来自拉丁语 latus) + -al → 侧面的
contract (收缩) + -ile → 可收缩的
tent- (尝试/触摸，来自拉丁语 temptare) + -acle → 触手
ex- (出) + pel (推) → 推出 → 驱逐/喷出
bio- (生物) + lumin- (光) + -escent → 生物发光的
来自拉丁语 genus “种类/出身” → 属；复数 genera
se- (分开) + crete (分离，来自拉丁语 cernere) → 分泌

句型：说明某生物能力的机制
模板：[Animal] can [action] faster than any other [category] by rapidly [mechanism].
例句：Cheetahs can accelerate faster than any other land animal by rapidly extending their flexible spines.

title: UNIT 089 · 两栖动物的分类
body: Amphibians were the first animals with backbones to emerge from the sea and adapt to life on the land. They are the ancestors of reptiles, which in turn, gave rise to mammals and birds. Amphibians have moist and hairless skin that allows water to pass in and out. These animals are classified into three main groups: the tailed amphibian is in the caudate group, which includes the sirens, salamanders, and newts. The tailless amphibian is in the anuran group that includes frogs and toads. The third group is the gymnophiona, and is made up of the wormlike caecilians.
translation: 两栖动物是第一批离开海洋、适应陆地生活的脊椎动物。它们是爬行动物的祖先，而爬行动物又进化出了哺乳动物和鸟类。两栖动物拥有湿润无毛的皮肤，水分可以透过皮肤进出。这些动物分为三大类：有尾两栖动物属于有尾目，包括鳗螈、火蜥蜴和蝾螈。无尾两栖动物属于无尾目，包括青蛙和蟾蜍。第三类是无足目，由形似蠕虫的蚓螈组成。
insights: 【the first... to do】原文：Amphibians were the first animals with backbones to emerge from the sea。翻译精雕：两栖动物是第一批离开海洋……的脊椎动物。技巧：the first + 名词 + to do 结构，不定式作定语。
【in turn 的递进】原文：reptiles, which in turn, gave rise to mammals and birds。翻译精雕：爬行动物又进化出了哺乳动物和鸟类。技巧：in turn 表“依次/转而”，give rise to 表“产生/引起”。
【allow... to pass in and out】原文：skin that allows water to pass in and out。翻译精雕：水分可以透过皮肤进出。技巧：定语从句转为独立分句。

grammar.title: the first + 名词 + to do
grammar.skeleton: Amphibians were the first animals with backbones + to [emerge from the sea] and [adapt to life on the land].
grammar.notes: 不定式作后置定语。

grammar.title: which in turn + give rise to
grammar.skeleton: They are the ancestors of reptiles, + [which in turn, gave rise to mammals and birds].
grammar.notes: give rise to = lead to / produce。

grammar.title: be classified into + 冒号
grammar.skeleton: These animals are classified into three main groups: + the tailed amphibian is in the caudate group, [which includes...].
grammar.notes: be classified into 表“被分为”。

vocab.root: amphi- (两种) + bi- (生命) + -an → 过两种生活的 → 两栖动物
ad- + apt (适合) → 使适合 → 适应
caud- (尾，来自拉丁语 cauda) → 有尾目
an- (无) + ura (尾) → 无尾目

vocab.meaning: be made up of 由……组成
蚓螈（无足目约 150 种两栖动物的统称）

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述演化/发展的谱系
模板：[A] were the first [category] to [milestone]. They are the ancestors of [B], which in turn, gave rise to [C] and [D].
例句：Mainframe computers were the first machines to process business data at scale. They are the ancestors of personal computers, which in turn, gave rise to laptops and smartphones.

title: UNIT 090 · 物种大灭绝
body: Paleontologists recognize several mass extinctions that have occurred during the past 500 million years. These events are located in the Ordovician, Devonian, Paleozoic, Mesozoic, Triassic, and Cretaceous Period of geological time. The extinction of the dinosaurs, which occurred at the end of Cretaceous Period, is the most recent mass extinction and resulted in the loss of about 75% of all living species at that time.
translation: 古生物学家确认，在过去 5 亿年间发生过数次物种大灭绝。这些事件分别发生在地质年代的奥陶纪、泥盆纪、古生代、中生代、三叠纪和白垩纪。恐龙灭绝发生在白垩纪末期，是最近一次物种大灭绝，导致当时约 75% 的现存物种消失。
insights: 【recognize 的译法】原文：Paleontologists recognize several mass extinctions。翻译精雕：古生物学家确认……数次物种大灭绝。技巧：recognize 在学术语境中译为“确认/认定”。
【result in the loss of】原文：resulted in the loss of about 75% of all living species。翻译精雕：导致……约 75% 的现存物种消失。技巧：the loss of 名词转动词“消失”。
【原文知识勘误】古生代 (Paleozoic) 与中生代 (Mesozoic) 是“代”(Era)，而奥陶纪、泥盆纪、三叠纪、白垩纪是“纪”(Period)。原文把二者并列，学术上不严谨；五次大灭绝通常为奥陶纪末、泥盆纪晚期、二叠纪末、三叠纪末和白垩纪末。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + 现在完成时
grammar.skeleton: Paleontologists recognize several mass extinctions + [that have occurred during the past 500 million years].
grammar.notes: during the past + 时间段 常与现在完成时连用。

grammar.title: 非限制性从句 + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: The extinction of the dinosaurs, [which occurred at the end of Cretaceous Period], + [is the most recent mass extinction] and [resulted in the loss of about 75% of all living species at that time].
grammar.notes: 两个谓语时态不同：is (现在事实) / resulted (过去事件)。

vocab.root: paleo- (古) + onto- (存在/生物) + -logist → 古生物学家
extinct: ex- (出) + stinct (熄灭，来自拉丁语 stinguere) → 熄灭 → 灭绝的
paleo- (古) + zo- (生命) + -ic → 古生代
meso- (中) + zo- (生命) + -ic → 中生代
来自拉丁语 creta “白垩” → 白垩纪
dino- (可怕的，来自希腊语 deinos) + saur (蜥蜴) → 恐龙

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述某事件的规模与后果
模板：[Event], which occurred [time], is the most recent [category] and resulted in the loss of about [percentage] of [total] at that time.
例句：The 2008 financial crisis, which occurred after the housing bubble burst, is the most recent global recession and resulted in the loss of about 8% of all US jobs at that time.

🦖 地质年代层级
Eon (宙) → Era (代)：古生代 Paleozoic、中生代 Mesozoic、新生代 Cenozoic → Period (纪)：如三叠纪 Triassic、侏罗纪 Jurassic、白垩纪 Cretaceous → Epoch (世)

title: UNIT 091 · 大灭绝后的新机遇
genre: 进化生物学 / 说明文
body: Mass extinctions create opportunities for the survivors to exploit new habitats as the families, orders, and classes of entire groups of species are extinguished. The new environment provides niches for the survivors to evolve new characteristics and habits, which ultimately develop into entirely new species.
translation: 随着整个物种群体中的各个科、目和纲相继灭绝，大灭绝为幸存者开拓新的栖息地创造了机会。新的环境为幸存者提供了生态位，使它们得以进化出新的特征和习性，并最终发展成全新的物种。
insights: 【as 从句的前置】原文：Mass extinctions create opportunities... as the families, orders, and classes... are extinguished。翻译精雕：随着……相继灭绝，大灭绝为……创造了机会。技巧：as 表“随着”，前置作背景。
【opportunities for sb. to do】原文：create opportunities for the survivors to exploit new habitats。翻译精雕：为幸存者开拓新的栖息地创造了机会。技巧：for sb. to do 结构，中文“为……创造……的机会”。
【熟词僻义】原文：exploit new habitats。翻译精雕：开拓新的栖息地。技巧：exploit 在生态学中是中性的“利用/开发”，不是“剥削”。

grammar.title: create + 名词 + for sb. to do + as 从句
grammar.skeleton: Mass extinctions create opportunities + for the survivors to exploit new habitats + as [the families, orders, and classes of entire groups of species] are extinguished.
grammar.notes: as 引导时间/原因状语。

grammar.title: provide + for sb. to do + which 从句
grammar.skeleton: The new environment provides niches + for the survivors to evolve new characteristics and habits, + [which ultimately develop into entirely new species].
grammar.notes: which 指代 characteristics and habits 或整个过程。

熟词僻义：order (生物分类) 目
熟词僻义：class (生物分类) 纲
ex- (出) + ploit (折叠，来自拉丁语 plicare) → 展开利用 → 开发/利用
habit- (居住，来自拉丁语 habitare) + -at → 栖息地
熟词僻义：niche 生态位
ex- (出) + stinguish (熄灭) → 熄灭

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明危机中蕴含机遇
模板：[Crisis] creates opportunities for [survivors] to exploit new [areas] as [old players] are [eliminated].
例句：Economic downturns create opportunities for agile startups to exploit new markets as established firms are forced to cut back.

title: UNIT 092 · 生物多样性与人类资源
body: The biodiversity of the world's ecosystems covers all the known living species, and as it dwindles, so too do many of the resources on which humans depend. There are at least 40,000 different plants, animals, fungi, bacteria, and virus species that mankind depends on for food, clothing, shelter, and medicines. Fresh air and water are two of the vital essentials needed to sustain life on this planet, and they in turn, depend on the continued health of the ecosystems, along with the associated species within them. Some of the chemical cycles needed to maintain that health include the nitrogen and carbon cycles that promote biodiversity growth.
translation: 世界各生态系统的生物多样性涵盖了所有已知的生物物种，随着生物多样性的减少，人类赖以生存的许多资源也会随之减少。人类的食物、衣物、住所和药物至少依赖 4 万种不同的植物、动物、真菌、细菌和病毒物种。清新的空气和洁净的水是维持这个星球上生命所需的两大必需品，而它们又依赖于生态系统及其中相关物种的持续健康。维持这种健康所需的化学循环包括氮循环和碳循环，它们能够促进生物多样性的增长。
insights: 【so too do 倒装】原文：as it dwindles, so too do many of the resources on which humans depend。翻译精雕：随着生物多样性的减少，人类赖以生存的许多资源也会随之减少。技巧：so + 助动词 + 主语 表“……也一样”，中文用“也会随之”。
【on which 的译法】原文：the resources on which humans depend。翻译精雕：人类赖以生存的资源。技巧：介词 + which 从句前置为“赖以……的”。
【in turn 的承接】原文：they in turn, depend on the continued health of the ecosystems。翻译精雕：而它们又依赖于生态系统的持续健康。技巧：in turn 体现依赖链条，译“又”。

grammar.title: as 从句 + so too do 倒装
grammar.skeleton: as it dwindles, + so too do many of the resources + [on which humans depend].
grammar.notes: so do + 主语 表肯定的“也”，此处 do = dwindle。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + for 目的
grammar.skeleton: There are at least 40,000 different ... species + [that mankind depends on for food, clothing, shelter, and medicines].
grammar.notes: depend on sth. for sth. 表“依赖……获得……”。

grammar.title: 分词定语 + in turn
grammar.skeleton: Fresh air and water are two of the vital essentials [needed to sustain life on this planet], + and they in turn, depend on the continued health of the ecosystems, [along with the associated species within them].
grammar.notes: needed to sustain 修饰 essentials。

bio- (生命) + diversity (多样性) → 生物多样性
来自古英语 dwinan “消瘦” → 逐渐减少
vit- (生命，来自拉丁语 vita) + -al → 生命攸关的 → 极重要的
sus- (= sub- 在下) + tain (持) → 在下面支持 → 维持；sustainable 可持续的

title: UNIT 093 · 进化论的核心观点
genre: 进化生物学 / 说明文
body: A central, but historically controversial component of evolutionary theory, is that all living organisms, from microscopic bacteria to plants, insects, birds and mammals, share a common ancestor.
translation: 进化论中一个核心但历来颇具争议的组成部分是：所有生物，从微小的细菌到植物、昆虫、鸟类和哺乳动物，都拥有一个共同的祖先。
insights: 【but 连接形容词】原文：A central, but historically controversial component。翻译精雕：一个核心但历来颇具争议的组成部分。技巧：historically 译为“历来”，强调长期性。
【表语从句】原文：is that all living organisms... share a common ancestor。翻译精雕：……是：所有生物……都拥有一个共同的祖先。技巧：that 表语从句较长时，用冒号引出。

grammar.title: 主语 + that 表语从句
grammar.skeleton: A central, but historically controversial component of evolutionary theory, + is + [that all living organisms, [from microscopic bacteria to plants, insects, birds and mammals], share a common ancestor].
grammar.notes: from... to... 插入列举生物范围；主语与谓语之间的逗号是风格性停顿。

vocab.root: contro- (相反) + vers- (转) + -ial → 转向反面的 → 有争议的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：引出某理论的核心观点
模板：A central, but historically controversial component of [theory], is that [core claim].
例句：A central, but historically controversial component of behavioral economics, is that people often make irrational financial decisions.

title: UNIT 094 · 进化论的确立与发展
body: Hostility towards evolutionary theory gave way to acclaim as scientists vigorously debated, explored, and built on Darwin's theory of natural selection. As the 20th century unfolded, scientific advances revealed the detailed mechanisms missing from Darwin's theory. Study of the complex chemistry of all organisms unveiled the structure of genes as well as how they were duplicated, altered and passed from generation to generation. New techniques in molecular biology compared the genetic structures of different species. From these studies scientists determined an evolutionary relationship between species that was previously undetectable. Today, evolution is recognized as the cornerstone of modern biology and unites such diverse scientific fields as cell biology, genetics, paleontology and even geology and statistics. The study of evolutionary theory reveals an exquisitely complex interaction of some of the forces that act upon life forms on Earth.
translation: 随着科学家们积极地辩论、探索并发展达尔文的自然选择理论，人们对进化论的敌视逐渐让位于赞誉。随着 20 世纪的推进，科学进步揭示了达尔文理论中所缺失的具体机制。对所有生物复杂化学过程的研究，揭开了基因的结构，以及基因如何被复制、改变并代代相传的奥秘。分子生物学的新技术对不同物种的遗传结构进行了比较。通过这些研究，科学家们确定了物种之间此前无法检测到的进化关系。如今，进化论被公认为现代生物学的基石，并将细胞生物学、遗传学、古生物学，乃至地质学和统计学等众多不同的科学领域联系在一起。对进化论的研究揭示了作用于地球生命形式的各种力量之间极其复杂的相互作用。
insights: 【give way to 的译法】原文：Hostility towards evolutionary theory gave way to acclaim。翻译精雕：人们对进化论的敌视逐渐让位于赞誉。技巧：give way to 表“让位于、被……取代”，加“逐渐”体现过程。
【unfold 的时间化】原文：As the 20th century unfolded。翻译精雕：随着 20 世纪的推进。技巧：unfold 本义“展开”，用于时间时译为“推进/展开”。
【unite such diverse fields as】原文：unites such diverse scientific fields as cell biology, genetics...。翻译精雕：将……等众多不同的科学领域联系在一起。技巧：such A as B 结构，中文改为“B 等 A”。
【exquisitely 的强调】原文：an exquisitely complex interaction。翻译精雕：极其复杂的相互作用。技巧：exquisitely 本义“精美地”，此处作程度副词“极其”。

grammar.title: give way to + as 从句
grammar.skeleton: Hostility towards evolutionary theory gave way to acclaim + as scientists vigorously [debated], [explored], and [built on] Darwin's theory of natural selection.
grammar.notes: 三个动词共享宾语 Darwin's theory。

grammar.title: 宾语 + as well as + how 从句
grammar.skeleton: Study of the complex chemistry of all organisms unveiled + [the structure of genes] as well as [how they were duplicated, altered and passed from generation to generation].
grammar.notes: 名词与 how 宾语从句并列作宾语。

grammar.title: such + 名词 + as + 列举
grammar.skeleton: evolution ... unites + such diverse scientific fields as + cell biology, genetics, paleontology and even geology and statistics.
grammar.notes: such A as B = A such as B。

ac- (= ad-) + claim (喊) → 向……欢呼 → 称赞
vigor (活力) + -ous + -ly → 有力地

alter- (其他的，来自拉丁语 alter) → 改变
corner + stone → 奠基石 → 基础/基石

模板：Hostility towards [idea] gave way to acclaim as [experts] vigorously debated, explored, and built on [original work].

title: UNIT 095 · 化石的形成与用途
body: Fossils are most commonly found in the sedimentary strata of sandstone, shale and limestone deposits. Fossilized remains of trapped organisms can also be found in natural asphalt, amber and ice. The hard, indigestible skeletons and shells of animals, and the woody material of plants, tend to be better preserved than soft tissue organisms that more readily decay. Paleontologists use fossils to learn how life has changed and evolved throughout earth's history, but also as an important key in determining the different periods of geological time.
translation: 化石最常见于砂岩、页岩和石灰岩沉积层中。被困住的生物的化石遗骸也可能在天然沥青、琥珀和冰中被发现。动物坚硬、难以分解的骨骼和外壳，以及植物的木质部分，往往比更容易腐烂的软组织生物保存得更好。古生物学家利用化石来了解生命在地球历史中是如何变化和进化的，同时化石也是确定不同地质年代的重要依据。
insights: 【tend to 的译法】原文：tend to be better preserved than soft tissue organisms。翻译精雕：往往比……保存得更好。技巧：tend to 译为“往往、倾向于”。
【原书释义更正】indigestible 原书释为“难消化的”，在化石语境下指“难以被分解的”；sedimentary 应为“沉积的”而非“沉淀的”。
【but also 的并列】原文：use fossils to learn how..., but also as an important key in determining...。翻译精雕：利用化石来了解……，同时化石也是确定……的重要依据。技巧：原文 not only 被省略，中文用“同时……也是……”。

grammar.title: 被动 + 介词短语
grammar.skeleton: Fossils are most commonly found + in the sedimentary strata of sandstone, shale and limestone deposits.
grammar.notes: strata 为 stratum 的复数。

grammar.title: 比较级 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: The hard, indigestible skeletons and shells of animals, and the woody material of plants, + tend to be better preserved + than soft tissue organisms [that more readily decay].
grammar.notes: better preserved 被动比较级；readily = easily。

grammar.title: use + 宾语 + to do / as
grammar.skeleton: Paleontologists use fossils [to learn how life has changed and evolved throughout earth's history], + but also [as an important key in determining the different periods of geological time].
grammar.notes: use sth. to do 与 use sth. as 并列。

vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 fossilis “挖出来的” → 化石

vocab.meaning: 沉积的 (sedimentary rock 沉积岩)
vocab.root: sediment (沉积物：sed- 坐 + -ment) + -ary → 沉积的
strat- (铺开，来自拉丁语 sternere) → 层

例句：Historians use letters to learn how daily life has changed throughout the centuries, but also as an important key in determining the dates of events.

title: UNIT 096 · 人体肌肉骨骼系统
body:
Basic Human Anatomy: Musculoskeletal System

The human skeleton consists of more than 200 bones, bound together by tough and relatively inelastic connective tissues called ligaments. The different parts of the body have varying degrees of movement which is controlled by the action of the skeletal muscles. These muscles are attached to the bones by tendons and permit the free movement of the arms, for example, which are connected to the shoulder bones. In contrast, the knee joint is limited to a hinge-like action. While the bones of the skull are immovable, the head movement is quite flexible at its connection with the neck.
translation:
人体基础解剖：肌肉骨骼系统

人体骨骼由 200 多块骨头组成，这些骨头由坚韧且相对缺乏弹性、被称为韧带的结缔组织连接在一起。身体的不同部位有着不同程度的活动范围，这些活动由骨骼肌的作用控制。骨骼肌通过肌腱附着在骨头上，例如使与肩骨相连的手臂能够自由活动。相比之下，膝关节只能做铰链式的运动。虽然颅骨是不能活动的，但头部在与颈部的连接处却可以相当灵活地运动。
insights: 【长分词定语的拆分】原文：more than 200 bones, bound together by tough and relatively inelastic connective tissues called ligaments。翻译精雕：200 多块骨头，这些骨头由……被称为韧带的结缔组织连接在一起。技巧：重复“这些骨头”承接分词短语。
【In contrast 对比】原文：In contrast, the knee joint is limited to a hinge-like action。翻译精雕：相比之下，膝关节只能做铰链式的运动。技巧：be limited to 译为“只能/仅限于”。
【While 让步对比】原文：While the bones of the skull are immovable, the head movement is quite flexible...。翻译精雕：虽然颅骨是不能活动的，但头部……却可以相当灵活地运动。技巧：while 表让步，用“虽然……但……却……”。

grammar.title: consist of + 过去分词 + called
grammar.skeleton: The human skeleton consists of more than 200 bones, + [bound together by tough and relatively inelastic connective tissues [called ligaments]].
grammar.notes: bound 是 bind 的过去分词。

grammar.title: 并列谓语 + which 从句
grammar.skeleton: These muscles [are attached to the bones by tendons] and [permit the free movement of the arms], for example, + [which are connected to the shoulder bones].
grammar.notes: which 指代 arms。

grammar.title: While 让步
grammar.skeleton: While the bones of the skull are immovable, + the head movement is quite flexible at its connection with the neck.
grammar.notes: while 置于句首多表让步/对比。

vocab.root: ana- (向上/彻底) + tomy (切) → 切开 → 解剖学
lig- (绑，来自拉丁语 ligare) + -ament → 绑住的东西 → 韧带
另义：hinge on 取决于 (Everything hinges on the result.)

模板：[Part A] permits the free movement of [X]. In contrast, [part B] is limited to [restricted action]. While [part C] is [fixed], [part D] is quite flexible.
例句：The new policy permits the free movement of goods. In contrast, labor mobility is limited to skilled workers. While tariffs remain fixed, quotas are quite flexible.

title: UNIT 097 · 密质骨
body: There are two main types of bone. The very dense compact bone, with its hard outer casing, makes up most of the bones found in the arms and legs. These osteon bones are the elongated cylinders of compact bone that acts as weight-bearing pillars and are structurally able to withstand a level of mechanical stress. The center of each osteon contains a hollow canal that acts as a central passageway.
translation: 骨主要分为两种类型。致密的密质骨带有坚硬的外层，构成了手臂和腿部的大部分骨骼。这些骨单位是由密质骨构成的细长圆柱体，起着承重支柱的作用，在结构上能够承受一定程度的机械应力。每个骨单位的中心都有一条中空的管道，作为中央通道。
insights: 【make up 的译法】原文：The very dense compact bone... makes up most of the bones found in the arms and legs。翻译精雕：……构成了手臂和腿部的大部分骨骼。技巧：make up 译为“构成”。
【acts as 的功能化】原文：act as weight-bearing pillars。翻译精雕：起着承重支柱的作用。技巧：act as 译“起……作用”。
【structurally able to】原文：are structurally able to withstand a level of mechanical stress。翻译精雕：在结构上能够承受一定程度的机械应力。技巧：副词 structurally 译为“在结构上”。

grammar.title: with 介词短语插入
grammar.skeleton: The very dense compact bone, [with its hard outer casing], + makes up most of the bones [found in the arms and legs].
grammar.notes: found in 过去分词作定语。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + 并列表语
grammar.skeleton: These osteon bones are the elongated cylinders of compact bone + [that act(s) as weight-bearing pillars] + and are structurally able to withstand a level of mechanical stress.
grammar.notes: 原文 that acts 应与 cylinders 一致为 act。

vocab.root: compact: com- (共同) + pact (固定) → 紧密的

vocab.meaning: 骨单位（密质骨构造的基本单位）
vocab.root: osteo- (骨，来自希腊语 osteon) → 骨单位；osteoporosis 骨质疏松
e- (出) + long (长) + -ate → 拉长的
引申：pillar 支柱 (a pillar of society)
with- (对抗) + stand → 抵抗/承受

模板：[Structures] act as [function] and are structurally able to withstand a level of [stress].
例句：Earthquake-resistant buildings act as flexible frames and are structurally able to withstand a level of lateral shaking.

title: UNIT 098 · 松质骨
body: A spongy bone, also known as cancellous bone, is composed of a honeycomb network of bones that act as internal supporting beams for some compact bones. The spongy bone is designed to bear stress from several directions, as exerted on the pelvis in bending or stretching. The spaces between the trabeculae are filled with red bone marrow that contains the blood vessels to nourish the spongy bone. Bones of the pelvis, ribs, breastbone, vertebrae, skull, and at the ends of the arm and leg bones, all contain this cancellous bone.
translation: 松质骨，又称海绵骨，由蜂窝状的骨网构成，作为某些密质骨的内部支撑梁。松质骨的设计使其能够承受来自多个方向的应力，例如身体弯曲或伸展时作用在骨盆上的力。骨小梁之间的空隙中充满了红骨髓，红骨髓中含有为松质骨提供营养的血管。骨盆、肋骨、胸骨、椎骨、颅骨以及四肢骨骼的末端都含有这种松质骨。
insights: 【also known as】原文：A spongy bone, also known as cancellous bone。翻译精雕：松质骨，又称海绵骨。技巧：also known as 译“又称”。
【as exerted on 的处理】原文：to bear stress from several directions, as exerted on the pelvis in bending or stretching。翻译精雕：承受来自多个方向的应力，例如身体弯曲或伸展时作用在骨盆上的力。技巧：as exerted on 表举例，译为“例如……时作用在……上的力”。

grammar.skeleton: A spongy bone, [also known as cancellous bone], + is composed of a honeycomb network of bones + [that act as internal supporting beams for some compact bones].
grammar.notes: that 指代 bones。

grammar.skeleton: The spongy bone is designed to bear stress from several directions, + as (stress is) exerted on the pelvis in bending or stretching.
grammar.notes: as 后省略主语和 be。

grammar.title: 长主语 + all 复指
grammar.skeleton: [Bones of the pelvis, ribs, breastbone, vertebrae, skull, and at the ends of the arm and leg bones], + all contain this cancellous bone.
grammar.notes: all 复指前面的主语。

title: UNIT 099 · 人体神经系统
body: The human nervous system consists of two divisions, the central nervous system and the peripheral nervous system. The former includes the brain and the spinal cord. The latter covers all the neural tissue of the motor and sensory systems. Impulses go to the central nervous system through sensory nerves, being transported by the motor nerves. The motor system is divided into the somatic (or skeletal) nervous system and the autonomic nervous system. With a few exceptions, the somatic system allows voluntary control over skeletal muscle. The autonomic nervous system is largely involuntary, and controls the cardiac muscles, the smooth muscles and the various glands.
translation: 人体神经系统由两大部分组成：中枢神经系统和周围神经系统。前者包括脑和脊髓。后者涵盖运动系统和感觉系统的所有神经组织。神经冲动通过感觉神经传向中枢神经系统，再经由运动神经传出。运动系统分为躯体（或骨骼）神经系统和自主神经系统。除少数例外，躯体神经系统使人能够随意控制骨骼肌。自主神经系统在很大程度上是不随意的，它控制心肌、平滑肌和各种腺体。
insights: 【the former / the latter】原文：The former includes... The latter covers...。翻译精雕：前者包括……后者涵盖……。技巧：固定译法。
【原文逻辑的修正】原文：Impulses go to the central nervous system through sensory nerves, being transported by the motor nerves。翻译精雕：神经冲动通过感觉神经传向中枢神经系统，再经由运动神经传出。技巧：原文分词结构易被误解为“由运动神经传入”，翻译时按生理学事实补出“再……传出”。
【voluntary / involuntary】原文：allows voluntary control / is largely involuntary。翻译精雕：随意控制 / 不随意的。技巧：生理学中 voluntary 译为“随意的（受意识控制的）”，不译“自愿的”。

grammar.title: consist of + 同位语
grammar.skeleton: The human nervous system consists of two divisions, + [the central nervous system and the peripheral nervous system].
grammar.notes: 同位语解释 two divisions。

grammar.title: With a few exceptions 插入
grammar.skeleton: With a few exceptions, + the somatic system allows voluntary control over skeletal muscle.
grammar.notes: control over 表“对……的控制”。

grammar.title: 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: The autonomic nervous system [is largely involuntary], and [controls the cardiac muscles, the smooth muscles and the various glands].
grammar.notes: largely = mostly，在很大程度上。

vocab.root: spinal: spine (脊柱) + -al → 脊柱的
peripheral: peri- (周围) + pher- (携带) + -al → 周边的；外围设备
neur- (神经) + -al → 神经的
熟词僻义：motor adj. 运动的 (motor nerve 运动神经)
sens- (感觉) + -ory → 感觉的
im- (进入) + pulse (推动) → 推动力 → 冲动/神经冲动
somat- (身体，来自希腊语 soma) + -ic → 躯体的
auto- (自己) + nom- (法则) + -ic → 自主的
volunt- (意愿，来自拉丁语 voluntas) + -ary → 自愿的/随意的
cardi- (心脏，来自希腊语 kardia) + -ac → 心脏的
in- (不) + voluntary → 不随意的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：二分法描述系统结构
模板：[System] consists of two divisions, [A] and [B]. The former includes [parts of A]. The latter covers [parts of B].
例句：The economy consists of two sectors, the public and the private. The former includes government services. The latter covers all privately owned businesses.

🧠 托福生理：voluntary vs involuntary
Voluntary (随意的)：受意识控制，如抬手、行走 → 骨骼肌、躯体神经系统。
Involuntary (不随意的)：不受意识控制，如心跳、消化 → 心肌、平滑肌、自主神经系统。

title: UNIT 100 · 随意运动的神经机制
body: Every voluntary movement of the head, limbs, and body is caused by nerve impulses arising in the motor area of the brain's cortex. These impulses are carried by the cranial nerves, or by nerves that emerge from the spinal cord, to connect with the appropriate skeletal muscles.
translation: 头部、四肢和身体的每一个随意运动，都是由大脑皮层运动区产生的神经冲动引起的。这些冲动由颅神经或从脊髓发出的神经传递，与相应的骨骼肌相连。
insights: 【被动因果句】原文：Every voluntary movement... is caused by nerve impulses arising in the motor area...。翻译精雕：……都是由……产生的神经冲动引起的。技巧：“是由……引起的”保留被动的因果强调。
【分词定语的前置】原文：nerve impulses arising in the motor area of the brain's cortex。翻译精雕：大脑皮层运动区产生的神经冲动。技巧：arising 现在分词前置为“产生的”。

grammar.title: 被动 + 现在分词定语
grammar.skeleton: Every voluntary movement of the head, limbs, and body + is caused by + nerve impulses [arising in the motor area of the brain's cortex].
grammar.notes: every + 单数名词作主语，谓语用单数。

grammar.title: 被动 + or 并列 + 目的不定式
grammar.skeleton: These impulses are carried by the cranial nerves, or by nerves [that emerge from the spinal cord], + to connect with the appropriate skeletal muscles.
grammar.notes: to connect 表目的/结果。

vocab.root: a- (加强) + rise → 产生/出现；arise from 由……引起
来自拉丁语 cortex “树皮” → 皮层/大脑皮质
cranial: crani- (头骨，来自希腊语 kranion) + -al → 颅的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明某行为由某机制驱动
模板：Every [action] of [subject] is caused by [signals] arising in [source]. These [signals] are carried by [channel A], or by [channel B], to connect with [target].
例句：Every major decision of the company is caused by data insights arising in the analytics team. These insights are carried by weekly reports, or by dashboards, to connect with the right managers.

title: UNIT 101 · 反射
body: Body movement may also occur in direct response to an outside stimulus; thus, a tap on the knee causes a jerk, and a light shone into the eye makes the pupil contract. These involuntary responses are called reflexes.
translation: 身体运动也可能是对外部刺激的直接反应；因此，轻敲膝盖会引起抽动，光线照进眼睛会使瞳孔收缩。这些不随意的反应被称为反射。
insights: 【in direct response to】原文：Body movement may also occur in direct response to an outside stimulus。翻译精雕：身体运动也可能是对外部刺激的直接反应。技巧：in response to 名词结构转为判断句“是对……的反应”。
【使役结构】原文：a light shone into the eye makes the pupil contract。翻译精雕：光线照进眼睛会使瞳孔收缩。技巧：make + 宾语 + 动词原形，译“使……”。
【熟词僻义】pupil 瞳孔（≠ 学生）；contract 收缩（≠ 合同）。

grammar.title: 分号 + thus 连接因果
grammar.skeleton: Body movement may also occur in direct response to an outside stimulus; + thus, + [a tap on the knee causes a jerk], and [a light shone into the eye makes the pupil contract].
grammar.notes: thus 为副词，前用分号。

grammar.title: make + 宾语 + 原形
grammar.skeleton: a light [shone into the eye] + makes + the pupil + contract.
grammar.notes: shone 为 shine 的过去分词作定语。

vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 stimulus “刺棒” → 刺激；复数 stimuli；stimulate 刺激
熟词僻义：pupil 瞳孔 (≠ 学生)
熟词僻义：contract v. 收缩 (≠ 合同)；contraction 收缩
re- (回) + flex (弯曲) → 弯回来 → 反射

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用 thus 引出具体例证
模板：[Phenomenon] may also occur in direct response to [trigger]; thus, [example 1], and [example 2]. These [adj.] responses are called [term].
例句：Prices may also change in direct response to public news; thus, a strong earnings report lifts a stock, and a scandal makes it fall. These rapid reactions are called market shocks.

title: UNIT 102 · 肌张力
body: Muscular contractions do not always cause actual movement. A small fraction of the total number of fibers that make up the muscles, are usually contracting. This serves to maintain the posture of a limb and enables the limb to resist passive elongation, or stretching that can lead to flabbiness. This slight continuous contraction is called muscle tone.
translation: 肌肉收缩并不总是引起实际的运动。在构成肌肉的全部纤维中，通常只有一小部分处于收缩状态。这有助于维持肢体的姿势，并使肢体能够抵抗被动拉长，即可能导致肌肉松弛的拉伸。这种轻微而持续的收缩被称为肌张力。
insights: 【部分否定】原文：Muscular contractions do not always cause actual movement。翻译精雕：肌肉收缩并不总是引起实际的运动。技巧：not always 为部分否定，译“并不总是”。
【a small fraction of 的语序】原文：A small fraction of the total number of fibers that make up the muscles, are usually contracting。翻译精雕：在构成肌肉的全部纤维中，通常只有一小部分处于收缩状态。技巧：先说范围“在……中”，再说部分，加“只有”体现 small。
【serve to 的译法】原文：This serves to maintain...。翻译精雕：这有助于维持……。技巧：serve to do 译“有助于/起到……作用”。

grammar.title: 部分否定
grammar.skeleton: Muscular contractions + do not always + cause actual movement.
grammar.notes: not always / not all / not every 均表部分否定。

grammar.title: 主谓一致：fraction of
grammar.skeleton: A small fraction of the total number of fibers [that make up the muscles], + are usually contracting.
grammar.notes: fraction of + 复数名词，谓语可随后面名词用复数。

grammar.title: serve to + enable sth. to do
grammar.skeleton: This serves to maintain the posture of a limb + and enables the limb to resist passive elongation, or stretching [that can lead to flabbiness].
grammar.notes: or 表同义解释。

vocab.root: fract- (破碎，来自拉丁语 frangere) + -ion → 碎片 → 小部分/分数
re- (反) + sist (站) → 反着站 → 抵抗

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明“少量但持续的作用”的意义
模板：A small fraction of [whole] are usually [active]. This serves to maintain [state] and enables [X] to resist [negative change].
例句：A small fraction of a city's police officers are usually on patrol. This serves to maintain public order and enables the community to resist small crimes.

title: UNIT 103 · 血液循环
body: The right chamber of the heart pumps blood through the lungs where it picks up oxygen. The blood is then transferred to the left side of the heart to begin its long winding passage through the body. Eventually, the blood is recirculated back into the right chambers of the heart before starting its cycle over again. The heart pumps blood into the main artery, the aorta, from where it is distributed into increasingly smaller arteries until it passes through the smallest arteries, known as arterioles. From the arterioles, the blood circulates into a vast number of tiny, thin-walled structures called capillaries. Here the blood gives up its oxygen and supplies nutrients to the body tissue. During this metabolism process, it absorbs carbon dioxide and other waste products. The blood completes its circuit by passing through small veins that merge with increasingly larger vessels until it reaches the largest veins, the inferior and superior venae cavae. These veins then return the blood to the right side of the heart before being transferred to the lungs for cleaning and restarting the circulation. Contractions of the heart muscles create the pumping action that propels the blood through the arteries and veins. Contractions of skeletal muscle also contribute to the circulation. Valves in the heart, arteries and veins, ensure the blood flows in the one direction.
translation: 心脏的右心室将血液泵入肺部，血液在那里获取氧气。随后，血液被输送到心脏左侧，开始它在全身蜿蜒漫长的旅程。最终，血液再循环回到心脏右侧，然后重新开始循环。心脏将血液泵入主动脉，再从那里分配到越来越细的动脉中，直到流经最小的动脉，即小动脉。血液从小动脉流入数量庞大的细小薄壁结构——毛细血管。在这里，血液释放出氧气，并为身体组织提供营养。在这一新陈代谢过程中，血液吸收二氧化碳和其他代谢废物。血液经由小静脉完成循环，小静脉汇入越来越粗的血管，直到到达最大的静脉，即下腔静脉和上腔静脉。这些静脉将血液送回心脏右侧，再输送到肺部进行净化，重新开始循环。心肌收缩产生泵血作用，推动血液在动脉和静脉中流动。骨骼肌的收缩也有助于血液循环。心脏、动脉和静脉中的瓣膜确保血液单向流动。
insights: 【where 从句的连贯】原文：pumps blood through the lungs where it picks up oxygen。翻译精雕：将血液泵入肺部，血液在那里获取氧气。技巧：where 从句译为“在那里……”，保持动作顺序。
【increasingly + 比较级】原文：distributed into increasingly smaller arteries。翻译精雕：分配到越来越细的动脉中。技巧：increasingly + adj. 译为“越来越……”。
【give up 的熟词僻义】原文：the blood gives up its oxygen。翻译精雕：血液释放出氧气。技巧：give up 在此是“交出、释放”，不是“放弃”。
【长篇流程的衔接词】原文多用 then / Eventually / From... / Here / During...。翻译精雕：随后 / 最终 / 从……/ 在这里 / 在……过程中。技巧：保留时间与空间衔接词，读者才能跟上循环路线。

grammar.title: from where 从句
grammar.skeleton: The heart pumps blood into the main artery, the aorta, + [from where it is distributed into increasingly smaller arteries] + until it passes through the smallest arteries, [known as arterioles].
grammar.notes: from where = from which place。

grammar.title: by doing + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: The blood completes its circuit + by passing through small veins + [that merge with increasingly larger vessels] + until it reaches the largest veins, the inferior and superior venae cavae.
grammar.notes: merge with 表“汇入”。

grammar.title: ensure + 宾语从句
grammar.skeleton: Valves in the heart, arteries and veins, + ensure (that) the blood flows in the one direction.
grammar.notes: ensure 后的 that 可省略。

vocab.root: 来自希腊语 arteria “气管” (古人以为动脉输送空气) → 动脉；引申“交通干线”
capill- (毛发，来自拉丁语 capillus) + -ary → 毛发般细的 → 毛细血管
ab- (离开) + sorb (吸，来自拉丁语 sorbere) → 吸收
meta- (变化) + bol- (扔) + -ism → 物质转化 → 新陈代谢
circ- (圆) + it (走) → 绕圈走 → 回路/一圈
熟词僻义：vessel 血管 (blood vessel)；亦作“船只、容器”
infer- (下方) + -ior (比较级) → 下方的；劣等的
super- (上方) + -ior → 上方的；优越的
con- (共同) + tribute (给予) → 共同给予 → 贡献

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述逐级分配的过程
模板：[Source] pumps [X] into [main channel], from where it is distributed into increasingly smaller [channels] until it reaches [end point].
例句：The central bank pumps money into major banks, from where it is distributed into increasingly smaller lenders until it reaches individual borrowers.

❤️ 托福生理：体循环 vs 肺循环
Pulmonary circulation (肺循环)：右心室 → 肺动脉 → 肺 (获取氧气) → 肺静脉 → 左心房。
Systemic circulation (体循环)：左心室 → 主动脉 → 全身毛细血管 → 上下腔静脉 → 右心房。

title: UNIT 104 · 免疫系统的双重机制
body: The body's defence against foreign proteins and infectious micro-organisms, involves a complex dual system. The two parts of the system are termed, cellular immunity, in which lymphocytes are the effective agent, and humoral immunity, based on the action of antibody molecules. The immunity system depends on a portion of the invader's surface pattern being recognized before the appropriate agents are activated.
translation: 人体抵御外来蛋白质和传染性微生物的防御，涉及一个复杂的双重系统。该系统的两个部分分别被称为细胞免疫和体液免疫：在细胞免疫中，淋巴细胞是起作用的因子；而体液免疫则以抗体分子的作用为基础。免疫系统要发挥作用，取决于入侵者表面的部分特征模式先被识别出来，然后相应的因子才会被激活。
insights: 【双重系统的并列译法】原文：The two parts of the system are termed, cellular immunity, in which..., and humoral immunity, based on...。翻译精雕：该系统的两个部分分别被称为细胞免疫和体液免疫：在细胞免疫中……；而体液免疫则……。技巧：先给出两个名称，再用冒号分述，层次清晰。
【动名词复合结构】原文：depends on a portion of the invader's surface pattern being recognized before...。翻译精雕：取决于入侵者表面的部分特征模式先被识别出来，然后……才会被激活。技巧：名词 + being done 是动名词复合结构，before 译为“先……然后才……”。

grammar.title: be termed + in which / based on
grammar.skeleton: The two parts of the system are termed, + [cellular immunity, in which lymphocytes are the effective agent], + and [humoral immunity, based on the action of antibody molecules].
grammar.notes: in which 从句与 based on 分词短语分别修饰两个术语。

grammar.title: depend on + 动名词复合结构
grammar.skeleton: The immunity system depends on + [a portion of the invader's surface pattern being recognized] + before the appropriate agents are activated.
grammar.notes: sth. being done 作 on 的宾语，sth. 是逻辑主语。

vocab.root: im- (免除) + mune (义务，来自拉丁语 munus) → 免除负担的 → 免疫的
熟词僻义：foreign 外来的、异物的 (foreign body 异物)
dual: du- (二) + -al → 双重的
lympho- (淋巴) + cyte (细胞) → 淋巴细胞
humor (体液，古义) + -al → 体液的
anti- (抗) + body → 抗体
act (行动) + -ive + -ate → 使活跃

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述双重/二元系统
模板：[X] involves a complex dual system. The two parts of the system are termed [A], in which [mechanism A], and [B], based on [mechanism B].
例句：Modern governance involves a complex dual system. The two parts of the system are termed central authority, in which national laws apply, and local autonomy, based on regional decision-making.

title: UNIT 105 · 淋巴细胞与抗体
body: The composition of lymphocytes resembles that of blood plasma. The lymphocytes are manufactured in the bone marrow and multiply in the thymus and spleen. They circulate in the bloodstream and penetrate the walls of capillaries to reach the tissue cells. When particular lymphocytes recognize the pattern of an antigen, they release a large number of antibodies to attack the foreign molecule. Antibodies alert the body's defence arsenal by attaching themselves to the antigen and identifying them for destruction by phagocytes. The phagocytes are primarily a complement of complex enzymes that engulf and digest foreign matter.
translation: 淋巴液的成分与血浆的成分相似。淋巴细胞在骨髓中生成，并在胸腺和脾脏中增殖。它们在血液中循环，并穿透毛细血管壁到达组织细胞。当特定的淋巴细胞识别出抗原的模式时，就会释放大量抗体来攻击这种外来分子。抗体通过附着在抗原上并对其进行标记，以供吞噬细胞摧毁，从而向人体的防御武器库发出警报。吞噬细胞主要由一组复杂的酶构成，它们会吞噬并消化外来物质。
insights: 【that of 还原】原文：The composition of lymphocytes resembles that of blood plasma。翻译精雕：淋巴液的成分与血浆的成分相似。技巧：that 指代 composition。注：原文 lymphocytes 此处实指“淋巴液 (lymph)”，翻译按语义处理。
【比喻的保留】原文：Antibodies alert the body's defence arsenal。翻译精雕：向人体的防御武器库发出警报。技巧：军事比喻（arsenal 武器库）在科普文中常见，应保留。
【by doing 方式的后置】原文：by attaching themselves to the antigen and identifying them for destruction by phagocytes。翻译精雕：通过附着在抗原上并对其进行标记，以供吞噬细胞摧毁。技巧：for destruction by 译“以供……摧毁”。

grammar.title: 并列被动谓语
grammar.skeleton: The lymphocytes [are manufactured in the bone marrow] and [multiply in the thymus and spleen].
grammar.notes: 被动 are manufactured 与主动 multiply 并列。

grammar.title: When 从句 + 目的不定式
grammar.skeleton: When particular lymphocytes recognize the pattern of an antigen, + they release a large number of antibodies + to attack the foreign molecule.
grammar.notes: to attack 表目的。

grammar.title: by doing + 双动名词
grammar.skeleton: Antibodies alert the body's defence arsenal + by [attaching themselves to the antigen] and [identifying them for destruction by phagocytes].
grammar.notes: 原文 them 应为 it (指 antigen)，写作时注意代词一致。

vocab.root: anti- (抗) + gen (产生) → 引起抗体产生的物质 → 抗原
熟词僻义：complement 补体；本义“补充物”，注意与 compliment (称赞) 区分
phago- (吃，来自希腊语 phagein) + cyte (细胞) → 吞噬细胞
en- (使进入) + gulf (海湾/深渊) → 吞没

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述识别—响应—清除的机制
模板：When [detector] recognizes the pattern of [threat], [it] releases [response] to attack [threat]. [Response] alerts [system] by [marking] [threat] for destruction by [final agent].
例句：When the security software recognizes the pattern of a virus, it releases a quarantine command to isolate the file. The command alerts the system by tagging the file for deletion by the cleanup tool.

title: UNIT 106 · 呼吸系统
body: Blood is re-oxygenated in the lungs, where the oxygen enters the blood through tiny capillaries and combines with the hemoglobin in the red blood cells, before returning to the blood stream. Air is drawn into the lungs by inhaling and is the source of the oxygen that passes into the blood. As the air is exhaled from the lungs, it expels unwanted carbon dioxide which has replaced the oxygen. Contractions of the diaphragm, and of the muscles between the ribs, control the size and gross capacity of the chest.
translation: 血液在肺部重新获得氧气：氧气通过细小的毛细血管进入血液，与红细胞中的血红蛋白结合，然后再回到血流中。空气通过吸气被吸入肺部，它是进入血液的氧气的来源。当空气从肺部呼出时，便排出了取代氧气的多余二氧化碳。膈肌和肋间肌的收缩控制着胸腔的大小和总容量。
insights: 【前缀 re- 的译法】原文：Blood is re-oxygenated in the lungs。翻译精雕：血液在肺部重新获得氧气。技巧：re- 表“重新”，oxygenate 动词译为“获得氧气”。
【where 从句改冒号】原文：..., where the oxygen enters the blood through tiny capillaries and combines with...。翻译精雕：……：氧气通过……进入血液，与……结合。技巧：where 从句是对前句的具体说明，用冒号引出。
【定语从句的意译】原文：expels unwanted carbon dioxide which has replaced the oxygen。翻译精雕：排出了取代氧气的多余二氧化碳。技巧：unwanted 译“多余的”比“不想要的”更符合科技文体。

grammar.title: where 从句 + 并列谓语 + before doing
grammar.skeleton: Blood is re-oxygenated in the lungs, + [where the oxygen enters the blood through tiny capillaries and combines with the hemoglobin in the red blood cells], + before returning to the blood stream.
grammar.notes: before returning 的逻辑主语是 blood。

grammar.title: 被动 + by doing + 并列表语
grammar.skeleton: Air [is drawn into the lungs by inhaling] and [is the source of the oxygen [that passes into the blood]].
grammar.notes: be drawn into 表“被吸入”。

hemo- (血) + globin (球蛋白) → 血红蛋白

模板：[Input] is drawn into [organ] by [action] and is the source of [resource]. As [output] is [released], it expels unwanted [waste] which has replaced [resource].
例句：Fresh capital is drawn into the startup by fundraising and is the source of its growth. As old shares are sold, the company expels inactive investors who have replaced its early backers.

title: UNIT 107 · 消化与排泄
body: Chewing breaks food into fragments and mixes it with saliva before digestion begins. The food passes down the gullet into the stomach, where the gastric and intestinal juices continue the digestion process. This mixture of food and secretions is called chyme, and is pushed down the alimentary canal by the rhythmic contractions of the smooth muscle of the gastrointestinal system. This process is referred to as peristalsis, and leads to the small intestine where most of the nutrients are absorbed from the chyme. The unabsorbed remainder, and waste substances from the liver, pass to the large intestine and are expelled as feces. Water and water-soluble substances travel via the bloodstream from the intestines to the kidneys where all the constituents of the blood plasma are absorbed, except its proteins. The kidneys return most of the water and salts to the body, but excrete unwanted salts, waste products, and excess water, as urine.
translation: 在消化开始之前，咀嚼会把食物分解成碎块，并与唾液混合。食物沿食管进入胃，胃液和肠液在那里继续消化过程。这种食物与分泌物的混合物被称为食糜，在胃肠系统平滑肌有节律的收缩作用下，被推向消化道下方。这一过程被称为蠕动，它把食糜推向小肠，大部分营养物质在小肠中被吸收。未被吸收的残余物以及来自肝脏的废物进入大肠，以粪便的形式排出体外。水和水溶性物质经由血液从肠道运送到肾脏，在肾脏中，除蛋白质以外，血浆的所有成分都会被过滤吸收。肾脏将大部分水和盐分送回体内，但会将多余的盐分、代谢废物和多余的水分以尿液的形式排出。
insights: 【break into 的译法】原文：Chewing breaks food into fragments。翻译精雕：咀嚼会把食物分解成碎块。技巧：break A into B 译“把 A 分解成 B”。
【被动 + by 的主动化】原文：is pushed down the alimentary canal by the rhythmic contractions...。翻译精雕：在……有节律的收缩作用下，被推向消化道下方。技巧：by 短语较长时，可译为“在……作用下”。
【except 的位置】原文：where all the constituents of the blood plasma are absorbed, except its proteins。翻译精雕：除蛋白质以外，血浆的所有成分都会被……。技巧：except 成分在中文中前置为“除……以外”。

grammar.title: 被动 + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: This mixture of food and secretions [is called chyme], and [is pushed down the alimentary canal by the rhythmic contractions of the smooth muscle of the gastrointestinal system].
grammar.notes: 两个被动谓语共享主语。

grammar.title: where 从句修饰器官
grammar.skeleton: This process is referred to as peristalsis, + and leads to the small intestine + [where most of the nutrients are absorbed from the chyme].
grammar.notes: lead to 此处为字面义“通向”。

grammar.notes: excrete A as B 表“把 A 以 B 的形式排出”。

例句：The editing team returns most of the strong material to the manuscript, but cuts unwanted repetition, filler, and excess detail, as notes for future work.

title: UNIT 108 · 内分泌系统
body: In addition to the integrative action of the nervous system, the endocrine glands control various other body functions. The pituitary gland is an important part of this system. This master gland lies at the base of the brain and secretes a variety of hormones. Vasopressin is secreted from the posterior lobe and acts on the kidney to control the volume of urine. The pancreas is another gland in the endocrine system, used to secrete insulin. The parathyroid gland secretes a hormone that regulates the quantity of calcium and phosphorus in the blood.
translation: 除了神经系统的整合作用之外，内分泌腺还控制着身体的各种其他功能。脑垂体是这一系统的重要组成部分。这个“主腺”位于大脑底部，分泌多种激素。血管加压素由脑垂体后叶分泌，作用于肾脏以控制尿量。胰腺是内分泌系统中的另一种腺体，用于分泌胰岛素。甲状旁腺分泌一种调节血液中钙和磷含量的激素。
insights: 【In addition to 的译法】原文：In addition to the integrative action of the nervous system...。翻译精雕：除了神经系统的整合作用之外……。技巧：in addition to 译“除了……之外（还）”。
【master gland 的比喻】原文：This master gland。翻译精雕：这个“主腺”。技巧：master 比喻统领地位，加引号表示比喻用法。
【act on】原文：acts on the kidney to control the volume of urine。翻译精雕：作用于肾脏以控制尿量。技巧：act on 固定译“作用于”。

grammar.title: In addition to + 主句
grammar.skeleton: In addition to the integrative action of the nervous system, + the endocrine glands control various other body functions.
grammar.notes: in addition to + 名词/动名词。

grammar.title: 被动 + 并列谓语 + 目的
grammar.skeleton: Vasopressin [is secreted from the posterior lobe] and [acts on the kidney to control the volume of urine].
grammar.notes: to control 表目的。

grammar.title: 过去分词作后置定语
grammar.skeleton: The pancreas is another gland in the endocrine system, + [used to secrete insulin].
grammar.notes: used to do = 被用来做 (≠ used to do 过去常常)。

例句：In addition to the federal government, state governments control various other public services. The governor's office is an important part of this system. This master office sits in the state capital and issues executive orders.

title: UNIT 109 · 人类生殖
body: Reproduction is accomplished by the union of male sperm and the female ovum. In coitus, the male organ ejaculates more than 250 million sperm into the vagina, from where, some make their way to the uterus. Approximately every 28 days, ovulation occurs as an egg is released into the uterus. It is during this period that the uterus is prepared for the implantation of a fertilized ovum by the action of estrogens. If a male cell fails to unite with a female cell, other hormones cause the uterine wall to slough and menstruation occurs. From puberty to menopause, the processes of ovulation, preparation, and menstruation are repeated monthly, except during the months when the female is pregnant.
translation: 生殖是通过男性精子与女性卵子的结合来完成的。性交时，男性器官会将超过 2.5 亿个精子射入阴道，其中一部分精子从那里进入子宫。大约每 28 天，会有一个卵子被释放出来，即发生排卵。正是在这一时期，子宫在雌激素的作用下做好准备，以便受精卵着床。如果精子未能与卵子结合，其他激素会导致子宫内膜脱落，月经随之出现。从青春期到绝经期，排卵、准备和月经的过程每月重复一次，怀孕期间除外。
insights: 【强调句 It is... that】原文：It is during this period that the uterus is prepared for...。翻译精雕：正是在这一时期，子宫……做好准备。技巧：It is... that 强调句译“正是……”。
【fail to 的译法】原文：If a male cell fails to unite with a female cell。翻译精雕：如果精子未能与卵子结合。技巧：fail to do 译“未能”。
【except during 的处理】原文：are repeated monthly, except during the months when the female is pregnant。翻译精雕：每月重复一次，怀孕期间除外。技巧：长 except 短语可压缩为“……除外”。

grammar.title: 被动 + by 方式
grammar.skeleton: Reproduction is accomplished + by the union of male sperm and the female ovum.
grammar.notes: be accomplished by = 通过……完成。

grammar.title: It is + 状语 + that 强调句
grammar.skeleton: It is [during this period] that the uterus is prepared for the implantation of a fertilized ovum + by the action of estrogens.
grammar.notes: 强调时间状语。

grammar.title: cause + 宾语 + to do
grammar.skeleton: other hormones cause the uterine wall to slough + and menstruation occurs.
grammar.notes: cause sth. to do 表“导致……”。

vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 ovum “蛋” → 卵子；复数 ova；oval 椭圆形的
