✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用强调句突出关键时间
模板：It is during [period] that [key event] by [mechanism].
例句：It is during early childhood that language ability is shaped by daily interaction.

title: UNIT 110 · 皮肤的结构与功能
body: The dermis is the inner layer of the skin containing the sweat glands, blood vessels, nerve endings, and the base for hair and nails. The epidermis is the outer layer of the skin and is only a few cells thick. The surface is made of dead cells which are shed from the body, but it also contains pigments, pores, and ducts. The sweat glands excrete waste through the pores which serve to cool the body as the fluid droplets evaporate. The blood vessels of the dermis supplement temperature regulation by contracting to preserve body heat and expanding to dissipate it. Separate kinds of receptors convey pressure, temperature and pain to the brain. Fat cells in the dermis insulate the body and oil glands serve to lubricate the epidermis.
translation: 真皮是皮肤的内层，含有汗腺、血管、神经末梢以及毛发和指甲的根基。表皮是皮肤的外层，只有几层细胞那么厚。表皮的表面由死细胞构成，这些死细胞会从身体上脱落，但表皮也含有色素、毛孔和导管。汗腺通过毛孔排出废物，汗液蒸发时起到为身体降温的作用。真皮中的血管通过收缩来保存体热、通过扩张来散热，从而辅助调节体温。不同种类的感受器把压力、温度和疼痛的信息传递给大脑。真皮中的脂肪细胞为身体隔热，而皮脂腺则起到润滑表皮的作用。
insights: 【only a few cells thick】原文：is only a few cells thick。翻译精雕：只有几层细胞那么厚。技巧：数量 + 单位 + 形容词 (a few cells thick) 译为“只有……那么厚”。
【对称动名词】原文：by contracting to preserve body heat and expanding to dissipate it。翻译精雕：通过收缩来保存体热、通过扩张来散热。技巧：保持对称结构，重复“通过……来……”。
【serve to 的统一译法】原文：pores which serve to cool the body / oil glands serve to lubricate...。翻译精雕：起到为身体降温的作用 / 起到润滑……的作用。技巧：同一篇中 serve to 统一译“起到……作用”。

grammar.title: 现在分词定语 + 并列宾语
grammar.skeleton: The dermis is the inner layer of the skin + [containing the sweat glands, blood vessels, nerve endings, and the base for hair and nails].
grammar.notes: containing 修饰 layer。

grammar.title: 数量 + 形容词
grammar.skeleton: The epidermis is the outer layer of the skin + and is only a few cells thick.
grammar.notes: 表示尺寸：three meters long / a few cells thick。

grammar.title: by doing + 对称结构
grammar.skeleton: The blood vessels of the dermis supplement temperature regulation + by [contracting to preserve body heat] and [expanding to dissipate it].
grammar.notes: 两个动名词各带目的不定式。

epi- (在上) + dermis → 表皮

vocab.meaning: 管：管状体内通道，尤指运输腺分泌物的管道

vocab.root: 另义：shed light on 阐明；shed tears 流泪
e- (出) + vapor (蒸汽) + -ation → 蒸发
supple- (补充，来自拉丁语 supplere) + -ment → 补充

模板：[Layer A] is the inner layer of [X], containing [components]. [Layer B] is the outer layer and is only [measure]. [Component] serves to [function].
例句：The core team is the inner layer of the organization, containing the founders and key engineers. The partner network is the outer layer and is only a few contracts deep. The advisory board serves to guide strategy.

title: UNIT 111 · 人耳的听觉能力
body: Vertebrates are the class of animals with backbones and they are the only ones that have ears. Invertebrate animals, such as jellyfish and insects, have other structures and organs that compensate for their lack of ears. Human ears are capable of perceiving an extraordinarily wide variation in the volume of noise. The tiniest audible sound is about 1 trillion times less intense than a sound loud enough to cause pain to the ear. Besides the volume of sound, the human ear can distinguish the pitch related to the vibration frequency of a sound. Similarly, the human ear can differentiate the various tones related to sounds. Masking is a sonic phenomenon that occurs when lower-pitched sounds tend to deafen the ear and make it harder to hear higher-pitched sounds.
translation: 脊椎动物是有脊椎的一类动物，它们是唯一长有耳朵的动物。水母和昆虫等无脊椎动物则拥有其他结构和器官，以弥补它们没有耳朵的缺陷。人耳能够感知范围极其宽广的音量变化。最微弱的可听声音的强度，大约只有足以让耳朵感到疼痛的声音的一万亿分之一。除了音量之外，人耳还能分辨与声音振动频率相关的音高。同样，人耳还能区分与声音相关的各种音色。掩蔽是一种声学现象，当较低音调的声音使耳朵“发聋”，使人更难听到较高音调的声音时，就会出现这种现象。
insights: 【compensate for】原文：have other structures and organs that compensate for their lack of ears。翻译精雕：拥有其他结构和器官，以弥补它们没有耳朵的缺陷。技巧：compensate for 译“弥补”。

【倍数表达的转换】原文：The tiniest audible sound is about 1 trillion times less intense than a sound loud enough to cause pain。翻译精雕：最微弱的可听声音的强度，大约只有……声音的一万亿分之一。技巧：英文 X times less than 在中文中应转为“只有……的 X 分之一”，避免“少一万亿倍”这类不合逻辑的表达。
【Besides / Similarly 衔接】原文：Besides the volume of sound... Similarly...。翻译精雕：除了音量之外……同样……。技巧：保留衔接词，体现层层递进。

grammar.title: be capable of + doing
grammar.skeleton: Human ears are capable of + perceiving an extraordinarily wide variation in the volume of noise.
grammar.notes: be capable of doing 表能力。

grammar.title: 倍数比较 + enough to do
grammar.skeleton: The tiniest audible sound is about 1 trillion times less intense + than a sound [loud enough to cause pain to the ear].
grammar.notes: adj. + enough to do 后置修饰 sound。

grammar.title: when 从句 + make + 宾语 + 形容词
grammar.skeleton: Masking is a sonic phenomenon + [that occurs when lower-pitched sounds tend to deafen the ear and make it harder to hear higher-pitched sounds].
grammar.notes: make it harder to do 中 it 为形式宾语。

aud- (听) + -ible → 听得见的；inaudible 听不见的
de- (去除) + tect (覆盖) → 揭开覆盖 → 察觉/探测

vocab.meaning: 振动频率 (原书为 vibration frequency)

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

title: UNIT 112 · 视觉的本质
body: The actual process of seeing is performed by the brain rather than the eye. The function of eyes is to translate the electromagnetic vibrations of light into patterns of nerve impulses that are transmitted to the brain.
translation: 真正的“看”这一过程是由大脑而非眼睛完成的。眼睛的功能是将光的电磁振动转化为神经冲动的模式，再传送到大脑。
insights: 【rather than 的对比】原文：The actual process of seeing is performed by the brain rather than the eye。翻译精雕：真正的“看”这一过程是由大脑而非眼睛完成的。技巧：rather than 译“而非”，突出反常识观点。
【translate A into B】原文：to translate the electromagnetic vibrations of light into patterns of nerve impulses。翻译精雕：将光的电磁振动转化为神经冲动的模式。技巧：translate 非语言语境译“转化”。

grammar.title: 被动 + rather than
grammar.skeleton: The actual process of seeing + is performed by + the brain rather than the eye.
grammar.notes: rather than 连接两个并列成分。

grammar.title: 不定式表语 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: The function of eyes is + to translate the electromagnetic vibrations of light into patterns of nerve impulses + [that are transmitted to the brain].
grammar.notes: that 指代 patterns。

vocab.root: electro- (电) + magnetic (磁的) → 电磁的
trans- (穿过) + mit (送) → 传送

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：纠正常识误解的定义句
模板：The actual process of [X] is performed by [true agent] rather than [assumed agent]. The function of [assumed agent] is to translate [input] into [output] that is transmitted to [true agent].
例句：The actual process of learning is performed by the student rather than the teacher. The function of the teacher is to translate knowledge into structured experiences that are transmitted to the student.

title: UNIT 113 · 眼球的结构
body: The human eyeball is a spherical structure with a pronounced bulge on its exposed front surface. The outer part of the eye is composed of three layers of tissue. The front of the eyeball has a protective outside layer called the sclera, and it is continuous with the bulging transparent cornea. The choroid is the layer of blood vessels between the sclera and the retina, and joins the ciliary body. The iris is the coloured part of the eyeball behind the cornea and adjusts for the amount of light available. The innermost layer is the light-sensitive retina which connects to the optic nerve.
translation: 人的眼球是一个球形结构，其暴露在外的前表面有一个明显的凸起。眼球外部由三层组织构成。眼球前部有一层名为巩膜的外保护层，它与凸起的透明角膜相连续。脉络膜是位于巩膜和视网膜之间的血管层，与睫状体相连。虹膜是位于角膜后面的眼球有色部分，可根据可用光线的多少进行调节。最内层是对光敏感的视网膜，它与视神经相连。
insights: 【with 介词短语的译法】原文：a spherical structure with a pronounced bulge on its exposed front surface。翻译精雕：一个球形结构，其暴露在外的前表面有一个明显的凸起。技巧：with 短语较长时拆为独立分句。
【熟词僻义】原文：pronounced bulge。翻译精雕：明显的凸起。技巧：pronounced 作形容词意为“明显的”，不是“发音的”。
【be continuous with】原文：it is continuous with the bulging transparent cornea。翻译精雕：它与凸起的透明角膜相连续。技巧：be continuous with 解剖学中意为“与……相连续”。

grammar.title: 主系表 + with 短语
grammar.skeleton: The human eyeball is a spherical structure + [with a pronounced bulge on its exposed front surface].
grammar.notes: with 表“带有”。

grammar.title: 分词定语 + 并列
grammar.skeleton: The front of the eyeball has a protective outside layer [called the sclera], + and it is continuous with the bulging transparent cornea.
grammar.notes: bulging 现在分词作定语。

grammar.title: adjust for
grammar.skeleton: The iris is the coloured part of the eyeball behind the cornea + and adjusts for the amount of light available.
grammar.notes: available 后置修饰 light。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：pronounced adj. 明显的、显著的
optic: opt- (看) + -ic → 视觉的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：由外向内描述层级结构
模板：The outer part of [X] is composed of three layers. [Layer 1] is [description]. [Layer 2] lies between [A] and [B]. The innermost layer is [layer 3], which connects to [Y].
例句：The outer part of the Earth is composed of three layers. The crust is the thin rocky shell. The mantle lies between the crust and the core. The innermost layer is the core, which generates the magnetic field.

title: UNIT 114 · 角膜与晶状体
body: The cornea is a tough, five-layered membrane through which light is admitted to the interior of the eye. Behind the cornea is a chamber filled with clear watery fluid called the aqueous humor. This separates the cornea from the crystalline lens. The lens itself is a flattened sphere constructed of a large number of transparent fibers arranged in layers. It is connected by ligaments to a ringlike muscle. This muscle can change the focal length of the lens by flattening it or making it more nearly spherical.
translation: 角膜是一层坚韧的五层膜，光线通过它进入眼睛内部。角膜后面是一个充满清澈水状液体的腔室，这种液体被称为房水。它将角膜与晶状体隔开。晶状体本身是一个扁平的球体，由大量分层排列的透明纤维构成。它通过韧带与一圈环形肌肉相连。这块肌肉可以通过使晶状体变扁平或变得更接近球形来改变其焦距。
insights: 【through which 定语从句】原文：a tough, five-layered membrane through which light is admitted to the interior of the eye。翻译精雕：一层坚韧的五层膜，光线通过它进入眼睛内部。技巧：介词 + which 拆为“……通过它……”。
【倒装句】原文：Behind the cornea is a chamber filled with...。翻译精雕：角膜后面是一个充满……的腔室。技巧：地点状语提前的完全倒装，中文顺译即可。
【by doing 并列】原文：by flattening it or making it more nearly spherical。翻译精雕：通过使晶状体变扁平或变得更接近球形。技巧：两个使役动名词对称翻译。

grammar.title: 介词 + which 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: The cornea is a tough, five-layered membrane + [through which light is admitted to the interior of the eye].
grammar.notes: be admitted to 表“被允许进入”。

grammar.title: 完全倒装
grammar.skeleton: Behind the cornea + is + a chamber [filled with clear watery fluid [called the aqueous humor]].
grammar.notes: 地点状语前置 + 系动词 + 主语。

grammar.title: by + 两个使役动名词
grammar.skeleton: This muscle can change the focal length of the lens + by [flattening it] or [making it more nearly spherical].
grammar.notes: make it + adj. 复合宾语。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：admit 允许进入 (admit light)

vocab.meaning: 有机物体内封闭的腔；室

vocab.root: aqua- (水) + -eous → 水的；aquatic 水生的
熟词僻义：humor (眼球中的) 液体 (aqueous humor 房水)

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用倒装描述空间位置
模板：Behind [A] is a [space] filled with [substance] called [term]. This separates [A] from [B].
例句：Behind the main stage is a narrow corridor filled with props called the wings. This separates the stage from the dressing rooms.

title: UNIT 115 · 眼睑与泪腺的保护
body: The eyelids are one of the most important structures that contribute to the protection of the eyeball itself. These consist of an upper and lower fold of skin and tissue, which opens and closes the eyelid by means of muscles. The eyelid provides a protective covering over the eyeball against excessive light and mechanical injury. The eyelashes are a fringe of short hairs growing on the edge of either eyelid. When the eyelids are partly closed, the lashes act as a screen to keep dust particles and insects out of the eyes. The conjunctiva is a thin protective membrane inside the eyelids, which doubles over to cover the visible sclera. Each eye also has a tear gland, situated at the outside corner of the eye. The salty secretion of these glands lubricates the forward part of the eyeballs when the eyelids are closed and flushes away any small dust particles, or other foreign matter, on the surface of the eyes.
translation: 眼睑是保护眼球本身的最重要结构之一。眼睑由上下两层皮肤和组织褶皱构成，通过肌肉的作用开合。眼睑为眼球提供保护性覆盖，防止过强的光线和机械损伤。睫毛是长在每个眼睑边缘的一排短毛。当眼睑半闭时，睫毛起到屏障作用，阻挡灰尘颗粒和昆虫进入眼睛。结膜是眼睑内侧一层薄薄的保护膜，它向后折叠，覆盖在可见的巩膜上。每只眼睛还有一个泪腺，位于眼睛的外眼角。闭眼时，这些腺体分泌的咸味液体会润滑眼球前部，并冲走眼球表面的细小灰尘颗粒或其他异物。
insights: 【one of the most + 复数】原文：The eyelids are one of the most important structures that contribute to...。翻译精雕：眼睑是保护眼球本身的最重要结构之一。技巧：one of the most + 复数名词 译“最……之一”。
【keep... out of】原文：to keep dust particles and insects out of the eyes。翻译精雕：阻挡灰尘颗粒和昆虫进入眼睛。技巧：keep A out of B 译“阻止 A 进入 B”。
【either eyelid】原文：growing on the edge of either eyelid。翻译精雕：长在每个眼睑边缘。技巧：either 在此表示“两者中任一个/每一个”。

grammar.title: one of the + 最高级 + 复数 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: The eyelids are one of the most important structures + [that contribute to the protection of the eyeball itself].
grammar.notes: 定语从句修饰 structures，谓语用复数 contribute。

grammar.title: act as + to do
grammar.skeleton: When the eyelids are partly closed, + the lashes act as a screen + to keep dust particles and insects out of the eyes.
grammar.notes: act as 表“充当”。

grammar.title: 并列谓语 + when 从句
grammar.skeleton: The salty secretion of these glands + [lubricates the forward part of the eyeballs when the eyelids are closed] + and [flushes away any small dust particles, or other foreign matter, on the surface of the eyes].
grammar.notes: flush away 表“冲走”。

vocab.root: ex- (超出) + cess (走) + -ive → 走得过头的 → 过度的
引申：fringe 边缘 (fringe groups 边缘群体)
part (部分) + -icle (小) → 微粒
situ- (位置，来自拉丁语 situs) + -ate → 位于

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明保护机制如何运作
模板：When [condition], [part] act as a screen to keep [threats] out of [protected area].
例句：When markets are volatile, diversified portfolios act as a screen to keep sudden losses out of investors' savings.

title: UNIT 116 · 舌头的功能
body: The tongue serves as an organ of taste, with taste buds scattered over its surface and concentrated toward the back of the tongue. In chewing, the tongue holds the food against the teeth; in swallowing, it moves the food back into the pharynx, and then into the esophagus when the pressure of the tongue closes the opening of the trachea, or windpipe. It also acts, together with the lips, teeth, and hard palate, to form word sounds.
translation: 舌头是味觉器官，其表面分布着味蕾，并集中于舌根部。咀嚼时，舌头把食物抵在牙齿上；吞咽时，舌头把食物向后推入咽部，当舌头的压力关闭气管口时，再将食物推入食道。舌头还与嘴唇、牙齿和硬腭一起配合，发出语音。
insights: 【with 独立结构】原文：with taste buds scattered over its surface and concentrated toward the back of the tongue。翻译精雕：其表面分布着味蕾，并集中于舌根部。技巧：with + 宾语 + 过去分词，中文转为“其……分布着……”。
【分号的对比】原文：In chewing, ...; in swallowing, ...。翻译精雕：咀嚼时，……；吞咽时，……。技巧：保留分号与平行结构。
【同位语 or】原文：the trachea, or windpipe。翻译精雕：气管。技巧：trachea 与 windpipe 同义（学术词 vs 通俗词），中文只译一次。

grammar.title: serve as + with 独立主格
grammar.skeleton: The tongue serves as an organ of taste, + [with taste buds [scattered over its surface] and [concentrated toward the back of the tongue]].
grammar.notes: 两个过去分词作宾补。

grammar.title: In doing + 分号平行
grammar.skeleton: In chewing, the tongue holds the food against the teeth; + in swallowing, it moves the food back into the pharynx, and then into the esophagus + when the pressure of the tongue closes the opening of the trachea.
grammar.notes: in doing 表“在……时”。

grammar.title: together with 插入
grammar.skeleton: It also acts, [together with the lips, teeth, and hard palate], + to form word sounds.
grammar.notes: together with 不影响主谓一致。

vocab.root: palate 另义：味觉、口味

句型：用平行结构描述不同阶段的作用
模板：In [stage A], [subject] [action A]; in [stage B], it [action B].
例句：In planning, the manager sets clear goals; in execution, she removes obstacles for the team.

title: UNIT 117 · 原子：理解物质世界的关键
body: Understanding atoms is the key to understanding the physical world. More than 100 different elements exist in nature and each has its own unique atomic makeup. The atoms of these elements react with one another and combine in different ways to form a virtually unlimited number of chemical compounds. When two or more atoms combine, they form a molecule, and it is these molecules which join together to form cells. The cells then combine in their millions to make up the humans, the animals and all the plants of the world.
translation: 理解原子是理解物质世界的关键。自然界中存在 100 多种不同的元素，每种元素都有其独特的原子构成。这些元素的原子相互反应，以不同的方式结合，形成几乎无限多种化合物。当两个或更多原子结合时，就形成了分子，而正是这些分子结合在一起，构成了细胞。细胞再以数以百万计的数量组合起来，构成了人类、动物以及世界上所有的植物。
insights: 【动名词主语的对称】原文：Understanding atoms is the key to understanding the physical world。翻译精雕：理解原子是理解物质世界的关键。技巧：the key to doing，to 为介词，后接动名词。
【强调句】原文：it is these molecules which join together to form cells。翻译精雕：正是这些分子结合在一起，构成了细胞。技巧：It is... which/that 强调句译“正是……”。
【in their millions】原文：The cells then combine in their millions。翻译精雕：细胞再以数以百万计的数量组合起来。技巧：in their millions 译“数以百万计地”。

grammar.title: the key to + doing
grammar.skeleton: Understanding atoms is the key to + understanding the physical world.
grammar.notes: key to 中 to 是介词。

grammar.title: 强调句 it is... which
grammar.skeleton: When two or more atoms combine, they form a molecule, + and it is these molecules which join together to form cells.
grammar.notes: 强调主语 these molecules。

grammar.title: make up 构成
grammar.skeleton: The cells then combine in their millions + to make up the humans, the animals and all the plants of the world.
grammar.notes: make up = constitute。

熟词僻义：makeup 构成、组成 (genetic makeup 基因构成)

句型：描述层层构成的递进关系
模板：When [A] combine, they form [B], and it is these [B] which join together to form [C]. [C] then combine to make up [D].
例句：When words combine, they form sentences, and it is these sentences which join together to form paragraphs. Paragraphs then combine to make up an essay.

title: UNIT 118 · 原子的结构
body: An atom consists of a cloud of smaller particles called electrons, which surround a small dense nucleus of protons and neutrons. Electrons and protons are electrically charged, and this affects the way they interact with each other and other electrically charged particles. Electrons carry a negative charge, while protons are positively charged. The opposing charges attract each other, similar to the opposite poles of a magnet. Conversely, like charges; negative to negative, or positive to positive; repel one another. The attraction between the electrons and protons of an atom holds the atom together. Nearly all of the mass of the atom is contained in its nucleus, although the nucleus occupies only a tiny fraction of the space inside the atom. If an atom was magnified to the size of a football stadium, the nucleus would be about the size of a grape. Each atom of an element has the same number of protons, but when the number of neutrons varies, the element is called an isotope. Isotopes are distinguished by their mass number, which is the total number of protons and neutrons that make up the atom.
translation: 原子由一团被称为电子的较小粒子构成，电子环绕着一个由质子和中子组成的小而致密的原子核。电子和质子带电，这影响着它们彼此之间以及与其他带电粒子相互作用的方式。电子带负电，而质子带正电。异性电荷相互吸引，类似于磁铁的异极相吸。相反，同性电荷——负对负，或正对正——则相互排斥。原子中电子与质子之间的吸引力使原子保持完整。原子几乎全部的质量都集中在原子核中，尽管原子核只占原子内部空间的极小部分。如果把一个原子放大到足球场那么大，原子核大约只有一颗葡萄那么大。同一元素的每个原子都有相同数目的质子，但当中子数目不同时，这种元素就被称为同位素。同位素通过其质量数来区分，质量数是构成原子的质子和中子的总数。
insights: 【虚拟语气的比喻】原文：If an atom was magnified to the size of a football stadium, the nucleus would be about the size of a grape。翻译精雕：如果把一个原子放大到足球场那么大，原子核大约只有一颗葡萄那么大。技巧：科普类比常用虚拟语气，中文加“只有”体现悬殊。
【Conversely 的译法】原文：Conversely, like charges... repel one another。翻译精雕：相反，同性电荷……则相互排斥。技巧：conversely 译“相反地”；like 此处为形容词“相同的”。
【hold together】原文：The attraction... holds the atom together。翻译精雕：……吸引力使原子保持完整。技巧：hold together 译“使……保持完整/结合在一起”。

grammar.notes: which 指代 electrons。

grammar.skeleton: Electrons carry a negative charge, + while protons are positively charged.
grammar.notes: while 表对比。

grammar.skeleton: Isotopes are distinguished by their mass number, + [which is the total number of protons and neutrons [that make up the atom]].
grammar.notes: which 指代 mass number。

neutr- (中性) + -on → 中子
con- + vers- (转) + -e + -ly → 反过来 → 相反地
熟词僻义：like adj. 相同的 (like charges 同性电荷)
re- (回) + pel (推) → 推回 → 排斥；repellent 驱虫剂

title: UNIT 119 · 波的传播
body: Wave motions can be transmitted transversely or longitudinally, and in both cases, only the energy of wave motion is propagated through the medium. None of the medium itself actually moves very far.
translation: 波动可以以横波或纵波的方式传播，在这两种情况下，通过介质传播的只是波动的能量。介质本身并不会真正移动很远。
insights: 【only 的强调】原文：only the energy of wave motion is propagated through the medium。翻译精雕：通过介质传播的只是波动的能量。技巧：用“……的只是……”的分裂句式突出 only。
【全部否定】原文：None of the medium itself actually moves very far。翻译精雕：介质本身并不会真正移动很远。技巧：none of 为全部否定，结合语义译为“并不会”。

grammar.title: 被动 + in both cases
grammar.skeleton: Wave motions can be transmitted transversely or longitudinally, + and in both cases, + only the energy of wave motion is propagated through the medium.
grammar.notes: transversely / longitudinally 两个副词修饰 transmitted。

grammar.title: None of 全部否定
grammar.skeleton: None of the medium itself + actually moves very far.
grammar.notes: none of + 不可数名词，谓语用单数。

vocab.root: trans- (横过) + vers- (转) + -e + -ly → 横向地
longitude (经度/长度) + -al + -ly → 纵向地

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：区分“传递的内容”与“载体本身”
模板：[Signals] can be transmitted [way A] or [way B], and in both cases, only the [content] is propagated through [medium]. None of [medium] itself actually [moves].
例句：Ideas can be transmitted orally or in writing, and in both cases, only the meaning is propagated through language. None of the speaker's thoughts themselves actually leave the mind.

🌊 横波 vs 纵波
Transverse wave (横波)：质点振动方向与波的传播方向垂直，如光波、水面波。
Longitudinal wave (纵波)：质点振动方向与传播方向平行，如声波。

title: UNIT 120 · 声波的传播
body: A sound wave is a series of alternate increases and decreases in air pressure. The energy of the wave motion is propagated outward from the center of the disturbance that is its origin. The individual air molecules carrying the sound, move back and forth, parallel to the direction of the wave motion. Thus, each individual molecule passes the energy on to neighboring molecules. After the sound wave has passed, each molecule remains in about the same location.
translation: 声波是空气压力一系列交替的增大和减小。波动的能量从其源头——扰动中心——向外传播。携带声音的单个空气分子沿着与波动方向平行的方向来回运动。因此，每个分子都把能量传递给相邻的分子。声波经过之后，每个分子仍大致停留在原来的位置。
insights: 【alternate 的译法】原文：a series of alternate increases and decreases in air pressure。翻译精雕：空气压力一系列交替的增大和减小。技巧：alternate 作形容词“交替的”。
【同位语从句的简化】原文：from the center of the disturbance that is its origin。翻译精雕：从其源头——扰动中心——向外传播。技巧：定语从句 that is its origin 用破折号插入，简洁明了。
【pass on】原文：each individual molecule passes the energy on to neighboring molecules。翻译精雕：每个分子都把能量传递给相邻的分子。技巧：pass sth. on to sb. 译“把……传递给……”。

grammar.title: 被动 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: The energy of the wave motion is propagated outward + from the center of the disturbance + [that is its origin].
grammar.notes: that 从句修饰 disturbance。

grammar.title: 分词定语 + 平行状语
grammar.skeleton: The individual air molecules [carrying the sound], + move back and forth, + parallel to the direction of the wave motion.
grammar.notes: parallel to 形容词短语作状语。

grammar.title: After 从句 + remain
grammar.skeleton: After the sound wave has passed, + each molecule remains in about the same location.
grammar.notes: remain 为系动词或不及物动词。

vocab.root: alter- (其他的) + -nate → 轮流的/交替的；alternative 替代的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述能量/信息的接力传递
模板：Each individual [unit] passes the [energy/information] on to neighboring [units]. After [the wave] has passed, each [unit] remains in about the same location.
例句：Each employee passes the message on to neighboring teams. After the announcement has passed through, each team remains in its original structure.

title: UNIT 121 · 产生特定频率的声音
body: Different methods are used to produce sounds at a desired frequency. For example, sirens emit sound by means of an air blast interrupted by a toothed wheel with 44 teeth.
translation: 人们采用不同的方法来产生所需频率的声音。例如，警报器通过一股被一个有 44 个齿的齿轮所断续切断的气流来发出声音。
insights: 【被动转主动】原文：Different methods are used to produce sounds at a desired frequency。翻译精雕：人们采用不同的方法来产生所需频率的声音。技巧：补主语“人们”。
【by means of + 分词】原文：by means of an air blast interrupted by a toothed wheel with 44 teeth。翻译精雕：通过一股被……齿轮所断续切断的气流。技巧：interrupt 此处指“周期性切断”，补“断续”体现机理。

grammar.title: 被动 + 目的不定式
grammar.skeleton: Different methods are used + to produce sounds at a desired frequency.
grammar.notes: at a frequency 表“以……频率”。

grammar.title: by means of + 过去分词 + with
grammar.skeleton: sirens emit sound + by means of an air blast [interrupted by a toothed wheel [with 44 teeth]].
grammar.notes: interrupted 修饰 air blast；with 修饰 wheel。

vocab.root: 另义：Siren (希腊神话) 塞壬海妖
e- (出) + mit (送) → 发出/排放；emission 排放
inter- (之间) + rupt (断裂) → 从中断开 → 打断/中断

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：举例说明实现某目标的方法
模板：Different methods are used to [goal]. For example, [device] [achieves goal] by means of [mechanism].
例句：Different methods are used to reduce noise in cities. For example, highways block traffic sound by means of tall concrete barriers.

title: UNIT 122 · 振幅与响度
body: The amplitude of a sound wave is determined from the motion of the air molecules as they move. This corresponds to the changes in air pressure that accompany the movement of the wave. A greater amplitude generates more pressure as the molecules strike the eardrum, and consequently the louder the person perceives the sound.
translation: 声波的振幅由空气分子运动时的运动幅度决定。这对应着伴随波的传播而产生的气压变化。振幅越大，分子撞击耳膜时产生的压力就越大，因此人感受到的声音就越响。
insights: 【correspond to】原文：This corresponds to the changes in air pressure that accompany the movement of the wave。翻译精雕：这对应着伴随波的传播而产生的气压变化。技巧：correspond to 译“对应于”。
【consequently 的因果链】原文：A greater amplitude generates more pressure..., and consequently the louder the person perceives the sound。翻译精雕：振幅越大，……压力就越大，因此人感受到的声音就越响。技巧：原文是“比较级因果链”，中文用“越……就越……因此……越……”。

grammar.title: 被动 + as 时间从句
grammar.skeleton: The amplitude of a sound wave is determined from the motion of the air molecules + as they move.
grammar.notes: be determined from/by 表“由……决定”。

grammar.title: 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: This corresponds to the changes in air pressure + [that accompany the movement of the wave].
grammar.notes: accompany 为及物动词，不加 with。

grammar.title: 比较级因果
grammar.skeleton: A greater amplitude generates more pressure + as the molecules strike the eardrum, + and consequently the louder the person perceives the sound.
grammar.notes: 原文后半句结构不完整，规范写法：the louder the sound the person perceives。

vocab.root: ampl- (宽大，来自拉丁语 amplus) + -itude → 幅度/振幅

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述变量之间的递进因果
模板：A greater [cause] generates more [intermediate effect], and consequently the [more adj.] [final effect].
例句：A greater investment in education generates more skilled workers, and consequently the stronger the economy becomes.

title: UNIT 123 · 声音的强度
body: The distance at which a sound can be heard depends on its intensity. Intensity is the average rate of energy flow per unit area perpendicular to the direction of propagation. A similar analogy is the rate in which a river flows through a gate in a dam.
translation: 声音能被听到的距离取决于其强度。强度是指垂直于传播方向的单位面积上能量流动的平均速率。一个类似的比喻是河水流过水坝闸门的速率。
insights: 【at which 定语从句】原文：The distance at which a sound can be heard depends on its intensity。翻译精雕：声音能被听到的距离取决于其强度。技巧：介词 + which 前置为“……的距离”。
【定义的精确性】原文：the average rate of energy flow per unit area perpendicular to the direction of propagation。翻译精雕：垂直于传播方向的单位面积上能量流动的平均速率。技巧：物理定义要保持修饰关系精确：perpendicular 修饰 area。
【类比的翻译】原文：A similar analogy is...。翻译精雕：一个类似的比喻是……。技巧：analogy 译“类比/比喻”。

grammar.title: 介词 + which 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: The distance + [at which a sound can be heard] + depends on its intensity.
grammar.notes: at which = where (在那个距离上)。

grammar.title: 定义句：多重后置修饰
grammar.skeleton: Intensity is the average rate of energy flow + [per unit area] + [perpendicular to the direction of propagation].
grammar.notes: perpendicular to 形容词短语修饰 area。

vocab.root: in- (向内) + tens- (拉紧) + -ity → 强度
ana- (按照) + log- (比例/言语) + -y → 按比例 → 类比

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用类比解释抽象概念
模板：[Concept] is [definition]. A similar analogy is [everyday example].
例句：Bandwidth is the maximum rate of data transfer across a network. A similar analogy is the number of lanes on a highway.

title: UNIT 124 · 声音的直线传播与折射
body: Sound moves forward in a straight line when travelling through a medium having uniform density. Sound is also subject to refraction and can be bent from its original path, similarly to the way light waves can be bent.
translation: 声音在密度均匀的介质中传播时沿直线前进。声音也会发生折射，可以偏离原来的路径，这与光波发生弯曲的方式类似。
insights: 【be subject to】原文：Sound is also subject to refraction。翻译精雕：声音也会发生折射。技巧：be subject to 表“会受到……影响/易发生……”。
【similarly to the way】原文：similarly to the way light waves can be bent。翻译精雕：这与光波发生弯曲的方式类似。技巧：类比成分独立成句。

grammar.title: when doing + 现在分词定语
grammar.skeleton: Sound moves forward in a straight line + when travelling through a medium [having uniform density].
grammar.notes: having uniform density = which has uniform density。

grammar.title: be subject to + 并列
grammar.skeleton: Sound is also subject to refraction + and can be bent from its original path, + similarly to the way [light waves can be bent].
grammar.notes: the way 后接定语从句。

vocab.root: uni- (一) + form (形) → 同一形态的 → 统一的/均匀的；n. 制服
re- (回) + fract (折断) + -ion → 折射

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明正常规律与例外
模板：[X] moves [normally] when [condition]. [X] is also subject to [phenomenon] and can be [changed], similarly to the way [Y] can be.
例句：Public opinion moves steadily when information is consistent. Opinion is also subject to manipulation and can be shifted, similarly to the way markets can be swayed.

title: UNIT 125 · 光学与电磁波谱
body: Optics is a branch of physical science dealing with the propagation and behavior of light. Light is part of the electromagnetic spectrum that extends from X rays to microwaves, and includes the radiant energy producing the sensation of vision.
translation: 光学是物理科学的一个分支，研究光的传播和性质。光是电磁波谱的一部分，电磁波谱从 X 射线延伸到微波，其中包括产生视觉感受的辐射能。
insights: 【deal with 的译法】原文：a branch of physical science dealing with the propagation and behavior of light。翻译精雕：物理科学的一个分支，研究光的传播和性质。技巧：deal with 在学科定义中译“研究”；behavior 译“性质/特性”。
【定语从句拆分】原文：the electromagnetic spectrum that extends from X rays to microwaves, and includes...。翻译精雕：电磁波谱，电磁波谱从……延伸到……，其中包括……。技巧：重复中心词承接。

grammar.title: 学科定义 + 分词定语
grammar.skeleton: Optics is a branch of physical science + [dealing with the propagation and behavior of light].
grammar.notes: dealing with = which deals with。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: Light is part of the electromagnetic spectrum + [that extends from X rays to microwaves, and includes the radiant energy [producing the sensation of vision]].
grammar.notes: producing 修饰 radiant energy。

vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 spectrum “影像” → 光谱；引申“范围、系列”(a wide spectrum of opinions)
radiant: radi- (光线) + -ant → 发光的/辐射的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：为学科分支下定义
模板：[Field] is a branch of [discipline] dealing with [subject A] and [subject B].
例句：Linguistics is a branch of social science dealing with the structure and evolution of language.

🌈 托福高频：spectrum 的引申

spectrum 本义“光谱”，常引申为“范围”：across the political spectrum (政治光谱的各个派别)、a broad spectrum of interests (广泛的兴趣)。

title: UNIT 126 · 透镜的成像原理
body: Lenses come in two primary forms, depending on whether their surface curve is convex or concave. A lens with two convex surfaces will always refract light rays parallel to the optic axis. The radius of the surface curve of a lens determines its focal length; the smaller the radius the shorter the focal length. With a convex lens, the rays converge to a focal point on the opposite side of the lens to the object. Concave lenses form erect, but diminished virtual images. If the object distance is smaller than the focal length of the lens, the virtual image is erect and larger than the object. These lenses can then be used as magnifiers, which is their basic application in a microscope. The angle subtended at the eye by this enlarged image is greater than would be the angle subtended by the object if it is at the normal viewing distance. The ratio of these two angles is the magnifying power of the lens.
translation: 根据表面曲面是凸面还是凹面，透镜主要分为两种形式。两面都凸的透镜总会使平行于光轴的光线发生折射。透镜表面曲率的半径决定了它的焦距：半径越小，焦距越短。对于凸透镜，光线会会聚到与物体相对的透镜另一侧的焦点上。凹透镜形成正立但缩小的虚像。如果物距小于透镜的焦距，所成的虚像是正立且比物体大的。这类透镜因此可以用作放大镜，这也是它在显微镜中的基本用途。这一放大的像在眼睛处所张的视角，大于物体处于正常观察距离时所张的视角。这两个角度之比就是透镜的放大率。
insights: 【come in two forms】原文：Lenses come in two primary forms。翻译精雕：透镜主要分为两种形式。技巧：come in + 形式/尺寸 表“有……种类”。
【the + 比较级】原文：the smaller the radius the shorter the focal length。翻译精雕：半径越小，焦距越短。技巧：标准的“越……越……”。
【原文知识勘误】原文先说凹透镜成缩小虚像，接着说“若物距小于焦距，虚像正立放大，可作放大镜”，后者实际描述的是凸透镜。翻译时保留原文，但应知道放大镜使用的是凸透镜。
【subtend 的专业译法】原文：The angle subtended at the eye。翻译精雕：在眼睛处所张的视角。技巧：subtend 是几何术语“对向/张（角）”。

grammar.title: depending on + whether
grammar.skeleton: Lenses come in two primary forms, + depending on whether their surface curve is convex or concave.
grammar.notes: whether... or... 引导宾语从句。

grammar.title: 分号 + the more... the more
grammar.skeleton: The radius of the surface curve of a lens determines its focal length; + the smaller the radius (is), the shorter the focal length (is).
grammar.notes: 双比较结构中 be 动词常省略。

grammar.title: 比较 + 倒装 + 条件
grammar.skeleton: The angle subtended at the eye by this enlarged image is greater + than would be the angle subtended by the object + if it is at the normal viewing distance.
grammar.notes: than 后倒装 (would be + 主语)，避免主语过长。

vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 radius “车辐/光线” → 半径；复数 radii
记忆：convex 凸、concave 凹 (cave 洞穴 → 凹)
con- (共同) + verge (倾向/转向) → 汇聚；反义 diverge 发散
熟词僻义：erect adj. 直立的 (erect image 正立像)
熟词僻义：virtual image 虚像；virtually 几乎

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：表达两变量的反比关系
模板：[Parameter A] determines [B]; the smaller the [A], the shorter the [B].
例句：The size of a class determines teacher attention per student; the larger the class, the less attention each student receives.

🔍 凸透镜 vs 凹透镜
Convex lens (凸透镜/会聚透镜)：光线会聚 (converge)；物距小于焦距时成正立放大虚像 → 放大镜、显微镜目镜。
Concave lens (凹透镜/发散透镜)：光线发散 (diverge)；总成正立缩小虚像 → 近视眼镜。

title: UNIT 127 · 天气与气候
body: Weather conditions are created from elements, such as temperature, humidity, cloudiness, precipitation, wind, and pressure. The combination and variation of these elements generate different weather systems that result in monsoons, thunderstorms, tornadoes and areas of high and low pressure. All weather systems have well-defined cycles and structural features, which are governed by the laws of heat and motion. The science of meteorology is the study of these conditions with a focus on weather forecasting. Climate refers to the type of weather that is experienced over a long period of time in a particular region.
translation: 天气状况由温度、湿度、云量、降水、风和气压等要素构成。这些要素的组合与变化产生了不同的天气系统，进而形成季风、雷暴、龙卷风以及高压区和低压区。所有天气系统都有明确的周期和结构特征，受热力学和运动规律支配。气象学是研究这些状况的科学，其重点在于天气预报。气候是指某一特定地区在长时间内所经历的天气类型。
insights: 【result in 的递进】原文：generate different weather systems that result in monsoons...。翻译精雕：产生了不同的天气系统，进而形成季风……。技巧：that 定语从句转为“进而……”的递进分句。
【be governed by】原文：which are governed by the laws of heat and motion。翻译精雕：受热力学和运动规律支配。技巧：govern 在科学语境译为“支配”。
【weather vs climate】原文：Climate refers to the type of weather that is experienced over a long period of time。翻译精雕：气候是指……在长时间内所经历的天气类型。技巧：weather 是短期状态，climate 是长期规律，定义需体现时间尺度。

grammar.title: 被动 + such as
grammar.skeleton: Weather conditions are created from elements, + such as temperature, humidity, cloudiness, precipitation, wind, and pressure.
grammar.notes: be created from 表“由……形成”。

grammar.title: 定语从句 result in
grammar.skeleton: The combination and variation of these elements generate different weather systems + [that result in monsoons, thunderstorms, tornadoes and areas of high and low pressure].
grammar.notes: result in = lead to。

grammar.title: refer to + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Climate refers to the type of weather + [that is experienced over a long period of time in a particular region].
grammar.notes: over a long period of time 表时间跨度。

vocab.root: humid (潮湿的) + -ity → 湿度
pre- (向前) + cipit- (头，来自拉丁语 caput) + -ation → 头朝前落下 → 降水；化学中“沉淀”
meteor- (高空现象，来自希腊语 meteoron) + -ology → 气象学

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：区分短期现象与长期规律
模板：[Short-term term] is created from elements, such as [A], [B], and [C]. [Long-term term] refers to the type of [short-term term] that is experienced over a long period of time in a particular [context].
例句：A mood is created from factors, such as sleep, stress, and diet. Temperament refers to the type of mood that is experienced over a long period of time in a particular person.

⛈️ 托福高频：precipitation 的双义
气象学：降水 (rain, snow, hail 的总称)
化学：沉淀 (precipitate v. 沉淀；n. 沉淀物)
另：precipitate v. 促成、加速 (precipitate a crisis)

title: UNIT 128 · 温标
body: The Kelvin is measure of temperature used mainly in physical science and based on a system of absolute zero. The Celsius, or centigrade scale, and the Fahrenheit scale, both measure temperature in degrees. Most nations use the Celsius scale, but the United States continues to use the Fahrenheit scale.
translation: 开尔文是一种主要用于物理科学的温度计量单位，以绝对零度体系为基础。摄氏温标（又称百分温标）和华氏温标都以“度”为单位测量温度。大多数国家使用摄氏温标，但美国仍继续使用华氏温标。
insights: 【并列分词的处理】原文：The Kelvin is measure of temperature used mainly in physical science and based on a system of absolute zero。翻译精雕：开尔文是一种主要用于物理科学的温度计量单位，以绝对零度体系为基础。技巧：两个过去分词分别处理为前置定语与后置分句。
【centigrade 的含义】原文：The Celsius, or centigrade scale。翻译精雕：摄氏温标（又称百分温标）。技巧：centi- (百) + grade (等级)，冰点到沸点分 100 度。

grammar.title: 两个过去分词并列
grammar.skeleton: The Kelvin is (a) measure of temperature + [used mainly in physical science] and [based on a system of absolute zero].
grammar.notes: 原文 is measure 缺冠词 a。

grammar.title: both 同位
grammar.skeleton: The Celsius, or centigrade scale, and the Fahrenheit scale, + both measure temperature in degrees.
grammar.notes: both 复指前面两个主语。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：scale 刻度/温标
centi- (百) + grade (等级) → 百分度的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：对比不同标准的使用情况
模板：Most [group] use [standard A], but [exception] continues to use [standard B].
例句：Most countries use the metric system, but the United States continues to use imperial units.

🌡️ 温标换算

℉ = ℃ × 1.8 + 32
K = ℃ + 273.15
水的冰点：0 ℃ = 32 ℉ = 273.15 K；沸点：100 ℃ = 212 ℉ = 373.15 K

title: UNIT 129 · 云与雾的形成
body: Clouds, and almost all precipitation, are produced by the cooling of air as it rises. When the air temperature is reduced, excess water vapour in the air condenses into liquid droplets, or ice crystals. A fog is formed when this happens close to the surface of the earth, but when it occurs higher up, clouds will appear in the sky.
translation: 云以及几乎所有的降水，都是由空气上升时冷却而产生的。当气温降低时，空气中多余的水蒸气会凝结成液态小水滴或冰晶。如果这一过程发生在靠近地表的地方，就会形成雾；如果发生在更高的地方，天空中就会出现云。
insights: 【名词化的因果】原文：are produced by the cooling of air as it rises。翻译精雕：是由空气上升时冷却而产生的。技巧：the cooling of air 名词结构转为“空气……冷却”主谓结构。
【condense into】原文：condenses into liquid droplets, or ice crystals。翻译精雕：凝结成液态小水滴或冰晶。技巧：condense into 译“凝结成”。
【条件对比】原文：A fog is formed when..., but when it occurs higher up, clouds will appear...。翻译精雕：如果……就会形成雾；如果……天空中就会出现云。技巧：两个 when 从句对比，用“如果……就……”平行结构。

grammar.title: 被动 + as 时间
grammar.skeleton: Clouds, and almost all precipitation, + are produced by the cooling of air + as it rises.
grammar.notes: as 引导时间状语，表“当……时”。

grammar.title: when + but when 对比
grammar.skeleton: A fog is formed + when this happens close to the surface of the earth, + but when it occurs higher up, + clouds will appear in the sky.
grammar.notes: 两个 when 从句形成对比。

vocab.root: con- (加强) + dense (密的) → 使变密 → 凝结；浓缩

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：同一过程在不同条件下的不同结果
模板：[Result A] is formed when this happens [condition A], but when it occurs [condition B], [result B] will appear.
例句：A local trend is formed when this happens within a small community, but when it occurs on a national scale, a social movement will appear.

title: UNIT 130 · 酸雾与伦敦烟雾
body: Fog is thickened and acidified when the air is filled with sulfur-laden soot particles produced by burning coal. Dense acid fogs were the cause of thousands of deaths in UK up to 1956, when legislation was introduced prohibiting coal burning in the cities.
translation: 当空气中充满燃煤产生的含硫烟尘颗粒时，雾会变浓并酸化。直到 1956 年英国出台禁止在城市中燃煤的法规之前，浓重的酸雾一直是造成数千人死亡的原因。
insights: 【分词定语的前置】原文：sulfur-laden soot particles produced by burning coal。翻译精雕：燃煤产生的含硫烟尘颗粒。技巧：-laden 意为“满载……的”，译“含……的”。

【up to... when 的时间关系】原文：were the cause of thousands of deaths in UK up to 1956, when legislation was introduced prohibiting...。翻译精雕：直到 1956 年英国出台……法规之前，……一直是造成……的原因。技巧：up to + 时间点 + when 从句，译为“直到……之前，一直……”。
【背景补充】1952 年伦敦烟雾事件 (Great Smog of London) 造成约 4000–12000 人死亡，直接促成了 1956 年《清洁空气法》(Clean Air Act)。

grammar.title: 被动 + when 从句 + 分词定语
grammar.skeleton: Fog is thickened and acidified + when the air is filled with sulfur-laden soot particles [produced by burning coal].
grammar.notes: 两个过去分词共享 is。

grammar.title: 非限制性 when 从句 + 分词
grammar.skeleton: Dense acid fogs were the cause of thousands of deaths in UK up to 1956, + [when legislation was introduced [prohibiting coal burning in the cities]].
grammar.notes: prohibiting 现在分词修饰 legislation。

vocab.root: acid (酸) + -ify → 使酸化；ocean acidification 海洋酸化
laden: 满载的 (laden with 装满……)
legis- (法律，来自拉丁语 lex) + lation (提出) → 立法/法规
pro- (向前) + hibit (持有) → 挡在前面 → 禁止

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述问题持续直至政策出台
模板：[Problem] was the cause of [harm] up to [year], when legislation was introduced prohibiting [harmful practice].
例句：Lead poisoning was the cause of serious health problems up to the 1970s, when legislation was introduced prohibiting leaded gasoline.

title: UNIT 131 · 彩虹与日晕
body: Rainbows and halos are optical phenomena that occur when light shines through cloud particles. When sunlight comes from behind the observer and strikes raindrops falling from cumulonimbus clouds, rainbows can appear in the sky. The raindrops act as tiny prisms, bending and reflecting the different colours of light. The different angles create bands of color which are then seen by the observer as a rainbow. Halos occur when the sunlight, or moonlight, comes from in front of the observer and is reflected from ice crystals as the light passes through high, thin, cirrostratus clouds.
translation: 彩虹和日晕是光线穿过云中粒子时产生的光学现象。当阳光从观察者身后射来，照在积雨云落下的雨滴上时，天空中就可能出现彩虹。雨滴就像微小的棱镜，使不同颜色的光发生折射和反射。不同的角度形成了色带，观察者看到的就是彩虹。当阳光或月光从观察者前方射来，穿过高空稀薄的卷层云并被其中的冰晶反射时，就会出现日晕。
insights: 【act as 的比喻】原文：The raindrops act as tiny prisms。翻译精雕：雨滴就像微小的棱镜。技巧：act as 用于比喻时译“就像……一样”。
【分词的伴随】原文：bending and reflecting the different colours of light。翻译精雕：使不同颜色的光发生折射和反射。技巧：bend light 即“折射”，用规范术语。
【对比结构】彩虹：光从观察者身后来 (from behind)；日晕：光从观察者前方来 (from in front of)。技巧：注意介词短语的对比，翻译时准确体现方位。

grammar.title: When 从句 + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: When sunlight [comes from behind the observer] and [strikes raindrops [falling from cumulonimbus clouds]], + rainbows can appear in the sky.
grammar.notes: falling 修饰 raindrops。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + 被动
grammar.skeleton: The different angles create bands of color + [which are then seen by the observer as a rainbow].
grammar.notes: be seen as 表“被看作”。

grammar.title: When 从句：并列谓语 + as 从句
grammar.skeleton: Halos occur when the sunlight, or moonlight, [comes from in front of the observer] and [is reflected from ice crystals] + as the light passes through high, thin, cirrostratus clouds.
grammar.notes: from in front of 为双重介词结构。

vocab.root: phenomenon 的复数 phenomena
另义：halo 光环 (halo effect 光环效应)
cumulus (积云，来自拉丁语 “堆”) + nimbus (雨云) → 积雨云
cirrus (卷云，“卷发”) + stratus (层云，“铺开”) → 卷层云

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明某现象产生的条件
模板：When [condition A] and [condition B], [phenomenon] can appear. [Agents] act as tiny [tools], [doing] [process].
例句：When interest rates fall and confidence rises, a housing boom can appear. Low-cost loans act as tiny engines, fueling demand across the market.

☁️ 云的拉丁词根
cirrus (卷曲) → 卷云；stratus (层) → 层云；cumulus (堆积) → 积云；nimbus (雨) → 雨云。组合：cirrostratus 卷层云、cumulonimbus 积雨云、nimbostratus 雨层云。

title: UNIT 132 · 降水的形式
body: Rain, drizzle, freezing rain, snow, hail, ice pellets and sleet are all forms of precipitation. Snowflakes are either, single ice crystal or clusters of ice crystals. Hailstones are balls of ice which consist of clusters of raindrops that have collided and frozen together. Large hailstones only occur in violent thunderstorms when strong updrafts keep the hailstones suspended in the atmosphere long enough to grow in size.
translation: 雨、毛毛雨、冻雨、雪、冰雹、冰粒和雨夹雪都是降水的形式。雪花要么是单个冰晶，要么是冰晶团。冰雹是冰球，由相互碰撞并冻结在一起的雨滴团构成。大冰雹只出现在猛烈的雷暴中，那时强大的上升气流使冰雹在大气中悬浮足够长的时间，从而越长越大。
insights: 【either...or 的译法】原文：Snowflakes are either single ice crystals or clusters of ice crystals。翻译精雕：雪花要么是单个冰晶，要么是冰晶团。技巧：either... or 译“要么……要么……”。
【keep + 宾语 + 补足语】原文：strong updrafts keep the hailstones suspended in the atmosphere long enough to grow in size。翻译精雕：强大的上升气流使冰雹在大气中悬浮足够长的时间，从而越长越大。技巧：long enough to do 译为“足够长……从而……”。

grammar.title: consist of + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Hailstones are balls of ice + [which consist of clusters of raindrops [that have collided and frozen together]].
grammar.notes: 双层定语从句。

grammar.title: only + when 从句 + keep sth. done
grammar.skeleton: Large hailstones only occur in violent thunderstorms + when strong updrafts keep the hailstones suspended in the atmosphere + long enough to grow in size.
grammar.notes: keep + 宾语 + 过去分词表状态。

vocab.root: 来自古英语 clyster “一串” → 簇/群；cluster of galaxies 星系团
col- (共同) + lide (撞击，来自拉丁语 laedere) → 碰撞；collision 碰撞

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明某结果出现的严格条件
模板：Large [results] only occur in [situation] when [force] keeps [object] [state] long enough to [grow/develop].
例句：Major innovations only occur in strong research hubs when steady funding keeps talented teams together long enough to mature their ideas.

title: UNIT 133 · 风与风暴
body: Wind is created by movement of air and can range from a gently breeze to the violence of hurricanes and typhoons. Wind speeds in these latter cases can exceed 120 km/h near the storm's center and may approach 320 km/h at the periphery. Tornadoes have the distinction of recording wind speeds as high as 480 km/h, which are the highest wind speeds measured on the surface of the Earth. Except for these storms, wind speed of other types of storms usually increase with height up to the level of the troposphere.
translation: 风是由空气流动形成的，其强度从轻柔的微风到猛烈的飓风和台风不等。在后两种情况下，风暴中心附近的风速可超过每小时 120 公里，而外围的风速可能接近每小时 320 公里。龙卷风的特别之处在于其风速记录高达每小时 480 公里，这是在地球表面测得的最高风速。除这些风暴外，其他类型风暴的风速通常随高度增加而增大，直至对流层的高度。
insights: 【range from... to...】原文：can range from a gentle breeze to the violence of hurricanes and typhoons。翻译精雕：其强度从轻柔的微风到猛烈的飓风和台风不等。技巧：range from A to B 译“从 A 到 B 不等”。
【have the distinction of】原文：Tornadoes have the distinction of recording wind speeds as high as 480 km/h。翻译精雕：龙卷风的特别之处在于其风速记录高达……。技巧：have the distinction of doing 译“……的特别之处在于/享有……的殊荣”。
【原文数据存疑】原文称风暴中心附近 120 km/h、外围可接近 320 km/h，与常识（飓风眼墙附近风速最大）相反，学习时注意辨别。

grammar.title: 被动 + 并列谓语 + range from
grammar.skeleton: Wind [is created by movement of air] and [can range from a gentle breeze to the violence of hurricanes and typhoons].
grammar.notes: 原文 gently breeze 应为 gentle breeze（形容词修饰名词）。

grammar.title: 定语从句（非限制）
grammar.skeleton: Tornadoes have the distinction of recording wind speeds as high as 480 km/h, + [which are the highest wind speeds measured on the surface of the Earth].
grammar.notes: as high as 表“高达”。

grammar.title: Except for + increase with
grammar.skeleton: Except for these storms, + wind speed of other types of storms usually increase(s) with height + up to the level of the troposphere.
grammar.notes: 主语 wind speed 为单数，谓语应为 increases。

vocab.root: 来自粤语“大风” → typhoon 台风
ex- (超出) + ceed (走) → 走出界限 → 超过
tropo- (转动/变化，来自希腊语 tropos) + sphere → 对流层
peri- (周围) + pher- (携带) + -y → 周边

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述范围与极值
模板：[X] can range from [mild form] to [extreme form]. [Example] has the distinction of [record], which is the highest [measure] on [scope].
例句：Ticket prices can range from a few dollars to thousands. The Super Bowl has the distinction of the highest average price, which is the highest for any single sporting event in the US.

title: UNIT 134 · 天气预报的进步与局限
body: Since the early 20th century, great strides have been made in the ability to accurately predict coming weather patterns. This is largely due to the development of computer technology and information available from satellites and radar. Weather data from around the world is collected by many agencies, such as the World Meteorological Organization and the National Weather Service. This data helps create computer models to produce forecasts by applying the laws of motion and of the conservation of energy and mass. In some cases, these forecasts have provided warnings of major storms as much as a week in advance. However, because the behavior of weather systems is chaotic, it is difficult to accurately forecast weather patterns more than about two weeks in advance, although long range forecasting is an established area in meteorology.
translation: 自 20 世纪初以来，准确预测未来天气形势的能力取得了长足进步。这主要归功于计算机技术的发展以及来自卫星和雷达的信息。世界各地的天气数据由许多机构收集，如世界气象组织和美国国家气象局。这些数据有助于建立计算机模型，通过应用运动定律以及能量守恒和质量守恒定律来进行预报。在某些情况下，这些预报能提前一周之久发布重大风暴预警。然而，由于天气系统的行为具有混沌性，尽管长期预报已是气象学中一个成熟的领域，但要准确预报两周以后的天气形势仍然十分困难。
insights: 【make great strides】原文：great strides have been made in the ability to accurately predict...。翻译精雕：准确预测……的能力取得了长足进步。技巧：make strides 译“取得长足进步”。
【be due to】原文：This is largely due to the development of...。翻译精雕：这主要归功于……的发展。技巧：due to 在正面语境译“归功于”。
【as much as】原文：as much as a week in advance。翻译精雕：提前一周之久。技巧：as much as 强调数量之大。
【although 置于句末的处理】原文：it is difficult to... more than about two weeks in advance, although long range forecasting is an established area。翻译精雕：尽管长期预报已是……成熟的领域，但要准确预报……仍然十分困难。技巧：让步从句提前，主句加“仍然”。

grammar.title: 现在完成时被动 + 不定式定语
grammar.skeleton: Since the early 20th century, + great strides have been made + in the ability [to accurately predict coming weather patterns].
grammar.notes: since + 时间点 与现在完成时连用；to accurately predict 是分裂不定式。

grammar.title: help + do + by doing
grammar.skeleton: This data helps create computer models + to produce forecasts + by applying the laws of motion and of the conservation of energy and mass.
grammar.notes: help (to) do；by applying 表方式。

grammar.title: because 原因 + it is difficult to do + although
grammar.skeleton: because the behavior of weather systems is chaotic, + it is difficult to accurately forecast weather patterns more than about two weeks in advance, + although long range forecasting is an established area in meteorology.
grammar.notes: 形式主语 it + 真正主语 to forecast。

vocab.root: 另义：take sth. in stride 从容应对

vocab.meaning: 能量 / 质量守恒定律

vocab.root: fore- (预先) + cast (投掷) → 预先抛出 → 预报
chaos (混沌) + -tic → 混乱的/混沌的

句型：描述进步及其原因
模板：Since [time], great strides have been made in the ability to [achievement]. This is largely due to the development of [factor A] and [factor B].
例句：Since the 1990s, great strides have been made in the ability to sequence human DNA. This is largely due to the development of faster computers and automated laboratory tools.

title: UNIT 135 · 海洋的分区与海底地形
body: The Atlantic Ocean, the Pacific Ocean, and the Indian Ocean, form the three major subdivisions of the world's oceans, and each is bounded by continental land masses. The Southern Ocean is bounded by the Antarctic, and together with the Arctic Ocean, they represent the two minor subdivisions of the world's oceans. The Arctic Ocean is almost landlocked, except between Greenland and Europe. The northern limits of the Southern Ocean are bounded by a circumpolar current that surrounds the Antarctic continent. Each of the world's major land masses are bordered by a submerged continental shelf that extends sea ward from the shoreline. The average distance of the shelf is 75 km, but it varies from nearly zero to 1, 500 km. At a depth of about 200 m, the shelf gives way abruptly to a steeper zone known as the continental slope, which descends to depths of about 3, 500 m. The continental rise is a gradually sloping zone of sediment that is considered part of the ocean floor. This extends about 600 km from the base of the continental slope to the flat abyssal plains of the deep-ocean floor. The midocean ridges are extensive mountain chains with zones of intersecting fractures and deep troughs and are located in the central parts of the oceans. The areas where the ridge system merges with the continents are regions of great geologic activity, characterized by volcanoes, earthquakes and major fault lines. The Red Sea and the Gulf of California are two areas where these events occur. The midocean ridges are often associated with the junction of the tectonic plates that are responsible for movements of the Earth's crust. The inner troughs of these ridges are closest to the Earth's mantle from where molten rock upwells and spreads laterally on the seabed.
translation: 大西洋、太平洋和印度洋构成了世界海洋的三大主要部分，每个大洋都以大陆陆块为界。南大洋以南极洲为界，它与北冰洋一起，构成了世界海洋的两个次要部分。北冰洋几乎被陆地包围，只有格陵兰岛与欧洲之间例外。南大洋的北部边界由环绕南极大陆的南极绕极流划定。世界上每块主要陆地的周围都有一片被海水淹没的大陆架，从海岸线向海洋延伸。大陆架的平均宽度为 75 公里，但从近乎零到 1500 公里不等。在约 200 米深处，大陆架突然过渡到更陡峭的地带，即大陆坡，它向下延伸至约 3500 米深。大陆隆是一片缓慢倾斜的沉积物地带，被视为海底的一部分。它从大陆坡底部延伸约 600 公里，直至深海底平坦的深海平原。洋中脊是延绵的山脉，带有交错的断裂带和深海槽，位于各大洋的中部。洋脊系统与大陆交汇的区域是地质活动强烈的地区，以火山、地震和主要断层线为特征。红海和加利福尼亚湾就是发生这些活动的两个地区。洋中脊通常与构造板块的交界处相关联，正是这些板块造成了地壳的运动。洋脊内部的槽谷离地幔最近，熔融岩浆从那里涌出，并在海床上向两侧扩散。
insights: 【be bounded by】原文：each is bounded by continental land masses。翻译精雕：每个大洋都以大陆陆块为界。技巧：be bounded by 译“以……为界”。
【give way to 的地形用法】原文：the shelf gives way abruptly to a steeper zone known as the continental slope。翻译精雕：大陆架突然过渡到更陡峭的地带，即大陆坡。技巧：give way to 在地理描述中译“过渡到/让位于”。
【be characterized by】原文：regions of great geologic activity, characterized by volcanoes, earthquakes and major fault lines。翻译精雕：地质活动强烈的地区，以火山、地震和主要断层线为特征。技巧：be characterized by 译“以……为特征”。
【长篇地形描述的顺序】原文按“海岸线 → 大陆架 → 大陆坡 → 大陆隆 → 深海平原 → 洋中脊”由浅入深描述。翻译精雕：保持这一空间顺序，并用“随后/直至”衔接。

grammar.notes: which 指代 continental slope。

grammar.title: from where 从句
grammar.skeleton: The inner troughs of these ridges are closest to the Earth's mantle + [from where molten rock upwells and spreads laterally on the seabed].
grammar.notes: from where = from which。

模板：At [position], [zone A] gives way abruptly to a steeper zone known as [zone B], which descends to [depth/level].

🌊 海底地形由浅到深

海岸线 shoreline → 大陆架 continental shelf (约 0–200 m) → 大陆坡 continental slope (约 200–3500 m) → 大陆隆 continental rise → 深海平原 abyssal plain → 洋中脊 mid-ocean ridge / 海沟 trench

title: UNIT 136 · 海底沉积物
body: The ocean floor is mainly a sediment consisting of rock particles and organic remains, which is estimated to be an average of half a kilometer thick. When continental rocks are weathered, and carried out to sea by rivers and wind, the resultant clay minerals form abundant deposits on the seabed. Thick deposits of such detrital material are often found near river mouths and on continental shelves. The fine particles of clay are spread by ocean currents and eventually accumulate on the deep-ocean floor. These sediments are stirred up and periodically redistributed by fierce current-generated disturbances called benthic storms. The name is derived from the sparsely populated deep-sea habitat known as the benthic zone. The sediment in this zone will often have an accumulation of the calcium carbonate shells from small organisms, such as foraminifera and the siliceous shells of marine protozoans.
translation: 海底主要由岩石颗粒和有机遗骸构成的沉积物组成，据估计平均厚度为半公里。当大陆岩石被风化，并被河流和风带入大海时，由此产生的黏土矿物会在海床上形成大量沉积。这种碎屑物质的厚层沉积常见于河口和大陆架上。细小的黏土颗粒被洋流扩散，最终堆积在深海海底。这些沉积物会被由洋流引起的、被称为“海底风暴”的强烈扰动搅起，并周期性地重新分布。这一名称源自人烟稀少的深海栖息地，即海底带。这一区域的沉积物中常常堆积着有孔虫等小生物的碳酸钙外壳，以及海洋原生动物的硅质外壳。
insights: 【be estimated to be】原文：which is estimated to be an average of half a kilometer thick。翻译精雕：据估计平均厚度为半公里。技巧：be estimated to be 译“据估计”。
【熟词僻义】原文：When continental rocks are weathered。翻译精雕：当大陆岩石被风化。技巧：weather 作动词意为“风化”，托福地质高频。
【sparsely populated】原文：the sparsely populated deep-sea habitat。翻译精雕：生物稀少的深海栖息地。技巧：populated 用于生物时译“生物分布”，不译“人口”。

title: UNIT 137 · 洋流的驱动力
body: The rotation of the Earth influences the large surface currents of the ocean, and prevailing winds, known as gyres, also contribute to maintaining the motion. While the ocean's surface currents are a function of winds and the Earth's rotation, the circulation of the deeper ocean water is more a function of density differences between adjacent water masses.
translation: 地球自转影响着大洋的大规模表层洋流，而被称为“环流”的盛行风也有助于维持这种运动。表层洋流取决于风和地球自转，而深层海水的循环则更多地取决于相邻水团之间的密度差异。
insights: 【be a function of】原文：the ocean's surface currents are a function of winds and the Earth's rotation。翻译精雕：表层洋流取决于风和地球自转。技巧：be a function of 是数学/科学表达，译“取决于/是……的函数”。
【原文概念勘误】gyre 实际指“大洋环流”（由风驱动的大型环状洋流系统），而非“盛行风”本身；原文表述有歧义。

grammar.notes: contribute to doing，to 为介词。

title: UNIT 138 · 火山的形成
body: Volcanoes are formed when magma, the molten rock associated with the Earth's hot core, escapes through a weakness in the Earth's crust. An eruption can occur through one or more volcanic vents, which can be a single opening, a cluster of openings, or from a long crack called a fissure vent. Magma is generally found within the upper part of the mantle, but less commonly, within the base of the Earth's crust. During an eruption on the Earth's surface, the molten rock forms a lava flow, which can be thick, viscous and very hot, or as thin and fluid as warm syrup. These flows rapidly descend down the sides of a volcano, destroying everything in their path until they harden and form igneous rock. Repeated eruptions lead to the accumulation of volcanic material that piles up around the vents and eventually forms the topographic feature we recognize as a volcano. A crater is normally a common feature in relation to volcanic activity, but the shape of a volcano can vary from a small hill to a large mountain, or even a plateau.
translation: 当岩浆——与地球炽热地核相关的熔融岩石——从地壳的薄弱处逸出时，火山便形成了。喷发可以通过一个或多个火山口发生，火山口可能是单个开口、一组开口，或是一条被称为裂隙喷口的长裂缝。岩浆通常位于地幔上部，较少见于地壳底部。在地表喷发时，熔岩会形成熔岩流，它可能浓稠、黏滞且极其炽热，也可能像温热的糖浆一样稀薄易流动。这些熔岩流沿火山两侧迅速流下，摧毁沿途的一切，直到冷却硬化形成火成岩。反复的喷发导致火山物质在火山口周围不断堆积，最终形成我们认得的“火山”这一地形特征。火山口通常是与火山活动相关的常见特征，但火山的形态可能从小山丘到大山，甚至到高原，各不相同。
insights: 【同位语破折号化】原文：magma, the molten rock associated with the Earth's hot core, escapes through...。翻译精雕：岩浆——与地球炽热地核相关的熔融岩石——从……逸出。技巧：插入的同位语用破折号，保持主句连贯。
【as... as 比较】原文：as thin and fluid as warm syrup。翻译精雕：像温热的糖浆一样稀薄易流动。技巧：as + adj. + as 译“像……一样……”。
【less commonly 的处理】原文：Magma is generally found within the upper part of the mantle, but less commonly, within the base of the Earth's crust。翻译精雕：岩浆通常位于地幔上部，较少见于地壳底部。技巧：less commonly 译“较少见于”。

🌋 托福地质三大岩类
Igneous rock (火成岩)：岩浆冷却凝固而成，如花岗岩、玄武岩。
Sedimentary rock (沉积岩)：沉积物压实胶结而成，如砂岩、石灰岩。
Metamorphic rock (变质岩)：在高温高压下变质而成，如大理岩、板岩。

title: UNIT 139 · 机械沉积岩
body: The manner in which sedimentary rocks originate, determines their classification. Principally, this occurs through mechanical or chemical processes. The mechanical process occurs from the fragmentation, disintegration and transportation of rocks by flowing water, but without any chemical deterioration. When these fragmented mineral particles are carried to larger bodies of water, they eventually settle out to be deposited as layers of sediment. Shale and sandstone are common sedimentary rocks of mechanical origin.
translation: 沉积岩的形成方式决定了它们的分类。从根本上说，这一过程通过机械作用或化学作用进行。机械作用是指岩石在流水作用下破碎、崩解和搬运，但不发生任何化学变化。当这些破碎的矿物颗粒被带到更大的水体中时，它们最终会沉降下来，沉积成一层层的沉积物。页岩和砂岩是常见的机械成因沉积岩。
insights: 【主语从句前置】原文：The manner in which sedimentary rocks originate, determines their classification。翻译精雕：沉积岩的形成方式决定了它们的分类。技巧：in which 定语从句前置为“……的方式”。
【名词串的动词化】原文：occurs from the fragmentation, disintegration and transportation of rocks by flowing water。翻译精雕：岩石在流水作用下破碎、崩解和搬运。技巧：三个名词化结构还原为动词。
【settle out to be deposited】原文：they eventually settle out to be deposited as layers of sediment。翻译精雕：它们最终会沉降下来，沉积成一层层的沉积物。技巧：settle out 译“沉降”，to be deposited 表结果。

grammar.skeleton: The manner [in which sedimentary rocks originate], + determines their classification.
grammar.notes: 主语中心词 manner 为单数。

grammar.title: by + but without

title: UNIT 140 · 化学沉积岩
body: Limestone is a well known example of a chemical sedimentary rock. It may originate from the remains of microscopic marine organisms which precipitate on the ocean floor. Another process may involve dissolving the organisms in water which circulates through the parent rock formation, before precipitating from the solution and being deposited in a sea or lake. Halite and gypsum are formed by the evaporation of salt solutions and the consequent precipitation of the salts.
translation: 石灰岩是化学沉积岩的一个著名例子。它可能源自沉淀在海底的微小海洋生物的遗骸。另一种过程可能是：这些生物在流经母岩层的水中溶解，随后从溶液中析出沉淀，并沉积在海洋或湖泊中。岩盐和石膏则是由盐溶液蒸发以及随之而来的盐分沉淀形成的。
insights: 【originate from】原文：It may originate from the remains of microscopic marine organisms。翻译精雕：它可能源自……遗骸。技巧：originate from 译“源自”。
【involve doing】原文：Another process may involve dissolving the organisms in water...。翻译精雕：另一种过程可能是：这些生物在……中溶解。技巧：involve doing 用冒号引出具体过程。
【consequent 的译法】原文：the consequent precipitation of the salts。翻译精雕：随之而来的盐分沉淀。技巧：consequent 译“随之而来的”。

grammar.notes: which 指代 organisms 或 remains。

grammar.skeleton: Another process may involve dissolving the organisms in water [which circulates through the parent rock formation], + before [precipitating from the solution] and [being deposited in a sea or lake].

title: UNIT 141 · 页岩与油页岩
body: Shale is the common name for varieties of fine-grained sedimentary rocks that are formed from the consolidation of beds of clay, or mud, over long periods of time. Shales exhibiting a series of fine laminations, parallel to the bedding planes, can be easily fractured. These sedimentary rocks are commonly found in various shades of gray, but may also come in shades of red, pink, green, brown and black. The rocks are soft enough to scratch with a knife and, usually have a smooth and almost greasy feel to the touch. Particular varieties of shales do yield oil, which can be extracted and then distilled by heat. Sedimentary oil shales are widely distributed throughout the world and provide a valuable source of oil for countries lacking conventional oil deposits.
translation: 页岩是多种细粒沉积岩的通称，由黏土层或泥层经过漫长时间压实固结而成。具有一系列平行于层理面的细薄纹层的页岩，很容易破裂。这类沉积岩通常呈现深浅不一的灰色，但也可能呈红色、粉色、绿色、棕色和黑色等各种色调。这类岩石质地很软，用小刀就能刻划，摸起来通常光滑，几乎有油腻感。某些种类的页岩确实能产出石油，石油可以被提取出来，再经加热蒸馏。沉积型油页岩广泛分布于世界各地，为缺乏常规石油储藏的国家提供了宝贵的石油来源。
insights: 【the common name for】原文：Shale is the common name for varieties of fine-grained sedimentary rocks。翻译精雕：页岩是多种细粒沉积岩的通称。技巧：common name 译为“通称”。
【enough to do 的译法】原文：The rocks are soft enough to scratch with a knife。翻译精雕：这类岩石质地很软，用小刀就能刻划。技巧：adj. + enough to do 拆为“很……，……就能……”。
【强调助动词 do】原文：Particular varieties of shales do yield oil。翻译精雕：某些种类的页岩确实能产出石油。技巧：do + 动词原形表强调，译“确实”。

grammar.notes: the consolidation of = 固结这一过程。

title: UNIT 142 · 石灰岩的鉴定
body: Limestone forms when calcium carbonate precipitates from water, but the manner in which this precipitation takes place, produces the different kinds of limestone. When dilute hydrochloric acid comes into contact with a piece of limestone, the acid reacts with the calcite and forms bubbles of carbon dioxide. This “fizz” reaction is so characteristic of limestone that many field geologists carry a small bottle of diluted hydrochloric acid to quickly and easily identify a limestone outcrop.
translation: 当碳酸钙从水中沉淀出来时，就形成了石灰岩，而沉淀发生的方式不同，便产生了不同种类的石灰岩。当稀盐酸与一块石灰岩接触时，酸会与方解石发生反应，产生二氧化碳气泡。这种“嘶嘶”反应是石灰岩的典型特征，以至于许多野外地质学家都会随身携带一小瓶稀盐酸，以便快速、轻松地鉴别石灰岩露头。
insights: 【so... that 结果】原文：This “fizz” reaction is so characteristic of limestone that many field geologists carry...。翻译精雕：这种“嘶嘶”反应是石灰岩的典型特征，以至于许多……。技巧：so... that 译“如此……以至于……”。
【come into contact with】原文：When dilute hydrochloric acid comes into contact with a piece of limestone。翻译精雕：当稀盐酸与一块石灰岩接触时。技巧：固定搭配“与……接触”。
【熟词僻义】field geologists / outcrop。翻译精雕：野外地质学家 / 露头。技巧：field 指“野外现场”(field work 野外工作)；outcrop 指“岩石露出地表的部分”。

grammar.title: when 从句 + but 主语从句修饰
grammar.skeleton: Limestone forms when calcium carbonate precipitates from water, + but the manner [in which this precipitation takes place], produces the different kinds of limestone.
grammar.notes: in which 定语从句修饰 manner。

grammar.title: so + adj. + that 结果从句
grammar.skeleton: This “fizz” reaction is so characteristic of limestone + that many field geologists carry a small bottle of diluted hydrochloric acid + to quickly and easily identify a limestone outcrop.
grammar.notes: be characteristic of 表“是……的特征”。

vocab.root: di- (分开) + lute (洗，来自拉丁语 luere) → 冲淡 → 稀释
hydro- (氢/水) + chlor- (氯) + -ic → 盐酸
熟词僻义：field 野外、现场 (field trip 实地考察)
out (出) + crop (冒出) → 露出地面的岩层

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明某特征典型到成为鉴别标准
模板：This [feature] is so characteristic of [X] that many [experts] [practice] to quickly and easily identify [X].
例句：This accent is so characteristic of the region that many linguists use it to quickly and easily identify a speaker's hometown.

title: UNIT 143 · 地震的震源
body: The point within the Earth along the rupturing geological fault where an earthquake originates is called the focus, or hypocenter. Seismologists know from observations that most earthquakes originate as shallow-focus earthquakes, and most of them occur near plate boundaries —— areas where the Earth's crustal plates move against each other.
translation: 在地球内部，沿着发生断裂的地质断层、地震起源的那一点被称为震源。地震学家通过观测得知，大多数地震起源于浅源地震，并且大多发生在板块边界附近——即地壳板块相互挤压运动的区域。
insights: 【长主语的拆解】原文：The point within the Earth along the rupturing geological fault where an earthquake originates is called the focus。翻译精雕：在地球内部，沿着……断层、地震起源的那一点被称为震源。技巧：主语中心词 point 带三个修饰语，先译位置再译定义。
【focus vs epicenter】focus/hypocenter 是地下的“震源”；epicenter 是震源正上方地表的“震中”。技巧：二者常被混淆，翻译时必须区分。
【破折号的解释】原文：plate boundaries —— areas where the Earth's crustal plates move against each other。翻译精雕：板块边界附近——即地壳板块相互挤压运动的区域。技巧：破折号后加“即”。

grammar.title: 复杂主语 + 被动
grammar.skeleton: The point [within the Earth] [along the rupturing geological fault] [where an earthquake originates] + is called the focus, or hypocenter.
grammar.notes: where 从句修饰 point。

grammar.title: know from + that 宾语从句 + 破折号同位语
grammar.skeleton: Seismologists know from observations + that [most earthquakes originate as shallow-focus earthquakes], and [most of them occur near plate boundaries —— areas where the Earth's crustal plates move against each other].
grammar.notes: 破折号引出同位语解释 plate boundaries。

vocab.root: rupt- (断裂，来自拉丁语 rumpere) + -ure → 破裂
熟词僻义：focus 震源 (地下)；epicenter 震中 (地表)
hypo- (在下) + center → 地下的中心 → 震源
seism- (地震，来自希腊语 seismos) + -ologist → 地震学家

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：以观测为依据陈述规律
模板：[Experts] know from observations that most [X] originate as [type], and most of them occur near [location] —— areas where [explanation].
例句：Economists know from observations that most recessions originate as financial shocks, and most of them occur near the end of credit booms —— periods when lending grows fastest.

🌍 震源 vs 震中
Focus / Hypocenter (震源)：地下岩层破裂的起始点。
Epicenter (震中)：震源正上方的地表位置 (epi- 在……之上)。新闻中常说的“震中”就是 epicenter。

title: UNIT 144 · 地震的破坏程度
body: The destruction caused by an earthquake depends on the amount of shaking that occurs and the duration of the event. The severity of an earthquake is measured as its magnitude on the Richter scale. The design, construction method and materials used in a structure, can significantly affect the amount of damage incurred. Earthquakes vary from small, imperceptible shaking, to large shocks felt over thousands of kilometers. Earthquakes can deform the ground, collapse buildings and other structures, and create tsunamis.
translation: 地震造成的破坏取决于震动的强度和持续时间。地震的严重程度用里氏震级来衡量。建筑物所采用的设计、施工方法和材料，会显著影响其所遭受的损害程度。地震的规模大小不一，从难以察觉的轻微震动，到数千公里外都能感受到的强烈冲击。地震能使地面变形、使建筑物和其他结构倒塌，还会引发海啸。
insights: 【incur 的译法】原文：can significantly affect the amount of damage incurred。翻译精雕：会显著影响其所遭受的损害程度。技巧：incur 表“招致、遭受”，过去分词后置译为“所遭受的”。
【vary from... to...】原文：Earthquakes vary from small, imperceptible shaking, to large shocks felt over thousands of kilometers。翻译精雕：地震的规模大小不一，从……到……。技巧：vary from A to B 译“从 A 到 B 不等”。
【三个动词的并列】原文：deform the ground, collapse buildings..., and create tsunamis。翻译精雕：使地面变形、使建筑物……倒塌，还会引发海啸。技巧：collapse 在此用作及物动词“使倒塌”。

grammar.title: depend on + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: The destruction [caused by an earthquake] + depends on + [the amount of shaking [that occurs]] and [the duration of the event].
grammar.notes: caused by 修饰 destruction。

grammar.title: 被动 + as
grammar.skeleton: The severity of an earthquake is measured as its magnitude on the Richter scale.
grammar.notes: be measured as 表“以……衡量”。

grammar.title: 过去分词后置
grammar.skeleton: can significantly affect the amount of damage [incurred].
grammar.notes: incurred = that is incurred。

vocab.root: in- (进入) + cur (跑，来自拉丁语 currere) → 跑进来 → 招致/遭受 (incur costs)
im- (不) + percept- (感知) + -ible → 无法察觉的
col- (共同) + lapse (滑落) → 一起滑落 → 倒塌/崩溃
来自日语“津波” (港口的波浪) → 海啸
severe (严重的) + -ity

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明后果取决于多重因素
模板：The [damage] caused by [event] depends on [factor A] and [factor B]. [Design choices] can significantly affect the amount of [damage] incurred.
例句：The losses caused by a cyber attack depend on the type of data stolen and the time to detection. Security policies can significantly affect the amount of damage incurred.

title: UNIT 145 · 地震波：P 波与 S 波
body: Body waves are the vibrations of energy that is transmitted through the Earth when a sudden movement occurs in the Earth's crust, in or around, a fault zone. There are two types of body waves which are distinguished by the fact that the primary, P waves, are compression waves. P waves are the fastest seismic waves and travel in strong rock at about 6 to 7 km per second. When confronted with rocky material, these waves move back and forth and alternatively, compress and expand the rock in their path. The secondary, S waves, occur after the P waves, and result in shearing or twisting the rock as they travel through the material. S waves travel at about 3.5 km per second. S waves cause rocky material to move either side to side or up and down perpendicular to the direction the waves are traveling, thus shearing the rocks. Both P and S waves help seismologists to locate the focus and epicenter of an earthquake.
translation: 体波是指当地壳在断层带内或附近发生突然运动时，在地球内部传播的能量振动。体波有两种类型，其区别在于：初至波，即 P 波，是压缩波。P 波是最快的地震波，在坚硬岩石中的传播速度约为每秒 6 到 7 公里。遇到岩石物质时，这些波会来回运动，交替地压缩和扩张其路径上的岩石。次至波，即 S 波，出现在 P 波之后，它们在穿过物质时会使岩石发生剪切或扭曲。S 波的传播速度约为每秒 3.5 公里。S 波使岩石物质沿垂直于波传播方向的方向左右或上下移动，从而剪切岩石。P 波和 S 波都能帮助地震学家确定地震的震源和震中。
insights: 【distinguished by the fact that】原文：There are two types of body waves which are distinguished by the fact that the primary, P waves, are compression waves。翻译精雕：体波有两种类型，其区别在于：初至波，即 P 波，是压缩波。技巧：the fact that 同位语从句用冒号引出。
【When confronted with】原文：When confronted with rocky material, these waves move back and forth。翻译精雕：遇到岩石物质时，这些波会来回运动。技巧：when (they are) confronted with 省略结构，译“遇到……时”。
【原文用词勘误】alternatively（或者）应为 alternately（交替地），原文混用；翻译按“交替地”处理。

grammar.title: 同位语从句 the fact that
grammar.skeleton: There are two types of body waves + [which are distinguished by the fact [that the primary, P waves, are compression waves]].
grammar.notes: that 从句解释 the fact 的内容。

grammar.title: When + 过去分词 省略
grammar.skeleton: When confronted with rocky material, + these waves move back and forth + and alternately compress and expand the rock in their path.
grammar.notes: 省略主语和 be。

grammar.title: result in + doing
grammar.skeleton: The secondary, S waves, occur after the P waves, + and result in shearing or twisting the rock + as they travel through the material.
grammar.notes: result in + 动名词。

grammar.title: cause + 宾语 + to do + thus doing
grammar.skeleton: S waves cause rocky material to move either side to side or up and down + perpendicular to the direction [the waves are traveling], + thus shearing the rocks.
grammar.notes: thus doing 表结果。

vocab.root: com- (加强) + press (压) + -ion → 压缩
epi- (在上) + center → 震中
con- (共同) + front (前额) → 面对面

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：对比两种类型的机制与速度
模板：[Type A] are [mechanism A] and travel at about [speed A]. [Type B] occur after [Type A], and result in [effect B]. Both [A] and [B] help [experts] to [purpose].
例句：Short-term loans are quick to approve and arrive within days. Long-term loans come after careful review, and result in lower monthly payments. Both types help families to manage cash flow.

📡 P 波 vs S 波
P wave (Primary，纵波)：压缩—扩张，振动方向与传播方向平行；速度最快；可穿过固体、液体和气体。
S wave (Secondary，横波)：剪切，振动方向与传播方向垂直；速度较慢；不能穿过液体——这正是科学家推断地球外核为液态的依据。

title: UNIT 146 · 冰川概述
body: Glaciers are an intriguing part of the Earth's natural environment. They are made up of an enduring accumulation of ice, snow, water, rocks, and sediments that slowly move under the influence of gravity. The unparalleled, and majestic beauty of glaciers, are mostly found in the wild and inaccessible mountainous regions.
translation: 冰川是地球自然环境中引人入胜的一部分。它们由冰、雪、水、岩石和沉积物长期累积而成，在重力作用下缓慢移动。冰川那无与伦比的壮丽之美，大多存在于荒野和人迹罕至的山区。
insights: 【under the influence of】原文：slowly move under the influence of gravity。翻译精雕：在重力作用下缓慢移动。技巧：under the influence of 译“在……作用/影响下”。
【描写性形容词的翻译】原文：The unparalleled, and majestic beauty of glaciers。翻译精雕：冰川那无与伦比的壮丽之美。技巧：说明文中的抒情段落可适当用四字词增强文采。

grammar.title: be made up of + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: They are made up of an enduring accumulation of ice, snow, water, rocks, and sediments + [that slowly move under the influence of gravity].
grammar.notes: that 从句修饰 accumulation 或整个冰川。

grammar.title: 主谓一致考点
grammar.skeleton: The unparalleled, and majestic beauty of glaciers, + are (is) mostly found in the wild and inaccessible mountainous regions.
grammar.notes: 中心词 beauty 为单数，规范应为 is。

vocab.root: glaci- (冰，来自拉丁语 glacies) + -er → 冰川；glacial 冰川的/冰冷的
intrigue (激起好奇) + -ing → 引人入胜的
in- (不) + access (接近) + -ible → 难以接近的
un- (不) + parallel (相匹敌) + -ed → 无可比拟的
en- (使) + dur- (持续) + -ing → 持久的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：引出话题并点出其吸引力
模板：[X] are an intriguing part of [larger context]. They are made up of [components] that [behavior].
例句：Coral reefs are an intriguing part of the ocean ecosystem. They are made up of countless tiny animals that build limestone structures over centuries.

title: UNIT 147 · 冰盖、冰帽与冰原
body: Ice sheets cover huge land areas and are the largest ice masses found on Earth. The Antarctica ice sheet covers 13 million sq km and is over 4 km thick. In many places, its weight has depressed the continent below sea level. If this weight were removed, the continent would slowly rise and readjust itself, as Europe still apparently does. Following the melting of the continental ice sheet from the last Ice Age, the European land mass is said to be slowly rising. Ice caps are smaller than ice sheets and form when a considerable depth of snow and ice fills a basin, or covers a plateau. Ice fields develop where large interconnecting valley glaciers are separated by mountain peaks and ridges that project through the ice.
translation: 冰盖覆盖着广阔的陆地，是地球上最大的冰体。南极冰盖面积达 1300 万平方公里，厚度超过 4 公里。在许多地方，冰盖的重量已将大陆压到海平面以下。如果移除这一重量，大陆就会慢慢上升并重新调整，欧洲显然至今仍在经历这一过程。据说，自上一个冰期大陆冰盖融化以来，欧洲陆块一直在缓慢抬升。冰帽比冰盖小，当相当厚的冰雪填满一个盆地或覆盖一片高原时便会形成冰帽。冰原则形成于大型相互连通的山谷冰川被突出冰面的山峰和山脊分隔开的地方。
insights: 【虚拟条件】原文：If this weight were removed, the continent would slowly rise and readjust itself。翻译精雕：如果移除这一重量，大陆就会慢慢上升并重新调整。技巧：与现在事实相反的虚拟，中文用“如果……就会……”。
【be said to be】原文：the European land mass is said to be slowly rising。翻译精雕：据说……欧洲陆块一直在缓慢抬升。技巧：be said to 译“据说”。
【where 从句的地点化】原文：Ice fields develop where large interconnecting valley glaciers are separated by...。翻译精雕：冰原则形成于……被……分隔开的地方。技巧：where 引导地点状语从句，译“……的地方”。

grammar.title: 虚拟语气 + as 比较
grammar.skeleton: If this weight were removed, + the continent would slowly rise and readjust itself, + as Europe still apparently does.
grammar.notes: as 引导方式状语从句，does 替代 rise and readjust。

grammar.title: Following + 名词 + 被动进行
grammar.skeleton: Following the melting of the continental ice sheet from the last Ice Age, + the European land mass is said to be slowly rising.
grammar.notes: following = after；be said to be doing 表进行。

grammar.title: where 地点从句 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Ice fields develop + where large interconnecting valley glaciers are separated by mountain peaks and ridges + [that project through the ice].
grammar.notes: project 作不及物动词“突出”。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：depress 使下降、压低 (≠ 使沮丧)
熟词僻义：project v. 突出、伸出 (pro- 向前 + ject 扔)

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用虚拟语气推演“移除某因素”的后果
模板：If [force] were removed, [object] would slowly [response], as [real example] still apparently does.
例句：If government subsidies were removed, the industry would slowly shrink and restructure, as the coal sector still apparently does.

title: UNIT 148 · 冰川的侵蚀与沉积
body: As glaciers move over bedrock, they scrape and abrade its surface, producing fine-grained rock flour. Glaciers can also pluck away rocks up to boulder size, and transport and deposit them along the margins of the glacier down in the valleys. The glaciers deposit these materials as till, a sediment consisting of mud, sand, gravel, and boulders. Much of this material is deposited in long mounds called moraines. Lateral moraines are formed on each side of a valley glacier where abraded sediment and plucked rocks are deposited.
translation: 冰川在基岩上移动时，会刮擦和磨蚀岩石表面，产生细粒的岩粉。冰川还能拔起大到巨砾的岩石，将它们搬运到山谷中，沿冰川边缘沉积下来。冰川将这些物质以冰碛的形式沉积下来，冰碛是由泥、沙、砾石和巨砾组成的沉积物。这些物质大多沉积成被称为冰碛垄的长条形土丘。侧碛形成于山谷冰川的两侧，那里沉积着被磨蚀的沉积物和被拔起的岩石。
insights: 【分词结果】原文：they scrape and abrade its surface, producing fine-grained rock flour。翻译精雕：会刮擦和磨蚀岩石表面，产生细粒的岩粉。技巧：producing 表结果，直接接为后续动作。
【熟词僻义】原文：rock flour / till / pluck。翻译精雕：岩粉 / 冰碛 / 拔起。技巧：flour 不是“面粉”，till 不是“直到”，pluck 指冰川冻结并拔起岩块（冰川拔蚀作用）。
【同位语解释】原文：as till, a sediment consisting of mud, sand, gravel, and boulders。翻译精雕：以冰碛的形式……，冰碛是由……组成的沉积物。技巧：同位语单独成句并重复“冰碛”。

grammar.title: As 时间 + 分词结果
grammar.skeleton: As glaciers move over bedrock, + they scrape and abrade its surface, + producing fine-grained rock flour.
grammar.notes: producing 表结果。

grammar.title: 并列谓语 + up to
grammar.skeleton: Glaciers can also [pluck away rocks up to boulder size], and [transport and deposit them along the margins of the glacier down in the valleys].
grammar.notes: up to boulder size 表“大到巨砾那么大”。

grammar.title: where 从句
grammar.skeleton: Lateral moraines are formed on each side of a valley glacier + [where abraded sediment and plucked rocks are deposited].
grammar.notes: where 指代两侧位置。

vocab.root: 引申：bedrock 基础、根本 (the bedrock of democracy)
ab- (离开) + rade (刮，来自拉丁语 radere) → 刮掉 → 磨蚀
熟词僻义：rock flour 岩粉
熟词僻义：till n. 冰碛 (≠ 直到)；v. 耕种

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述侵蚀—搬运—沉积的完整过程
模板：As [agent] moves over [surface], it [erodes] its surface, producing [fine material]. [Agent] can also [pick up] [larger material], and transport and deposit them along [location].
例句：As rivers move over soft rock, they wear down its surface, producing fine silt. Rivers can also carry away large stones, and transport and deposit them along their banks.

title: UNIT 149 · 冰川退缩与全球变暖
body: Some glaciologists believe the current retreat of certain glaciers is influenced by global warming. The build-up of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere has been cited as the cause of this phenomenon. One of the reasons for this gaseous buildup is attributed to the burning of fossil fuels from the time of the Industrial Revolution in the late 1800's. Higher average temperatures may cause glaciers to melt at a faster rate than normal, unless they can be replenished by winter snows.
translation: 一些冰川学家认为，当前某些冰川的退缩受到了全球变暖的影响。大气中温室气体的积累被认为是这一现象的原因。造成这种气体积累的原因之一，被归因于自 19 世纪后期工业革命以来对化石燃料的燃烧。较高的平均气温可能导致冰川以比正常情况更快的速度融化，除非它们能得到冬季降雪的补充。
insights: 【be cited as】原文：has been cited as the cause of this phenomenon。翻译精雕：被认为是这一现象的原因。技巧：be cited as 字面为“被引作”，在学术语境中译“被认为是”。
【be attributed to】原文：One of the reasons... is attributed to the burning of fossil fuels。翻译精雕：……被归因于……对化石燃料的燃烧。技巧：attribute A to B 译“把 A 归因于 B”。
【unless 的条件】原文：unless they can be replenished by winter snows。翻译精雕：除非它们能得到冬季降雪的补充。技巧：unless 译“除非”，被动转为“得到……补充”。
【学术态度的措辞】原文用 Some... believe / may cause 等谨慎表达。技巧：翻译时保留“一些……认为 / 可能”，不要把推测译成定论。

grammar.title: believe + 宾语从句
grammar.skeleton: Some glaciologists believe + [(that) the current retreat of certain glaciers is influenced by global warming].
grammar.notes: be influenced by 表“受……影响”。

grammar.title: be attributed to
grammar.skeleton: One of the reasons for this gaseous buildup + is attributed to + the burning of fossil fuels from the time of the Industrial Revolution in the late 1800's.
grammar.notes: one of the reasons 作主语，谓语用单数。

grammar.title: cause + 宾语 + to do + unless
grammar.skeleton: Higher average temperatures may cause glaciers to melt at a faster rate than normal, + unless they can be replenished by winter snows.
grammar.notes: at a faster rate than normal 表比较。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：retreat (冰川) 退缩；另义“静修所”
re- (再) + plen- (满，来自拉丁语 plenus) + -ish → 再填满 → 补充
at- (= ad-) + tribute (给予) → 把……归于
来自拉丁语 citare “召唤” → 引用

specialHTML:
