句型：谨慎表达因果归因
模板：Some [experts] believe [phenomenon] is influenced by [cause]. [Factor] has been cited as the cause, and one of the reasons is attributed to [deeper cause].

title: UNIT 150 · 冰川的消融与地貌塑造
body: The farther a glacier moves from its source of accumulation into the warmer, lower elevated regions, the more likely it is to ablate, or melt. As the ice ablates, it begins to deposit the rocks and debris that have fallen into its path and crevasses, plus what it has eroded as it moves down from the mountains. Just as streams of flowing water create landforms when they deposit their loads of material, glaciers are streams of frozen water that drop their burden and shape the landscape as they recede.
translation: 冰川离其积累源头越远，进入越温暖、海拔越低的地区，就越有可能消融或融化。随着冰体消融，冰川开始沉积那些落入其路径和冰隙中的岩石与碎屑，以及它从山上向下移动时侵蚀下来的物质。正如流水在沉积所携带的物质时会塑造地貌一样，冰川作为冻结的水流，在退缩时也会卸下其负载，塑造地貌景观。
insights: 【the more..., the more likely】原文：The farther a glacier moves..., the more likely it is to ablate。翻译精雕：冰川离……越远……，就越有可能消融。技巧：“越……就越……”。
【Just as... 类比】原文：Just as streams of flowing water create landforms..., glaciers are streams of frozen water that...。翻译精雕：正如流水……一样，冰川作为冻结的水流……也会……。技巧：just as 译“正如……一样”，后句加“也”。
【plus what 的处理】原文：the rocks and debris..., plus what it has eroded...。翻译精雕：……岩石与碎屑，以及它……侵蚀下来的物质。技巧：plus 连接名词与 what 从句，译“以及”。

grammar.title: the + 比较级, the + 比较级
grammar.skeleton: The farther a glacier moves from its source of accumulation into the warmer, lower elevated regions, + the more likely it is to ablate, or melt.
grammar.notes: be likely to do 拆分到比较结构中。

grammar.notes: what 引导名词性从句。

grammar.title: Just as 类比 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Just as streams of flowing water create landforms when they deposit their loads of material, + glaciers are streams of frozen water + [that drop their burden and shape the landscape as they recede].
grammar.notes: just as 引导方式/类比状语。

title: UNIT 151 · 月球与卫星
body: The Moon is the only natural satellite of the Earth. Other planets in the solar system also have satellites that are often referred to as moons. Telescopes have revealed a wealth of lunar details since their invention in the 17th century, and spacecraft have contributed further knowledge since the 1950s.
translation: 月球是地球唯一的天然卫星。太阳系中的其他行星也有卫星，它们通常也被称为“月亮”。自 17 世纪望远镜发明以来，它揭示了大量月球细节；而自 20 世纪 50 年代以来，航天器又进一步丰富了我们的知识。
insights: 【the only】原文：The Moon is the only natural satellite of the Earth。翻译精雕：月球是地球唯一的天然卫星。技巧：natural satellite 与 artificial satellite (人造卫星) 区分。
【a wealth of】原文：Telescopes have revealed a wealth of lunar details。翻译精雕：望远镜揭示了大量月球细节。技巧：a wealth of 译“大量的、丰富的”。
【时间状语的处理】原文：since their invention in the 17th century / since the 1950s。翻译精雕：自 17 世纪望远镜发明以来 / 自 20 世纪 50 年代以来。技巧：since 时间状语提前，与现在完成时呼应。

grammar.title: be referred to as
grammar.skeleton: Other planets in the solar system also have satellites + [that are often referred to as moons].
grammar.notes: refer to A as B 的被动形式。

grammar.title: 现在完成时 + since
grammar.skeleton: Telescopes have revealed a wealth of lunar details + since their invention in the 17th century, + and spacecraft have contributed further knowledge + since the 1950s.
grammar.notes: 两个现在完成时分句并列。

vocab.root: lun- (月亮，来自拉丁语 luna) + -ar → 月球的；lunar calendar 农历

模板：[Tool A] has revealed a wealth of [details] since [time A], and [tool B] has contributed further knowledge since [time B].
例句：Microscopes have revealed a wealth of cellular details since the 17th century, and DNA sequencing has contributed further knowledge since the 1970s.

title: UNIT 152 · 月球与地球的运行方向
body: The Moon orbits Earth in a counterclockwise direction, and the Earth itself, rotates on its axis from west to east, which is also a counterclockwise movement. Similarly, the Earth revolves around the Sun in a counterclockwise orbit.
translation: 月球沿逆时针方向绕地球运行，而地球本身绕地轴自西向东自转，这也是一种逆时针运动。同样，地球也沿逆时针轨道绕太阳公转。（注：这里的“逆时针”指从北极上空俯视时的方向。）
insights: 【rotate vs revolve】原文：the Earth itself, rotates on its axis... the Earth revolves around the Sun。翻译精雕：地球……自转……地球……公转。技巧：rotate = 自转（绕自身轴），revolve = 公转（绕另一天体），必须区分。
【补充说明】逆时针 (counterclockwise) 的判断以“从北极上空俯视”为参照，原文未说明，翻译时可加注。

grammar.title: 并列句 + which 从句
grammar.skeleton: The Moon orbits Earth in a counterclockwise direction, + and the Earth itself, rotates on its axis from west to east, + [which is also a counterclockwise movement].
grammar.notes: which 指代前面整个分句。

grammar.title: Similarly 承接
grammar.skeleton: Similarly, + the Earth revolves around the Sun in a counterclockwise orbit.
grammar.notes: similarly 表类比关系。

vocab.meaning: 绕（吸引中心 运转）n. 轨道
vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 orbis “圆圈” → 轨道 (n.)；绕……运行 (v.)
counter- (相反) + clockwise (顺时针) → 逆时针的
re- (回) + volve (转) → 旋转/公转；revolution 公转/革命

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用 Similarly 建立类比
模板：[A] [moves] in [direction], and [B] itself [moves] [direction], which is also [same pattern]. Similarly, [C] [moves] in [same pattern].
例句：Fashion trends move from cities to suburbs, and music trends themselves spread from youth to adults, which is also a top-down pattern. Similarly, technology adoption follows a top-down path.

🌏 rotate vs revolve
Rotation (自转)：天体绕自身轴旋转 → 地球自转一周 ≈ 24 小时 (一天)。
Revolution (公转)：天体绕另一天体运行 → 地球公转一周 ≈ 365.25 天 (一年)。

title: UNIT 153 · 月相的变化
body: The Moon goes through a series of phases depending on its distance from the Sun. A full Moon occurs when it is farthest from the Sun and a new Moon appears when it is closest. These positions occur in each of the 30 day cycles that it takes the Moon to revolve around the Earth. The gibbous phase is when more than half the Moon is illuminated, while the crescent phase is when less than half is illuminated. The Moon is said to be waning as it changes from a full Moon to a new Moon, but waxing as it progresses from a new to a full Moon.
translation: 月球会经历一系列月相变化，这取决于它与太阳的距离。月球离太阳最远时出现满月，离太阳最近时出现新月。在月球绕地球公转一周所需的约 30 天周期中，每个周期都会出现这些位置。凸月是指月球被照亮的部分超过一半的阶段，而蛾眉月则是被照亮的部分不到一半的阶段。月球从满月变为新月时被称为“亏”，而从新月变为满月时则被称为“盈”。
insights: 【原文科学性勘误】原文称月相“取决于月球与太阳的距离”，这一说法不准确。月相实际取决于太阳、地球、月球三者的相对位置：月球位于地球与太阳之间时为新月，位于地球另一侧（与太阳相对）时为满月。另，月球绕地球的朔望周期约为 29.5 天。学习时应注意甄别。
【术语对译】gibbous 凸月 / crescent 蛾眉月 / waning 亏 / waxing 盈。技巧：天文术语有固定中文译名。
【while 对比】原文：The gibbous phase is when..., while the crescent phase is when...。翻译精雕：凸月是指……的阶段，而蛾眉月则是……的阶段。技巧：when 引导表语从句，译“是指……的阶段”。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + it takes sb. time to do
grammar.skeleton: These positions occur in each of the 30 day cycles + [that it takes the Moon to revolve around the Earth].
grammar.notes: it takes + 时间 + to do 结构，that 从句中 cycles 作 takes 的宾语。

grammar.title: when 引导表语从句
grammar.skeleton: The gibbous phase is + [when more than half the Moon is illuminated], + while the crescent phase is [when less than half is illuminated].
grammar.notes: when 从句作表语。

grammar.title: be said to be + doing
grammar.skeleton: The Moon is said to be waning + as it changes from a full Moon to a new Moon, + but waxing + as it progresses from a new to a full Moon.
grammar.notes: but 后省略 is said to be。

vocab.root: il- (= in-) + lumin- (光) + -ate → 照亮；阐明
来自希腊语 phasis “出现” → 月相/阶段
来自拉丁语 crescere “生长” → 新月形；渐增的

例句：Public interest is said to be fading as it moves from launch hype to routine use, but growing as it progresses from niche to mainstream adoption.

title: UNIT 154 · 日食
body: It is a cosmic coincidence that, when seen from the Earth, the Moon and the Sun each appear to be disks of the same apparent size. Each month, at the time of a new Moon, a solar eclipse will be seen at a location on the Earth. This occurs when the Moon's orbit coincides exactly with the plane of the Earth's orbit around the Sun. Partial eclipses are more commonly seen, because the Moon doesn't always fully cover the Sun's disk. Total eclipses only occur 2 to 5 times a year.
translation: 从地球上看，月球和太阳看起来是视大小相同的圆盘，这是一个宇宙巧合。每个月新月时，地球上的某个地方就有可能看到日食。当月球轨道与地球绕太阳运行的轨道平面恰好重合时，就会发生日食。日偏食更为常见，因为月球并不总能完全遮住太阳的圆面。日全食每年只发生 2 到 5 次。
insights: 【形式主语 It is... that】原文：It is a cosmic coincidence that... the Moon and the Sun each appear to be disks of the same apparent size。翻译精雕：……看起来是视大小相同的圆盘，这是一个宇宙巧合。技巧：形式主语句中，中文常先说内容，再作评价。
【apparent size 术语】原文：the same apparent size。翻译精雕：视大小相同。技巧：apparent size 是天文学“视大小”，不是“明显的大小”。
【原文科学性勘误】日食并非每月都发生，因为月球轨道与黄道面有约 5° 的夹角，只有新月恰好位于交点附近时才会发生日食；每年日食（含偏食、环食、全食）通常为 2–5 次，日全食更少。

grammar.title: It is + 名词 + that 主语从句
grammar.skeleton: It is a cosmic coincidence + that, [when seen from the Earth], the Moon and the Sun each appear to be disks of the same apparent size.
grammar.notes: that 从句是真正的主语。

grammar.title: when 从句 + coincide with
grammar.skeleton: This occurs + when the Moon's orbit coincides exactly with the plane of the Earth's orbit around the Sun.
grammar.notes: coincide with 表“与……重合”。

grammar.title: because + not always
grammar.skeleton: Partial eclipses are more commonly seen, + because the Moon doesn't always fully cover the Sun's disk.
grammar.notes: not always 为部分否定。

co- + incide (落下) + -ence → 同时落下 → 巧合

来自希腊语 ekleipsis “遗弃/缺失” → 日/月食；v. 使黯然失色

vocab.meaning: 表面上的；视（大小）的；明显的
vocab.root: ap- (= ad-) + par- (出现) + -ent → 显现出来的

title: UNIT 155 · 月球表面的陨石坑
body: The Moon's surface is covered with craters, which are overlain by a layer of soil, called regolith. Nearly all the craters are formed by the explosive impact from high-velocity meteorites.
translation: 月球表面布满了陨石坑，坑上覆盖着一层被称为月壤（风化层）的土壤。几乎所有的陨石坑都是由高速陨石的爆炸性撞击形成的。
insights: 【被动 + 定语从句】原文：The Moon's surface is covered with craters, which are overlain by a layer of soil, called regolith。翻译精雕：月球表面布满了陨石坑，坑上覆盖着一层被称为月壤的土壤。技巧：overlain 被动转为主动“坑上覆盖着”。
【crater 的语境译法】crater 在火山语境译“火山口”，在月球语境译“陨石坑/环形山”。

grammar.title: be covered with + 非限制性从句
grammar.skeleton: The Moon's surface is covered with craters, + [which are overlain by a layer of soil, called regolith].
grammar.notes: overlain 是 overlie 的过去分词 (overlie—overlay—overlain)。

grammar.title: 被动 + by
grammar.skeleton: Nearly all the craters are formed by + the explosive impact from high-velocity meteorites.
grammar.notes: high-velocity 复合形容词。

rego- (覆盖，来自希腊语 rhegos) + lith (石头) → 风化层

☄️ meteor / meteoroid / meteorite
meteoroid：太空中的小天体；meteor：进入大气层燃烧发光的流星；meteorite：落到地面（或月面）的陨石。

title: UNIT 156 · 太阳系的行星
body: The International Astronomical Union (IAU) is the body that gives official names to objects in the solar system. To date, they have recognised, and named, eight major or classical planets. Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars are classified as the inner planets and Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune, are referred to as the outer planets. The inner planets are smaller and composed primarily of rock and iron. The outer planets are much larger and consist mainly of hydrogen, helium and ice. Historically, Pluto had been listed as the ninth planet, but it was reclassified as a dwarf planet by the IAU in 2006, because of its size and gravitational characteristics.
translation: 国际天文学联合会（IAU）是为太阳系天体正式命名的机构。迄今为止，该组织已经确认并命名了八大行星（即经典行星）。水星、金星、地球和火星被归为内行星，而木星、土星、天王星和海王星则被称为外行星。内行星体积较小，主要由岩石和铁构成。外行星则大得多，主要由氢、氦和冰构成。历史上，冥王星曾被列为第九大行星，但由于其大小和引力特征，国际天文学联合会于 2006 年将其重新归类为矮行星。
insights: 【To date 的译法】原文：To date, they have recognised, and named, eight major or classical planets。翻译精雕：迄今为止，该组织已经确认并命名了八大行星。技巧：to date 译“迄今为止”，与现在完成时呼应。
【对比结构】原文：The inner planets are smaller and composed primarily of rock and iron. The outer planets are much larger and consist mainly of...。翻译精雕：内行星体积较小……外行星则大得多……。技巧：两句形成对比，后句加“则”。
【过去完成时的历史感】原文：Pluto had been listed as the ninth planet, but it was reclassified...。翻译精雕：冥王星曾被列为第九大行星，但……被重新归类为……。技巧：had been 用“曾”体现。

grammar.notes: 过去完成时表示“过去的过去”。

title: UNIT 157 · 水星与金星
body: Mercury is surprisingly dense, apparently because it has an unusually large iron core. During its early history, the transient atmosphere of Mercury seems to be the reason its surface bears the record for bombardment by asteroidal bodies. Venus has a carbon dioxide atmosphere which exerts a pressure about 90 times that of the Earth's atmosphere. There is a hypothetical argument that this creates a greenhouse effect to explain the extremely high temperatures measured on the surface of Venus. Coincidently, Venus rotates in a clockwise direction, which is opposite to the rotation of the other inner planets.
translation: 水星的密度出人意料地大，这显然是因为它拥有一个异常巨大的铁核。在水星早期的历史中，其短暂存在的大气层似乎是其表面留下大量小行星撞击记录的原因。金星拥有以二氧化碳为主的大气层，其压力约为地球大气压的 90 倍。有一种假说认为，这形成了温室效应，可以解释在金星表面测得的极高温度。巧合的是，金星沿顺时针方向自转，这与其他内行星的自转方向相反。
insights: 【apparently because】原文：Mercury is surprisingly dense, apparently because it has an unusually large iron core。翻译精雕：水星的密度出人意料地大，这显然是因为……。技巧：apparently 译“显然/看来”，保持推测语气。
【倍数 + that of】原文：exerts a pressure about 90 times that of the Earth's atmosphere。翻译精雕：其压力约为地球大气压的 90 倍。技巧：X times that of Y 译“是 Y 的 X 倍”。
【hypothetical argument】原文：There is a hypothetical argument that...。翻译精雕：有一种假说认为……。技巧：同位语从句译为“……认为”。注：如今金星的温室效应已被广泛接受，不仅是假说。

grammar.title: seem to be + 省略关系词
grammar.skeleton: the transient atmosphere of Mercury seems to be the reason + [(why) its surface bears the record for bombardment by asteroidal bodies].
grammar.notes: the reason 后省略 why/that。

grammar.title: 倍数 + that of
grammar.skeleton: Venus has a carbon dioxide atmosphere + [which exerts a pressure about 90 times that of the Earth's atmosphere].
grammar.notes: that 指代 pressure。

grammar.title: 同位语从句 + to do
grammar.skeleton: There is a hypothetical argument + [that this creates a greenhouse effect to explain the extremely high temperatures measured on the surface of Venus].
grammar.notes: that 从句解释 argument 的内容。

vocab.root: trans- (穿过) + i- (走) + -ent → 走过去的 → 短暂的
bombard (轰炸) + -ment → 轰击/撞击
aster- (星，来自希腊语 aster) + -oid (像……的) → 像星星的 → 小行星
hypo- (在下) + thet- (放置) + -ical → 放在下面作基础的 → 假设的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：用倍数比较突出极端特征
模板：[X] has [feature] which exerts a [quantity] about [number] times that of [reference].
例句：The new processor has a cache which delivers a speed about 10 times that of the previous generation.

title: UNIT 158 · 木星与土星
body: Jupiter is the largest of the planets' with one single ring and a satellite the size of Mercury. The hydrogen and helium atmosphere contains pastel-coloured clouds, but its immense magnetosphere, make it unique in terms of the Sun's planetary system. Saturn is a close rival of Jupiter in many ways, but it has a much more intricate ring structure, and a similarly large satellite, but far less magnetospheric effect.
translation: 木星是行星中最大的一颗，有一个单环，以及一颗与水星一样大的卫星。它由氢和氦构成的大气层中含有色彩柔和的云层，而其巨大的磁层使它在太阳的行星系统中独树一帜。土星在许多方面与木星不相上下，但它拥有复杂得多的环系结构，以及一颗同样巨大的卫星，不过磁层效应要弱得多。
insights: 【the size of】原文：a satellite the size of Mercury。翻译精雕：一颗与水星一样大的卫星。技巧：名词 + the size of + 名词 = “与……一样大的”。
【in terms of】原文：make it unique in terms of the Sun's planetary system。翻译精雕：使它在太阳的行星系统中独树一帜。技巧：in terms of 译“就……而言/在……中”。
【rival 的译法】原文：Saturn is a close rival of Jupiter in many ways。翻译精雕：土星在许多方面与木星不相上下。技巧：a close rival 译“不相上下的对手”。

grammar.title: with 介词短语 + 同位修饰
grammar.skeleton: Jupiter is the largest of the planets + [with one single ring and a satellite [the size of Mercury]].
grammar.notes: the size of Mercury 作后置定语修饰 satellite。注：今天已知木星有多个暗淡的环。

grammar.title: but + make + 宾语 + 形容词
grammar.skeleton: The hydrogen and helium atmosphere contains pastel-coloured clouds, + but its immense magnetosphere, make(s) it unique in terms of the Sun's planetary system.
grammar.notes: 主语 magnetosphere 为单数，规范应为 makes。

grammar.title: but + 多重并列宾语
grammar.skeleton: Saturn is a close rival of Jupiter in many ways, + but it has [a much more intricate ring structure], and [a similarly large satellite], but [far less magnetospheric effect].
grammar.notes: much / far 修饰比较级。

vocab.root: 来自拉丁语 rivalis “共用一条溪流的人” → 竞争者；v. 与……匹敌
in- (进入) + tric- (困扰) + -ate → 卷入纠缠的 → 错综复杂的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：对比两个相似对象的异同
模板：[B] is a close rival of [A] in many ways, but it has a much more [adj.] [feature], and a similarly [adj.] [feature], but far less [feature].
例句：Tokyo is a close rival of New York in many ways, but it has a much more efficient transit system, and a similarly vibrant culture, but far less street crime.

title: UNIT 159 · 宇宙学与宇宙起源论
body: Cosmology is a branch of astronomy, but the observational and theoretical techniques used by cosmologists involve a wide range of other sciences, particularly, physics and chemistry. Cosmology is distinguished from cosmogony, which now usually only refers to studying the origin of the solar system. Previously, cosmogony used to cover the wider field related to studying the origin of the whole universe.
translation: 宇宙学是天文学的一个分支，但宇宙学家所使用的观测和理论方法涉及广泛的其他学科，尤其是物理学和化学。宇宙学不同于天体演化学（宇宙起源论），后者如今通常仅指对太阳系起源的研究。过去，天体演化学曾涵盖与研究整个宇宙起源相关的更广泛领域。
insights: 【be distinguished from】原文：Cosmology is distinguished from cosmogony。翻译精雕：宇宙学不同于天体演化学。技巧：be distinguished from 译“不同于/有别于”。
【used to 的过去时】原文：Previously, cosmogony used to cover the wider field...。翻译精雕：过去，天体演化学曾涵盖……更广泛的领域。技巧：used to do 表过去的情况，译“曾经”。
【术语区分】cosmology 宇宙学（研究宇宙整体结构与演化）/ cosmogony 天体演化学（研究天体起源）。

grammar.title: but + 过去分词定语 + involve
grammar.skeleton: Cosmology is a branch of astronomy, + but the observational and theoretical techniques [used by cosmologists] + involve a wide range of other sciences, + particularly, physics and chemistry.
grammar.notes: used by 修饰 techniques。

grammar.title: which 从句 + only refers to
grammar.skeleton: Cosmology is distinguished from cosmogony, + [which now usually only refers to studying the origin of the solar system].
grammar.notes: refer to doing，to 为介词。

vocab.root: cosmo- (宇宙) + gony (产生，来自希腊语 gonos) → 宇宙起源论
cosmo- (宇宙) + -logy → 宇宙学
astro- (星) + nomy (法则) → 天文学

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：区分两个易混学科
模板：[Field A] is distinguished from [field B], which now usually only refers to [narrow scope]. Previously, [field B] used to cover the wider field related to [broad scope].
例句：Ecology is distinguished from environmentalism, which now usually only refers to political advocacy. Previously, environmentalism used to cover the wider field related to studying nature.

title: UNIT 160 · 星系与星际物质
body: A galaxy is a massive ensemble of hundreds of millions of stars, all gravitationally interacting and orbiting about a common center. Astronomers estimate that there are some, 125 billion galaxies in the universe. All the stars visible from the Earth by the unaided eyes, belong to the Earth's galaxy, which we view longitudinally as the Milky Way. The Sun, with its associated planets, is just one star in this galaxy. Besides stars, star clusters and planets, the space within and between galaxies, consists of a whole range of material, collectively called interstellar matter. This matter includes atomic hydrogen gas; molecular hydrogen; complex molecules of hydrogen, nitrogen, carbon, silicon and other elements, along with cosmic rays and black holes.
translation: 星系是由数亿颗恒星组成的庞大集合体，这些恒星在引力作用下相互作用，并围绕一个共同的中心运行。天文学家估计，宇宙中约有 1250 亿个星系。从地球上用肉眼能看到的所有恒星，都属于地球所在的星系，我们从侧面纵向观察它，看到的就是银河。太阳及其相关的行星，只是这个星系中的一颗恒星。除了恒星、星团和行星之外，星系内部和星系之间的空间还包含各种各样的物质，统称为星际物质。这些物质包括原子氢气、分子氢，由氢、氮、碳、硅和其他元素构成的复杂分子，以及宇宙射线和黑洞。
insights: 【all + 分词的独立结构】原文：hundreds of millions of stars, all gravitationally interacting and orbiting about a common center。翻译精雕：数亿颗恒星……，这些恒星在引力作用下相互作用，并围绕……运行。技巧：all + doing 独立结构拆为独立分句。
【大数字的换算】原文：some 125 billion galaxies。翻译精雕：约 1250 亿个星系。技巧：billion = 十亿，需换算为中文“亿”。some 在数字前表“大约”。
【collectively called】原文：a whole range of material, collectively called interstellar matter。翻译精雕：各种各样的物质，统称为星际物质。技巧：collectively called 译“统称为”。

grammar.title: 同位语 + 独立结构
grammar.skeleton: A galaxy is a massive ensemble of hundreds of millions of stars, + [all gravitationally interacting and orbiting about a common center].
grammar.notes: all 作逻辑主语的独立主格结构。

grammar.title: 主语 + 过去分词 + which 从句
grammar.skeleton: All the stars [visible from the Earth by the unaided eyes], belong to the Earth's galaxy, + [which we view longitudinally as the Milky Way].
grammar.notes: visible 形容词短语后置修饰 stars。

grammar.title: Besides + 主语 + consist of
grammar.skeleton: Besides stars, star clusters and planets, + the space within and between galaxies, + consists of a whole range of material, [collectively called interstellar matter].
grammar.notes: besides = in addition to (除……之外还有)。

vocab.root: 来自希腊语 galaxias “乳汁的” → 银河 → 星系
inter- (之间) + stellar (星的，来自拉丁语 stella) → 星际的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：定义集合体并说明其成员关系
模板：[X] is a massive ensemble of [members], all [interacting] and [moving] about a common [center].
例句：A city is a massive ensemble of millions of people, all economically interacting and organizing around a common center.

title: UNIT 161 · 椭圆星系与旋涡星系
body: The large telescopes are capable of viewing and photographing the distant galaxies, but individual stars can only be distinguished on the galaxies nearest to the Earth. The combined light of all the stars is all that is detected in most galaxies. Galaxies come in a variety of forms and sizes from the ellipticals to the spirals. Ellepticals have a bright nucleus within their overall globular shape, which contains a population of old stars and usually little apparent gas or dust among a few newly formed stars. These galaxies range of size from giant to dwarf. In contrast, spiral galaxies are flattened disk systems containing some old stars and large populations of young stars, together with the gas, dust, and molecular clouds that are the birthplace of stars. Some of these galaxies containing bright young stars and gas clouds, are arranged in long spiral arms that can be observed to wind around the galaxy. Generally, a halo of faint older stars surrounds the small nuclear bulge that often exists, along with two jets of energetic matter being emitted in opposite directions.
translation: 大型望远镜能够观测并拍摄遥远的星系，但只有离地球最近的星系才能分辨出单颗恒星。在大多数星系中，我们能探测到的只是所有恒星的总光芒。星系形态和大小各异，从椭圆星系到旋涡星系不等。椭圆星系整体呈球状，中心有一个明亮的核，其中聚集着大量年老的恒星，在少数新形成的恒星之间通常几乎看不到气体或尘埃。这类星系的大小从巨型到矮型不等。相比之下，旋涡星系是扁平的盘状系统，含有一些年老的恒星和大量年轻的恒星，还有作为恒星诞生地的气体、尘埃和分子云。其中一些含有明亮年轻恒星和气体云的星系，排列成长长的旋臂，可以观察到它们环绕星系旋转。通常，一圈暗淡的老年恒星构成的星系晕环绕着常常存在的小核球，同时还有两股高能物质喷流朝相反方向射出。
insights: 【all that is detected】原文：The combined light of all the stars is all that is detected in most galaxies。翻译精雕：在大多数星系中，我们能探测到的只是所有恒星的总光芒。技巧：all that... 译为“……的只是……”，突出“仅此而已”。
【come in a variety of】原文：Galaxies come in a variety of forms and sizes from the ellipticals to the spirals。翻译精雕：星系形态和大小各异，从椭圆星系到旋涡星系不等。技巧：come in + 形式 译“有……各种形态”。
【In contrast 的对比】椭圆星系：球状、老恒星、少气体；旋涡星系：扁平盘状、年轻恒星多、气体尘埃丰富。技巧：翻译对比段落时保持特征一一对应。

grammar.title: be capable of + but + only 被动
grammar.skeleton: The large telescopes are capable of viewing and photographing the distant galaxies, + but individual stars can only be distinguished on the galaxies nearest to the Earth.
grammar.notes: nearest to the Earth 形容词短语后置修饰 galaxies。

grammar.title: which 从句 + 并列宾语
grammar.skeleton: Ellipticals have a bright nucleus within their overall globular shape, + [which contains a population of old stars and usually little apparent gas or dust among a few newly formed stars].
grammar.notes: little 修饰不可数名词表否定“几乎没有”。

grammar.title: 现在分词定语 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: spiral galaxies are flattened disk systems [containing some old stars and large populations of young stars], + together with the gas, dust, and molecular clouds [that are the birthplace of stars].
grammar.notes: containing 修饰 systems。

grammar.title: 被动 + 现在分词被动
grammar.skeleton: along with two jets of energetic matter [being emitted in opposite directions].
grammar.notes: being emitted 表“正在被喷射”。

vocab.root: globular: globe (球) + -ular → 球形的；globular cluster 球状星团
熟词僻义：population (天体/生物) 群体、数量

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：对比两类事物的特征
模板：[Type A] have [feature A], which contains [components A]. In contrast, [type B] are [structure B] containing [components B].
例句：Traditional universities have large campuses, which contain lecture halls and libraries. In contrast, online universities are digital platforms containing video courses and discussion forums.

title: UNIT 162 · 不规则星系、环状星系与类星体
body: Other disk-like galaxies, with no overall spiral form, are classified as irregulars. These galaxies also contain large amounts of gas, dust, and young stars, but not arranged in any particular shape. Often, they are located near larger galaxies and their appearance is probably the result of a tidal encounter with the more massive bodies. When a close group of two or three galaxies are located together, their tidal interactions create distortions in their spiral arms and produce extremely peculiar, warped disks, and long streamer tails. Ring galaxies form when a small galaxy collides with the center of a spiral galaxy and a ring of stars forms at the outer edges of the new, combined galaxy. Quasars are apparently stellar objects, but their enormous redshifts identify them as objects at extreme distances, and possibly closely related to radio galaxies.
translation: 其他没有整体旋涡形态的盘状星系，被归类为不规则星系。这类星系同样含有大量的气体、尘埃和年轻恒星，但没有排列成任何特定形状。它们通常位于较大星系附近，其外观很可能是与质量更大的天体发生潮汐相遇的结果。当两三个星系紧密地聚集在一起时，它们之间的潮汐相互作用会使旋臂扭曲变形，产生极其奇特的翘曲盘面和长长的带状尾巴。当一个小星系撞击一个旋涡星系的中心时，就会形成环状星系，在新合并星系的外缘形成一圈恒星。类星体看起来像恒星，但其巨大的红移表明它们处于极其遥远的距离，并且可能与射电星系密切相关。
insights: 【be the result of】原文：their appearance is probably the result of a tidal encounter with the more massive bodies。翻译精雕：其外观很可能是与……发生潮汐相遇的结果。技巧：probably 保持推测语气。
【identify A as B】原文：their enormous redshifts identify them as objects at extreme distances。翻译精雕：其巨大的红移表明它们处于极其遥远的距离。技巧：identify A as B 在此译为“表明 A 是 B”。
【apparently 的位置】原文：Quasars are apparently stellar objects。翻译精雕：类星体看起来像恒星。技巧：apparently 表“表面上”，这正是 quasar (quasi-stellar 类星) 名称的由来。

grammar.title: with 插入 + 被动
grammar.skeleton: Other disk-like galaxies, [with no overall spiral form], + are classified as irregulars.
grammar.notes: with no = without。

grammar.title: When 从句 + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: When a close group of two or three galaxies are located together, + their tidal interactions [create distortions in their spiral arms] and [produce extremely peculiar, warped disks, and long streamer tails].
grammar.notes: a group of 作主语时谓语单复数均可。

grammar.title: but + identify A as B
grammar.skeleton: Quasars are apparently stellar objects, + but their enormous redshifts identify them as objects at extreme distances, + and possibly (are) closely related to radio galaxies.
grammar.notes: possibly 后省略 are。

vocab.root: tide (潮汐) + -al → 潮汐的
en- (使) + counter (相对) → 相遇/遭遇
来自拉丁语 peculium “私有财产” → 独有的 → 奇特的
dis- (分开) + tort (扭) + -ion → 扭曲
quasi- (类似) + stellar (恒星的) → 类星体
stell- (星，来自拉丁语 stella) + -ar → 恒星的；引申“杰出的”(stellar performance)

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：推测现象的成因
模板：Often, [X] are located near [Y] and their [feature] is probably the result of [interaction] with [Y].
例句：Often, small shops are located near large malls and their survival is probably the result of overflow traffic from the bigger stores.

🔭 托福天文：redshift (红移)

光源远离观察者时，光的波长被拉长，向光谱的红端偏移，称为红移。红移越大，天体退行速度越快、距离越远 —— 这是宇宙膨胀 (expanding universe) 的重要证据。

title: UNIT 163 · 污染的定义与分类
body: Pollution refers to contamination of the Earth's environment from materials that interfere with human health, the quality of life, or the natural functioning of ecosystems. There are two main categories of pollutants. Biodegradable materials that rapidly decompose by natural processes, such as sewage, are the less serious category. The nondegradable are materials that either, do not decompose, or pose a long term toxic threat, and are in the category that requires concerted remedial action.
translation: 污染是指地球环境受到某些物质的污染，这些物质会危害人类健康、生活质量或生态系统的自然运行。污染物主要分为两大类。能通过自然过程迅速分解的可生物降解物质（如污水）属于危害较轻的一类。不可降解物质则要么无法分解，要么构成长期的毒性威胁，属于需要协同采取补救行动的一类。
insights: 【interfere with 的译法】原文：materials that interfere with human health...。翻译精雕：会危害人类健康……的物质。技巧：interfere with 在负面语境中译“危害、妨碍”。
【either... or 的处理】原文：materials that either, do not decompose, or pose a long term toxic threat。翻译精雕：要么无法分解，要么构成长期的毒性威胁。技巧：either... or 译“要么……要么……”。
【concerted remedial action】原文：requires concerted remedial action。翻译精雕：需要协同采取补救行动。技巧：concerted 意为“协同一致的”，remedial 意为“补救的”。

grammar.title: refer to + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Pollution refers to contamination of the Earth's environment from materials + [that interfere with human health, the quality of life, or the natural functioning of ecosystems].
grammar.notes: interfere with 后接三个并列宾语。

grammar.title: 主语 + 定语从句 + 表语
grammar.skeleton: Biodegradable materials [that rapidly decompose by natural processes], [such as sewage], + are the less serious category.
grammar.notes: the less serious category 两者比较用比较级。

grammar.title: either... or + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: The nondegradable are materials + [that either, do not decompose, or pose a long term toxic threat], + and are in the category [that requires concerted remedial action].
grammar.notes: the + 形容词表一类事物。

vocab.root: con- (加强) + tamin- (接触) + -ation → 接触而弄脏 → 污染
inter- (之间) + fere (打击) → 在中间打 → 干扰/妨碍

vocab.meaning: 可以进行分解和还原处理的
vocab.root: bio- (生物) + de- (向下) + grade (等级) + -able → 可生物降解的
de- (分开) + compose (组成) → 分解

vocab.meaning: 不可以进行分解和还原处理的

vocab.root: con- (共同) + cert (确定) + -ed → 共同确定的 → 一致的
remedy (补救) + -al → 补救的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：二分法分类并比较严重程度
模板：There are two main categories of [X]. [Type A] that [feature A] are the less serious category. [Type B] are [X] that either [feature B1] or [feature B2], and are in the category that requires [action].
例句：There are two main categories of debt. Short-term loans that are repaid quickly are the less serious category. Long-term debts are obligations that either grow with interest or limit future choices, and are in the category that requires careful planning.

title: UNIT 164 · 污染的深远影响与治理成本
body: Because of the complex relationships among the many types of organisms and ecosystems, environmental contamination may have far-reaching consequences. These may not be immediately obvious and may also be difficult to predict. The depletion of the ozone layer is an instance where scientists can only speculate on some aspects of the potential impact. This ozone layer forms a protective atmospheric barrier, shielding the Earth from the Sun's ultraviolet rays. Another major factor related to pollution is the tremendous cost of clean-up and prevention. Efforts to control the combustion of coal, oil, wood, organic materials and other fossil fuels that produce emissions of carbon dioxide gas, are being waged on a very expensive global basis.
translation: 由于多种生物与生态系统之间存在复杂的关系，环境污染可能会产生深远的后果。这些后果可能不会立即显现，也可能难以预测。臭氧层损耗就是一个例子，科学家们对其潜在影响的某些方面只能进行推测。臭氧层构成了一道保护性的大气屏障，保护地球免受太阳紫外线的照射。与污染相关的另一个主要因素是巨大的清理和预防成本。在全球范围内，人们正花费巨资努力控制煤、石油、木材、有机物和其他会产生二氧化碳排放的化石燃料的燃烧。
insights: 【an instance where】原文：The depletion of the ozone layer is an instance where scientists can only speculate on...。翻译精雕：臭氧层损耗就是一个例子，科学家们对其……只能进行推测。技巧：where 从句修饰 instance（抽象“情形”），拆为后续分句。
【分词的功能化】原文：forms a protective atmospheric barrier, shielding the Earth from the Sun's ultraviolet rays。翻译精雕：构成了一道……屏障，保护地球免受……照射。技巧：shield A from B 译“保护 A 免受 B”。
【被动进行时的主动化】原文：Efforts to control... are being waged on a very expensive global basis。翻译精雕：在全球范围内，人们正花费巨资努力控制……。技巧：wage efforts / a campaign 表“开展”，被动进行时转为主动。

grammar.title: Because of + 主句
grammar.skeleton: Because of the complex relationships among the many types of organisms and ecosystems, + environmental contamination may have far-reaching consequences.
grammar.notes: among 用于三者以上。

grammar.title: where 定语从句（抽象）
grammar.skeleton: The depletion of the ozone layer is an instance + [where scientists can only speculate on some aspects of the potential impact].
grammar.notes: speculate on 表“对……推测”。

grammar.title: 长主语 + 现在进行时被动
grammar.skeleton: Efforts [to control the combustion of coal, ..., and other fossil fuels [that produce emissions of carbon dioxide gas]], + are being waged on a very expensive global basis.
grammar.notes: on a ... basis 表“以……方式/在……范围”。

vocab.root: specul- (观察，来自拉丁语 specula “瞭望台”) + -ate → 观察推测；投机
ultra- (超) + violet (紫色) → 紫外线
来自拉丁语 tremere “颤抖” → 令人发抖的 → 巨大的
de- (去除) + plet- (满) + -ion → 使不满 → 耗尽

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明影响复杂且难以预测
模板：Because of the complex relationships among [elements], [problem] may have far-reaching consequences. These may not be immediately obvious and may also be difficult to predict.
例句：Because of the complex relationships among global supply chains, a single factory closure may have far-reaching consequences. These may not be immediately obvious and may also be difficult to predict.

title: UNIT 165 · 环境不公
body: Research has shown that minority populations, and those with low-incomes, do not receive the same protection from environmental contamination as do communities in the higher-income bracket. Toxic waste incinerators, chemical plants, and solid waste dumps, are often located in areas where the lower-income communities lack organized and informed involvement in municipal decision-making.
translation: 研究表明，少数族裔群体和低收入人群受到的环境污染保护，与高收入社区并不相同。有毒废物焚化炉、化工厂和固体废物填埋场，往往建在那些低收入社区缺乏有组织、知情地参与市政决策的地区。
insights: 【the same... as do 倒装】原文：do not receive the same protection from environmental contamination as do communities in the higher-income bracket。翻译精雕：受到的环境污染保护，与高收入社区并不相同。技巧：as do + 主语 为比较中的倒装，翻译时还原比较对象。
【where 从句的处理】原文：are often located in areas where the lower-income communities lack organized and informed involvement in municipal decision-making。翻译精雕：往往建在那些低收入社区缺乏……参与市政决策的地区。技巧：where 从句前置为“……的地区”。
【背景补充】这一现象在社会学中被称为“环境正义”(environmental justice) 问题，是托福社会科学类文章的热门话题。

grammar.title: the same... as + 倒装
grammar.skeleton: Research has shown that minority populations, and those with low-incomes, + do not receive the same protection from environmental contamination + as do communities in the higher-income bracket.
grammar.notes: as do + 主语 避免主语过长时放在助动词前。

grammar.title: 被动 + where 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Toxic waste incinerators, chemical plants, and solid waste dumps, + are often located in areas + [where the lower-income communities lack organized and informed involvement in municipal decision-making].
grammar.notes: lack 为及物动词。

vocab.root: minor (较小的) + -ity → 少数；少数族裔
来自希腊语 toxikon “毒箭上的毒药” → 有毒的

vocab.meaning: 知情的，消息灵通的 (informed decision 明智的决定)

vocab.root: munici- (自治城市，来自拉丁语 municipium) + -al → 市政的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：引用研究揭示不平等
模板：Research has shown that [group A] do not receive the same [benefit] as do [group B].
例句：Research has shown that rural students do not receive the same access to advanced courses as do students in urban schools.

⚖️ 托福社会科学：Environmental Justice

指不同种族、收入群体在环境负担与环境保护上应享有平等待遇。研究发现，污染设施更多地集中在低收入和少数族裔社区，这被称为环境种族主义 (environmental racism)。

title: UNIT 166 · 城市烟雾
body: Urban air pollution is commonly known as smog. The dark London smog that Evelyn wrote of is generally a smoky mixture of carbon monoxide and organic compounds, related to fossil fuels. Coal often contains the impurity of sulfur dioxide and this is released from incomplete combustion. As the smog ages, it reacts with oxygen and sulfuric acids may condense as droplets, thus increasing the haze.
translation: 城市空气污染通常被称为烟雾。伊夫林笔下那种昏暗的伦敦烟雾，一般是一氧化碳和有机化合物的烟雾混合物，与化石燃料有关。煤炭中常含有二氧化硫杂质，在不完全燃烧时被释放出来。随着烟雾“老化”，它会与氧气发生反应，硫酸可能凝结成小液滴，从而使霾加重。
insights: 【be known as】原文：Urban air pollution is commonly known as smog。翻译精雕：城市空气污染通常被称为烟雾。技巧：smog = smoke + fog 的合成词。
【文化背景】原文：The dark London smog that Evelyn wrote of。翻译精雕：伊夫林笔下那种昏暗的伦敦烟雾。技巧：Evelyn 指 17 世纪英国作家 John Evelyn，他在 1661 年的《驱逐烟气》(Fumifugium) 中描写了伦敦的煤烟污染。
【熟词僻义】原文：As the smog ages。翻译精雕：随着烟雾“老化”。技巧：age 作动词意为“老化、陈化”。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + 过去分词
grammar.skeleton: The dark London smog [that Evelyn wrote of] + is generally a smoky mixture of carbon monoxide and organic compounds, + [related to fossil fuels].
grammar.notes: write of = write about。

grammar.title: As 从句 + thus doing
grammar.skeleton: As the smog ages, + it reacts with oxygen and sulfuric acids may condense as droplets, + thus increasing the haze.
grammar.notes: thus increasing 表结果。

vocab.root: smoke + fog → 烟雾 (混成词 blend)
im- (不) + pure (纯的) + -ity → 杂质
熟词僻义：age v. 老化、陈化
mono- (单一) + oxide → 一氧化物

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述污染物的化学演变
模板：As [pollutant] ages, it reacts with [substance] and [product] may [form], thus increasing [harm].
例句：As plastic waste ages, it reacts with sunlight and microplastics may break off, thus increasing ocean contamination.

🔤 托福词汇：混成词 (Blends)

smog = smoke + fog；brunch = breakfast + lunch；motel = motor + hotel；smartphone 等。识别混成词有助于快速理解新词。

title: UNIT 167 · 淡水需求与水污染
body: As the world's population grows, so does the demand for fresh water. From 1940 to 1990, withdrawals of fresh water from rivers, lakes, reservoirs, and other sources increased fourfold. Water pollution is caused from a variety of sources, such as sewage, industrial waste, agricultural chemicals, fertilizers and pesticides. When the topsoil is worn away by erosion from wind and rain, it also contributes to pollution of natural water resources. Soil and silt washed from logged hillsides, plowed fields, and construction sites, can clog waterways and kill aquatic vegetation. Even small amounts of silt can eliminate desirable fish species.
translation: 随着世界人口的增长，对淡水的需求也在增长。从 1940 年到 1990 年，从河流、湖泊、水库和其他水源中抽取的淡水量增长了四倍。水污染的来源多种多样，如污水、工业废物、农用化学品、化肥和杀虫剂。当表土因风雨侵蚀而流失时，也会造成天然水资源的污染。从伐木后的山坡、犁过的田地和建筑工地上冲刷下来的土壤和淤泥，会堵塞水道，杀死水生植物。即使少量的淤泥也可能使理想的鱼类物种消失。
insights: 【so does 倒装】原文：As the world's population grows, so does the demand for fresh water。翻译精雕：随着世界人口的增长，对淡水的需求也在增长。技巧：As..., so does... 译“随着……，……也……”。
【fourfold 的译法】原文：increased fourfold。翻译精雕：增长了四倍（即变为原来的四倍）。技巧：中文“增长了四倍”有歧义，严格应译“增至四倍”。
【原书释义更正】logged hillsides 原书释为“低湿的土地”，在此语境应为“被砍伐过树木的山坡”。

grammar.title: As + so does 倒装
grammar.skeleton: As the world's population grows, + so does the demand for fresh water.
grammar.notes: so + 助动词 + 主语 表“……也一样”。

grammar.title: be caused from (by)
grammar.skeleton: Water pollution is caused from (by) a variety of sources, + such as sewage, industrial waste, agricultural chemicals, fertilizers and pesticides.
grammar.notes: 规范搭配为 be caused by。

grammar.title: 过去分词定语 + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: Soil and silt [washed from logged hillsides, plowed fields, and construction sites], + can [clog waterways] and [kill aquatic vegetation].
grammar.notes: washed from 修饰 soil and silt。

vocab.root: reserve (储存) + -oir (场所) → 水库/储藏
pest (害虫) + -cide (杀) → 杀虫剂

vocab.meaning: 伐木过的（logged hillsides 被砍伐过的山坡）

vocab.root: e- (出) + limin- (门槛) + -ate → 赶出门槛 → 消除
veget- (生长) + -ation → 植被

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述需求随人口增长
模板：As [driver] grows, so does the demand for [resource]. From [year 1] to [year 2], [consumption] increased [multiple].
例句：As urban populations grow, so does the demand for public transportation. From 2000 to 2020, metro ridership in major cities increased threefold.

title: UNIT 168 · 土壤退化
body: Soil quality can be seriously degraded as a result of poor management techniques that cause pollution and enhance erosion. The use of chemical fertilizers, pesticides, and fungicides to improve crop production, is counterbalanced by their interference with the natural soil processes. This can result in the destruction of useful microorganisms, such as bacteria and fungi. Improper irrigation practices in areas with poor drainage may result in salt deposits that inhibit plant growth and even lead to crop failure.
translation: 不良的管理技术会导致污染并加剧侵蚀，从而使土壤质量严重退化。为提高作物产量而使用化肥、杀虫剂和杀菌剂，其好处会被它们对土壤自然过程的干扰所抵消。这可能导致细菌和真菌等有益微生物遭到破坏。在排水不良的地区，不当的灌溉方式可能导致盐分沉积，抑制植物生长，甚至导致作物歉收。
insights: 【as a result of 的因果重组】原文：Soil quality can be seriously degraded as a result of poor management techniques that cause pollution and enhance erosion。翻译精雕：不良的管理技术会导致污染并加剧侵蚀，从而使土壤质量严重退化。技巧：把原因前置，结果后置，用“从而”连接。

【be counterbalanced by】原文：The use of chemical fertilizers... is counterbalanced by their interference with the natural soil processes。翻译精雕：……其好处会被它们对土壤自然过程的干扰所抵消。技巧：counterbalance 意为“抵消”，补出“其好处”使逻辑完整。

grammar.title: 被动 + as a result of + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: Soil quality can be seriously degraded + as a result of poor management techniques + [that cause pollution and enhance erosion].
grammar.notes: as a result of = because of。

grammar.title: 动名词主语 + 被动
grammar.skeleton: The use of chemical fertilizers, pesticides, and fungicides [to improve crop production], + is counterbalanced by + their interference with the natural soil processes.
grammar.notes: 中心词 use 为单数。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: Improper irrigation practices in areas with poor drainage may result in salt deposits + [that inhibit plant growth and even lead to crop failure].
grammar.notes: inhibit 与 lead to 并列。

vocab.root: de- (向下) + grade (等级) → 降级 → 退化/降低
fungi (真菌) + -cide (杀) → 杀真菌剂
ir- (进入) + rig- (浇水，来自拉丁语 rigare) + -ation → 灌溉
熟词僻义：practice n. 做法、惯例 (farming practices 耕作方式)
in- (向内) + hibit (持有) → 抑制
counter- (相反) + balance (平衡) → 抵消

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明某做法的利弊相抵
模板：The use of [method] to [benefit] is counterbalanced by [its negative effect]. This can result in [damage].
例句：The use of social media to stay connected is counterbalanced by its interference with real-life relationships. This can result in increased loneliness.

title: UNIT 169 · 固体废物处理
body: Discarded paper, plastics, synthetic materials, metals and wood, are normally described as solid waste garbage. Billions of tons are thrown out annually and dumped in areas called landfills. This is the cheapest and most common disposal method for solid wastes, but landfills can start to contaminate the air, soil and ground water, if they become overfilled and poorly managed. When waste is burnt in an incinerator, the volume of residual solids is greatly reduced. While this method may produce some airborne particles, the dense ashen waste that remains can contain dangerous concentrations of hazardous compounds, which then needs to be properly handled.
translation: 废弃的纸张、塑料、合成材料、金属和木材通常被称为固体废弃垃圾。每年有数十亿吨垃圾被丢弃，并倾倒在被称为垃圾填埋场的地方。这是处理固体废物最便宜、最常见的方法，但如果填埋场过满且管理不善，就会开始污染空气、土壤和地下水。当垃圾在焚化炉中焚烧时，残余固体的体积会大大减少。虽然这种方法可能会产生一些空气中的颗粒物，但剩下的浓密灰烬中可能含有高浓度的有害化合物，因此需要妥善处理。
insights: 【but 的条件转折】原文：This is the cheapest and most common disposal method..., but landfills can start to contaminate..., if they become overfilled...。翻译精雕：这是……最便宜、最常见的方法，但如果填埋场过满……，就会开始污染……。技巧：if 条件前移到转折句内。
【While 让步】原文：While this method may produce some airborne particles, the dense ashen waste... can contain...。翻译精雕：虽然这种方法可能会产生……，但剩下的……可能含有……。技巧：while 表让步“虽然”。

grammar.title: 被动 + 并列谓语 + called
grammar.skeleton: Billions of tons [are thrown out annually] and [dumped in areas [called landfills]].
grammar.notes: dumped 前省略 are。

grammar.title: but + if 条件
grammar.skeleton: landfills can start to contaminate the air, soil and ground water, + if they become overfilled and poorly managed.
grammar.notes: start to do 表“开始……”。

grammar.title: While 让步 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: While this method may produce some airborne particles, + the dense ashen waste [that remains] can contain dangerous concentrations of hazardous compounds, + [which then need(s) to be properly handled].
grammar.notes: which 指代 waste 或 compounds。

vocab.root: syn- (共同) + thet- (放置) + -ic → 放在一起的 → 合成的/人造的
disposal: dispose (处理) + -al → 处置
re- (回) + sid- (坐) + -ual → 留下来坐着的 → 残余的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：权衡某方法的利弊
模板：[Method] is the cheapest and most common [solution], but [risk] if [condition]. While [alternative] may [minor drawback], [major drawback], which then needs to be properly handled.
例句：Fossil fuel power is the cheapest and most common energy source, but it can harm public health if emissions are poorly controlled. While nuclear power may produce little air pollution, the spent fuel can remain dangerous for centuries, which then needs to be properly stored.

title: UNIT 170 · 噪声污染
body: Noise is considered a form of pollution, especially when it is loud, and excessive, as produced by aeroplanes, traffic, and some industrial machinery. Noise pollution can cause hearing loss, stress, high blood pressure, sleep loss, distraction, and productivity loss. Measured in decibels, noise intensity ranges from zero, the quietest sound the human ear can detect, to over 160 decibels, but noise pollution is often at its worst in densely populated areas.
translation: 噪声被视为一种污染形式，尤其是当它响亮且过度时，比如由飞机、交通和某些工业机械产生的噪声。噪声污染会导致听力损失、压力、高血压、失眠、注意力分散和生产力下降。噪声强度以分贝为单位，从人耳能察觉到的最轻微声音——零分贝，到超过 160 分贝不等，而在人口稠密的地区，噪声污染往往最为严重。
insights: 【as produced by 的处理】原文：especially when it is loud, and excessive, as produced by aeroplanes...。翻译精雕：尤其是当它响亮且过度时，比如由飞机……产生的噪声。技巧：as produced by 表举例，译为“比如由……产生的”。
【分词状语前置】原文：Measured in decibels, noise intensity ranges from zero... to over 160 decibels。翻译精雕：噪声强度以分贝为单位，从……到……不等。技巧：过去分词短语译为独立的说明。
【at its worst】原文：noise pollution is often at its worst in densely populated areas。翻译精雕：在人口稠密的地区，噪声污染往往最为严重。技巧：at its worst 译“最严重”。

grammar.title: be considered + when + as
grammar.skeleton: Noise is considered a form of pollution, + especially when it is loud, and excessive, + as (it is) produced by aeroplanes, traffic, and some industrial machinery.
grammar.notes: as 后省略 it is。

grammar.title: 过去分词状语 + range from... to
grammar.skeleton: Measured in decibels, + noise intensity ranges from zero, [the quietest sound the human ear can detect], to over 160 decibels.
grammar.notes: 同位语解释 zero。

vocab.meaning: 使人分心的事，心乱，心烦
vocab.root: dis- (分开) + tract (拉) + -ion → 把注意力拉开 → 分心
deci- (十分之一) + bel (以贝尔命名) → 分贝

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：列举某问题的多种危害
模板：[Problem] can cause [harm A], [harm B], [harm C], and [harm D].
例句：Long working hours can cause burnout, poor sleep, weakened immunity, and lower productivity.

title: UNIT 171 · 美国西部边疆的开拓者
body: The American frontier offered sparsely populated land to the early settlers who were prepared to move and live there, and stake a claim. The harsh frontier life demanded self-reliance of the settlers, but they often called on the government for help to improving the new region. They asked for help to build roads, recommend crops, run surveys, certify claims, and dredged creeks. The federal government was also asked to provide protection from the Native Americans, who were often hostile to settlers moving onto their traditional lands.
translation: 美国边疆为那些愿意迁居到那里生活并申领土地的早期移民，提供了人烟稀少的土地。艰苦的边疆生活要求移民们自力更生，但他们也常常请求政府帮助开发这片新的地区。他们请求政府协助修建道路、推荐作物、进行勘测、认证土地申领以及疏浚小溪。联邦政府还被要求提供保护，以免受印第安原住民的袭击，因为印第安人常常敌视迁入其传统领地的移民。
insights: 【stake a claim】原文：who were prepared to move and live there, and stake a claim。翻译精雕：愿意迁居到那里生活并申领土地的……。技巧：stake a claim 是美国西部开拓史术语，指“立桩标界、申领土地所有权”。
【demand... of】原文：The harsh frontier life demanded self-reliance of the settlers。翻译精雕：艰苦的边疆生活要求移民们自力更生。技巧：demand sth. of sb. 译“要求某人……”。
【call on sb. for help】原文：they often called on the government for help to improving the new region。翻译精雕：他们也常常请求政府帮助开发这片新的地区。技巧：call on sb. for sth. 译“请求某人提供……”。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + 并列不定式
grammar.skeleton: The American frontier offered sparsely populated land to the early settlers + [who were prepared to [move and live there], and [stake a claim]].
grammar.notes: be prepared to do 表“愿意/准备做”。

grammar.title: but + call on sb. for
grammar.skeleton: The harsh frontier life demanded self-reliance of the settlers, + but they often called on the government for help to improving (improve) the new region.
grammar.notes: 原文 help to improving 有误，应为 help in improving 或 help to improve。

grammar.title: 非限制性定语从句 + be hostile to
grammar.skeleton: The federal government was also asked to provide protection from the Native Americans, + [who were often hostile to settlers [moving onto their traditional lands]].
grammar.notes: moving onto 现在分词修饰 settlers。

vocab.root: front (前面) + -ier → 前线 → 边疆/前沿 (the frontiers of science)

vocab.meaning: 进行勘测（原文 run surveys）

vocab.root: cert- (确定) + -ify → 证明/认证

vocab.meaning: 用挖掘机清除、加深或加宽
敌对的（be hostile to： 对…… 有敌意）
立桩申领（土地）；声称拥有

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述“自力更生”与“寻求外援”的张力
模板：The harsh [conditions] demanded [quality] of [group], but they often called on [authority] for help to [goal].
例句：The harsh startup environment demanded resilience of the founders, but they often called on investors for help to expand into new markets.

🤠 托福美国史：The Frontier

“边疆”是托福美国历史的高频话题。历史学家 Frederick Jackson Turner 在 1893 年提出“边疆假说”(Frontier Thesis)，认为西部开拓塑造了美国人的个人主义和民主精神。

title: UNIT 172 · 边疆生活的工具
body: On the frontier, tools varied with time, place and occupation. In agriculture, settlers depended on the plow, but if they turned to ranching, they needed rope to make a lariat, a branding iron, and a pair of pliers. If they took up mining, they carried a pickax, a screen and a skillet.
translation: 在边疆，工具因时间、地点和职业的不同而各异。在农业中，移民们依赖犁；但如果他们转而经营牧场，就需要用来做套索的绳子、烙印用的烙铁和一把钳子。如果他们从事采矿，就会带上鹤嘴镐、筛子和煎锅。
insights: 【vary with】原文：tools varied with time, place and occupation。翻译精雕：工具因时间、地点和职业的不同而各异。技巧：vary with 译“随……而变化/因……而异”。
【turn to / take up】原文：if they turned to ranching... If they took up mining...。翻译精雕：如果他们转而经营牧场……如果他们从事采矿……。技巧：turn to 表“转向”，take up 表“开始从事”。
【skillet 的用途】采矿者带煎锅不仅用于做饭，也常用于淘金 (panning for gold)。

grammar.title: vary with
grammar.skeleton: On the frontier, + tools varied with time, place and occupation.
grammar.notes: vary with = change according to。

grammar.title: but if + 条件 + 不定式定语
grammar.skeleton: In agriculture, settlers depended on the plow, + but if they turned to ranching, + they needed [rope to make a lariat], [a branding iron], and [a pair of pliers].
grammar.notes: to make a lariat 修饰 rope。

vocab.root: brand 本义“烙印”→ 引申“品牌”
熟词僻义：screen n. 筛子；v. 筛选、审查 (screen candidates)

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明不同情境下的不同需求
模板：In [context A], [people] depended on [tool A], but if they turned to [context B], they needed [tools B]. If they took up [context C], they carried [tools C].
例句：In traditional offices, workers depended on desktop computers, but if they turned to remote work, they needed laptops and stable internet. If they took up fieldwork, they carried tablets and portable chargers.

title: UNIT 173 · 走出森林：斧头与木屋
body: It wasn't until the second half of the 19th century that the frontier settlers were able to move beyond the forests. They first had to cut down trees and clear space to build a log cabin, and in time, to clear larger areas for growing crops. The single-bladed axe was the most important and most widely used tool, necessary for cutting down the trees during this initial stage of settlement. The forest provided their firewood and the timber to build their log cabins. During the first 200 years of the American frontier, some settlers used primitive versions of saws which were gradually improved as progress was achieved.
translation: 直到 19 世纪后半叶，边疆移民才得以越过森林向外迁移。他们首先必须砍伐树木、清理出空地来建造小木屋，并最终清理出更大的区域来种植庄稼。单刃斧是最重要、使用最广泛的工具，在定居的最初阶段，它是砍伐树木必不可少的工具。森林为他们提供了柴火和建造木屋的木材。在美国边疆的头 200 年里，一些移民使用的是原始的锯子，这些锯子随着技术的进步而逐步得到改进。
insights: 【It wasn't until... that】原文：It wasn't until the second half of the 19th century that the frontier settlers were able to move beyond the forests。翻译精雕：直到 19 世纪后半叶，边疆移民才得以越过森林向外迁移。技巧：固定译为“直到……才……”。
【in time 的译法】原文：and in time, to clear larger areas for growing crops。翻译精雕：并最终清理出更大的区域来种植庄稼。技巧：in time 在此为“最终、迟早”，不是“及时”。
【形容词短语后置】原文：the most important and most widely used tool, necessary for cutting down the trees。翻译精雕：最重要、使用最广泛的工具，……它是砍伐树木必不可少的工具。技巧：necessary for 形容词短语拆为独立分句。

grammar.title: It was not until... that 强调句
grammar.skeleton: It wasn't until the second half of the 19th century + that the frontier settlers were able to move beyond the forests.
grammar.notes: 强调时间状语。

grammar.title: first had to + 并列不定式
grammar.skeleton: They first had to [cut down trees and clear space to build a log cabin], and in time, [to clear larger areas for growing crops].
grammar.notes: in time 插入，表“最终”。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + as 时间/原因
grammar.skeleton: some settlers used primitive versions of saws + [which were gradually improved as progress was achieved].
grammar.notes: as 表“随着”。

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述发展的阶段顺序
模板：They first had to [initial task] to [immediate goal], and in time, to [later task] for [long-term goal].
例句：New immigrants first had to learn the language to find basic jobs, and in time, to earn professional qualifications for better careers.

title: UNIT 174 · 边疆木屋的建造
body: Frontier houses were built in various sizes and shapes, designed to provide the degree of comfort compatible to the settlers' ability and means. Although logs were hewn from whichever trees were available, oak and pine were favoured for building the cabins. Some settlers used split logs for floors and a bark thatch to cover the roof, or if suitable material was available, they might use shingles on the roof. The fireplace and chimney was daubed with mud, which was also used to fill the holes in the walls of the cabin. As the mud dried, it could be smoothed and provide a surface, suitable to be whitewashed.
translation: 边疆的房屋大小和形状各异，其设计旨在提供与移民的能力和财力相称的舒适程度。虽然原木取自当地能找到的任何树木，但人们建造木屋时更偏爱橡木和松木。有些移民用劈开的原木做地板，用树皮茅草覆盖屋顶；如果有合适的材料，他们也可能在屋顶上铺木瓦。壁炉和烟囱用泥巴涂抹，泥巴也被用来填补木屋墙上的孔洞。泥巴干燥后可以被抹平，形成一个适合刷白灰的表面。
insights: 【compatible to 的译法】原文：designed to provide the degree of comfort compatible to the settlers' ability and means。翻译精雕：其设计旨在提供与移民的能力和财力相称的舒适程度。技巧：compatible with/to 译“与……相称/相容”；means 在此为“财力”。
【whichever 的让步】原文：Although logs were hewn from whichever trees were available。翻译精雕：虽然原木取自当地能找到的任何树木。技巧：whichever 译“无论哪种/任何”。
【熟词僻义】原文：hewn / daub / whitewash。翻译精雕：砍凿 / 涂抹 / 刷白灰。技巧：whitewash 另有引申义“粉饰、掩盖（丑闻）”。

grammar.title: 过去分词 + 不定式 + 形容词短语后置
grammar.skeleton: Frontier houses were built in various sizes and shapes, + [designed to provide the degree of comfort [compatible to the settlers' ability and means]].
grammar.notes: compatible to 修饰 comfort。

grammar.title: Although 让步 + whichever
grammar.skeleton: Although logs were hewn from [whichever trees were available], + oak and pine were favoured for building the cabins.
grammar.notes: whichever 引导名词性从句作 from 的宾语。

grammar.title: 主谓一致：A and B
grammar.skeleton: The fireplace and chimney was daubed with mud, + [which was also used to fill the holes in the walls of the cabin].
grammar.notes: A and B 视为一个整体时谓语可用单数。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：bark n. 树皮 (≠ 狗叫)
引申：whitewash 粉饰、掩盖 (whitewash a scandal)
com- (共同) + pat- (忍受) + -ible → 能共同承受的 → 相容的
熟词僻义：means 财力 (live within one's means 量入为出)

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明设计与条件相匹配
模板：[Things] were built in various [forms], designed to provide the degree of [quality] compatible to [users]' ability and means.
例句：Public housing units were built in various sizes, designed to provide the degree of comfort compatible to residents' income and needs.

title: UNIT 175 · 边疆的社交生活
body: The principle amusement for people on the frontier was visiting neighbours. The visit to a tavern, or the family's attendance at a church revival service, provided entertaining recollections through the long, cold, evenings of winter. The loneliness of the frontier increased the yearning for other faces and social contact. The building of a log cabin could be a great social event for any neighbours who lived close enough. On these occasions, the women would bake for days, game would be killed and salted and, unless the religion of the frontier community forbade it, ample rum and whiskey would be provided. These gatherings offered a party atmosphere and could last for several days, until the work was completed.
translation: 边疆居民的主要娱乐是拜访邻居。去一趟酒馆，或全家参加一场教会的奋兴布道会，都能为漫长寒冷的冬夜提供有趣的回忆。边疆的孤寂加深了人们对见到他人面孔和社交接触的渴望。对于住得足够近的邻居来说，建造一座小木屋可能是一件盛大的社交活动。在这种场合，妇女们会一连烘焙好几天，男人们会猎杀野味并用盐腌制；除非当地社区的宗教禁止，否则还会提供充足的朗姆酒和威士忌。这些聚会充满了派对气氛，可能会持续好几天，直到工作完成为止。
insights: 【原文拼写】principle amusement 应为 principal amusement（主要的娱乐），原文误用。
【熟词僻义】原文：game would be killed and salted。翻译精雕：男人们会猎杀野味并用盐腌制。技巧：game 在此为“猎物/野味”，不是“游戏”。
【抽象主语的转换】原文：The loneliness of the frontier increased the yearning for other faces and social contact。翻译精雕：边疆的孤寂加深了人们对见到他人面孔和社交接触的渴望。技巧：yearning for other faces 意译为“对见到他人面孔的渴望”。
【unless 插入】原文：unless the religion of the frontier community forbade it, ample rum and whiskey would be provided。翻译精雕：除非当地社区的宗教禁止，否则还会提供充足的……。技巧：unless... 译“除非……否则……”。

grammar.title: 主系表
grammar.skeleton: The principal amusement for people on the frontier + was + visiting neighbours.
grammar.notes: 动名词作表语。

grammar.title: 复合主语 + provide
grammar.skeleton: [The visit to a tavern], or [the family's attendance at a church revival service], + provided entertaining recollections + through the long, cold, evenings of winter.
grammar.notes: or 连接的主语，谓语就近一致。

grammar.title: would 表过去习惯 + unless
grammar.skeleton: On these occasions, the women would bake for days, game would be killed and salted and, + [unless the religion of the frontier community forbade it], + ample rum and whiskey would be provided.
grammar.notes: would 表示过去的习惯性动作。

vocab.meaning: 奋兴大会（尤指旨在促进基督教信仰的布道会）
vocab.root: re- (再) + viv- (生命) + -al → 复兴；宗教奋兴会
熟词僻义：game n. 猎物、野味 (big game 大型猎物)
re- (再) + collect (收集) + -ion → 重新收集 → 回忆

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述孤立环境下社交需求的增强
模板：The [isolation] of [setting] increased the yearning for [social need]. [Event] could be a great social event for anyone who [condition].
例句：The isolation of remote work increased the yearning for face-to-face contact. A team offsite could be a great social event for anyone who lived close enough.

title: UNIT 176 · 东北部印第安人的狩猎
body: The Northeast Indians hunted a variety of game, large and small: deer, rabbit, squirrel, beaver, and various birds, such as turkey, partridge, duck, and geese. They also hunted moose, elk, and bear. Tribes of the Mississippi River Valley hunted the North American bison, or buffalo, that roamed across the vast prairies. Apart from hunting with spears, bows and arrows, and clubs, the Indians used traps and snares. The deadfall was a particularly effective design of trap, which used the weight of heavy objects and logs that fell on the prey, disabling it, or killing it outright. Another ruse was the use of disguises to get close to animals, or imitating animal calls to lure their prey. Setting well places fires was another hunting technique used to drive animals toward the hunters or traps.
translation: 东北部的印第安人猎捕各种大大小小的猎物：鹿、兔子、松鼠、河狸，以及火鸡、山鹑、鸭子和鹅等各种鸟类。他们也猎捕驼鹿、马鹿和熊。密西西比河流域的部落猎捕在广阔草原上游荡的北美野牛。除了用长矛、弓箭和棍棒狩猎外，印第安人还使用陷阱和套索。压木陷阱是一种特别有效的陷阱设计，它利用重物和原木的重量砸在猎物身上，使其丧失行动能力或当场毙命。另一种策略是通过伪装接近动物，或模仿动物的叫声来引诱猎物。在合适的位置放火，是将动物驱赶向猎人或陷阱的另一种狩猎技巧。
insights: 【冒号列举 + 分类】原文：hunted a variety of game, large and small: deer, rabbit...。翻译精雕：猎捕各种大大小小的猎物：……。技巧：large and small 后置修饰 game，译为“大大小小的”。
【Apart from 的译法】原文：Apart from hunting with spears..., the Indians used traps and snares。翻译精雕：除了用长矛……狩猎外，印第安人还使用陷阱和套索。技巧：apart from 在此为“除……之外还”(= besides)。
【分词结果】原文：logs that fell on the prey, disabling it, or killing it outright。翻译精雕：……砸在猎物身上，使其丧失行动能力或当场毙命。技巧：outright 译“当场、彻底”。
【原文拼写】well places fires 应为 well-placed fires（位置恰当的火）。

grammar.title: 冒号 + 同位列举
grammar.skeleton: The Northeast Indians hunted a variety of game, large and small: + deer, rabbit, squirrel, beaver, and various birds, such as turkey, partridge, duck, and geese.
grammar.notes: 冒号后的列举解释 game。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + 分词结果
grammar.skeleton: The deadfall was a particularly effective design of trap, + [which used the weight of heavy objects and logs [that fell on the prey]], + disabling it, or killing it outright.
grammar.notes: disabling / killing 现在分词表结果。

grammar.title: 动名词短语作主语
grammar.skeleton: [Setting well-placed fires] + was another hunting technique + [used to drive animals toward the hunters or traps].
grammar.notes: used to drive 过去分词修饰 technique。

vocab.root: 来自法语 prairie “草地” → 北美大草原
熟词僻义：club n. 棍棒
dis- (去除) + guise (外表) → 改变外表 → 伪装

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：列举多种策略
模板：Apart from [main method], [group] used [method B]. Another ruse was [method C], or [method D]. [Method E] was another technique used to [goal].
例句：Apart from TV advertising, the company used social media campaigns. Another tactic was hosting free workshops, or partnering with influencers. Offering referral discounts was another technique used to attract new customers.

title: UNIT 177 · 东北部印第安人的采集与渔猎
body: The Northeast Indians supplemented their diet by catching fish in the rivers, streams, lakes and ponds, through the use of harpoons, hooks, nets and traps. Peoples living along the Atlantic Coast depended on shellfish for part of their diet. Berries, nuts, roots, stalks and leaves from wild plants, were also an important source of food. A tall grass with an edible grain was a type of wild rice, which was collected by some tribes along the western Great Lakes, and used as food. Early spring in the maple country, provided the local people with a sap from the trees, which they boiled and converted to maple syrup and sugar.
translation: 东北部印第安人利用鱼叉、鱼钩、渔网和捕鱼笼，在河流、溪流、湖泊和池塘中捕鱼，以补充他们的饮食。生活在大西洋沿岸的族群依靠贝类作为部分食物来源。野生植物的浆果、坚果、根、茎和叶也是重要的食物来源。有一种长着可食用谷粒的高草是一种野生稻，五大湖西部沿岸的一些部落会采集它作为食物。在枫树生长的地区，早春时节，树木会为当地人提供树液，他们把树液熬煮，制成枫糖浆和枫糖。
insights: 【through the use of】原文：supplemented their diet by catching fish..., through the use of harpoons, hooks, nets and traps。翻译精雕：利用鱼叉、鱼钩……捕鱼，以补充他们的饮食。技巧：把工具与方式前置，目的“补充饮食”后置。
【被动转主动 + 定语从句】原文：a type of wild rice, which was collected by some tribes... and used as food。翻译精雕：一种野生稻，……一些部落会采集它作为食物。技巧：被动转为主动，主语换为“部落”。
【无灵主语】原文：Early spring in the maple country, provided the local people with a sap from the trees。翻译精雕：在枫树生长的地区，早春时节，树木会为当地人提供树液。技巧：时间作主语的无灵句，中文改为时间状语 + 有灵主语。

grammar.title: by doing + through the use of
grammar.skeleton: The Northeast Indians supplemented their diet + by catching fish in the rivers, streams, lakes and ponds, + through the use of harpoons, hooks, nets and traps.
grammar.notes: by 表方式，through the use of 表工具。

grammar.title: 现在分词定语 + depend on
grammar.skeleton: Peoples [living along the Atlantic Coast] + depended on shellfish for part of their diet.
grammar.notes: peoples 复数表“多个民族”。

grammar.title: provide sb. with sth. + which 从句
grammar.skeleton: Early spring in the maple country, provided the local people with a sap from the trees, + [which they boiled and converted to maple syrup and sugar].
grammar.notes: which 作 boiled 和 converted 的宾语。

vocab.meaning: 枫糖浆：由糖枫汁液做成的甜糖浆

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述多元化的资源来源
模板：[Group] supplemented their [main resource] by [method], through the use of [tools]. [Resource B] was also an important source of [X].
例句：Small farmers supplemented their income by selling crafts, through the use of online marketplaces. Tourism was also an important source of cash.

title: UNIT 178 · 易洛魁人的“三姐妹”农业
body: Most of the Northeast Indian tribes supplemented a hunting-gathering diet with farming. Maize, beans, and squash were the three most important crops of the Iroquois people, who used the corn stalks to support the vines of bean plants, and the large-leafed squash plants to block weed growth. As the Pilgrims, and other early settlers, encroached onto the homelands of the Algonquian tribe, they were introduced to the cultivated crops. The new intruders were also shown many of the local wild foods, including maple sugar, cranberries, blueberries, lobsters, clams and oysters.
translation: 东北部的大多数印第安部落在狩猎采集的饮食之外还从事农耕。玉米、豆类和南瓜是易洛魁人最重要的三种作物：他们用玉米秆支撑豆类植物的藤蔓，用叶片宽大的南瓜植株抑制杂草生长。当清教徒移民和其他早期定居者侵入阿尔贡金部落的家园时，他们认识了这些栽培作物。这些新来的入侵者还见识了许多当地的野生食物，包括枫糖、蔓越莓、蓝莓、龙虾、蛤蜊和牡蛎。
insights: 【supplement A with B】原文：supplemented a hunting-gathering diet with farming。翻译精雕：在狩猎采集的饮食之外还从事农耕。技巧：supplement A with B 译“在 A 之外补充 B”。
【非限制性从句的冒号化】原文：..., who used the corn stalks to support the vines of bean plants, and the large-leafed squash plants to block weed growth。翻译精雕：……：他们用玉米秆支撑……，用……南瓜植株抑制杂草生长。技巧：从句解释种植方法，用冒号引出。
【立场性用词】原文：encroached onto / The new intruders。翻译精雕：侵入 / 新来的入侵者。技巧：encroach 与 intruder 带有贬义，体现作者站在原住民视角，翻译时应保留这种态度色彩。

grammar.title: 非限制性定语从句 + 省略
grammar.skeleton: Maize, beans, and squash were the three most important crops of the Iroquois people, + [who used [the corn stalks] to support the vines of bean plants, and [the large-leafed squash plants] to block weed growth].
grammar.notes: 后半句省略 used，形成平行结构。

grammar.title: As 时间从句 + 被动
grammar.skeleton: As the Pilgrims, and other early settlers, encroached onto the homelands of the Algonquian tribe, + they were introduced to the cultivated crops.
grammar.notes: be introduced to 表“被介绍认识”。

vocab.meaning: 易洛魁族人（北美印第安人的一个民族）

vocab.root: 另义：squash v. 压扁

vocab.meaning: 阿尔贡金族人（北美印第安人的一个民族）
移民者：1620 年，在新英格兰建立普利茅斯殖民地的英国主张脱离国教者

vocab.root: cult- (耕种，来自拉丁语 colere) + -ivate → 耕种；培养
en- (使) + croach (钩子，来自古法语 croc) → 用钩子钩走 → 侵占
in- (进入) + trude (推) + -er → 闯入者

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明互补协作的系统
模板：[A], [B], and [C] were the three most important [elements], who used [A] to [function], and [C] to [function].
例句：Design, engineering, and marketing were the three most important teams of the company, which used design to shape the product, and marketing to reach customers.

🌽 托福美国史：Three Sisters

易洛魁人的“三姐妹”(Three Sisters) 种植法：玉米为豆类提供攀爬支架；豆类固氮，滋养土壤；南瓜宽大的叶子遮荫保湿、抑制杂草。这是典型的间作 (intercropping) 与互利关系。

title: UNIT 179 · 母系社会与父系社会
body: The family played an important role in the society of the Northeast Indians. A cluster of related families, claiming a common ancestor, was the basis for clans that developed in many of these tribes. The Iroquois was a matrilineal society, where the property and descent passed through the female heritage. Each of these clans was headed by a woman elder, known as the ‘clan mother’. She held great political power and was deemed to own the crops, and communal dwellings. The tribal chief was generally an elected male who retained the right to veto actions they opposed, and had to approve declarations of war. The Algonquian tribes used the opposite system to the Iroquois, by adopting a patrilineal society, where the descent and property were traced through the male line.
translation: 家庭在东北部印第安人的社会中扮演着重要角色。由一群自称拥有共同祖先的亲属家庭组成的群体，构成了许多部落中氏族的基础。易洛魁社会是母系社会，财产和血统通过女性世系传承。每个氏族都由一位女性长老领导，她被称为“氏族母亲”。她拥有巨大的政治权力，并被视为作物和公共住所的所有者。部落首领一般是选举产生的男性，他保留否决其反对的行动的权利，并且必须批准宣战。阿尔贡金部落则采用与易洛魁人相反的制度，实行父系社会，血统和财产通过男性世系来追溯。
insights: 【分词插入的处理】原文：A cluster of related families, claiming a common ancestor, was the basis for clans。翻译精雕：由一群自称拥有共同祖先的亲属家庭组成的群体，构成了……氏族的基础。技巧：claiming 现在分词前置为定语“自称……的”。
【where 从句】原文：a matrilineal society, where the property and descent passed through the female heritage。翻译精雕：母系社会，财产和血统通过女性世系传承。技巧：where 从句直接拆为后续分句。
【be deemed to】原文：was deemed to own the crops, and communal dwellings。翻译精雕：被视为作物和公共住所的所有者。技巧：be deemed to do 译“被视为……”。

grammar.title: 主语 + 分词插入 + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: A cluster of related families, [claiming a common ancestor], + was the basis for clans + [that developed in many of these tribes].
grammar.notes: a cluster of 作主语，谓语用单数。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + 并列谓语
grammar.skeleton: The tribal chief was generally an elected male + [who [retained the right to veto actions they opposed], and [had to approve declarations of war]].
grammar.notes: 原文 they 应为 he（指 chief），代词不一致。

grammar.title: by doing + where 从句
grammar.skeleton: The Algonquian tribes used the opposite system to the Iroquois, + by adopting a patrilineal society, + [where the descent and property were traced through the male line].
grammar.notes: the opposite... to 表“与……相反的”。

vocab.root: matri- (母亲，来自拉丁语 mater) + lineal (直系的) → 母系的
de- (向下) + scent (爬) → 向下传 → 血统/下降
re- (回) + tain (持) → 保持/保留
来自拉丁语 veto “我禁止” → 否决
patri- (父亲，来自拉丁语 pater) + lineal → 父系的

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：对比两种相反的社会制度
模板：[Group A] was a [system A] society, where [rule A]. [Group B] used the opposite system to [Group A], by adopting a [system B] society, where [rule B].
例句：The northern region was a centralized economy, where the state controlled production. The southern region used the opposite system to the north, by adopting a market economy, where private firms made decisions.

👪 托福人类学：亲属制度
Matrilineal (母系)：血统、财产通过母亲传承，如易洛魁人。
Patrilineal (父系)：通过父亲传承，如阿尔贡金人。
相关词：matriarchy 母权制 / patriarchy 父权制；matrilocal 从妻居 / patrilocal 从夫居。

title: UNIT 180 · 东南部印第安人的住所
body: Most of the Southeast Indian tribes located their villages in river valleys, where they planted crops in nearby, flat lying ground. Homes and public buildings were generally rectangular, but circular ones were less frequently used. The construction of these dwellings started with a framework of wattle poles, upon which branches and vines were tied. These were then daubed with a mixture of mud or clay. Sometimes, these structures were thatched with straw, reeds, rushes, grasses, and other available plant material. Mats, woven from bark, bamboo stalks, or palm fronds, were also used as covering, as were animal hides. The Seminole people lived in swampy areas and built distinctive, open-sided houses which they called chickees. These houses consisted of wooden platforms and thatched roofs, and were built on stilts.
translation: 东南部的大多数印第安部落把村庄建在河谷中，在附近平坦的土地上种植庄稼。住宅和公共建筑一般为长方形，圆形建筑则较少使用。这些住所的建造首先从搭建柳条杆框架开始，然后在框架上绑上树枝和藤蔓，再涂抹一层泥浆或黏土的混合物。有时，这些建筑会用稻草、芦苇、灯心草、禾草和其他可用的植物材料覆盖屋顶。用树皮、竹秆或棕榈叶编织的草席也被用作覆盖物，兽皮同样如此。塞米诺尔人生活在沼泽地区，建造了一种独特的、四面敞开的房屋，他们称之为“奇基屋”。这种房屋由木制平台和茅草屋顶构成，建在高脚桩上。
insights: 【熟词僻义】原文：located their villages in river valleys。翻译精雕：把村庄建在河谷中。技巧：locate 及物动词意为“把……设在某处”。
【upon which 的拆分】原文：a framework of wattle poles, upon which branches and vines were tied。翻译精雕：搭建柳条杆框架，然后在框架上绑上树枝和藤蔓。技巧：按工序顺序拆分，用“然后”衔接。
【as were 倒装】原文：Mats... were also used as covering, as were animal hides。翻译精雕：草席也被用作覆盖物，兽皮同样如此。技巧：as + 助动词 + 主语 表“……也一样”。

grammar.title: where 从句修饰地点
grammar.skeleton: Most of the Southeast Indian tribes located their villages in river valleys, + [where they planted crops in nearby, flat lying ground].
grammar.notes: where 指代 river valleys。

grammar.title: upon which 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: The construction of these dwellings started with a framework of wattle poles, + [upon which branches and vines were tied].
grammar.notes: 介词 + which 引导定语从句。

grammar.title: 过去分词插入 + as were 倒装
grammar.skeleton: Mats, [woven from bark, bamboo stalks, or palm fronds], were also used as covering, + as were animal hides.
grammar.notes: as were animal hides = animal hides were also used。

grammar.title: which 从句 + call A B
grammar.skeleton: The Seminole people lived in swampy areas and built distinctive, open-sided houses + [which they called chickees].
grammar.notes: call A B，which 作 A。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：locate v. 把……设在 (be located in 位于)

vocab.meaning: 柳栅：用嫩枝、芦苇或枝条编成的构架，用以筑墙、篱笆和屋顶
涂料：柔软粘稠的涂抹原料，如泥灰、润滑脂或泥浆

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：hide n. 兽皮 (≠ 躲藏)

vocab.meaning: （西米诺尔印第安人的）棕榈叶顶棚屋

句型：描述建造的工序
模板：The construction of [X] started with [step 1], upon which [step 2]. These were then [step 3]. Sometimes, these structures were [optional step].
例句：The construction of a new curriculum started with clear learning goals, upon which lessons and activities were designed. These were then tested with pilot classes. Sometimes, these lessons were revised with student feedback.

title: UNIT 181 · 东南部印第安人的服饰与纹身
body: The Southeast Indian men, normally, only wore a deerskin breechcloth during the warm weather in the region. Women wore wraparound, plant-fiber skirts and shell necklaces. In the cold weather, the men wore deerskin shirts, leggings and moccasins, while the women used deerskin capes and also wore moccasins. For ceremonial purposes, the tribal leaders and priests wore capes of feathers. The men of some Southeast tribes plucked out their hair with shell tweezers, and tattooed themselves with designs representing exploits in war. Others tattooed themselves with symbolic totems, representing an emblem of a family or clan. Some of the Southeast women were also adorned with elaborate tattoos.
translation: 在该地区温暖的天气里，东南部的印第安男子通常只穿一条鹿皮缠腰布。女子则穿用植物纤维制成的裹裙，戴贝壳项链。天冷时，男子穿鹿皮衬衫、绑腿和鹿皮软鞋，而女子则披鹿皮斗篷，同样穿鹿皮软鞋。在仪式场合，部落首领和祭司会披上羽毛斗篷。一些东南部部落的男子会用贝壳镊子拔掉头发，并在身上纹上象征其战功的图案。另一些人则纹上象征性的图腾，代表家族或氏族的标志。一些东南部女子也装饰着精美的纹身。
insights: 【while 对比】原文：the men wore deerskin shirts..., while the women used deerskin capes。翻译精雕：男子穿……，而女子则披……。技巧：while 表对比，译“而……则……”。
【现在分词定语】原文：tattooed themselves with designs representing exploits in war。翻译精雕：在身上纹上象征其战功的图案。技巧：representing 前置为“象征……的”。
【熟词僻义】原文：exploits in war。翻译精雕：战功。技巧：exploit 作名词意为“功绩、英勇事迹”，不是“剥削”。

grammar.title: 时间状语 + while 对比
grammar.skeleton: In the cold weather, + the men wore deerskin shirts, leggings and moccasins, + while the women used deerskin capes and also wore moccasins.
grammar.notes: while 连接两个对比分句。

grammar.title: 并列谓语 + 现在分词定语
grammar.skeleton: The men of some Southeast tribes [plucked out their hair with shell tweezers], and [tattooed themselves with designs [representing exploits in war]].
grammar.notes: 两个谓语共享主语。

grammar.title: 被动 + with
grammar.skeleton: Some of the Southeast women were also adorned with elaborate tattoos.
grammar.notes: be adorned with 表“饰有……”。

vocab.root: 另义：cape 海角 (Cape of Good Hope)
熟词僻义：exploit n. 功绩、英勇事迹；v. 开发、剥削
ad- + orn (装饰，来自拉丁语 ornare) → 装饰

✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：按场合描述不同的做法
模板：During [situation A], [group 1] normally only [practice A]. In [situation B], [group 1] [practice B], while [group 2] [practice C]. For [special purpose], [leaders] [special practice].
例句：During the workweek, employees normally only wear business casual. At client meetings, men wear suits, while women wear formal dresses. For award ceremonies, executives wear evening attire.

title: UNIT 182 · 青玉米节
body: The Cherokee, Creek, and other Southeast tribes of American Indians, performed an annual style of thanksgiving and renewal festival, known as the Green Corn Ceremony. It was held in mid or late summer, when the corn was ready for roasting. The ceremony lasted from four to eight days and included ritual fasting, dancing and feasting. Old fires were extinguished, and a new sacred fire was lit to provide every household with embers to start a new fire. Tools, weapons and clothing, were replaced with newly made items. Wrongdoers were forgiven for most crimes, other than murder. Different tribes had different recipes for making a ritual tea from varying species of holly and tobacco. English traders called this the Dark Drink, because of its dark color. The local Indians believed they would be spiritually purified by imbibing this beverage during the time of the ceremony.
translation: 切罗基族、克里克族以及美国东南部的其他印第安部落，每年都会举行一种感恩与更新的节日，称为“青玉米节”。节日在仲夏或夏末举行，那时玉米已经可以烤食。仪式持续四到八天，包括仪式性的禁食、舞蹈和宴饮。旧火被熄灭，新的圣火被点燃，为每户人家提供余烬来生起新火。工具、武器和衣物都被换成新制作的物品。除谋杀之外，作恶者的大多数罪行都会得到宽恕。不同部落有不同的配方，用不同种类的冬青和烟草制作一种仪式用茶。英国商人因其颜色深暗而称之为“黑饮”。当地印第安人相信，在仪式期间饮用这种饮料可以使他们在精神上得到净化。
insights: 【an annual style of】原文：performed an annual style of thanksgiving and renewal festival, known as the Green Corn Ceremony。翻译精雕：每年都会举行一种感恩与更新的节日，称为“青玉米节”。技巧：annual 转为副词“每年都”。
【when 从句修饰时间】原文：It was held in mid or late summer, when the corn was ready for roasting。翻译精雕：节日在仲夏或夏末举行，那时玉米已经可以烤食。技巧：非限制性 when 从句译“那时……”。
【other than 的译法】原文：Wrongdoers were forgiven for most crimes, other than murder。翻译精雕：除谋杀之外，作恶者的大多数罪行都会得到宽恕。技巧：other than = except，前置译“除……之外”。

grammar.title: known as + when 从句
grammar.skeleton: The Cherokee, Creek, and other Southeast tribes ... performed an annual style of thanksgiving and renewal festival, [known as the Green Corn Ceremony]. It was held in mid or late summer, + [when the corn was ready for roasting].
grammar.notes: when 引导非限制性定语从句修饰时间。

grammar.title: 被动并列 + 目的不定式
grammar.skeleton: Old fires were extinguished, + and a new sacred fire was lit + to provide every household with embers to start a new fire.
grammar.notes: provide sb. with sth.。

grammar.title: believe + 宾语从句 + by doing
grammar.skeleton: The local Indians believed + [(that) they would be spiritually purified by imbibing this beverage during the time of the ceremony].
grammar.notes: by doing 表方式。

美国克里克族印第安人

im- (进入) + bibe (喝，来自拉丁语 bibere) → 饮；吸收 (思想)

句型：描述节日的内容与象征
模板：The [festival] lasted from [duration] and included [activities]. Old [things] were [replaced], and new [things] were [introduced] to [symbolic purpose].
例句：The New Year festival lasted from three to fifteen days and included family reunions, feasting and fireworks. Old decorations were taken down, and new couplets were hung to welcome good fortune.

title: UNIT 183 · 书籍的构成
body: A book, also referred to as a volume, is made up of many sheets of paper, bound together as pages. Each page can contain printed or written text, illustrations, photographs, or other kinds of information, such as a musical score. The pages are sewn, or glued together on one side and bound between hard or soft paper covers.
translation: 书，又称卷册，由许多张纸装订成页而构成。每一页都可以包含印刷或手写的文字、插图、照片或其他类型的信息，例如乐谱。书页在一侧缝合或粘合在一起，并装订在精装或平装的封面之间。
insights: 【also referred to as】原文：A book, also referred to as a volume, is made up of...。翻译精雕：书，又称卷册，由……构成。技巧：also referred to as 译“又称”。
【bound together as】原文：many sheets of paper, bound together as pages。翻译精雕：许多张纸装订成页。技巧：bind... as 译“装订成……”。
【hard or soft covers】原文：bound between hard or soft paper covers。翻译精雕：装订在精装或平装的封面之间。技巧：hardcover / paperback 中文对应“精装 / 平装”。

grammar.title: 插入同位 + be made up of + 过去分词
grammar.skeleton: A book, [also referred to as a volume], + is made up of many sheets of paper, + [bound together as pages].
grammar.notes: bound 为 bind 的过去分词。

grammar.title: 并列被动谓语
grammar.skeleton: The pages are [sewn, or glued together on one side] and [bound between hard or soft paper covers].
grammar.notes: sewn 是 sew 的过去分词。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：volume 卷、册；亦作“体积、音量”
