✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：为常见事物下定义并说明组成
模板：A [thing], also referred to as [synonym], is made up of many [components], [joined] together as [units].
例句：A website, also referred to as a site, is made up of many web pages, linked together as a navigable whole.

title: UNIT 184 · 抄本：现代书籍的祖先
body: The codex is a Latin word for what is the direct ancestor of the modern book. The 4th century codex was a small ringed notebook, consisting of two or more rectangular, wooden tablets, covered with wax. The codex was the culmination of a gradual process that evolved from around the 1st century, when records were kept on the inconvenient scroll. The codex, as first used by the Greeks and Romans for business accounts and school work, could be marked with a stylus, smoothed over, and reused many times. The usefulness of the codex was improved when leaves of parchment were inserted between the tablets.
translation: codex（抄本）是一个拉丁语词，指的是现代书籍的直接祖先。4 世纪的抄本是一种带环的小笔记本，由两块或更多块涂有蜡层的长方形木板组成。抄本是一个渐进过程的顶点，这一过程始于约公元 1 世纪，当时人们还把记录写在不方便的卷轴上。抄本最初被希腊人和罗马人用于记商业账目和完成学校作业，可以用尖笔刻写、抹平，然后反复使用多次。当在木板之间插入羊皮纸书页后，抄本的实用性得到了提高。
insights: 【what 从句的处理】原文：The codex is a Latin word for what is the direct ancestor of the modern book。翻译精雕：codex（抄本）是一个拉丁语词，指的是现代书籍的直接祖先。技巧：for what is... 译为“指的是……”。
【culmination 的译法】原文：The codex was the culmination of a gradual process。翻译精雕：抄本是一个渐进过程的顶点。技巧：culmination 译“顶点、最终成果”。
【as first used by】原文：The codex, as first used by the Greeks and Romans for business accounts and school work, could be...。翻译精雕：抄本最初被……用于……，可以……。技巧：插入的 as 短语提前单独说明。

grammar.title: for + what 名词性从句
grammar.skeleton: The codex is a Latin word for + [what is the direct ancestor of the modern book].
grammar.notes: what 引导介词宾语从句。

grammar.title: 定语从句 + when 从句
grammar.skeleton: The codex was the culmination of a gradual process + [that evolved from around the 1st century], + [when records were kept on the inconvenient scroll].
grammar.notes: when 修饰 the 1st century。

grammar.title: as 插入 + 三个被动谓语
grammar.skeleton: The codex, [as first used by the Greeks and Romans for business accounts and school work], + could be [marked with a stylus], [smoothed over], and [reused many times].
grammar.notes: 三个过去分词共享 could be。

vocab.root: culmin- (顶点，来自拉丁语 culmen) + -ation → 顶点
熟词僻义：account n. 账目 (business accounts)；描述
熟词僻义：leaf n. (书的) 一页，一张 (两面)

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明某发明是渐进过程的顶点
模板：[Invention] was the culmination of a gradual process that evolved from [time], when [old method].
例句：The smartphone was the culmination of a gradual process that evolved from the 1970s, when calls were made only on bulky landlines.

title: UNIT 185 · 抄本的装订
body: In time, the codex came to consist of many sheets of papyrus, or later parchment. These sheets were gathered in small bundles and folded in the middle, before being laid one upon the other, and stitched together through the folds. The combined bundles were then attached to wooden boards by thongs.
translation: 后来，抄本逐渐由许多张莎草纸，后来又由羊皮纸构成。这些纸张被收集成小叠，从中间对折，然后一叠叠地摞起来，再穿过折缝缝合在一起。合并后的书叠再用皮带固定在木板上。
insights: 【come to do】原文：In time, the codex came to consist of many sheets of papyrus。翻译精雕：后来，抄本逐渐由许多张莎草纸……构成。技巧：come to do 表示“逐渐变得……”。
【工序动词链】原文：gathered... folded... laid one upon the other... stitched together through the folds。翻译精雕：收集成小叠，从中间对折，然后一叠叠地摞起来，再穿过折缝缝合在一起。技巧：按工序连用动词，用“然后、再”衔接。

grammar.title: come to + do
grammar.skeleton: In time, + the codex came to consist of many sheets of papyrus, or later parchment.
grammar.notes: come to do 表示状态的逐渐形成。

grammar.title: 被动并列 + before being done
grammar.skeleton: These sheets were [gathered in small bundles] and [folded in the middle], + before [being laid one upon the other], and [stitched together through the folds].
grammar.notes: before + 动名词被动式。

vocab.root: 来自希腊语 papyros → paper (纸) 的词源

vocab.meaning: 书帖 (装订用的一组折页)

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述逐步形成的结构
模板：In time, [X] came to consist of [component A], or later [component B]. These [components] were [step 1] before being [step 2].
例句：In time, the archive came to consist of handwritten letters, or later digital files. These records were sorted by year before being scanned and indexed.

📜 托福词源：papyrus → paper

英语 paper (纸) 来自 papyrus (莎草纸)；bible (圣经) 来自希腊城市 Byblos (莎草纸贸易中心)；library 来自拉丁语 liber (树皮内层，古代书写材料)。

title: UNIT 186 · 早期书写工具：楔形文字与刻刀
body: Cuneiform writing was created by pressing an angular stick of three or four sides, into soft clay, which was then baked to form a hardened tablet. This was the earliest form of Western writing, and the wedge-shaped marks survived, to provide a permanent record of the past. The Greeks developed the next major writing tools, which were the mallet and chisel, used for engraving stone, and the brush, for writing on parchment and pottery. Examples of this writing were found on ancient Greek pottery where a small round brush was used. Other archeological finds show Greek letters incised in stone by using a metal chisel and a mallet. Romans, using broad-edged tools, introduced variations in the width of alphabetic marks.
translation: 楔形文字是用一根三棱或四棱的带棱角的木棒压入软黏土中而形成的，黏土随后被烘烤成坚硬的泥板。这是西方文字最早的形式，这些楔形的刻痕得以保存下来，为过去提供了永久的记录。希腊人发展出了下一批主要的书写工具，即用于雕刻石头的木槌和凿子，以及用于在羊皮纸和陶器上书写的毛笔。这种书写的实例在古希腊陶器上被发现，人们使用的是一支小圆刷。其他考古发现显示，希腊字母是用金属凿子和木槌刻在石头上的。罗马人使用宽头工具，使字母笔画的宽度产生了变化。
insights: 【被动定义 + 定语从句】原文：Cuneiform writing was created by pressing an angular stick... into soft clay, which was then baked to form a hardened tablet。翻译精雕：楔形文字是用……木棒压入软黏土中而形成的，黏土随后被烘烤成坚硬的泥板。技巧：which 从句拆为后续分句，用“随后”衔接。
【同位语 which were】原文：the next major writing tools, which were the mallet and chisel, used for..., and the brush, for...。翻译精雕：下一批主要的书写工具，即用于……的木槌和凿子，以及用于……的毛笔。技巧：which were 译“即”，后接对称的用途说明。
【原文勘误】楔形文字 (cuneiform) 起源于两河流域的苏美尔，严格说是“近东”最早的文字，原文称“西方文字最早的形式”是笼统说法。

grammar.title: 被动 + by doing + which 从句
grammar.skeleton: Cuneiform writing was created + by pressing an angular stick of three or four sides, into soft clay, + [which was then baked to form a hardened tablet].
grammar.notes: which 指代 clay。

grammar.title: 同位语 + 过去分词 / 介词短语
grammar.skeleton: The Greeks developed the next major writing tools, + [which were [the mallet and chisel, used for engraving stone], and [the brush, for writing on parchment and pottery]].
grammar.notes: used for 与 for 对称表用途。

grammar.title: 现在分词状语
grammar.skeleton: Romans, [using broad-edged tools], + introduced variations in the width of alphabetic marks.
grammar.notes: using 表方式。

vocab.root: cunei- (楔子，来自拉丁语 cuneus) + form → 楔形的/楔形文字
per- (贯穿) + man- (停留) + -ent → 一直停留的 → 永久的
in- (进入) + cise (切) → 切入 → 刻
en- (使) + grave (刻) → 雕刻
archeo- (古代) + -logical → 考古学的

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述技术的代际演进
模板：This was the earliest form of [X]. [Group B] developed the next major [tools], which were [tool 1], used for [purpose 1], and [tool 2], for [purpose 2].
例句：The telegraph was the earliest form of electronic communication. Engineers developed the next major devices, which were the telephone, used for voice calls, and the radio, for mass broadcasting.

title: UNIT 187 · 古罗马的书写工具
body: By the beginning of the 1st century AD, Roman writing implements varied according to the purpose of the writing, and the surface used. Ephemeral writing and school exercises were often done on small, wax-coated wooden tablets, using a pointed stylus made of metal or bone. Letters were scratched on the waxed surface with the pointed end of the stylus and erasures were made with the opposite, blunt end of the same tool. Permanent writing was done on papyrus with a reed cut to a point and dipped in ink. Flat brushes and reeds, were cut with a broad edge and used on smooth surfaces. Such surfaces included vellum and parchment, which was made from specially prepared animal skins, as well as stone and plastered walls. Inscriptional writing was done with a mallet and chisel, but the style of these inscribed letters varied from thick to thin strokes.
translation: 到公元 1 世纪初，罗马人的书写工具因书写目的和书写表面的不同而各异。临时性的书写和学校练习，通常在涂有蜡的小木板上进行，使用金属或骨头制成的尖头笔。人们用尖笔的尖端在蜡面上刻写字母，用同一工具另一端的钝头进行擦除。需要长期保存的书写则在莎草纸上进行，使用削尖并蘸墨水的芦苇笔。扁平的毛笔和芦苇笔被削出宽边，用于光滑的表面。这些表面包括用经过特殊处理的动物皮制成的犊皮纸和羊皮纸，以及石头和抹了灰泥的墙壁。碑文书写使用木槌和凿子，但这些刻字的风格有粗细笔画的变化。
insights: 【vary according to】原文：Roman writing implements varied according to the purpose of the writing, and the surface used。翻译精雕：罗马人的书写工具因书写目的和书写表面的不同而各异。技巧：vary according to 译“因……的不同而各异”。
【ephemeral vs permanent】原文：Ephemeral writing... Permanent writing...。翻译精雕：临时性的书写……需要长期保存的书写……。技巧：保持对比结构，体现工具与用途的对应关系。

【被动转主动】原文：Letters were scratched on the waxed surface with the pointed end of the stylus and erasures were made with the opposite, blunt end。翻译精雕：人们用尖笔的尖端在蜡面上刻写字母，用……另一端的钝头进行擦除。技巧：补主语“人们”，两个被动合并为一个主动句。

grammar.title: vary according to + 过去分词
grammar.skeleton: By the beginning of the 1st century AD, + Roman writing implements varied according to the purpose of the writing, and the surface [used].
grammar.notes: used 后置修饰 surface。

grammar.title: 被动 + using 分词 + made of
grammar.skeleton: Ephemeral writing and school exercises were often done on small, wax-coated wooden tablets, + using a pointed stylus [made of metal or bone].
grammar.notes: using 的逻辑主语是泛指的书写者。

grammar.title: 被动 + with + 过去分词
grammar.skeleton: Permanent writing was done on papyrus + with a reed [cut to a point and dipped in ink].
grammar.notes: cut 与 dipped 并列修饰 reed。

grammar.title: which 从句 + as well as
grammar.skeleton: Such surfaces included vellum and parchment, + [which was made from specially prepared animal skins], + as well as stone and plastered walls.
grammar.notes: which 指代 vellum and parchment，规范应为 were。

vocab.root: implement: 来自拉丁语 implere “填满/供给” → 工具；v. 实施
ep- (在……之上) + hemer- (天，来自希腊语 hemera) + -al → 只持续一天的 → 短暂的

vocab.meaning: 能够长时间保留的书写

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：stroke 笔画；亦作“中风、划桨、一击”
in- (在上) + scribe (写) → 刻写；inscription 碑文

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明工具随用途而变化
模板：By [time], [tools] varied according to the purpose of [activity], and [condition]. [Temporary use] was often done on [medium A], using [tool A]. [Permanent use] was done on [medium B] with [tool B].
例句：By the 2000s, storage tools varied according to the purpose of the data, and the budget available. Temporary files were often saved on USB drives, using simple copy commands. Permanent archives were kept on servers with automated backups.

⏳ 托福高频：ephemeral 及其同义词

ephemeral ≈ transient ≈ fleeting ≈ short-lived ≈ temporary ≈ momentary。反义：permanent / lasting / enduring / perpetual。阅读同义替换题常考这一组。

title: UNIT 188 · 书写工具的更替
body: As the size of writing became smaller, both writing tools and surfaces changed. Vellum and parchment books replaced the papyrus roll, and the quill replaced the reed pen.
translation: 随着书写字体越来越小，书写工具和书写表面也都发生了变化。犊皮纸和羊皮纸书籍取代了莎草纸卷，羽毛笔取代了芦苇笔。
insights: 【As 的伴随变化】原文：As the size of writing became smaller, both writing tools and surfaces changed。翻译精雕：随着书写字体越来越小，书写工具和书写表面也都发生了变化。技巧：as 表“随着”，became smaller 译“越来越小”。
【replace 的方向】原文：Vellum and parchment books replaced the papyrus roll。翻译精雕：犊皮纸和羊皮纸书籍取代了莎草纸卷。技巧：A replaced B = A 取代了 B（A 是新的），注意不要译反。

grammar.title: As 伴随从句 + both... and
grammar.skeleton: As the size of writing became smaller, + both writing tools and surfaces changed.
grammar.notes: both A and B 作主语，谓语用复数。

grammar.title: 并列句：A replaced B
grammar.skeleton: Vellum and parchment books replaced the papyrus roll, + and the quill replaced the reed pen.
grammar.notes: replace A (旧) with B (新)；B replaced A。

vocab.root: re- (再) + place (放置) → 替换

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：描述技术的连锁更替
模板：As [trend], both [A] and [B] changed. [New A] replaced [old A], and [new B] replaced [old B].
例句：As online shopping grew, both retail spaces and payment methods changed. Warehouses replaced shopping malls, and mobile wallets replaced cash.

📝 写作提示：replace 的方向
A replaces B = A 取代 B (A 新，B 旧)
replace B with A = 用 A 替换 B
B is replaced by A = B 被 A 取代
这是中国学生写作中最常见的方向错误之一。

title: UNIT 189 · 圆珠笔的发展
body: The success of the ball pen was based on the development of a viscous, oil-based ink. Early ballpoint pens did not write well as they tended to skip, and the slow-drying oil-based ink, smudged easily.
translation: 圆珠笔的成功建立在一种黏稠的油性墨水的研发之上。早期的圆珠笔书写效果并不好，因为它们容易断墨，而且干得很慢的油性墨水很容易弄脏纸面。
insights: 【be based on 的译法】原文：The success of the ball pen was based on the development of a viscous, oil-based ink。翻译精雕：圆珠笔的成功建立在……墨水的研发之上。技巧：be based on 译“建立在……之上”。
【熟词僻义】原文：they tended to skip。翻译精雕：容易断墨。技巧：skip 在书写语境中指“跳笔、断墨”，不是“跳过”。

grammar.title: 被动 + based on
grammar.skeleton: The success of the ball pen + was based on + the development of a viscous, oil-based ink.
grammar.notes: oil-based 复合形容词。

grammar.title: as 原因 + tend to
grammar.skeleton: Early ballpoint pens did not write well + as [they tended to skip], and [the slow-drying oil-based ink, smudged easily].
grammar.notes: as 引导原因，后接两个分句。

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明成功的关键与早期缺陷
模板：The success of [product] was based on the development of [key technology]. Early [products] did not [work] well as they tended to [problem].
例句：The success of electric cars was based on the development of high-capacity lithium batteries. Early models did not sell well as they tended to run out of charge quickly.

title: UNIT 190 · 纤维头笔
body: Unlike its predecessors, the fiber-tip pen uses dye as a writing fluid. As a result, the fiber-tip pen can produce a wide range of colours that are unavailable in ballpoint and fountain pen inks.
translation: 与之前的笔不同，纤维头笔使用染料作为书写液。因此，纤维头笔能写出各种各样的颜色，而这些颜色是圆珠笔和钢笔墨水所无法呈现的。
insights: 【Unlike its predecessors】原文：Unlike its predecessors, the fiber-tip pen uses dye as a writing fluid。翻译精雕：与之前的笔不同，纤维头笔使用染料作为书写液。技巧：predecessor 译“前身/先前的事物”。
【定语从句的后置】原文：a wide range of colours that are unavailable in ballpoint and fountain pen inks。翻译精雕：各种各样的颜色，而这些颜色是……所无法呈现的。技巧：定语从句较长时后置，用“而这些……”承接。

grammar.title: Unlike 对比 + use A as B
grammar.skeleton: Unlike its predecessors, + the fiber-tip pen uses dye as a writing fluid.
grammar.notes: use A as B 表“把 A 用作 B”。

grammar.title: As a result + 定语从句
grammar.skeleton: As a result, + the fiber-tip pen can produce a wide range of colours + [that are unavailable in ballpoint and fountain pen inks].
grammar.notes: as a result 表结果。

vocab.root: pre- (之前) + de- (离开) + cess (走) + -or → 之前离开的人 → 前任

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：说明新事物的独特优势
模板：Unlike its predecessors, [new product] uses [new feature]. As a result, it can [benefit] that are unavailable in [older products].
例句：Unlike its predecessors, the new phone uses an AI chip. As a result, it can perform tasks that are unavailable in older models.

title: UNIT 191 · 铅笔
body: One of the most popular tools for ephemeral writing is the pencil. Pencil marks, unlike those made by writing implements using fluids, can be easily erased. Although commonly called lead pencils, they do not contain that metal, as the marking element is made from a mixture of clay, and the special form of carbon called graphite.
translation: 用于临时书写的最受欢迎的工具之一是铅笔。与使用液体的书写工具所留下的笔迹不同，铅笔的笔迹很容易擦掉。虽然铅笔通常被称为“铅”笔，但它们并不含有铅这种金属，因为其笔芯是由黏土和一种名为石墨的特殊形态的碳混合制成的。
insights: 【those made by 的还原】原文：Pencil marks, unlike those made by writing implements using fluids, can be easily erased。翻译精雕：与使用液体的书写工具所留下的笔迹不同，铅笔的笔迹很容易擦掉。技巧：those 指代 marks，翻译时还原并把 unlike 对比前置。
【Although 让步 + as 原因】原文：Although commonly called lead pencils, they do not contain that metal, as the marking element is made from...。翻译精雕：虽然铅笔通常被称为“铅”笔，但它们并不含有铅这种金属，因为……。技巧：让步与原因层层展开。

grammar.title: one of the most + 复数名词
grammar.skeleton: One of the most popular tools for ephemeral writing + is the pencil.
grammar.notes: 主语中心词 one，谓语用单数。

grammar.title: unlike + those + 过去分词
grammar.skeleton: Pencil marks, [unlike those [made by writing implements [using fluids]]], + can be easily erased.
grammar.notes: those = marks。

grammar.title: Although + 过去分词省略 + as 原因
grammar.skeleton: Although (they are) commonly called lead pencils, + they do not contain that metal, + as the marking element is made from a mixture of clay, and the special form of carbon called graphite.
grammar.notes: 省略式让步状语从句。

vocab.root: 熟词僻义：lead [led] n. 铅；铅笔芯

specialHTML:
✍️ 黄金句式仿写模板

句型：澄清名称与实质的矛盾
模板：Although commonly called [misleading name], [X] do not contain [implied thing], as [real composition].
例句：Although commonly called tin cans, most food cans do not contain much tin, as they are made mainly of steel with a thin tin coating.

✏️ 冷知识：为什么叫“铅”笔？

16 世纪英国人在 Borrowdale 发现石墨矿时，误以为它是一种铅 (plumbago，“像铅的东西”)，“lead pencil”这个名称就此沿用下来。实际上铅笔芯从来不含铅。

title: UNIT 192 · 自动铅笔
body: The first mechanical pencil was patented in 1877, and has undergone many changes since then. Modern versions allow several thin, cylindrical pieces of pencil “lead” , to be held in a metal or plastic barrel. One piece at a time is exposed at the pencil tip, and by means of a movable rod and a screwing motion, the required amount of “lead” can be adjusted.
translation: 第一支自动铅笔于 1877 年获得专利，此后经历了许多变化。现代的自动铅笔可以在金属或塑料笔管中容纳几根细圆柱形的铅笔“芯”。每次只有一根笔芯露出笔尖，借助可移动的推杆和旋转动作，可以调节所需的笔芯长度。
insights: 【现在完成时 + since then】原文：The first mechanical pencil was patented in 1877, and has undergone many changes since then。翻译精雕：第一支自动铅笔于 1877 年获得专利，此后经历了许多变化。技巧：过去时与现在完成时并用，中文用“于……此后……”。
【allow sth. to be done】原文：Modern versions allow several thin, cylindrical pieces of pencil “lead”, to be held in...。翻译精雕：现代的自动铅笔可以在……中容纳几根……笔“芯”。技巧：allow sth. to be done 转为主动“可以容纳”。
【by means of 的方式】原文：by means of a movable rod and a screwing motion, the required amount of “lead” can be adjusted。翻译精雕：借助可移动的推杆和旋转动作，可以调节所需的笔芯长度。技巧：by means of 译“借助”。

grammar.title: 被动过去时 + 现在完成时
grammar.skeleton: The first mechanical pencil [was patented in 1877], and [has undergone many changes since then].
grammar.notes: since then 与现在完成时连用。

grammar.title: allow + 宾语 + to be done
grammar.skeleton: Modern versions allow + several thin, cylindrical pieces of pencil “lead” + to be held in a metal or plastic barrel.
grammar.notes: 原文 lead 后的逗号多余。

grammar.title: by means of + 被动
grammar.skeleton: One piece at a time is exposed at the pencil tip, + and by means of a movable rod and a screwing motion, + the required amount of “lead” can be adjusted.
grammar.notes: at a time 表“每次”。
